  • Strong background in selling high-end technology (AI, HPC, Quantum).
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

The world the mission operates in is going post-quantum, contested, and machine-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it.

At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join #TeamQuantumSky?

jobs.excerpt: Overview Empower AI is AI for government.  Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation.
jobs.description:
Overview

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a Problem/Incident Management Analyst to analyze and optimize the workflows, processes, and service management practices behind IT service delivery for a Department of War agency, as an integral member of the User Experience, Service Management Optimization, and Dashboards team. The analyst maps and measures the workflows that support the Service Portal and ticket lifecycle, identifies bottlenecks and effort drivers, recommends and documents process improvements and automation candidates, supports the Service Management System's alignment to ITIL 4 and ISO/IEC 20000-1, and produces the analysis behind the CX Roadmap and Annual KPI/PRS Review. The role works with the Service Management Operations Lead, UX Designer, Dashboard Developer, and Automation Engineer. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE WORK POSITION AND UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Analyze and map the end-to-end workflows behind the IT Service Portal and ticket lifecycle (intake, categorization, routing, fulfillment, Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure), measure cycle times and effort, and identify bottlenecks, handoff failures, and automation candidates.
  • Recommend and document process improvements, RACI updates, and workflow changes to the Service Management System aligned with ITIL 4 and ISO/IEC 20000-1, and translate approved improvements into backlog items for the ITSM platform and automation teams.
  • Implement and enforce the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure Process across Tiers 0-IV: Resolved - Awaiting Customer Confirmation status, automatic user notification, Confirm and Close / Reopen options, auto-close after 3 business days with final notice
  • Run Proactive Problem Management: AAR and RCA for the top 5 recurring problem areas and Government-designated PL1/PL2 incidents
  • Create, execute and maintain a Problem Resolution Action Plan (with RCA)
  • Documented Proactive Problem Management process
  • Reduce recurring incidents, At least 15% year-over-year reduction in user-initiated incidents for the top 5 recurring problem areas
  • Produce data-driven analysis for the CX Roadmap, CX Current State & Gap Analysis Report, and Annual KPI/PRS Review and Recommendation Report, including benchmarking against Government and industry IT customer support metrics.
  • Maintain the process documentation repository (process flow diagrams and high-level procedures for Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management) and support the annual review of KPI/SLA/XLA thresholds.
  • Produce the Monthly Contract Performance Report aligned with the invoice, detailing financial performance and spending against non-FFP CLINs (Surge Labor-Hour and IT Materials), overall deliverable status, and contractual compliance matters, without duplicating operational content from the Monthly Customer Support Activity Report.
  • Maintain the master deliverables schedule and CDRL tracker, coordinate inputs from task leads, manage Government review cycles and comment resolution, and ensure all plans and reports are delivered in Government-approved formats on time.
  • Track and report Surge CLIN activity, including Surge Plan status, Labor Hour Task Trackers (project, work performed, hours and costs, cumulative costs, remaining NTE balance), and mobilization timelines, and ensure no surge work or cost is incurred without written authorization.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 7 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 3 years of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience as a management analyst, program analyst, or program control analyst supporting Federal IT services contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience producing contract performance reports, deliverables trackers, meeting minutes, and executive briefing materials on a fixed cadence.
  • Working knowledge of Federal contract types and mechanics (FFP, Labor-Hour, T&M, NTE ceilings, CLINs, CDRLs, FAR 52.204-14 Service Contract Reporting, invoicing).
  • Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar tools.
  • Experience coordinating across technical, finance, contracts, and Government stakeholders and managing action items to closure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and meticulous attention to detail.
  • The Contractor must provide staffed support during the following hours, excluding Federal holidays, Monday through Friday: 8:00 m. to 5:00 p.m. ET.

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Practice Manager; Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt; ISO/IEC 20000 Lead Implementer.
  • PMP, CAPM, or Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM); ITIL 4 Foundation.
  • Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community IT service contracts and GSA Alliant 2 or similar task orders.
  • Experience with surge/labor-hour CLIN tracking and IT materials procurement (RIP) processes.
  • Experience with SAM.gov Service Contract Reporting, WAWF/PIEE, and DISS/NCCS security administration processes.
  • Agile Scrum Master (CSM) or one (1) SAFe Agile Foundation Certification (SA, SP, SSM, POPM, SHWA, SHWP,ASE, SDP, LSSP)
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow reporting and ITSM performance metrics.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

This position requires the ability to perform the below essential functions:

  • Sitting for long periods
  • Standing for long periods
  • Ambulate throughout an office
  • Ambulate between several buildings
  • Stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl as required
  • Repeatedly lift and carry weight up to 25 pounds
  • Travel by land or air transportation 10 %

About Empower AI

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Empower AI is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

Actual salaries may vary based on various factors including but not limited to work location, skills, experience, gov con contractual requirements, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Empower AI's total compensation package for employees.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Meta Media Buyer (High-Ticket B2B Funnels) | $250K+ OTE | Remote Mission Own and scale GNO's Meta ads from $50K+/month to $150K+/month, generating qualified calls that show up and close, within target cost per booked call and cost per acquisition.
jobs.description:
Senior Meta Media Buyer (High-Ticket B2B Funnels) | $250K+ OTE | Remote

Mission
Own and scale GNO's Meta ads from $50K+/month to $150K+/month, generating qualified calls that show up and close, within target cost per booked call and cost per acquisition.

About GNO Partners
GNO helps Amazon brands scale and grow profits. Our founders built and exited two 7-figure Amazon brands. Since then, we've worked with 1,300+ brands, with 500+ active clients doing over $1B in combined sales, all run on a proprietary system we've built over 9 years. Meta is one of our main growth channels and we're ready to put real budget behind it.

About the Role
This is not a maintenance role. We want a senior buyer who has been in the trenches. You've personally run the accounts, made the calls and owned the numbers yourself, not "led a team that did it." You've built and scaled application (Direct App) and VSL call funnels for agencies, coaches or B2B service businesses. You'll own strategy and execution and work directly with the founders.

The major focus of this role is the ads themselves: ad strategy, ideation, copywriting, and creative. You'll come up with the angles, write the hooks and scripts, and drive what gets produced and tested. Media buying is a core part of the job too, but winning creative is what will move the numbers here.

Today we mainly run a Direct App funnel: ad → application → booked call.

Compensation

  • Base: $120K-$150K (negotiable, based on experience)
  • Commissions: $100K-$130K, tied to performance
  • OTE: $250K+ (uncapped)
  • Fully remote

What success looks like (first 3-6 months)

  • Hit the weekly qualified call targets agreed with the founders without tanking lead quality or show rate.
  • A steady pipeline of new ad concepts every week, built on angles, hooks and iterations of winners.
  • Scale spend from $50K+ toward $150K+/month while staying at CPBC & CAC KPI.
  • Tracking you trust: Pixel + CAPI + CRM, with 90%+ of booked calls tied back to the ad.
  • A structured testing engine with multiple meaningful tests per week across hooks, creatives, audiences and offers.

Responsibilities

  • Own ad strategy and creative: come up with angles, write ad copy, hooks and video scripts, brief production, and turn winners into new iterations.
  • Plan, build and manage Meta campaigns for:
    • Application and book-a-call funnels
  • Set up and maintain tracking (Pixel, CAPI, custom conversions, UTMs, offline events), and fix issues fast.
  • Own weekly reporting: KPIs, insights and a clear action plan.
  • Analyze the full funnel (impression → click → opt-in → booked → show → close) and fix what's broken, beyond "change targeting."
  • Work with the founders, creative and sales on new angles, offers and creatives.
  • Document structures, naming conventions and SOPs.

Requirements

  • 3+ years running Meta ads for agencies, coaches or B2B service businesses.
  • Strong direct-response copywriting and creative strategy, with a portfolio of ads you wrote or ideated that scaled.
  • Personally managed $100K+/month on Meta for 12+ consecutive months.
  • Hands-on with call, application, or VSL funnels.
  • You think in pipeline metrics (show rate, close rate, CAC), not front-end CPL.
  • Solid tech: Events Manager, CAPI, custom conversions, UTMs, GA4/attribution (Hyros or similar is a plus), CRM (Pipedrive).
  • Excellent written English and clear, structured thinking.

jobs.excerpt: About Frontier Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints.
jobs.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 380-person company that has most of our team in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints started helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we decided to spin out a new company to focus exclusively on that and call it Frontier.

Here at Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US-based startups and high-growth companies.

About the Client:

EverSpark is a technology-forward custom jewelry manufacturing platform powering independent jewelry designers, retailers, and enterprise brands. Our platform enables customers to design, render, price, revise, approve, and manufacture custom jewelry through a seamless digital workflow.

We combine manufacturing expertise with modern software, AI-assisted design tools, and a high-touch customer experience to streamline the end-to-end custom jewelry process.

Role Overview

We are hiring a remote Jewelry Account Manager / Customer Success Manager to manage customer relationships and guide clients throughout the custom jewelry design and manufacturing process.

This is a highly consultative, customer-facing role where you'll serve as the primary point of contact for customers. You'll help clients clarify design requirements, answer questions, coordinate with internal production teams, manage timelines, and ensure orders move smoothly from concept to delivery.

This role combines customer success, project coordination, pricing support, and production management, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both relationship management and operational execution.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, tech-savvy, an exceptional English communicator, and comfortable managing multiple high-value customer workflows in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Account Management

  • Manage inbound customer requests for custom jewelry pieces
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts
  • Communicate directly with customers via email, phone, and messaging platforms
  • Ensure a high-touch, responsive customer experience

Requirement Gathering & Order Clarification

  • Review customer submissions and identify missing or unclear information.
  • Ask thoughtful clarifying questions to fully understand customer requirements before production begins.
  • Translate customer requests into clear, actionable instructions for internal teams.
  • Guide customers through pricing, materials, manufacturing capabilities, and design trade-offs.
  • Ensure customer expectations are aligned with operational capabilities and production timelines.

Production & Internal Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with CAD designers, production, and operations teams throughout the manufacturing process.
  • Support CAD preparation and coordination by ensuring customer requirements are accurately translated into production-ready designs.
  • Assist with quote preparation and pricing coordination while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Track order progress from design through manufacturing and final delivery.
  • Ensure all required materials (e.g., stones, specifications, approvals) are received before production.
  • Escalate production or technical issues when needed.

Customer Follow-ups & Workflow Management

  • Follow up on pending approvals, missing customer inputs, or stalled orders.
  • Maintain accurate notes, customer communications, and order updates in internal systems.
  • Ensure customer projects continue progressing smoothly through every stage of production.
  • Support continuous improvement of internal workflows and customer processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organization, efficiency, and customer experience using technology or automation.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Job Title: Clinical AI Sales Specialist - MRI

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Sales Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for driving growth and adoption of icobrain across the U.S. market.

This role combines new business development with strategic account engagement and close collaboration across the broader GE HealthCare MR commercial organization. The successful candidate will develop new opportunities while leveraging GE HealthCare's established customer relationships, MR installed base, and commercial teams to expand the adoption of icobrain within health systems, academic medical centers, imaging organizations, and neurology-focused practices.

The role will also partner closely with the Customer Success team to support existing customers, including renewals and the transition of legacy icometrix agreements to GE HealthCare contracts.

This is a primarily remote sales role, with most customer engagement, prospecting, presentations, demonstrations, and opportunity development conducted virtually through phone and Microsoft Teams. In-person engagement will also be an important part of the role at strategic customer meetings, conferences, and other industry events.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong commercial mindset, an interest in MR and clinical AI, and the ability to work effectively within a highly collaborative, matrixed organization.

Job Description

  • Drive icobrain growth: Develop and execute a regional sales strategy to achieve orders and revenue goals while expanding icobrain adoption across key accounts and market segments.
  • Develop new opportunities: Identify, qualify, and advance new icobrain opportunities through direct customer engagement, targeted prospecting, and collaboration with GE HealthCare MR sales teams.
  • Leverage the broader GE HealthCare organization: Partner closely with MR Account Managers, Imaging Account Executives, clinical teams, product specialists, and other commercial stakeholders to identify opportunities within existing GE HealthCare accounts and the MR installed base.
  • Excel in a virtual and in-person selling environment: Proactively engage customers and prospects through phone, Microsoft Teams, email, and other virtual channels. Effectively develop relationships, deliver presentations and demonstrations, and advance opportunities remotely, while also actively engaging customers and prospects at conferences, industry meetings, and other in-person events.
  • Engage clinical and executive stakeholders: Build relationships with radiologists, neuroradiologists, neurologists, imaging leaders, IT stakeholders, administrators, and other decision makers involved in the evaluation and adoption of clinical AI solutions.
  • Serve as an icobrain subject matter expert: Develop a strong understanding of icobrain's clinical applications, workflows, and customer value and effectively communicate that value to clinical, technical, and business audiences.
  • Lead customer presentations and demonstrations: Deliver compelling product presentations and demonstrations, both virtually and in person, tailored to customer needs, workflows, and clinical use cases.
  • Navigate complex health systems: Develop account strategies that recognize the clinical, technical, financial, contracting, and operational requirements involved in adopting enterprise clinical AI solutions.
  • Own new opportunities from identification through close: Coordinate the commercial process across internal and customer stakeholders, including opportunity development, demonstrations, proposals, contracting, and transition to implementation and Customer Success.
  • Support renewals and contract transitions: Work closely with the Customer Success team to support existing customer renewals and help transition legacy icometrix customers to GE HealthCare agreements. Serve as a commercial partner during these discussions, helping maintain continuity of the customer relationship, address commercial needs, and identify opportunities to expand adoption.
  • Build strategic customer partnerships: Identify opportunities to position icobrain as part of broader MR and enterprise imaging strategies, particularly within academic medical centers, strategic health systems, and customers investing in advanced MR capabilities.
  • Maintain strong pipeline and forecast discipline: Accurately manage opportunities, pipeline, customer activity, and forecasts using GE HealthCare's CRM and established commercial processes.
  • Bring the voice of the customer back to the organization: Share market insights, competitive intelligence, customer feedback, and emerging clinical needs with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and MR leadership to help inform future commercial and product strategies.

Required Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of sales or commercial experience in healthcare, medical technology, diagnostic imaging, healthcare IT, clinical software, or a related field.
    • Demonstrated ability to develop new business and successfully manage complex sales opportunities from identification through close.
    • Experience navigating hospitals, health systems, academic medical centers, or other complex healthcare organizations.
    • Demonstrated ability to build customer relationships and successfully advance sales opportunities in a primarily virtual selling environment.
    • Ability to work effectively in a primarily remote sales model, with travel as needed for strategic customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and other high-value commercial activities.

Preferred:

    • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed commercial environment, collaborating with account teams, specialists, Customer Success, and other functions while maintaining ownership and accountability for assigned business objectives.
    • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate clinical and technical concepts into clear customer value.
    • Strategic account planning skills and the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels within an organization.
    • Ability to balance new business development with support of an established customer base, including renewals, contracting discussions, and expansion opportunities.
    • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated pipeline, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
    • Experience with diagnostic imaging, MRI, neurology, neuroradiology, clinical AI, or healthcare software is strongly preferred.
    • Ability to represent icobrain and the GE HealthCare MR organization effectively at customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and other in-person commercial activities.
    • Most importantly, a genuine interest in advancing MR and neurological care through the meaningful application of clinical AI.

Resumo da Vaga:

Nesta função, você utilizará sua experiência para ajudar no treinamento de sistemas de IA de última geração. Seu trabalho contribuirá diretamente para a forma como esses modelos aprendem, raciocinam e executam tarefas por meio de dados reais e de alta qualidade. Não é necessário ter experiência prévia com Inteligência Artificial — o mais importante é sua capacidade de seguir instruções e produzir dados de qualidade.

Principais Responsabilidades

  1. Capturar dados precisos de movimento utilizando os sensores IMU do seu smartphone durante atividades físicas especificadas.
  2. Gravar vídeos sincronizados para garantir a precisão dos dados e a integridade de todas as informações de movimento coletadas.
  3. Seguir protocolos técnicos detalhados para atender consistentemente aos padrões de qualidade, rotulagem e padronização do projeto.
  4. Entregar no mínimo 10 horas semanais de vídeos aprovados e de alta qualidade durante todo o período do projeto.
  5. Comunicar-se de forma clara e proativa com a equipe para esclarecer dúvidas e compartilhar observações sobre o processo de coleta de dados.
  6. Garantir entregas pontuais e consistentes, em conformidade com os marcos e expectativas do projeto.
  7. Participar da verificação de compatibilidade do dispositivo e de um processo de entrevista inovador com suporte de IA durante o onboarding.

Requisitos

  1. Ter acesso a uma faixa para fixação do celular na cabeça (head strap), capaz de registrar ambas as mãos, em até 48 horas após a data de início.
  2. Possuir um smartphone compatível. Dispositivos suportados incluem:
  3. iPhone 12 ou superior;
  4. Google Pixel 6 ou superior;
  5. Samsung Galaxy S21 ou superior.
  6. Excelente atenção aos detalhes e capacidade comprovada de seguir protocolos padronizados.
  7. Capacidade de gerenciar entregas de forma consistente e cumprir prazos em um ambiente dinâmico e orientado por dados.
  8. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal para documentação e colaboração remota.
  9. Facilidade com tecnologia e experiência no uso de dispositivos móveis para captura de vídeo e dados de sensores.
  10. Condições físicas para realizar tarefas repetitivas de movimento com segurança e eficiência.
  11. Acesso a um smartphone compatível capaz de realizar coleta de dados com alta fidelidade.

Observação: Candidaturas enviadas utilizando um endereço de e-mail Gmail serão consideradas um diferencial, pois facilitam a integração com as ferramentas do projeto.

Qualificações Desejáveis

  1. Formação ou experiência em robótica, cinesiologia, coleta de dados por sensores ou áreas técnicas relacionadas.
  2. Experiência com análise de movimento humano, segmentação de atividades ou rotulagem de conjuntos de dados para aprendizado de máquina.
  3. Familiaridade com organização e estruturação de grandes conjuntos de dados para aplicações de IA e robótica.

Estrutura de Remuneração

  1. A remuneração é baseada na produção. Os profissionais são pagos por cada vídeo gravado que atenda às especificações do projeto. O tempo necessário para concluir as atividades pode variar de acordo com a experiência e o fluxo de trabalho de cada participante.

Há requisitos mínimos de entrega: os vídeos devem possuir a duração especificada pelo projeto, e cada profissional deverá enviar entre 10 e 15 horas de vídeo por semana.

Início das Atividades e Disponibilidade

  1. Normalmente concluímos o processo de seleção em até 48 horas, portanto buscamos profissionais disponíveis para iniciar rapidamente. Caso seja selecionado(a), esperamos que você comece sua primeira tarefa assim que avançar no processo de candidatura.
  2. A expectativa é que o início das atividades ocorra aproximadamente 24 horas após a conclusão do onboarding.

Requisitos de Equipamentos

Smartphone

  1. Todas as tarefas deste projeto deverão ser realizadas utilizando um smartphone.
  2. Os participantes gravarão seu fluxo de trabalho diretamente pelo dispositivo móvel enquanto executam as atividades.

Faixa para Cabeça (Head Strap)

  1. As tarefas exigem o uso de uma câmera posicionada na cabeça por meio de uma faixa (head strap).
  2. Os participantes gravarão vídeos em primeira pessoa enquanto realizam as atividades físicas.
  3. As especificações da faixa necessária e de quaisquer equipamentos adicionais serão compartilhadas durante o processo de onboarding.

AVISO IMPORTANTE:

Os candidatos que atenderem aos requisitos de localização e equipamento do projeto serão contatados em breve para realizar um processo de verificação de identidade. Os candidatos selecionados deverão poder concluir esta verificação de identidade dentro de 48 horas após serem contatados. A verificação de identidade é necessária antes que o contrato possa ser enviado para assinatura.

Choice Hotels, one of the world’s largest lodging franchisors, is seeking an Extended Stay Revenue Manager for our Choice Revenue Optimization Consultation Services (ChoiceROCS) team, supporting Extended Stay hotels.   • Proactively communicate with properties regarding performance of Revenue Management Strategies, including how LOS restrictions and rate changes affect occupancy and RevPAR.

  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in revenue management or consulting with a focus on financial analysis or revenue analytics; extended stay or long-stay lodging experience strongly preferred.

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to interpret data, identify opportunities, and develop strategies.

  • Skilled at managing multiple priorities while maintaining day-to-day operations.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written; attentive listener.
  • Multi-property extended stay revenue management experience preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
  • Familiarity with Choice Internet sites, Property Management Systems, distribution platforms, and GDS systems preferred.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Results-driven, accountable, and innovative in achieving goals.

  • Strong collaboration skills; effective team player.
  • Self-starter able to work independently in a virtual environment; reliable internet access required.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Revenue Management Certification (CHRM or CRME) required within first year if not already certified.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $75,553- $88,886. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible to participate in the Revenue Management Incentive Plan.

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. Szia! Mi vagyunk a Teya.

A Teyát az az egyszerű meggyőződés hívta életre, hogy a helyi vállalkozások jobbat érdemelnek.

Azok a kávézók, éttermek, szalonok, üzletek és vállalkozások, amelyek karaktert adnak az utcáinknak, munkahelyeket teremtenek, és mozgásban tartják a közösségeinket. A pénzügyi szolgáltatások terén viszont régóta nehézségekkel találkoznak. A körülményes eszközbeszerzés, a nehezen elérhető ügyfélszolgálat és a bonyolult folyamatok rengeteg időt, energiát és pénzt vesznek el tőlük ahelyett, hogy a saját vállalkozásukra és ügyfeleikre figyelhetnének.

A Teya azért létezik, hogy ezen változtasson.

Olyan, egész Európa-szintű pénzügyi platformot építünk a helyi vállalkozásoknak, ahol az egyszerű eszközök, az átgondolt dizájn és a valódi emberi segítség áll a középpontban. Partnereink biztos támaszként számíthatnak ránk a cégük menedzselésében, ez a felelősség pedig a mindennapi munkánk alapja.

A dinamikus fejlődésben hiszünk, nem engedünk a minőségből, és a legkisebb részlet felett sem siklunk át. Hisszük, hogy a kimagasló teljesítmény és a valódi vendégszeretet kéz a kézben jár.

Ha szeretnél értékteremtő termékeket fejleszteni, valódi problémákra megoldást találni, és megbízható partnere lenni a helyi vállalkozásoknak, nagyon várjuk a jelentkezésedet!

Ebben a pozícióban közvetlenül hozzájárulsz majd ahhoz, hogy a kereskedők hogyan élik meg a mindennapjaikat a Teyával.

A küldetésed

A Merchant Support Specialist szerepe, hogy a kereskedők számára a lehető legmagasabb színvonalú támogatást biztosítsa. A feladat három fő pillérre épül:

Ehhez elengedhetetlen a Teya termék- és szolgáltatásportfóliójának alapos ismerete, valamint a technológiai affinitás, hogy hatékonyan kezeld a beérkező kéréseket a rendszereinken keresztül.

  • Helyszíni támogatás

Szeretnénk a kereskedők számára személyre szabott támogatást nyújtani, ami magában foglalja, hogy a Merchant Support Specialist ellátogat az üzleteikbe, és közvetlenül segít a felmerülő problémák kezelésében (például telepítés, helyszíni technikai támogatás).

  • Képes vagy meghallgatni és megérteni a kereskedők kihívásait, és gyorsan, hatékonyan megoldást találni rájuk

  • Korábbi szakmai tapasztalat nem szükséges – ha folyamatosan szeretnél fejlődni és tanulni, várjuk a jelentkezésedet!

jobs.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Operations Manager .This position is the BASIS Operations Manager role and is a senior leadership role within Peraton BASIS program responsible for the overall direction, cohesion, and performance of multiple operational workstreams. Reporting directly to the Program Manager, this individual provides strategic and operational leadership across areas such as, but not limited to Data Quality, Quality Assurance, Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM), Duplicate Identity Resolution Program (DIRP), Defense Health Agency (DHA) Initiatives, and Development, Modernization & Enhancement (DME).

The Operations Manager is accountable for the overall health and performance of all operational areas, ensuring alignment and delivery for the BASIS Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) requirements. A core responsibility of this position is the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of processes and procedures that drive team efficiency, standardize operations, and ensure the program consistently meets contractual performance thresholds.

The Operations Manager is responsible for developing and delivering clear, concise, and data-driven briefings to senior program leadership and Government customers, including Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC) leadership, and other key Government stakeholders. This includes preparing and presenting operational status updates, performance metric summaries, risk and issue assessments, and process improvement initiatives in formal and informal settings such as Monthly Status Reviews, In-Progress Reviews, and ad hoc Government-requested meetings. The Operations Manager ensures that all briefing materials accurately reflect the state of program operations, are tailored to the appropriate audience, and convey actionable insights that support informed Government decision-making. This individual proactively engages with Government customers to understand evolving priorities, communicate program performance against Performance Work Statement requirements, and build the trust and transparency necessary for a successful long-term partnership.

This position is remote

Below are some of the Operational Areas of Responsibility but not all inclusive.

Data Quality

  • Provide overarching leadership and accountability for all Data Quality operations, including Personal Data Repository (PDR) and TRICARE data programs
  • Partner with the Data Quality Manager to ensure data sweeps, error correction targets, and reporting commitments are met
  • Drive development of standard operating procedures (SOPs) that improve data quality workflows and reduce error recurrence
  • Ensure the program meets weekly error metric reporting and periodic Data Quality Analysis Report deliverables

Quality Assurance

  • Provide senior-level oversight and accountability for the program's Quality Control Plan (QCP) and Quality Assurance program
  • Partner with the Quality Assurance Lead to ensure testing standards, automated code coverage requirements (minimum 90%), and Test Driven Development (TDD) practices are consistently upheld across all development activities
  • Champion the development of quality-focused processes that integrate seamlessly
  • Ensure Quality Status Reports (QSRs) accurately reflect program performance and are submitted with each Monthly Status Report (MSR) on time

Electronic Health Records Modernization (EHRM)

  • Provide leadership accountability for the EHRM Operations and Maintenance (O&M) workstream
  • Partner with the EHRM Project Manager to ensure Information Systems Testing (IST) liaison commitments, defect tracking, and environment maintenance activities are executed effectively
  • Support the development of streamlined processes for EHRM defect management and stakeholder communication

Duplicate Identity Resolution Program (DIRP)

  • Provide senior-level accountability for the Duplicate Identity Resolution Program, ensuring the program meets work products and minimum monthly performance thresholds for merges, unmerges, and overlay corrections
  • Partner with the Duplicate Identity Resolution Project manager to identify process improvements that increase throughput and reduce manual processing time
  • Ensure all work products are delivered on time; trend analysis, algorithm review, and annual identity correlation reporting commitments are met

Defense Health Agency (DHA) Initiatives

  • Provide overall leadership accountability for all Defense Health Agency-directed enhancements and initiatives under the program
  • Partner with the Defense Health Agency Initiatives Manager to ensure milestone adherence, stakeholder coordination, and deliverable quality
  • Support the development of repeatable processes for onboarding, tracking, and delivering Defense Health Agency initiative requirements

Development, Modernization & Enhancement (DME)

  • Provide accountability for the successful planning and execution of all Development, Modernization & Enhancement
  • Partner with the Development, Modernization & Enhancement Project Managers to monitor milestone adherence, manage dependencies, and escalate risks to the Program Manager
  • Drive the development of standardized processes for requirements intake, delivery tracking, and change management across modernization efforts

General Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine program-wide processes and procedures to improve operational efficiency, reduce rework, and ensure all teams consistently meet Performance Work Statement requirements
  • Establish and maintain a cross-functional operating rhythm to surface risks, resolve dependencies, and ensure alignment across all operational areas
  • Contribute to Monthly Status Reports (MSRs), Weekly and Annual In-Progress Reviews (IPRs), and the Risk Management Plan
  • Identify operational gaps and lead root cause analysis efforts; develop corrective action plans as needed
  • Ensure all personnel across operational areas meet security, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) / Personally Identifiable Information (PII) handling, and mandatory annual training requirements
  • Support transition-in and transition-out planning activities as required by the Government

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 10 years of progressive experience in program or operations management, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role overseeing multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Ability to obtain a DoD Secret clearance
  • Must be a US Citizen
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-disciplinary teams within a Department of Defense (DoD) or Federal Government contracting environment
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional operations and drive accountability across diverse teams without direct line authority over all personnel
  • Experience developing, implementing, and improving processes and standard operating procedures (SOPs) at the program or enterprise level
  • Strong track record of delivering data-driven briefings and status reports to senior Government customers and executive leadership
  • Demonstrated experience managing contractual performance requirements, including Performance Work Statements (PWS) and Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASP)
  • Experience with risk management, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning
  • Familiarity with data quality operations, including error tracking, metric reporting, and data governance principles
  • Experience supporting or overseeing quality assurance programs, including test standards, automated testing coverage, and software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related field
  • Experience supporting Defense Health Agency (DHA), Defense Manpower Data Center (DMDC), Military Health System (MHS), or other DoD health IT programs

  • Familiarity with TRICARE data systems, the Personal Data Repository (PDR), or related military health data programs

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher, or equivalent process improvement certification
  • Experience with Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and Personally Identifiable Information (PII) compliance requirements in a DoD environment
  • Familiarity with Test Driven Development (TDD) practices and automated code coverage standards in an Agile or DevSecOps environment

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled MDM Technical Lead to join our innovative and dynamic team.

MDM Technical Lead | About You

As an MDM Technical Lead, you will translate approved MDM architecture into detailed technical designs and production-ready solutions. You will lead hands-on implementation across Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, dbt, identity resolution, matching and survivorship, stewardship, data quality, Gold-layer publishing, and Power BI integration. You bring strong technical leadership and data-engineering capabilities, with the ability to guide developers, resolve complex implementation issues, enforce engineering standards, and maintain solution and release quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.

MDM Technical Lead | Day-to-Day

  • Translate solution architecture and business requirements into detailed technical designs, source-to-target mappings, logical and physical models, integration specifications, and implementation tasks.
  • Lead the design and development of ingestion and transformation pipelines across source systems, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Fabric Data Factory, APIs, and dbt.
  • Configure and implement standardization, deterministic and fuzzy matching, confidence scoring, source crosswalks, survivorship, golden-record, hierarchy, and relationship-management logic.
  • Design exception and stewardship workflows supporting duplicate review, match correction, merge/unmerge, overrides, approvals, and complete auditability.
  • Lead development of data-quality rules, automated testing, reconciliation controls, exception reporting, lineage, monitoring, and restart/recovery capabilities.
  • Oversee the publication of curated Gold-layer data products, semantic models, and integrations supporting Power BI reporting and analytics.
  • Conduct technical and code reviews, mentor developers, manage defects and performance issues, and enforce development, security, CI/CD, documentation, and release standards.
  • Support system integration testing, UAT, production deployment, hypercare, knowledge transfer, and operational stabilization.

MDM Technical Lead | Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, MDM Development, Data Integration, or Technical Leadership, including responsibility for enterprise-scale implementations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Lakehouse, Fabric Data Factory, dbt, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Azure DevOps.
  • Deep understanding of MDM implementation concepts, including entity modeling, standardization, match/merge, survivorship, crosswalks, golden records, stewardship, relationships, and data quality.
  • Experience implementing commercial MDM platforms such as Profisee or building custom identity-resolution capabilities on modern cloud data platforms.
  • Strong experience with data-quality testing, source reconciliation, metadata, lineage, performance tuning, security, RBAC, and production monitoring.
  • Proven technical leadership skills, including solution decomposition, task assignment, code and design reviews, mentoring, defect resolution, and release-quality ownership.

Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Per Diem Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

"I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Per diem employees qualify for:

  • Hourly base rate, plus additional incentive structure (i.e., per visit completed, other incentives may apply)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Board certification (required)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

12

Time Type

Part time

$41.85 - $90.13

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

jobs.excerpt: About Clarity Pediatrics Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD.
jobs.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics

Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer,Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

We're backed by top VCs who have supported category-defining health-tech companies like One Medical, Hims, Spring Health, Cityblock, Honor, and Tia.

The Role

For a lot of families, food is where the hardest moments of the day happen. ADHD medications can blunt appetite, picky eating can turn dinner into a standoff, and weight conversations can leave kids feeling judged. As our Registered Dietitian, you'll help families turn those moments into progress, with care that is practical, evidence-based, and free of stigma.

You'll join a true multidisciplinary team. Our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians treat together, so your nutrition plan isn't a referral that disappears into a chart. It's part of one coordinated plan for the whole child.

This is also a chance to build. You'll help design the evidence-based programming and protocols behind our nutrition care, from 1:1 visits to virtual group programs for kids and caregivers. If you've ever wanted to design the program instead of just running it, this is that role, on a part-time schedule you set.

What You'll Do

Care for kids and families (Practice Devotion to our Families)

  • Conduct 1:1 virtual nutrition visits for children and caregivers as part of our integrated care model.

  • Lead engaging virtual group sessions that give kids and caregivers practical tools they can use at the next meal.

  • Meet families where they are, with culturally responsive, non-stigmatizing language and plans that fit real budgets, schedules, and food traditions.

Deliver safe, high-quality care (Patient Safety Always Comes First)

  • Assess growth, intake, and medication effects such as appetite suppression, and flag concerns to the care team quickly.

  • Monitor progress, adjust recommendations, and document every interaction accurately and on time.

Work as one team (Earn Trust From Everyone)

  • Partner closely with our physicians, nurse practitioners, and behavioral health clinicians on shared, whole-child care plans.

  • Be a trusted voice for families and colleagues: clear, warm, and consistent.

Build what's next (Observe, Improve and Innovate)

  • Help design evidence-based nutrition programming and group curricula, drawing on pediatric nutrition research, family-based behavioral treatment, and motivational interviewing.

  • Share what you learn from families so we can keep improving the model, and help us measure what's working.

Who You Are (Play to Win)

  • A credentialed RD. You hold an active RD or RDN credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

  • Experienced with kids and families. You have 3+ years of clinical or community nutrition experience, ideally in pediatric or family-focused settings.

  • Skilled in weight and metabolic health. You've supported patients with obesity, overweight, or metabolic conditions, and you know how to talk about weight in ways that build trust instead of shame.

  • A confident group facilitator. You can keep a virtual room of kids or caregivers engaged, and you enjoy it.

  • Comfortable with virtual care. You use EMRs and telehealth platforms with ease and document efficiently.

  • Culturally responsive. You've worked with families from diverse backgrounds and tailor your recommendations to their culture, resources, and goals.

  • A builder at heart. You're energized by a fast-growing startup and happy to iterate on new care models.

  • Ready to serve our Medicaid families. You're enrolled in California or Texas Medicaid, or willing to enroll.

Bonus points

  • State dietitian licensure, or openness to obtaining licenses with support from Clarity Pediatrics Medical Group.

  • Spanish fluency.

Compensation, Schedule and Benefits

The pay range for this role is 40–50 per hour, depending on experience. You're paid for all time worked, including visits, group sessions, prep, and documentation.

This is a part-time, hourly W-2 role, fully remote. You choose your hours within our operating window of Monday through Friday, 2pm–8pm PT. This role is eligible for sick leave and 401k participation.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Clarity, we believe every family deserves care that sees and understands them, and that starts with the team we build. Our patients and their families come from every background, community, and walk of life, and we're at our best when our team reflects that diversity. As a female-led company, we know firsthand that different perspectives lead to better decisions, better technology, and better care for kids.

We're building a workplace where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong, and where trust is earned and extended to all. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those whose experience doesn't match every line of this description. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Clarity Pediatrics is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point during the hiring process, please let us know at .

Recruitment Fraud Notice

jobs.excerpt: The company Small businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for an Office Coordinator.

You'll run the day-to-day of our Leeds office, making it a well-run, safe and welcoming place for the 100+ iwocans who work from there.

The team

The office team looks after iwoca's four offices in London, Leeds, Berlin and Frankfurt, and the events that keep iwocans connected across them. The team is led by the Office & Community Manager, who is based in London.

The Leeds office is home to most of iwoca's collections, customer success and account management teams, plus smaller groups from across the business. It's busiest midweek, when most teams come in together.

The role

As Office Coordinator, you'll report to the Office & Community Manager. You'll be the person who keeps the Leeds office running, and the first person iwocans in Leeds come to when something needs sorting.

  • Ownership. You'll run the office day to day: the weekly food and drinks order, deliveries, post and supplies, and the office Soldo card, reconciled each month. You'll walk the office each week and fix small issues yourself.

  • Variety. You'll welcome visitors and candidates, sort out meeting room clashes, and book and oversee cleaners, tradespeople and suppliers, from the coffee machines and Billi taps to the plants.

  • Responsibility. You'll keep the office safe. You'll be one of the office's fire marshals and first aiders, carry out facilities maintenance checks, and keep the first aid kits stocked.

  • Community. You'll help iwocans in Leeds feel part of iwoca and enjoy being here. You'll run the weekly office tour for new joiners, help teams to celebrate key moments like work anniversaries and organise community events.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Office operations. You have at least a year's experience running the day-to-day of an office or front of house, including ordering, deliveries and visitors.

  • Suppliers and contractors. You have worked with building management, contractors and facilities suppliers, and held them to what they agreed to deliver.

  • Fixing things without being asked. You have been the person who spots what isn't working in an office and sorts it. You can talk us through examples.

  • The physical side. You're comfortable unpacking deliveries, setting up for events and moving supplies of up to 15–20kg.

Bonus:

  • First aid and fire safety. You hold first aid or fire marshal certificates. If not, we'll train you when you join.

  • Expenses. You have managed company expenses on Soldo or a similar platform.

  • Facilities qualification. You have an IWFM qualification or equivalent.

  • AI Literacy. Experience using generative AI tools to drive efficiency in administrative tasks, paired with the judgment to audit and fact-check all AI-generated content.

The salary

We expect to pay from £26,500 to £30,000 (pro rata for 20 hours a week) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation Range: £26.5K - £30K

We are looking for a hands-on HR Operations & Recruiting Specialist based in the San Francisco Bay Area to support our expanding robotics and AI data collection project.

In this dual-impact role, you will be the backbone of our local workforce. You will lead initial candidate screening for specialized Robot Teleoperator roles while managing the entire employee lifecycle—driving seamless onboarding, accurate shift-based payroll coordination, and daily HR administration.

If you are organized, know California employment basics, understand operational hiring, and thrive in dynamic technical environments, this role offers direct exposure to next-generation AI and robotics programs.

Key Responsibilities

1. Candidate Sourcing & Screening

  • Conduct structured phone/video screens for entry-level and technical operational roles (VR/Console Robot Teleoperators)

  • Assess candidate reliability, technical and gaming comfort, physical readiness (e.g., equipment handling/battery swaps), and availability for shift rotations.

2. Onboarding & Compliance

  • Lead the end-to-end new hire onboarding process, ensuring high completion rates before day-one onsite training.

  • Oversee I-9 verification, E-Verify processing (including OPT, CPT, and work visa validations), background checks, and offer letter generation.

3. Payroll Management & Time Tracking

  • Audit and collect shift timesheets, break logs, and overtime records for hourly operators across weekend and weekday shifts.

  • Manage bonus program tracking (performance and attendance incentives) and submit clean payroll files to the accounting/payroll team on schedule.

  • Address employee payroll inquiries, pay stub questions, and hour discrepancies promptly.

4. HR Administration & Employee Support

  • Serve as the main point of contact for day-to-day employee questions regarding attendance policies, benefits eligibility, and workplace guidelines.

  • Maintain organized, compliant digital personnel files and track probationary/90-day milestone evaluations.

  • Facilitate offboarding workflows, final pay calculations, and exit documentation in compliance with California labor standards.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2–4 years of combined experience in HR Operations, People Operations, or Technical/Operational Recruiting.

  • California Labor Literacy: Solid understanding of California wage-and-hour rules (meal/rest breaks, overtime calculation, paid sick leave, and final pay rules).

  • Work Authorization Familiarity: Practical experience with I-9 compliance and E-Verify processes (OPT, STEM OPT, H-1B, and student work authorizations).

  • Payroll & Time Tracking: Hands-on experience administering hourly timecards and working with payroll systems

  • Communication & Organization: Clear, proactive communication skills with the ability to maintain meticulous documentation across fast-moving shift teams.

  • Location: Based in the San Francisco Bay Area with the ability to travel locally to project facilities (Peninsula / South Bay) as operational needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to the robotics, hardware, gaming, or AI data collection sectors.

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Completion of 2080 hours of post-graduate collaborative practice hours as an NP or PA in an integrated clinical care setting (required, as is the filing of the

jobs.excerpt: About us Your work can help save students’ lives.
jobs.description:
About us

Your work can help save students’ lives. For over 25 years, Gaggle has partnered with K-12 schools on student safety, and our team has helped save more than 8,600 student lives since 2018. Our technology flags signs of concern in students’ digital activity, our trained safety professionals review them around the clock so the right people can step in before a crisis, and our coaching and therapy services help students get support afterward. Today we serve more than 6 million students in over 1,500 districts, and protecting their data is central to that trust. Join our fully remote team, named a 2026 Top Workplace for remote work.

The opportunity

We're at a rare point in Gaggle's history. Our platform is evolving, and we're modernizing the infrastructure and engineering practices behind it, with security built in from the start and everything defined as code. Our engineering is becoming AI-first: engineers own the design and architecture, AI writes the code, and every change goes through risk-based governance, with review and controls matched to the risk of the change.

We're also rebuilding much of our IT and security foundation, including the identity systems our company runs on, and you'll lead it. Most security leaders inherit a program and spend years working around old decisions. Here, you'll define what our security, compliance and IT should look like and build it, in close partnership with a hands-on CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the security and compliance program. Define the program, set priorities and implement it. Serve as Gaggle's Information Security Officer.
  • Mature our compliance posture. Maintain SOC 2, and lead our alignment with FedRAMP as K-12 requirements evolve. Prepare for HITRUST if our health-related products require it.
  • Rebuild our IT foundation. Modernize identity and SSO, endpoint management and security, data loss prevention, and access management as we move off legacy infrastructure.
  • Build security into how we engineer. Partner with engineering to define control requirements, review designs and make compliance evidence part of how we build and ship.
  • Build a security-aware culture. Educate and equip employees so security becomes part of how we work, not a gate.
  • Enable safe AI adoption. Set the guardrails (policy, data handling and vendor review) that let the company move fast with AI, without slowing it down.
  • Lead our Systems Support Engineering team and shape how it grows as our platform and tools evolve. The three-person team is the top tier of technical support for our customer platform, handling the hardest escalations, and also runs internal IT.
  • Lead the decommissioning of legacy infrastructure (data sanitization, access and contract exit), in close partnership with the CTO.
  • Make the case for investment. Weigh costs against risk, prioritize initiatives and recommend where we invest.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building or substantially maturing a security and compliance program.
  • Hands-on implementation. You're comfortable doing the work yourself, not only directing it.
  • AI-forward in your own work. You use AI tools every day and actively look for ways to apply them to security, compliance and IT.
  • GRC expertise: policies, controls, risk management, audits, and holding engineering accountable for controls. You've obtained and maintained a certification such as SOC 2, HITRUST or FedRAMP.
  • Real cloud security literacy (AWS preferred). You can read an architecture and spot a missing control, and you understand OWASP and why it matters. You don't need to write code.
  • Experience leading IT and identity changes, such as a company-wide MDM, EDR or DLP rollout, or an SSO migration.
  • Experience leading an operational support team, such as IT support or escalation-level technical support.
  • Strong judgment about what to fix first, and the ability to explain why.
  • A business partner's mindset. You make risk-based trade-offs that help the business grow safely, and you'd rather find a path to yes than build a wall.
  • Steady, empathetic people leadership.

Our Team Commitment

Gaggle is proud to be recognized as a 2026 Top Workplace. We are committed to equal opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

MDM Technical Architect | About You

As an MDM Technical Architect, you will define the end-to-end architecture for enterprise Master Data Management, identity resolution, data quality, governance, and analytics solutions. You will establish the technical vision and design for integrating multiple source systems into a governed Microsoft Fabric and OneLake ecosystem, creating trusted golden records that support enterprise reporting and analytics. You bring deep expertise in MDM architecture, entity modeling, match and survivorship strategies, data stewardship, cloud data platforms, and enterprise security, along with the ability to guide stakeholders through complex platform and architecture decisions.

MDM Technical Architect | Day-to-Day

  • Define the overall MDM solution vision and architecture, covering source ingestion, entity and relationship modeling, identity resolution, source crosswalks, survivorship, golden records, stewardship, security, governance, and downstream consumption.
  • Evaluate commercial MDM platforms and custom cloud-native approaches, recommending the right solution based on scalability, licensing, stewardship, operating-model, and long-term support requirements.
  • Design integration patterns across enterprise source systems, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Factory, dbt, APIs, Power BI, and related analytics platforms.
  • Define deterministic and probabilistic matching strategies, confidence thresholds, duplicate detection, household resolution, survivorship rules, and exception-review processes.
  • Establish architectural guardrails for data quality, metadata, lineage, auditability, PII protection, role-based access, environment separation, and deployment governance.
  • Lead architecture workshops and design reviews, translating business requirements and source-data realities into solution blueprints, logical data models, source-to-target mappings, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Guide technical teams through implementation, resolve complex architectural issues, and ensure delivery remains aligned with approved enterprise, security, and governance standards.
  • Define production-readiness, transition, and support requirements, including monitoring, operational runbooks, knowledge transfer, and sustainable platform ownership.

MDM Technical Architect | Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Solution Architecture, MDM, Data Engineering, or Enterprise Data Management, including leadership of complex MDM or data-modernization programs.
  • Deep expertise in MDM architecture, entity resolution, golden-record design, match/merge, survivorship, crosswalks, hierarchy and relationship management, and data stewardship.
  • Strong architecture experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Factory, Azure, dbt, Power BI, lakehouse or medallion architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing commercial MDM platforms such as Profisee, Informatica MDM, Reltio, Ataccama, or Stibo Systems, or designing custom cloud-native identity-resolution solutions.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, security, PII protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and regulated-data practices.
  • Excellent client-facing architecture, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain platform options, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations to executive, business, and technical stakeholders.
