Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

What you'll do

In this role, you’ll join the Customer Success Architect team within Sales and Success as a CSA (AI-Service Management). This is an individual contributor role reporting to a regional leader. You'll help enterprise customers adopt Atlassian's AI-powered Service Collection: Jira Service Management (JSM), Customer Service Management, Assets, and Rovo Service Agents.

You'll lead time-boxed technical engagements and build solutions alongside customers, helping them turn traditional service desks into modern, AI-first service operations. Working with enterprise IT and business service leaders, you'll assess how they work today and co-design workflows across request, incident, problem, change, and asset management. You'll also help customers put autonomous and assisted AI experiences into production.

As a technical expert in Atlassian solutions, you'll deliver effective guidance at scale to help customers increase adoption and get more from their investment. The work involves connecting product capabilities with customers' business needs and desired outcomes. You'll partner with Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, and Product teams to provide solutions and technical guidance that help customers reach their goals.

You'll also help our strongest customer promoters share their successes with peers. As part of that work, you'll lead efforts to expand the Atlassian System of Work into IT, enterprise functions including HR, Facilities, Legal, and Finance, and customer service use cases.

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

On your first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • Discovery: Assess customers' service maturity and AI readiness across IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Service Management (ESM), and Customer Service Management (CSM). Review ticket volume data, recurring requests, and knowledge health to find high-impact opportunities for deflection and automation.

  • Design: Work with customers to design AI-first service workflows, including conversational request channels in Slack and Teams, multi-tier queues, change risk models, and Assets/CMDB schemas. Configure and fine-tune Rovo Service Agents for automated triage, deflection, smart routing, and context generation.

  • Deploy: Help customers move from pilot to production. Validate deflection rates, agent accuracy, SLAs, alerting and on-call processes, and automated change policies. Establish continuous learning loops so service teams can monitor, refine, and scale AI agents independently.

  • Collaborate: Work with Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, and Service Collection specialists on technical activation plans. Help customers modernize from legacy tools such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, and BMC, or from standalone Opsgenie.

  • Advocate: Share insights from customer feedback, adoption patterns, and technical friction that relevant Atlassian product and engineering teams can act on. Document validated use cases, reusable patterns, and customer outcomes to improve future engagements and help scale with the JSM, Assets, and Rovo engineering and product teams.

  • Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally for events and customer meetings.

Your background

  • Customer Success & Experience: 3-5 years in Customer Success, technical consulting, or solutions architecture, managing Enterprise customers with complex SaaS portfolios in IT or service operations.

  • Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience implementing Jira Service Management. Familiarity with other Service Management products, such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, and BMC. Practical experience configuring conversational AI, virtual service agents, automated triage, and workflow automation. Experience with Assets/CMDB modeling, API integrations (monitoring, chat, CRM), and optimizing knowledge sources (Confluence) for AI retrieval.

  • Solution Area Expertise: Deep knowledge of IT service management, service management across business functions, and ITIL 4 practices (incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and asset/configuration management). Understanding of Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) principles. ITIL 4 Foundation certification or higher required.

  • Product Mindset & Communication: Strong product mindset with the ability to translate technical AI capabilities into clear business outcomes (deflection, MTTR reduction, CSAT) for IT leaders and executive stakeholders. Comfortable balancing rapid agent prototyping with enterprise-grade governance and reliability.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

For more information visit

BI Developer for the Audience Activation Platform

The Audience Activation Platform is CDP’s newest offering for mission-driven organizations, aiming to build a more perfect view of the entire donor. We gather insights everywhere, from real-world and virtual events to socials, volunteer, donation, and other activities. With this comprehensive, connected, and real-time data, organizations can glean novel insights about what truly drives donor behavior, and tailor activities accordingly.

jobs.excerpt: Role Title: Distinguished Researcher, Research Program Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote Time commitment: Time commitment is flexible.
jobs.description:
Role Title: Distinguished Researcher, Research Program

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Time commitment: Time commitment is flexible. We understand that researchers at this level balance teaching, labs, and other research, so you set a weekly schedule that works around your existing commitments.

micro1 is engaging Distinguished Researchers, Research Programs to contribute to an innovative customer project at the frontiers of computational science. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is designed for early-career researchers with standout recognition, ready to drive progress on significant open problems and influence the future of AI research.

Scope of Work

  1. Identify and propose an impactful open problem or theoretical bound within your research subfield for targeted investigation.
  2. Develop and execute sustained research strategies using advanced AI agents on tasks such as proofs, algorithmic innovation, and computational simulations.
  3. Meticulously verify all findings through reproducible computations, formal tools, or line-by-line proof validation prior to external review.
  4. Collaborate with program engineers and AI model specialists to enhance agent performance and address technical challenges encountered during exploration.
  5. Document research attempts, partial progress, and validated results with clarity and structure to facilitate independent peer review.
  6. Deliver structured feedback on AI agent behaviors, strengths, and weaknesses to inform the evolution of frontier AI models.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Standout early-career achievements, including at least one best paper award at a premier venue (e.g., STOC, FOCS, SODA, PLDI, SC) or a recognized dissertation/early-career award; proof of recognition is required.
  2. Advanced standing as a late-stage PhD, postdoc, or within five years post-PhD in computer science, mathematics, or computational physics.
  3. Recent publication record with multiple papers in top-tier venues within the past three years and at least one breakthrough contribution or open problem advancement.
  4. Hands-on expertise in computational research methods, including simulation, numerical analysis, or algorithm development and implementation.
  5. Demonstrated excellence in written and verbal communication, evidenced by clear documentation and peer-reviewed outputs.
  6. Experience reviewing or sub-reviewing for major conferences and/or publicly applying formal verification tools or frontier AI models in research contexts (desirable).
  7. An online research statement or homepage detailing ongoing or targeted open problems (preferred).

How the process works

  1. Apply and complete the AI interview. This is a short, structured interview covering your research background and approach.
  2. Recruitment and hiring manager review. Our team and the hiring manager review your application, recognition, and recent publications.
  3. Interview with the recruitment team. Part of this conversation focuses on the open problem you’d propose to tackle in the program. Afterward, you’ll submit a short written proposal on that problem.
  4. Final interview (optional). Some candidates will have a final conversation with the hiring manager or one of our internal researchers.
  5. Onboarding. Selected researchers are onboarded and given access to the agents, compute, and engineering support.

jobs.description:
About Darkhorse Tech

Darkhorse Tech is a managed IT services provider built for dental. We support 1,500+ dental practices, specialists, multi-location groups, and DSOs nationwide with day-to-day IT support, cybersecurity, HIPAA compliance, cloud hosting, and email security. We are 100+ people who work almost entirely in one industry, which means we get good at it.

About This Role

We are hiring a Service Manager to own service delivery across our Service Team and our NOC.

Read that carefully, because it is the part most candidates miss. This is not a seat where you manage a help desk. You will manage five team leaders, four Technical Team Leaders and one NOC Team Lead, who together carry fifty-two people between them. Your job is not to solve tickets. It is to build five leaders who run their teams well, hold the same standards, and make good calls without asking you first.

If you are a strong technician who wants to keep touching the work, this is the wrong job. If you have managed managers before and you get satisfaction out of watching someone you coached handle something they could not have handled six months ago, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and develop four Technical Team Leaders and one NOC Team Lead through consistent one-on-ones, clear expectations, and real accountability
  • Own the service KPIs across both organizations: response time, resolution time, CSAT, ticket aging, and backlog
  • Make the experience consistent, so a client gets the same Darkhorse regardless of which pod takes the ticket, and a technician gets the same standards regardless of which lead they report to
  • Oversee NOC operations including backup verification, email security, third-party vendor coordination, practice management software updates, and proactive monitoring, and keep NOC integrated with Service rather than running as a separate island
  • Serve as the escalation point when a Team Leader cannot resolve a client issue, and then fix the reason it escalated
  • Own service delivery for our largest DSO accounts, multi-location groups running dozens of practices, including escalation, SLA performance, and driving consistency at scale
  • Review escalation patterns and resolution quality, and address root causes instead of individual tickets
  • Establish and enforce service processes, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Partner with People and Culture on hiring, onboarding, performance, and retention across the service organization
  • Carry quarterly ROCKs on our Service Traction Leadership Team

What We're Looking For

  • Real experience managing managers. Not managing a team of technicians. Managing the people who manage the technicians. This is the single most important qualification.
  • IT service leadership experience, ideally at an MSP
  • Track record of moving service KPIs, and the ability to talk specifically about what you changed and what happened
  • Comfort with NOC functions: backup verification, email security, monitoring
  • Experience with multi-location or enterprise accounts. Our largest DSO clients expect a different level of consistency than a single practice does.
  • Coaching instinct. You develop people rather than working around them.
  • Analytical and process-driven. You look at the data before you look for someone to blame.
  • Solid grounding in HIPAA, cybersecurity fundamentals, and ITIL principles
  • PSA and RMM experience. ConnectWise preferred.

Nice to Have

• Dental or healthcare IT background

  • Familiarity with dental practice management software (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental)
  • Experience integrating a NOC function with a reactive service desk

• EOS or Traction experience

Details

Location: Remote, anywhere in the U.S.

Schedule: Full-time, standard business hours Eastern, with coordination of Saturday and after-hours coverage across teams

Reports to: VP of Operations

Direct reports: Five (four Technical Team Leaders, one NOC Team Lead)

Compensation: $95,000 to $115,000, depending on experience

Why Darkhorse

Our technicians are not generalists guessing at a dental practice's software. We know this industry, and our people build real relationships with the practices they support instead of taking anonymous tickets off a national queue.

This role has been in place and is being backfilled, so you are not inventing it from scratch. You are inheriting five leaders and a working structure, with room to make it better.

Darkhorse Tech is an equal opportunity employer.

Salary: $95,000 – $115,000 / year

jobs.title: VistA / MUMPS Developer, IFCAP (SCM DSO)
jobs.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking experienced VistA / MUMPS Developers to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.
jobs.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking experienced VistA / MUMPS Developers to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.

The VistA / MUMPS Developer will support the development, sustainment, and modernization of the Integrated Funds Distribution, Control Point Activity, Accounting and Procurement (IFCAP) system, a critical component of the VA's Veterans Health Information Systems and Technology Architecture (VistA).

This position is responsible for maintaining and enhancing MUMPS-based applications, developing and supporting system interfaces, resolving production issues, implementing security updates, and ensuring the continued reliability of VA purchasing, inventory, and financial management systems.

IFCAP supports purchasing, funds control, inventory management, and procurement operations across VA medical centers. The system operates on InterSystems IRIS within the VA Enterprise Cloud on AWS and integrates with modern VA platforms, including the Integrated Financial and Acquisition Management System (iFAMS) and VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP).

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance MUMPS-based applications supporting VA VistA and IFCAP systems.
  • Maintain and modify IFCAP routines, including inventory management, purchasing, and financial processing functionality.
  • Develop, test, and deploy application enhancements and defect fixes through established VistA patch release processes.
  • Support the development and maintenance of interfaces connecting IFCAP with VA enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with interface developers and technical teams to document and explain IFCAP business logic and data structures.
  • Develop and maintain MUMPS components supporting item master, procurement, and financial system integrations.
  • Support integrations with iFAMS, VALIP, and other connected VA applications.
  • Perform regression testing to ensure system stability following platform upgrades and integration changes.
  • Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities, including findings from automated security scans.
  • Investigate and resolve production incidents escalated through VA Tier 2 support and patch coordination teams.
  • Troubleshoot application defects, data inconsistencies, and system performance issues.
  • Maintain compliance with VA VistA coding standards, configuration management practices, and patch release requirements.
  • Collaborate with developers, architects, testers, and cybersecurity teams to support application sustainment and modernization.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation covering application changes, system interfaces, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support knowledge transfer and documentation to ensure continuity of critical system expertise.

Qualifications

  • Minimum five years of professional software development experience using MUMPS/M on VistA or a comparable enterprise system.
  • Strong experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting MUMPS-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of VA FileMan, VistA Kernel, and Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs).
  • Experience developing, testing, and releasing VistA patches.
  • Experience working with InterSystems IRIS or Caché database technologies.
  • Experience maintaining legacy enterprise applications and supporting production systems.
  • Experience troubleshooting application defects, data processing issues, and production incidents.
  • Understanding of VistA application architecture, data structures, and software development practices.
  • Experience performing application testing, debugging, and regression validation.
  • Ability to analyze existing code, identify root causes, and implement reliable solutions.
  • Strong analytical, technical documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, testers, technical leadership, and government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience supporting IFCAP or the VA Generic Inventory Package (GIP).
  • Knowledge of VA procurement, purchasing, inventory management, and financial operations.
  • Experience developing or maintaining interfaces between VistA and modern enterprise applications.
  • Experience exposing VistA data through REST APIs, web services, or HL7 messaging.
  • Familiarity with VA financial systems, including iFAMS.
  • Experience supporting InterSystems IRIS or HealthShare environments.
  • InterSystems IRIS or HealthShare certification.
  • Experience working within Agile development teams using Jira and Git.
  • Familiarity with federal cybersecurity requirements, application security scanning, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Experience supporting application modernization, legacy system integration, and cloud-hosted environments.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal healthcare IT programs.
  • Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States, subject to VA approval. Occasional travel within the continental United States may be required.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $95,000 to $150,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

Description

Quantum Sky is searching for an experienced Sales Engineer to support complex sales opportunities with U.S. Federal agencies and commercial software providers seeking authorization to sell their products and services to the Federal Government. The ideal candidate combines strong technical sales, cloud architecture, cybersecurity, and Federal compliance expertise. This role partners with sales and customers throughout the sales lifecycle—from technical discovery and solution design through demonstrations, estimation, proposals, and technical validation. Candidates should be comfortable translating business, technical, and compliance requirements into cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure, GCP, containers, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, and DevSecOps.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with sales teams to develop technical strategies for direct Federal agency opportunities and commercial software providers pursuing Federal market authorization.
  • Lead technical discovery to understand customer requirements, application architectures, cloud environments, security posture, and compliance objectives.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to commercial SaaS and software companies pursuing FedRAMP, FISMA, DoD, and other Federal security authorizations.
  • Translate Federal cybersecurity and compliance requirements into practical cloud architectures and implementation approaches.
  • Design solutions incorporating public cloud, containers, Kubernetes, serverless computing, cybersecurity, automation, and DevSecOps.
  • Develop and deliver architecture diagrams, technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of concept.
  • Support technical responses to Federal RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and other procurement activities.
  • Develop reusable reference architectures, demonstrations, and technical sales enablement materials.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 8+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, consulting, or a related technical customer-facing role.
  • Experience supporting large, complex technology sales opportunities involving Federal agencies and/or commercial software providers entering the Federal market.
  • Experience working with SaaS or software companies pursuing FedRAMP or other Federal security authorizations.
  • Strong knowledge of FedRAMP, FISMA, RMF, NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, and DISA requirements.
  • Ability to lead technical discovery and translate customer requirements into compelling solution architectures.
  • Experience communicating complex technical and compliance concepts to engineering, cybersecurity, product, program, and executive audiences.
  • Strong written, presentation, and customer-facing communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of containers, Docker, Kubernetes, managed container platforms (AKS, EKS, ECS, GKE), and serverless architectures
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform), CI/CD, DevSecOps

Desired:

  • Experience supporting Civilian, DoD, or Intelligence Community customers.
  • Professional certifications in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, cybersecurity

Key Competencies:

  • Technical Sales Leadership: Own the technical strategy for complex opportunities and establish credibility with customers.
  • Federal Compliance Expertise: Translate Federal security requirements into practical technical architectures.
  • Federal Market Enablement: Help commercial software providers understand and overcome technical barriers to Federal authorization.
  • Multi-Cloud Architecture: Design and communicate solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Consultative Selling: Connect customer business and mission objectives to technical solutions.
  • Executive Communication: Clearly communicate complex cloud and compliance concepts to technical and business stakeholders.

Location:

  • Remote work requiring travel to customer sites as needed

Travel:

  • 30%

About Quantum Sky

Compensation:

  • Compensation is unique to each candidate and relative to the skills and experience they bring to the position. The salary range for this position is typically between $150,000 - $185,000 with additional compensation for each sale. This does not guarantee a specific salary as compensation is based upon multiple factors such as education, experience, certifications, and other requirements, and may fall outside of the above-stated range.

Benefits:

  • Highlights of our benefits include Health/Dental/Vision, 401(k) match, Paid Time Off, STD/LTD/Life Insurance, Referral Bonuses, professional development reimbursement, and parental leave.
Quantum Sky is a trusted leader in IT services and solutions, delivering mission-focused digital transformation that drives measurable success. Our expertise spans four core technology domains—Network Modernization, Hybrid Cloud, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise IT—empowering our clients with cutting-edge solutions tailored to their evolving needs. With over 50 years of experience, Quantum Sky proudly supports Defense, Intelligence, Space, National Security, Civilian, Health, and Public Safety clients across the United States and worldwide. At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. jobs.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Data Architect – Enterprise Asset Management (EAM/CMMS) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program within the Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) product line.
jobs.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Data Architect – Enterprise Asset Management (EAM/CMMS) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program within the Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) product line.

The Data Architect will lead enterprise data architecture, legacy data migration, and data integration activities supporting VA's Enterprise Asset Management/Computerized Maintenance Management System (EAM/CMMS), built on the Nuvolo and ServiceNow platforms.

This position is responsible for defining target data models, developing source-to-target mappings, designing data transformation processes, and overseeing the migration of equipment, asset, and location data from legacy systems into the modernized enterprise platform.

The EAM/CMMS initiative supports the modernization of VA medical equipment tracking and maintenance operations, replacing legacy systems including Maximo Enterprise Asset and Work Management (EAWM) and the Automated Engineering Management System/Medical Equipment Reporting System (AEMS/MERS). The selected candidate will collaborate with VA stakeholders, facility personnel, data engineers, and the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP) team to ensure accurate, secure, and reliable data migration across VA medical facilities.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise data architecture supporting VA's EAM/CMMS implementation.
  • Own and maintain the target data model and source-to-target mappings from legacy AEMS/MERS, Maximo, and facility inventory systems into the Nuvolo EAM/CMMS platform.
  • Extend established asset and location mapping frameworks to additional enterprise record types, ensuring stakeholder review and approval.
  • Collaborate with the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP) data team to design and coordinate ETL pipelines using Databricks.
  • Define data transformation requirements, processing workflows, and responsibilities for pipeline development and execution.
  • Establish data quality standards, validation rules, and data profiling procedures to support enterprise migration activities.
  • Analyze and profile legacy equipment, asset, and location data to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and data quality issues.
  • Coordinate with VA facility personnel to resolve data quality issues and ensure readiness for scheduled migration activities.
  • Integrate facility inventory spreadsheets and other legacy data sources into standardized mapping, transformation, and validation processes.
  • Plan and coordinate phased data migration activities, including trial loads, validation, record reconciliation, cutover, and rollback procedures.
  • Develop and maintain data reconciliation processes to verify accuracy, completeness, and consistency between source and target systems.
  • Ensure consistency of enterprise asset and location hierarchies across healthcare technology management and Real-Time Location Systems (RTLS).
  • Define data integration and reporting requirements for enterprise systems, including the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW).
  • Support the transition of existing AEMS/MERS data feeds to the modernized EAM/CMMS environment.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and support the development of operational reports and dashboards.
  • Develop and maintain enterprise data dictionaries, mapping specifications, transformation rules, and data lineage documentation.
  • Coordinate with data engineers, developers, and technical stakeholders to resolve data integration and migration challenges.
  • Identify and manage technical dependencies, data quality risks, and migration-related issues.
  • Support data migration testing, validation, defect resolution, and post-deployment reconciliation activities.
  • Maintain technical documentation and reusable migration artifacts to support future facility deployments.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and Planning Interval (PI) activities.
  • Collaborate with Agile teams to estimate data engineering work and align migration activities with sprint commitments.
  • Provide technical guidance and recommendations regarding data architecture, integration, migration strategies, and data quality improvements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on data reliability, migration efficiency, and enterprise data management.

Qualifications

  • Minimum eight years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or enterprise data management.
  • Minimum three years of experience serving as a Data Architect, Data Engineering Lead, or comparable technical leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading at least one large-scale migration from a legacy system to a modern enterprise platform, including data mapping, cleansing, validation, and cutover.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, relational database design, and enterprise data modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark (PySpark), or comparable cloud data platforms such as Snowflake or Azure Synapse.
  • Experience using Python for data transformation, validation, and processing.
  • Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and enterprise data integration workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing data quality rules, conducting data profiling, and resolving data inconsistencies at scale.
  • Experience developing source-to-target mapping specifications, transformation rules, and data dictionaries.
  • Strong understanding of data migration methodologies, including trial loads, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning.
  • Experience designing and maintaining logical and physical data models.
  • Ability to translate complex technical data requirements into clear documentation that business stakeholders can review and approve.
  • Experience collaborating with data engineers, application developers, business analysts, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to independently manage technical priorities and coordinate data architecture activities across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) or Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), including Nuvolo, IBM Maximo, or ServiceNow EAM.
  • Experience working with ServiceNow Import Sets, Transform Maps, and enterprise data loading processes.
  • Familiarity with Databricks Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.
  • Experience implementing master data management practices, particularly for enterprise asset and location hierarchies.
  • Experience extracting and transforming data from VA VistA, FileMan, or comparable legacy healthcare information systems.
  • Experience supporting phased, site-by-site, or wave-based enterprise data migration initiatives.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), or other federal healthcare IT programs.
  • Experience working within SAFe Agile development environments.
  • Familiarity with enterprise data governance, metadata management, and data lineage practices.
  • Experience developing enterprise reporting datasets and supporting business intelligence solutions.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional certification.
  • Certified SAFe Architect certification.
  • Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate or AWS Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.
  • DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) certification.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Four additional years of professional experience in data engineering or data architecture may substitute for the bachelor's degree.

Required Certification:

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.
  • Candidates who do not currently hold this certification must obtain it within six months of hire.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a VA Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential.
  • Must meet the VA residency requirement of residing in the United States for at least three of the previous five years.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $86,000 to $165,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

Job Description:

Job Title: Director, Strategy and M&A

Location: Remote USA
Reports to: Chief Strategy Officer

Employment Type: Full-time

This is an existing vacancy

About the Role:

The Director, Strategy and M&A is a key member of the Corporate Strategy/M&A team responsible for developing the analytical foundation that supports enterprise strategy and acquisition decisions. The role develops financial models and investment analysis for M&A opportunities, conducts strategic deep dives across the business, and contributes to the company’s competitive intelligence activities. The role will make extensive use of AI-enabled approaches and AI tools to deliver results with greater speed, efficiency and accuracy.

In this role, you will support 3 elements of the strategy team which include: Corporate Strategy, M&A, and Competitive Intelligence:

1. Corporate Strategy Support

  • Support multi-year strategic planning cycles, annual strategy refreshes and cross-functional strategic initiatives, connecting enterprise strategy, operating plans and capital allocation priorities
  • Conduct strategic and financial deep dives into growth, margins, revenue trends, customer segments, whitespace, risks and new business opportunities
  • Maintain analysis of customer segments and workflows, including Total Addressable Market, revenue penetration and growth opportunity assessments

· Develop concise, decision-oriented presentations, recommendations and analytical frameworks for executive leadership and the Board

2. M&A Pipeline Building, Financial Modeling & Due Diligence

  • Support acquisition pipeline development by identifying and profiling opportunities aligned with the company’s M&A strategy and maintaining related tracking and reporting
  • Build standalone target, transaction and synergy models (including P&L, cash flow, valuation, returns, pro forma impact and sensitivity analysis), in close coordination with Sponsor deal team
  • Develop decision-ready presentations that clearly connect financial outputs with strategic rationale and key risks
  • Conduct financial and analytical work supporting M&A due diligence, gathering and validating financial, commercial and operational data
  • Partner with the Transformation Office on due diligence process management and diligence conclusions

3. Competitive Intelligence Support

  • Monitor automotive industry dynamics, technology trends, customer needs and competitive developments to identify strategic inflection points, risks and growth opportunities
  • Conduct quantitative and strategic analysis of emerging and established competitors
  • Manage the CI SharePoint portal and CI tip line and develop competitor profiles and executive-level competitive assessments

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in corporate development/M&A, investment banking, strategy consulting, or corporate strategy, with direct deal experience
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including valuation, transaction structuring, and returns analysis
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple transactions or workstreams in parallel, including coordination of external advisors
  • Experience in automotive, mobility, or data and analytics preferred
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and executive communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations
  • Ability to leverage AI tools to execute research, modeling and analysis; experience with building and using AI agents
  • High degree of judgment, credibility, and discretion in handling sensitive strategic and financial matters
  • Proven ability to work across functions without formal authority and operate effectively in a virtual environment

Preferred Qualifications:

· Background in automotive, mobility, or data and analytics

· Current awareness of generative AI and agentic tools, and the ability to apply them to strategic thinking and planning needs


Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $167,500 - $210,000 USD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. jobs.title: Freelance Data Product Lead voor Finance, Procurement & Sales (50%)
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Doel van de opdracht Als Reporting & Data Product Lead coördineer je de data- en reportingnoden binnen Finance, Procurement en Verkoop.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Doel van de opdracht

Als Reporting & Data Product Lead coördineer je de data- en reportingnoden binnen Finance, Procurement en Verkoop. Je bewaakt het overzicht en de inhoudelijke kwaliteit van de oplossingen. Daarnaast ondersteun je de Business Information Analysts (BIA's) en Product Owners, structureer je noden en prioriteiten en vertaal je businessbehoeften waar mogelijk naar duurzame, herbruikbare data-oplossingen in plaats van afzonderlijke rapporten of point solutions.

Je geeft richting aan productteams zodat zij:

  • data- en reportingnoden gestructureerd capteren en prioriteren;
  • data-initiatieven vertalen naar PI Objectives, features en backlogitems;
  • afhankelijkheden tussen productteams zichtbaar maken;
  • gevalideerde dataproducten opbouwen;
  • sneller tot kwalitatieve oplossingen komen;
  • self-service en hergebruik van data mogelijk maken, in overleg met de data solution architect en de coördinator van het digitale platform.

Omschrijving van de opdracht

1. Inhoudelijke regie over data en reporting

  • Je brengt de belangrijkste data- en reportingnoden binnen Finance, Procurement en Verkoop in kaart.
  • Samen met de BIA's beoordeel je hoe deze noden het best worden opgelost, bijvoorbeeld via embedded reporting in SAP, dataproducten of Power BI.
  • Je bewaakt dat oplossingen vertrekken vanuit onderliggende businessconcepten, data en herbruikbaarheid, en niet uitsluitend vanuit één individueel rapport.
  • Je detecteert gemeenschappelijke noden over productteams heen en voorkomt waar mogelijk dubbele of tegenstrijdige oplossingen.
  • Je bewaakt mee de definities, business rules en het consistente gebruik van data.

2. Evolutie naar dataproducten

Je neemt het voortouw in de evolutie van end-to-end analyses vanuit SAP S/4HANA naar gevalideerde dataproducten met een passende oplossing voor het leveren van inzichten.

  • Je identificeert welke data logisch als herbruikbaar dataproduct kan worden aangeboden.
  • Je stemt de scope, businessdefinities, kwaliteit en ownership van deze dataproducten af.
  • Je werkt samen met BIA's, Data Engineers, de coördinator van het digitale platform en de data solution architect aan de gewenste oplossing.
  • Je bewaakt dat gemaakte keuzes aansluiten op de bredere data-architectuur en geldende standaarden.
  • Je faciliteert het hergebruik van dataproducten voor verschillende rapporten, analyses en use cases.

3. Ondersteunen en richting geven aan BIA's

  • Je bent een inhoudelijk klankbord en sparringpartner voor de BIA's binnen de betrokken productteams.
  • Je helpt hen om complexe data- en reportingvragen te structureren.
  • Je reviewt waar nodig analyses en voorgestelde oplossingen.
  • Je draagt bij aan een uniforme werkwijze en een consistent kwaliteitsniveau over de verschillende productteams heen.
  • Je stimuleert kennisdeling en samenwerking tussen BIA's.

4. Prioritering en PI-planning

  • Je ondersteunt BIA's bij het concretiseren van data- en reportinginitiatieven voor de PI-planning.
  • Je helpt initiatieven op te delen in haalbare stappen, features en backlogitems.
  • Je brengt afhankelijkheden en de benodigde capaciteit van BIA's en Data Engineers in kaart.
  • Samen met de betrokken Product Owners bewaak je de voortgang van de belangrijkste data- en reportingdoelstellingen.
  • Je signaleert tijdig blokkades, ontbrekende beslissingen en capaciteitstekorten.
  • Je ondersteunt de prioritering op basis van businesswaarde, afhankelijkheden en technische randvoorwaarden.

📝 Jouw profiel

We zoeken een senior profiel dat business, data en delivery met elkaar verbindt.

Vereiste ervaring

  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring in Business Intelligence, Data Warehouse, data-analyse, data-architectuur of vergelijkbare rollen.
  • Ervaring met het vertalen van complexe businessnoden naar schaalbare data- en BI-oplossingen.
  • Ervaring met moderne dataplatformen en dataproductconcepten.
  • Ervaring met samenwerking tussen business analysts of BIA's, Data Engineers, architecten en Product Owners.
  • Ervaring met Agile werken, bij voorkeur in een SAFe-context.
  • Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement en prioritering over meerdere teams heen.
  • Sterke kennis van data modelling, dimensionele modellen, reportingarchitectuur en semantische modellen.
  • Goede kennis van Power BI, inclusief datamodellering en het opbouwen en gebruiken van semantische modellen.

Competenties

  • Je doorgrondt snel complexe bedrijfsprocessen en databronnen.
  • Je werkt vlot samen met zowel business stakeholders als technische profielen.
  • Je bewaakt een doelarchitectuur zonder de voortgang onnodig te belemmeren.
  • Je stelt oplossingsrichtingen en prioriteiten kritisch in vraag.
  • Je hebt een sterke focus op hergebruik, standaardisatie, datakwaliteit en businesswaarde.

Pluspunten

  • Ervaring met Databricks en/of lakehouse-architecturen.
  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen of operationaliseren van dataproducten.
  • Ervaring binnen de domeinen Finance, Procurement en/of Sales.
  • Ervaring met SAP.
  • Ervaring met data governance.

⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (60%).

THE ROLE

The Data Quality Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing the data quality framework across the enterprise lakehouse platform. This role ensures that data assets meet defined quality standards through automated validation, monitoring, anomaly detection, and incident management, building trust in data across the organization. 


***This position is open to candidates currently based in Hungary who have the legal right to live and work in the country. Only shortlisted candidates who meet these requirements will be contacted regarding next steps.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

▸  Design and implement a comprehensive data quality framework covering completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness 

▸  Build automated data quality test suites using Great Expectations, dbt tests, or Soda Core 

▸  Develop data quality dashboards and scorecards to provide visibility to data producers and consumers 

▸  Implement anomaly detection and data observability solutions (Monte Carlo, Bigeye, or custom solutions) 

▸  Integrate quality checks into CI/CD pipelines to prevent bad data from reaching production 

▸  Define and manage SLAs for data quality at the pipeline and data product level 

▸  Triage and resolve data quality incidents, coordinating with upstream source owners 

▸  Collaborate with data governance team to enforce quality rules aligned with business glossary definitions 

▸  Profile new data sources as part of the onboarding process to establish baseline quality benchmarks 

▸  Educate data engineering and product teams on data quality standards and measurement approaches 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

▸  2-4 years in data engineering, data quality, or analytics engineering roles 

▸  Hands-on experience with data quality tools: Great Expectations, dbt tests, Soda, Monte Carlo, or similar 

▸  Strong SQL and Python skills for writing validation logic and quality metric queries 

▸  Experience with Apache Spark or dbt for large-scale data transformation and testing 

▸  Familiarity with data profiling techniques and statistical approaches to anomaly detection 

▸  Knowledge of data observability concepts and their application in lakehouse environments 

▸  Experience with Airflow or similar orchestration tools to schedule quality jobs 

▸  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or related field 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

▸  Experience with Databricks or Snowflake data quality native features 

▸  Knowledge of DataHub or data catalog integration for quality score publishing 

▸  Familiarity with data contracts and shift-left quality approaches in data mesh architectures 

What Dynata Can Offer You


In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive range of benefits tailored to each country. Our benefits are designed to support your well-being and help you achieve a healthy work-life balance.

Dynata is the world’s largest first-party data and insights platform. With a reach that encompasses 62 million consumers and business professionals globally, and an extensive library of individual profile attributes collected through surveys, Dynata is the cornerstone for precise, trustworthy quality data. The company has built innovative data services and solutions around its robust first-party data offering to bring the voice of the customer to the entire marketing continuum – from strategy, innovation, and branding to advertising, measurement, and optimization. jobs.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Integration Engineer – Enterprise Asset Management (EAM/CMMS) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program within the Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) product line.
jobs.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Integration Engineer – Enterprise Asset Management (EAM/CMMS) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program within the Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) product line.

The Integration Engineer will design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise system integrations supporting VA's Enterprise Asset Management/Computerized Maintenance Management System (EAM/CMMS), built on the Nuvolo and ServiceNow platforms.

This position is responsible for developing secure and reliable interfaces, building REST APIs, supporting enterprise data exchange, and ensuring interoperability between EAM/CMMS and critical VA financial, logistics, healthcare technology, and reporting systems.

The EAM/CMMS initiative supports the modernization of VA medical equipment tracking and maintenance operations, replacing legacy systems including Maximo Enterprise Asset and Work Management (EAWM) and the Automated Engineering Management System/Medical Equipment Reporting System (AEMS/MERS). The selected candidate will collaborate with the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP) team, application developers, integration specialists, and technical stakeholders to develop and sustain interfaces connecting EAM/CMMS with iFAMS, the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW), and other enterprise platforms.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise system integrations supporting VA's EAM/CMMS platform.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs, integration services, and data exchange interfaces using ServiceNow and Nuvolo technologies.
  • Build and maintain ServiceNow query APIs, filters, and integration endpoints supporting capital asset data exchange through the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP).
  • Develop receiving endpoints and integration processes for depreciation data transmitted from the Integrated Financial and Acquisition Management System (iFAMS) through VALIP.
  • Collaborate with VALIP integration and platform teams to define connection requirements, payload structures, interface schedules, and error-handling procedures.
  • Develop, maintain, and update Interface Control Documents (ICDs), API specifications, technical interface requirements, and integration documentation.
  • Coordinate interface requirements, technical reviews, and approval activities with partner system teams and VA stakeholders.
  • Evaluate and implement integration solutions connecting EAM/CMMS with healthcare technology management systems and Real-Time Location Systems (RTLS).
  • Configure and support single sign-on (SSO) integrations with VA identity management services.
  • Implement and maintain automated user provisioning processes within the ServiceNow environment.
  • Develop and maintain secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, or comparable technologies.
  • Design and execute end-to-end integration testing across enterprise systems, including payload validation, transaction processing, and data reconciliation.

About Us:

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. Job Description:

About the Role

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be the finance-literate point of contact for customers' Controllers, FP&A teams, and CFO offices. You will resolve product issues that touch accounting logic, and you will help customers understand why their numbers look the way they do. This role combines technical troubleshooting with finance advisory, so both skill sets are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Case resolution

  • Own and resolve support cases within SLAs across consolidation, budgeting, and reporting workloads.
  • Diagnose issues in currency translation, intercompany processing, trial-balance mappings, data flows, and time-based aggregations (YTD, QTD, HTD) and summary methods.
  • Reproduce issues in test environments, using event logs, error messages, and customer recordings to isolate root cause.
  • Separate product defects from enhancement requests, set clear expectations with customers, and log well-documented tickets with reproduction steps.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Product, Cloud/DevOps, and Customer Success, providing escalations that state business impact clearly.

Finance advisory

  • Explain to finance users how the platform applies accounting logic, including consolidation methods, FX rates, eliminations, account roll-ups, and P&L versus balance-sheet aggregation.
  • Advise on configuration choices for budget versions, scenarios, locking, and cycle opening.
  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles for recurring finance questions.

Continuous improvement

  • Contribute to triage playbooks and AI-assisted support tools and help improve their training data.

Mandatory Qualifications

Education and certification

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or Economics, or an equivalent qualification.
  • Professional qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, or CFA) or an MBA in Finance is a strong plus.

Finance experience

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in at least two of: financial consolidation, budgeting and planning, corporate accounting, or the financial close.
  • Working knowledge of the consolidation process, including entity hierarchies and ownership, FX translation (average versus closing rates), intercompany matching and elimination, and chart-of-accounts mapping.
  • Understanding of budget, actual, and forecast versioning, and of aggregation rules for P&L versus balance-sheet items.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one corporate performance management (CPM) or enterprise performance management (EPM) platform.
  • Experience supporting finance users in a customer-facing or ticket-based support role.

Technical skills

  • Advanced Excel: complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and Excel add-ins.
  • Basic-to-intermediate SQL, and familiarity with data flows, ETL, or mapping concepts.
  • Ability to read logs, error messages, and API responses (for example, OData responses or REST calls via Postman).

Communication

  • Clear written and spoken English for customer and engineering communication.
  • Ability to explain accounting outcomes to finance users who are not technical.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-currency, multi-entity group reporting across EMEA or APAC.
  • Experience with ERP-to-planning integrations and ERP finance modules.
  • Familiarity with SaaS and private-cloud architectures, single sign-on, and network or allow-listing troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of ticketing and CRM systems.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-enabled support platforms.

Core Competencies

  • Finance-led troubleshooting: starting from the business outcome and working back to the cause.
  • Clear communication with non-technical finance stakeholders.
  • Prioritization under SLA pressure, across multiple customers and time zones.
  • Judgment on when to escalate, and on distinguishing defects from enhancements.
  • Openness to new tools and AI-assisted workflows.

jobs.excerpt: Founding Product Lead · Remote in Europe · Copenhagen HQ · Full-time · Warrants We've just closed our seed round to take Denmark's cemeteries digital.
jobs.description:
Founding Product Lead · Remote in Europe · Copenhagen HQ · Full-time · Warrants

We've just closed our seed round to take Denmark's cemeteries digital. The person in this seat will decide much of what we build across Europe and beyond.

This isn't a PM job. You'll own outcomes, not a backlog. You'll spend real time on cemeteries with gardeners and church councils, and you'll prototype and ship concepts yourself. If you've founded something, or were early at a startup that took off, we especially want to hear from you.

About Us

Most cemeteries still run on paper maps, spreadsheets and the memory of whoever has worked there longest. Memora replaces that with one platform for everyone who touches a cemetery: the councils and municipalities that run it, the gardeners who look after the graves, and the families who pay for that care and want to see it done.

We're live with cemeteries across Denmark and freshly funded. We're deliberately lean, and plan to stay that way.

The Why

Memora is growing rapidly. We’re selling into a sector with almost no true digital presence, which means no playbook to copy and no competitor roadmap to trail. We need someone who can:

  • Get the truth from the field - working with our cemetery leaders, gardeners, and family groups — rather than from a meeting room
  • Turn messy sector reality (Danish structures, legacy systems, public-sector procurement) into product decisions Memora builds from.
  • Prioritise ruthlessly across live surfaces and say no with reasons
  • Own outcomes you can measure, not features you can list

Who you are

Must have:

  • You've shipped something end to end that people use: as a founder, early employee, or product lead
  • Genuinely comfortable doing fieldwork: you’re comfortable walking cemeteries in the rain and learn more there than anywhere else. Talk with customers, cemetery leaders, gardeners. Break down the data sources, run our product summits with the userbase.
  • Strong written communication — you can make a complex trade-off legible in a page, and you understand useful specs
  • Technical enough to hold a conversation about trade-offs, and to read the data yourself
  • Comfortable operating in a small team who’s done this before, without the playbook: you can scope your own work, write your own docs, and chase your own answers

Strongly preferred:

  • B2B/B2G SaaS experience: sales cycles, real customer relationships, public-sector quirks
  • Operations-heavy or field-workforce products, where the software has to survive contact with a real working day
  • Experience with compliance-sensitive data (we’re GDPR + public-sector)
  • Marketplace or two-sided product experience

Bonus:

  • Experience with cemetery or public records systems
  • You have run discovery in a sector that had never been sold software before

A Note on AI

Yes, we lean hard on AI tools and we expect you to as well. We ship to municipalities managing data for real families, so the bar is well-researched, well-argued, human-owned decisions, not “the model said it was a good idea.”

We treat these tools like a sharp junior colleague: fast, occasionally brilliant, frequently wrong, and never the final authority. For a product role that means using them to move faster through research, synthesis, and drafting — while still being the person who talked to the customer, who knows why the trade-off went that way, and who can defend it in the room. “AI wrote it” is never a defence in a postmortem.

If that distinction is obvious to you, we should talk. If your instinct is to paste this post into Claude and ask for “the final application, make no mistakes”, wrong place. We’re hiring humans, not the sub-agents we already work with and know well.

How we work

We’re building Memora to be the kind of company we’d want to work for ourselves: high trust, low bureaucracy, and full of people who care deeply about doing great work and giving back.

  • We’re remote by design. We expect ownership, communication, and roughly 4 hours of overlap with Copenhagen (CET).
  • We believe great work and great lives aren’t in competition with each other. Remote work means your whole life doesn’t stop when work starts and that’s a good thing by us. Families, school pickups, deep-focus afternoons: we welcome the whole human. We optimize for people doing the best work of their careers while still having a life they’re excited to live.
  • We’re a small team by design, which means you’ll have real autonomy and real influence. Everyone talks to customers, helps onboard them, visits cemeteries, and sees first-hand how their work impacts real people.
  • Low ego and high standards. We challenge ideas, admit mistakes, ask questions, and care more about getting to the right answer than being right. Psychological safety matters here, and so does excellence.
  • We’re async-first and intentionally lightweight. We write things down, keep meetings purposeful, and avoid process for process’ sake. Our default approach is simple: communicate clearly, make good decisions, and ship.
  • And because we’re building a real team, not just a collection of Slack profiles and titles, we get together for an offsite every quarter somewhere in the world. From skiing trips to sailing excursions, we work this way from a deep belief that the best ideas don’t always happen in a meeting room, but maybe from a chairlift.

Compensation & equity

  • Senior salary
  • Meaningful warrant grant: we’re early enough that this matters and we want you for the full journey
  • Annual leave + Danish-equivalent benefits
  • Quarterly offsites around the world

This role owns the end-to-end pipeline, from hosting and operating locally deployed large language models, to ingesting and extracting text from document images (PDF and TIFF), to engineering and refining prompts, to validating results and writing structured output to SQL Server. The position works closely with Clinical Quality Analysts (CQA), who independently audit AI output, and with the Project Management Office, IT, Cybersecurity, and Compliance to ensure solutions are accurate, secure, and compliant with HIPAA and organizational standards.

Location: Remote

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Deploy, configure, and maintain locally hosted large language models, including the supporting GPU/server infrastructure, inference serving, and model version management.
  • Evaluate, benchmark, and recommend new or updated on-premises models as the technology evolves.
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines that retrieve documents (PDF, TIFF) from network shares and perform OCR and text extraction.
  • Design, test, and iteratively refine prompts and structured-output logic to improve accuracy, consistency, and reliability for each project.
  • Validate AI output programmatically and write results to SQL Server, ensuring data integrity and traceability.
  • Compile and deliver results to CQA for audit; analyze CQA findings to determine what should change in prompts, extraction, or model configuration.
  • Manage multiple concurrent AI projects in collaboration with the PMO, maintaining test sets, accuracy metrics, and version history of prompts and workflows.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity and Compliance to ensure on-premises AI systems, data handling, and access controls meet HIPAA, data-governance, and organizational security requirements.
  • Track usage and performance data and report on accuracy, throughput, and ROI to leadership.
  • Provide occasional prompt support for hosted AI tools (e.g., Box AI) as needed.
  • Maintain documentation of architectures, workflows, test results, and configurations.
  • Stay current with developments in open-weight language models, OCR/document AI, and model-serving technology.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to advance the organization’s AI strategy and innovation initiatives.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong understanding of large language models, including the practical limits of locally hosted models (context size, quantization, throughput, hardware requirements).
  • Proficiency in Python for pipeline development, automation, and data handling.
  • Experience deploying and operating models in a self-hosted environment, including GPU infrastructure, inference serving, and Linux or Windows server administration.
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server, including writing and troubleshooting queries and inserts (AI-assisted proficiency acceptable).
  • Experience with OCR and document-processing workflows for scanned or image-based documents (PDF, TIFF).
  • Strong prompt-engineering skills, including structured/JSON output design and systematic accuracy testing.
  • Ability to measure and communicate model accuracy using test sets, metrics, and reviewer feedback.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA, data privacy, and security principles related to AI and PHI.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with clinical, technical, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with strong documentation habits and attention to detail.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • 1+ years of experience deploying or working with language models, NLP, or automation systems.
  • Demonstrated experience building prompt-based or document-processing workflows for business use.
  • Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries is a plus.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This position primarily involves seated work in an office or remote environment.
  • Occasional standing, walking, and lifting of objects up to 25 pounds may be required.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: Summary Banks and fintechs are rebuilding how money moves.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Summary

Banks and fintechs are rebuilding how money moves. Embedded finance, real-time payments and programmable money movement are now on the roadmap for both. CSI is delivering the modern infrastructure behind that shift through business lines including Qolo and Apiture. In this role you’ll own the content that explains why that infrastructure matters. You’ll lead content strategy and creation for two audiences, commercial banks and fintechs. You’ll turn deep technical capabilities into clear, credible content that wins over bank and treasury leaders, product executives and technical buyers.


Responsibilities

Qolo content strategy and planning (primary focus)

  • Build and manage Qolo’s content strategy and editorial calendar for enterprise commercial banking and fintech audiences, in line with business goals, product launches and demand generation programs.
  • Set content priorities using market, competitive and customer research, and help develop research studies and analyze what they find.
  • Bring Qolo’s point of view on embedded banking, payments infrastructure and the future of commercial money movement to life through compelling stories and assets

Creation

  • Write and edit content in many formats: thought leadership, white papers, solution briefs, use cases, blogs, website and campaign copy, executive communications, sales enablement materials and multimedia scripts.
  • Translate technical capabilities such as virtual accounts, ledgering, card issuing, ACH, RTP and FedNow, and programmable money movement into clear, persuasive content for business and technical buyers.
  • Partner with product, engineering and subject matter experts to get technical content right.

Cross-brand support (CSI and Apiture)

  • Support CSI and Apiture content needs as priorities require, and adapt your voice and messaging to each brand’s audience and standards.
  • Help keep the story consistent where the brands overlap.

Editorial governance

  • Own Qolo’s editorial standards and content review process, in line with the broader CSI style guide.
  • Review content for clarity, technical accuracy, consistency and brand voice.

Measurement and optimization

  • Track content performance with analytics and SEO tools, and report on engagement, pipeline contribution and business impact.
  • Use the results to guide current and future content plans.

Collaboration

  • Lead content projects across demand generation, product marketing, digital, sales and communications teams.
  • Support sales with content for enterprise bank and fintech buyer journeys, including new-logo and expansion deals.
  • Manage content resources and budgets, including freelance writers and agencies where needed.
  • Use new tools, including AI-enabled content tools, to improve quality and efficiency.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, journalism or a related field, with a strong portfolio of B2B content.
  • Experience creating content for payments, commercial banking, banking-as-a-service, embedded finance, fintech or other complex financial technology audiences.
  • Strong understanding of payments and banking concepts, with the ability to quickly learn and write credibly about complex topics.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical concepts into clear, compelling content for business and technical audiences.
  • Experience developing a range of content, including thought leadership, long-form editorial, digital content and sales enablement.
  • Experience developing content strategies tied to business priorities and using performance data to assess and improve results.
  • Strong organizational and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage priorities across multiple brands, business units and contributors.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, CMS platforms and content analytics; familiarity with AP style and AI-assisted content tools is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, English or a related field, or equivalent experience.

As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit

CSI provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for our employees. When determining your pay, we consider various factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience and location. Along with a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for incentive awards based on both individual and business performance. We also offer a comprehensive range of benefits. To learn more about our benefits, visit: Benefits Summary

CSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email us at and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

For applicants residing in California, please read Privacy Notice for California Residents | CSI (csiweb.com)
