jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Marketing Manager

Location: South Africa

Job Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Marketing Manager to take full ownership of a growing company’s marketing strategy, brand positioning, digital presence and lead-generation activities.

This is a senior, hands-on marketing leadership role for someone who can develop the strategy and lead its execution from beginning to end. You will be responsible for strengthening the brand, improving search visibility, generating high-quality leads and developing sustainable referral and partnership channels.

This is not a social media coordinator or content-posting position. We are looking for a commercially minded marketing professional who understands how SEO, paid advertising, content, social media, brand strategy, campaigns and website performance work together to generate measurable business results.

You will have the autonomy to outsource specialist work such as graphic design, web development, copywriting or motion graphics when required, while remaining accountable for the overall strategy, quality and results.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and own the company’s overall marketing and brand strategy.
  • Translate business objectives into clear marketing priorities, campaigns and measurable targets.
  • Create and execute an integrated marketing plan across digital, referral and brand-development channels.
  • Manage campaigns from initial concept through execution, measurement and optimisation.
  • Advise senior leadership on market positioning, growth opportunities and marketing priorities.
  • Build and develop the marketing function as the company grows.
  • Identify when additional specialist support, agencies or contractors are required.

Brand Strategy

  • Strengthen and consistently manage the company’s brand across all platforms.
  • Develop clear and compelling messaging for clients, families, referral partners and other key stakeholders.
  • Ensure all marketing materials reflect a professional, credible and consistent brand.
  • Oversee external designers, copywriters and creative specialists where required.
  • Maintain high standards across all marketing output.

SEO, Website & Digital Performance

  • Develop and execute an SEO strategy to improve search visibility, rankings and organic traffic.
  • Conduct keyword, competitor and market research.
  • Improve website content, structure, user experience and conversion performance.
  • Monitor website traffic, user behaviour, lead sources and conversion data.
  • Identify opportunities to improve website performance and lead conversion.
  • Coordinate website improvements with external developers or specialists.
  • Ensure digital activity is focused on meaningful business outcomes and lead generation.

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, manage and optimise Google Ads and other relevant paid advertising campaigns.
  • Develop campaigns focused on generating high-quality, relevant leads.
  • Monitor campaign performance, budgets, conversion rates and cost per lead.
  • Test and optimise messaging, audiences, landing pages and campaign strategies.
  • Analyse results and make data-driven recommendations.
  • Provide clear reporting on performance, challenges, opportunities and recommended adjustments.

Content, Social Media & Campaigns

  • Develop a content and social media strategy aligned with broader commercial objectives.
  • Oversee the creation of website content, social media content, campaigns and marketing materials.
  • Ensure content is relevant, accurate, engaging and appropriate for a professional healthcare environment.
  • Build brand awareness, engagement and trust across relevant platforms.
  • Manage marketing and campaign calendars and ensure consistent execution.
  • Ensure content supports lead generation and business growth rather than simply focusing on engagement metrics.

Referral & Partnership Marketing

  • Develop strategies to strengthen professional referral relationships.
  • Identify opportunities to generate leads through partnerships, professional networks and community relationships.
  • Develop campaigns and marketing materials that support referral growth.
  • Track referral sources and determine which activities generate the strongest results.
  • Develop sustainable relationship-based lead-generation channels.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Significant experience in a senior marketing, marketing management or brand strategy role.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing an end-to-end marketing strategy.
  • Strong practical knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, social media, digital campaigns, websites and lead generation.
  • Proven track record of generating measurable leads and improving digital marketing performance.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and use it to drive decisions.
  • Experience managing external agencies, designers, developers, copywriters or other specialist providers.
  • Strong understanding of the US market and US consumer behaviour.
  • Excellent written communication skills.
  • Strong strategic thinking, organisation and project management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take complete ownership of marketing delivery.
  • A portfolio or clear evidence of successful campaigns and measurable marketing outcomes will be required.

Highly Advantageous

  • Experience within healthcare, home care, behavioural health, ABA or another regulated service environment.
  • Experience marketing services to US-based audiences.
  • Familiarity with healthcare referral networks and relationship-based lead generation.
  • Experience building, restructuring or scaling an in-house marketing function.
  • Experience working with service-based businesses where lead generation and conversion are key performance indicators.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

About Us

At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed.

And now we are looking for an Engineering Manager to join us as part of our team.

About the role

PitchBook — a platform for investment professionals. Our software provides access to data and the analytical tools to get answers fast and discover promising opportunities. Uncovers actionable insights and trends hidden within the financial data of millions of companies. Users all over the world include large corporations, start-ups, venture capital and private equity firms, investment banks, and many others.

Data Collection Technology is a core technology domain responsible for ingesting, processing, managing, and publishing data to the main platform. It combines a suite of battle-proven legacy data collection tools with a modern data collection platform.
The broader data management platform provides a unified environment for managing and validating data across both private and public markets. It brings together multiple tools and workflows, standardizes quality-assurance processes, and enables scalable automation for data operations.

As an Engineering Manager in PitchBook’s DataTech team, you will be responsible for ensuring your teams execute well and deliver the outcomes they commit to. Your primary focus will be strengthening delivery capabilities and helping teams improve planning, execution and predictability.

You will also ensure effective platform-wide operational processes, including customer support and incident management. People management and team development remain important responsibilities, with successful and sustainable delivery as the primary focus.

Tech Stack: Java 21, Kubernetes/GitOps, Spring Boot, MFE Architecture, OpenAPI, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Redis

Team setup: 2 teams

Work Environment: ​​flexible

As a qualified expert You will

Own delivery and engineering outcomes for DataTech teams

  • Be accountable for delivery, velocity, quality, reliability and scalability
  • Ensure work is aligned with DataTech priorities, using effective visualization and reporting to understand delivery, identify problems and drive improvements

Ensure strong SDLC execution and technical quality

  • Ensure teams execute effectively across refinement, design, estimation, implementation, testing and deployment
  • Identify execution gaps and work with SDE Leads to improve how delivery works
  • Invest in improving a AI-enabled SDLC, including adoption and evolution of SDD frameworks and practices

Plan and manage capacity

  • Own short- and long-term capacity and capability planning
  • Allocate people in line with DataTech priorities and delivery commitments
  • Surface capacity and delivery risks and drive mitigation

Own product quality, reliability and operations

  • Be accountable for stability, reliability, performance and overall quality
  • Ensure effective platform-wide customer support, incident management, observability and other operational processes
  • Balance delivery with technical health and operational needs

Lead and grow engineers and SDE Leads

  • Manage engineers and SDE Leads through coaching, feedback, growth and performance management
  • Build and evolve teams through hiring, onboarding and shaping the right skill mix
  • Maintain healthy team dynamics and address people issues early

Strengthen ways of working and collaboration

  • Improve engineering practices where they help teams deliver more effectively
  • Partner with Product, Data and other domains to align plans and manage dependencies
  • Contribute to domain-level planning and cross-team collaboration

We’re looking for you if you have

  • Proven engineering leadership experience managing multiple software/data engineering teams
  • Strong track record of delivery, including improving planning, prioritization and execution
  • Ability to use delivery data, visualization and reporting to identify problems and drive improvements
  • Strong people-management skills: coaching, performance management and team development
  • Strong technical judgment and ability to work with engineering leads to improve delivery practices, including effective use of GenAI and SDD
  • Clear communication and collaboration skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Ownership mindset: accountable for delivery as well as long-term quality and maintainability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Bonus points

  • Experience in DataTech-like domains (data ingestion, processing, curation).
  • Familiarity with Stream-Aligned Teams / Team Topologies.
  • Experience working with Architecture, Platform, SRE and other enabling teams.
  • Experience improving observability, reliability and incident management for backend/data services.

What’s in it for You

Reveal great tech solutions

Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling client growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients.

Experience an agile and flexible working environment

Enjoy the freedom of fully remote work with a flexible working schedule. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, supported by provided laptops and licensed software. We focus on lasting cooperation and unite result-oriented individuals who stand on a high-performance approach to work.

Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth

Benefit from performance and merit reviews, elevate your skills with personal development plans, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more.

Be among like-minded people

Work with a team of one mind who cares about what they do and how they do. Collaborate with top-notch experts who are always ready to help and support you through any challenges. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values. Feel supported by your HR, and take advantage of our referral bonus program.

jobs.title: Preparador/a de Ofimática para oposiciones autonómicas y estatales (Office 365 y
jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy ¿Preparas la prueba de ofimática de oposiciones autonómicas o estatales, con Office 365 o LibreOffice?
jobs.description:
🚀 Únete al claustro de preparadores de Polaris x Ucademy

¿Preparas la prueba de ofimática de oposiciones autonómicas o estatales, con Office 365 o LibreOffice? Colabora en remoto con Polaris x Ucademy.

💻 Buscamos preparadores/as de Ofimática para oposiciones

La ofimática es una prueba decisiva, y muchas veces eliminatoria, en las oposiciones de perfil administrativo. Cada administración la examina a su manera: con paquetes distintos, versiones distintas y formatos distintos.

Queremos construir un claustro de preparadores especializados en ofimática para oposiciones, con especial foco en las oposiciones de las comunidades autónomas.

🗺️ Especial foco: oposiciones de las Comunidades Autónomas

Buscamos especialmente preparadores que conozcan la prueba de ofimática de los cuerpos auxiliares y administrativos de las comunidades autónomas, porque es donde más cambia:

  • El paquete ofimático: unas comunidades examinan de Microsoft 365 y otras de LibreOffice (Writer, Calc, Impress, Base).

  • La versión: algunas fijan una versión concreta del programa y otras la última disponible.

  • El formato: test teórico-práctico, supuestos sobre capturas de pantalla o ejercicios delante del ordenador.

Por ejemplo, la Comunidad de Madrid examina de Windows y Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Access, Outlook y herramientas colaborativas como Teams o SharePoint) con un test de ofimática propio; la Xunta de Galicia y la Junta de Andalucía, en cambio, examinan de LibreOffice. Por eso necesitamos preparadores que conozcan a fondo la prueba de cada comunidad.

No necesitas conocerlas todas. Buscamos a quien domine a fondo la prueba de su comunidad, o de varias.

🗂️ Dos tipos de prueba

📝 Ofimática tipo test: preguntas sobre funciones, rutas de menús, opciones y atajos de cada programa, a menudo con supuestos sobre capturas de pantalla.

🖥️ Ofimática práctica: ejercicios reales con tiempo limitado o pruebas específicas de ofimática.

🛠️ Paquetes y herramientas

Microsoft 365

  • Word · Excel · Access · Outlook · PowerPoint

  • Herramientas colaborativas: Teams, SharePoint y OneDrive

LibreOffice

  • Writer · Calc · Impress · Base

Común

  • Windows (10 y 11), explorador de archivos, Internet e informática básica

🏛️ Otras oposiciones en las que también buscamos experiencia

  • Administración General del Estado (Auxiliar y Administrativo)

  • Justicia (Tramitación Procesal y Administrativa)

  • Sanidad (Auxiliar Administrativo y Administrativo)

  • Ferroviarias (áreas administrativas de ADIF y Renfe)

  • Ayuntamientos, diputaciones y universidades (por ejemplo, el Ayuntamiento de Madrid)

🌟 Quiénes somos

En Polaris x Ucademy preparamos oposiciones de una forma más digital, práctica y personalizada. Ya hemos acompañado a miles de opositores y tenemos un objetivo claro: que 10.000 personas consigan su plaza preparándose con nosotros.

Para lograrlo, estamos ampliando nuestro claustro de preparadores de alto rendimiento.

Somos muy digitales, pero lo humano no se negocia. La tecnología nos ayuda a enseñar mejor, y son nuestros preparadores quienes aportan conocimiento, criterio, cercanía y acompañamiento.

🔎 A quién buscamos

  • Preparadores/as de ofimática para oposiciones, sobre todo de cuerpos auxiliares y administrativos autonómicos.

  • Funcionarios/as con plaza que hayan superado la prueba de ofimática de su comunidad y quieran enseñarla.

  • Formadores/as de ofimática (Microsoft 365 o LibreOffice) con interés en el mundo de las oposiciones.

  • Personas que sepan cómo pregunta cada tribunal: qué versión, qué funciones y qué tipo de supuestos.

  • Quienes sepan enseñar y acompañar: explicar paso a paso, detectar errores y hacer fácil lo que parece técnico.

🎯 En qué podrás colaborar

Según tu perfil y disponibilidad, podrás participar en uno o varios proyectos:

  • Clases online de Microsoft 365 o LibreOffice, adaptadas a la prueba de cada comunidad.

  • Preguntas tipo test y supuestos sobre capturas con el formato de cada tribunal.

  • Ejercicios prácticos con tiempo limitado y su corrección.

  • Resolución en vídeo de exámenes oficiales de convocatorias anteriores.

  • Simulacros de la prueba de ofimática.

  • Seguimiento de alumnos, vídeos cortos, esquemas y guías de atajos.

🤝 Cómo funciona la colaboración

No es un puesto de trabajo a jornada completa ni parcial. Colaborarás con Polaris x Ucademy mediante prestación de servicios en proyectos educativos concretos, compatible con tu actividad profesional.

Si tienes plaza, no te pedimos que dejes tu puesto. Queremos que pongas tu experiencia al servicio de otros opositores de una forma flexible.

🌍 100 % remoto
🕐 Horarios y disponibilidad a convenir
📚 Proyectos y entregables definidos desde el inicio
💰 Compensación competitiva según el proyecto y los entregables

🎬 Cómo es el proceso de selección

Queremos conocerte enseñando, no solo leyendo tu CV. El proceso tiene tres pasos:

1. Revisión de perfil. En la candidatura responderás a unas preguntas breves y nos enviarás un vídeo de presentación de 1 minuto. Grábalo con el móvil, sin complicaciones: cuéntanos quién eres, qué paquete ofimático dominas y en qué comunidades u oposiciones estás acostumbrado/a a formar.

2. Contacto de validación. Si tu perfil encaja, nos pondremos en contacto contigo por llamada o por escrito para resolver dudas, conocer tu disponibilidad y explicarte cómo colaboramos.

3. Clase de prueba y entrevista. Agendarás tu entrevista y, antes de la fecha, nos enviarás una clase grabada de máximo 5 minutos: la explicación de un contenido de ofimática o la resolución comentada de varias preguntas tipo test o de un ejercicio práctico, con un material de apoyo creado por ti. Puedes grabar tu pantalla si te resulta más cómodo. No buscamos una producción perfecta: queremos ver cómo explicas y cómo haces sencillo lo difícil.

Si dominas la ofimática de las oposiciones y quieres ayudar a otros a superar esa prueba, queremos conocerte.

Account Executive (Education Technology Advisor)

Opportunity Overview

Inspiroz is at an exciting point in its journey.

Over the past five years, we have experienced significant growth while becoming a trusted technology partner to more than 300 charter and independent schools across the United States. We believe tremendous opportunity remains ahead, and we are intentionally investing in our Sales organization to accelerate that growth.

To support our continued expansion, we are adding another Education Technology Advisor to our Sales team as part of our continued investment in building a high-performing, consultative sales organization.

Our Education Technology Advisors serve as trusted advisors to school leaders, helping them navigate technology challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop solutions that advance their educational mission. Success comes from building relationships, earning trust, understanding each school's unique needs, and guiding prospects through a thoughtful, consultative buying experience.

This is a full-cycle sales role responsible for developing new opportunities, managing the sales process from initial outreach through signed agreement, and building long-term client relationships that contribute to Inspiroz's continued growth.

Up to 25%, travel; including conferences, prospect visits, and client meetings.

About Inspiroz

Inspiroz is a leading provider of managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and technology strategy for charter schools, independent schools, and other mission-driven educational organizations.

For more than 35 years, we have helped organizations leverage technology to achieve their missions. Since entering the K–12 education market in 2012, we have become a trusted technology partner to more than 300 schools across 19 states.

Our success is built on a simple belief: schools deserve a technology partner that understands education. We combine deep technical expertise with a consultative, relationship-driven approach to help school leaders build secure, reliable, and scalable technology environments that allow them to focus on students.

As an EOS® organization committed to accountability, continuous improvement, and servant leadership, we invest heavily in developing our people and creating opportunities for professional growth.

Position Summary

The Education Technology Advisor is responsible for generating profitable new client relationships by identifying opportunities, earning the trust of prospective clients, and converting qualified prospects into long-term Inspiroz partners.

This role owns the full client acquisition lifecycle—from developing new opportunities and building strategic relationships through executing Inspiroz's consultative sales process and successfully transitioning new clients to our service delivery teams.

Successful Education Technology Advisors are disciplined business developers, strong relationship builders, consultative problem solvers, and trusted representatives of the Inspiroz brand.

  • Service Delivery Leadership
  • Technical Subject Matter Experts
  • Client Success and Operations Teams

Why Join Inspiroz

Joining Inspiroz means becoming part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to helping schools leverage technology to better serve students and educators.

Join us!

jobs.excerpt: 📌 Role Snapshot • Position: Remote Trial Class Manager (Independent Contractor) — Arabic-speaking market • What you’ll do: Deliver 1:1 online trial lessons, assess the child’s needs, recommend the most suitable Kodland program, and support the family through the enrollment decision • Typical schedule:25+ hours/week on average, mostly during after-school / evening hours on weekdays, plus daytime weekend slots • Compensation: Fixed pay per completed trial lesson + performance-based bonuses (clear and structured bonus logic) • Training & support: A structured onboarding process with live training, guided practice, and a short assessment before you work with real families If this structure matches your expectations and availability, please review the details below.
jobs.description:
📌 Role Snapshot

  • Position: Remote Trial Class Manager (Independent Contractor) — Arabic-speaking market

  • What you’ll do: Deliver 1:1 online trial lessons, assess the child’s needs, recommend the most suitable Kodland program, and support the family through the enrollment decision

  • Typical schedule:25+ hours/week on average, mostly during after-school / evening hours on weekdays, plus daytime weekend slots

  • Compensation: Fixed pay per completed trial lesson + performance-based bonuses (clear and structured bonus logic)

  • Training & support: A structured onboarding process with live training, guided practice, and a short assessment before you work with real families

If this structure matches your expectations and availability, please review the details below.

1. About Kodland 👨‍💻👩‍💻

Kodland is an international online school that helps children develop practical digital skills and learn how to use technology creatively and responsibly.

  • We teach children aged 8–17, offering programs in Python, Roblox, Minecraft, Digital Creativity, and other modern digital disciplines.

  • Kodland operates globally, working with students and families across Europe, the UK, the USA, CIS, Latin America, MENA, and other regions.

  • All classes are delivered live via Zoom, in 1:1 or small-group formats, with a strong focus on project-based learning.

  • Our mission is to help children grow into confident, logical thinkers with strong technological literacy and problem-solving skills.

🔗 Learn more about Kodland: Kodland — International Online Coding & Design School for Kids (5-17)

2. A Day of a TCM

In this short video, you’ll see:

  • what a typical working day looks like for a Trial Class Manager,

  • when and how TCMs usually work during the week and weekends,

  • how a real trial lesson flows, from the first minutes to the final conversation with the parent.

👉 Please watch this before applying — it will help you decide if this role fits your lifestyle.

3. What Does a Trial Class Manager (TCM) Do? 🎧

A Trial Class Manager (TCM) is responsible for delivering the very first online trial lesson and guiding families through their initial decision about learning with Kodland.

During each trial session, you will:

  • Meet the child and at least one parent via Zoom.

  • Build rapport and ask targeted questions to understand the child’s background, interests, goals, and prior experience.

  • Lead a short hands-on activity (simple coding, game logic, or digital task) using our prepared materials.

  • Recommend the most suitable program and learning format, based on the child’s needs and engagement during the trial.

  • Answer questions, handle basic objections, and guide the family toward a clear “yes/no” decision regarding enrollment.

This role is a combination of:

  • 🎓 Education — explaining concepts clearly and keeping the child engaged

  • 🗣 Communication — listening carefully, asking the right questions, and adapting your approach to each family

  • 💼 Sales — demonstrating value, discussing pricing transparently, and confidently closing when there is a fit

⚠️ Important to note:

This is not a pure teaching role and not a scripted call-center position. You will be provided with structure, materials, and guidance — but you are expected to think independently, adapt to each family, and actively lead the conversation.

4. Requirements ✅

Must-haves

  • Clear, confident spoken Arabic & English

  • A reliable laptop or PC with a working webcam and microphone

  • Stable internet connection suitable for uninterrupted Zoom video calls

  • A quiet, professional workspace with your camera turned on

  • Consistent availability of 20–25 hours per week during prime time

    (weekday afternoons/evenings + daytime weekend hours)

  • Genuine comfort communicating with both children and adults

Nice-to-haves

  • Background in sales, customer service, customer success, tutoring, or coaching

  • Any prior experience working with children and/or parents

  • Experience working remotely and managing your own schedule independently

5. Schedule & Availability 🕒

When do TCMs usually work?

  • Weekdays: primarily between 16:00–22:00 Egypt time

  • Weekends: primarily between 10:00–20:00 Egypt time

The standard setup includes 5 working days per week, with

  • 1 weekday off, and

  • 1 day off on Friday or Saturday.

Exact hours are negotiable, but consistent weekly availability is required so we can plan schedules in advance and reliably allocate trial classes.

Typical workload progression

The usual setup looks like this:

  • After passing probation period:

    You start with 15 trial class hours per week, plus around 3 administrative hours

    (1:1s, team meetings, internal webinars)

  • As you gain experience:

    Your schedule typically increases to 20 trial class hours per week, plus administrative hours

  • Top-performing TCMs:

    Have the opportunity to increase up to 25 trial class hours per week

📌 Note: Administrative hours are paid at the same rate as completed trial classes.

Availability & professionalism

You set your availability together with your Team Leader in advance, and we expect you to honour the time slots you open, so families are not left waiting.

That said, we understand that unexpected situations and force majeure can happen. We approach scheduling humanely and reasonably — the key expectation is professional communication in advance whenever changes are needed so that everything can be handled smoothly.

6. Compensation & Income Model 💶

This is an independent contractor role with performance-based income. Payments are made in EGP twice per month.

🔑 How Your Income Is Built

  1. Base Payment

    You receive a fixed payment for every completed trial class.

  2. Bonus Income

    You earn a percentage of your total monthly sales.

    The higher your conversion rate, the higher your bonus percentage.

Current Model

  • Base payment:100 EGP per completed trial

  • Revenue bonus:3%, 4.5% and 6% of total monthly revenue (depends on your monthly revenue)

💰 What This Means in Real Numbers

The examples below are based on real internal averages.

📌 These figures reflect a part-time role

  • Early stage / newcomers ~ up to 400$ per month (base + bonus)

  • Stable performers ~ up to 700$+ per month

  • Top performers: can reach up to 1200$+ per month

💡

We actively support our managers with regular feedback and performance analysis, as well as ongoing training, webinars, and best-practice sharing. Our goal is to help you grow into stronger performance and, as a result, higher income.

At the same time, it’s important to understand: income growth doesn’t happen instantly and depends on personal skills, learning speed, consistency, and effort. Progress comes step by step. If you’re motivated to learn, reflect, and continuously improve, this role offers real earning potential — even with part-time hours!

7. Training & Hiring Journey 🧭

We don’t send you straight into real classes. There is a clear and structured training journey before you start working with real families.

Your journey with Kodland:

1️⃣ This page + Application Form

You carefully review this page and submit the application form at the bottom.

2️⃣ Recruiter Interview (≈20 minutes, Zoom)

A short call to check your technical setup, English level, basic fit, and expectations.

3️⃣ Training Phase: Self-Study, Webinars & Practice

You get access to our learning platform with all the core materials needed to succeed as a TCM.

This phase includes:

  • structured self-study materials,

  • live webinars explaining the role, income model, schedule, and tools,

  • practical sessions and guided role-plays with feedback.

4️⃣ Assessment Phase: Simulated Trial Classes

You complete simulated trial classes with trainers and your future Team Lead to confirm you’re ready to work with real families.

If needed, you may receive feedback and a second attempt.

5️⃣ Onboarding & First Real Trials

You sign your contractor agreement, get access to all tools, and start your probation period with real families and clear performance expectations.

⏱ Timeline:

The typical time from application to starting real trial classes is around 2 weeks, depending on training schedules and your participation speed.

8. Is This Role For You? 🎯

You will likely enjoy this role if:

  • You enjoy talking to people, asking questions, and understanding their needs

  • You stay focused on learning and improvement, even when results don’t come immediately.

  • You’re comfortable working evenings and on one weekend day.

  • You are self-disciplined and can work remotely without constant supervision

  • You genuinely care about children’s learning and growth through technology

  • You are motivated by performance-based income and improving your results over time

This role is probably not a good fit if:

  • You’re looking for a traditional 9–5 role with a fixed salary

  • You feel uncomfortable selling, discussing prices, or guiding people toward a decision

  • You strongly prefer not to work evenings or weekends

  • You don’t want to be on camera or communicate directly with parents

  • You find it difficult to manage your own time in a remote setup

9. What Happens After You Apply? ⏭️

  1. You submit the application form below.

  2. Our team reviews your availability, technical setup, and basic fit.

  3. If there’s a match, we invite you to a 20-minute Zoom interview with a recruiter.

  4. After the interview, you’ll clearly know:

    • whether this role is a good fit for you, and

    • whether you’re invited to join the next Welcome Webinar & Training group.

If it’s not a match (for example, due to availability or expectations), we’ll let you know as well.

jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Generate is a Boston-based MIT-spin off technology company with the mission to digitize one of the world’s largest and least digital industries: the 12-trillion-dollar Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) sector.

We are bringing the many innovations and techniques from state-of-the-art gaming technology (like Proceduralism, GPGPU, Real-Time Graphics, and more) into transforming how the AEC sector designs and builds. When implemented at scale, our technology can help tackle the global climate and housing crises by accelerating the deployment of cost-effective, sustainable building materials and systems.

Our team is seeking an experienced Unreal Engine C++ Software Engineer to develop and deploy the technology at scale.

YOUR ROLE

In this role, you will:

  • Work as part of a small development team in a lean engineering environment on incremental releases of design software with a planned public launch in Q4 2022. You will make significant contributions to the software's structure and features with a laser focus on providing a fluid, game-like, user-centric design experience.
  • Contribute to significant aspects of the product development process — data structures, algorithm design, computational geometry, procedural geometry generation, history systems, inferencing and constraint systems, and building information modeling systems, runtime procedural construction system generation, runtime procedural building facades and interiors, custom compute based rasterization in Unreal Engine, and Houdini-esque building design tools.
  • Contribute expertise and intuition to monthly feature development workshops, bi-weekly sprint planning meetings, and quick daily standups.
  • Engage in open-ended workshop sessions, to help the product get from "a user wants to do X" to "here is how we will implement X, given our product architecture."
  • Collaborate with our small, cross-functional team of game developers, architects, and product designers to develop innovative solutions to creating and generating buildings (walls, floors, windows, doors, beams, columns, furniture, etc.).

REQUIREMENTS

  • Deep, intuitive understanding of Unreal Engine 4 (mandatory).
  • Deep, intuitive understanding of C++ and modern software design principles.
  • Track record in the software, technology, or game industries.
  • Experience building and shipping successful games or products.
  • Comfort with the lean product development process in a startup environment: including regular pivots, difficult choices about resource prioritization, and an emphasis on product-market fit.
  • A drive to understand and solve complex problems with novel, creative, and practical solutions.
  • Self-motivated and a self-starter.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, both virtually and in person.
  • Familiarity with version control (We use Git).
  • Operate in a workplace environment conducive to the respectful debate of ideas and opinions. Our team has incredible talent, and our technology will only become better if everyone gets to respectfully challenge each other's ideas to arrive at the best possible solution.
  • Most importantly, treat team members kindly—kindness is contagious, and nobody should feel disrespected in an intrinsically stressful technology-development environment.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with computational and procedural mesh geometry.
  • Previous development of user-facing tools or desktop software.
  • CAD industry experience (Autodesk, Dassault, OnShape, SolidWorks, etc.).
  • Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry experience.
  • With JavaScript systems (Redux, React, TypeScript, Next.js, etc.).
  • Experience with networked systems, distributed data, CRDT, or collaborative editing.

Please include links to any representative code or portfolio samples you can share (Github, Bitbucket, tools, games, apps, etc.) in the "Experience Summary" section of the application. We would prefer candidates in the US, but are eager to talk to anyone with a track record in the game development space and making great software.

Generate is remote work first, but we are also willing to discuss relocation to Boston, Massachusetts: a global epicenter of technological innovation!

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, including those from historically underrepresented communities. We are committed to reflecting the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion, both in the workplace and in the products we deliver to the industry. We are excited to hear from you!

jobs.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions

    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling

  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in the United States = $55,000 - $110,000
      • Base Compensation varies based on state of residence and experience
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead (PLG B2B SaaS, Remote, Ukraine)
jobs.excerpt: Our client is an early-stage, product-led B2B SaaS company that helps B2B teams make their LinkedIn advertising pay off sooner.
jobs.description:
Our client is an early-stage, product-led B2B SaaS company that helps B2B teams make their LinkedIn advertising pay off sooner. The product picks up the signals that lead to revenue before a deal closes (LinkedIn engagement, website visits, movement in the CRM) so customers can see what works in time to shift their budget.

The product is self-serve, with a 30-day free trial and no card required. A growing share of it already works inside the AI assistants customers use every day, such as Claude: through the company's MCP server, an assistant reads the account's ad, CRM and website data and turns it into reports, audits, benchmarks and recommendations.

In its first year on the market the team went from a product alone to steady inbound demand, top Google rankings for its core keywords, a daily publishing rhythm, a network of partnerships and a fast-growing user community. The next step is already in progress: the team is prototyping the next, AI-first version of the product.

Why this role exists

There is a Growth Marketing Lead who covers how people find the product and sign up. The Product Marketing Lead role owns what happens next: which of those people are the right users, how they reach value, why they pay and why they leave.

You sit between product and marketing. The product team decides what gets built and what the architecture allows; you bring the market evidence, shape how the product is packaged, priced and onboarded, and come back with proposals for what the product should do to win. We are not looking for someone who waits for a finished feature and is then told to go sell it.

What you will own

  • ICP and messaging: who the product is for, what we tell them, and one shared place where this lives for the whole team.
  • Activation, retention and churn: the path from sign-up to first value to paid, why accounts leave, and the experiments that change both.
  • Packaging and pricing, together with the product lead: what goes into each plan, where the price sits against competitors, how the credit-based model should evolve. This is among the first things you will work on.
  • Onboarding: how a new account learns the product in its first weeks.
  • The company's own LinkedIn Ads: you run the company's LinkedIn campaigns using the product itself, so you know it the way customers use it.
  • Market and competitor research turned into product proposals, brought to the product team with evidence, including into the work on the next version of the product.
  • Hands-on work: in a small team everyone contributes to strategy and everyone ships.

How the team works

  • You report directly to the company's founder.
  • You work every day with the Growth Marketing Lead, the Content Lead, the product lead and the CTO. Growth answers for how many leads come in; you define which leads are the right ones.
  • Some friction with product on pricing and packaging is expected, and welcome: that is how the two sides find the right answer.
  • Claude and other AI tools are provided and used daily. The team expects you to use them a lot, check what they produce, and know the product well enough to see when the output is wrong.
  • The team values people who will say openly what is not working in the product and propose what to change, with confidence that comes from their own experience.

Requirements

  • Product marketing in a product-led (PLG) B2B SaaS company. This weighs more than anything else here. In PLG the product is the sales channel: you change what people see in the product so that more of them try it, reach value and stay.
  • LinkedIn Ads you launched yourself. You have personally set up and run LinkedIn campaigns, even small ones. Deep optimization can be learned on the job; a first launch of your own cannot be skipped. Experience with Meta (Facebook) or Google Ads does not replace it.
  • Activation, retention and pricing experience: you have worked on the path from trial to paid, on churn, or on plans and prices, and can show what changed as a result.
  • Your own market research, and a view on what the product should build next.
  • Practical, daily AI use: research, analysis and reports with AI tools, and the habit of checking what they produce.
  • Self-management: you plan your own week and close what you start without reminders.
  • English at C1: you write messaging and pages for the US market yourself.
  • Fluent spoken and written Ukrainian: the team works in Ukrainian.

Nice to have

  • Experience with hybrid "subscription plus consumption" pricing (credits, usage-based plans) and choosing a value metric.
  • Hands-on work with MCP, AI connectors or open APIs, or product marketing for a product with such an integration.
  • Experience at a similar early stage, where one person covered research, pricing and onboarding.
  • Experience shaping product positioning.
  • Building your own automations with AI.

This probably isn't a fit if you

  • Have worked only in sales-led or enterprise marketing, where the sales team closes the deal.
  • Are a performance marketer first, without product marketing ownership of activation, pricing or onboarding.
  • Have paid-ads experience only on Meta or Google.
  • Prefer to take a finished feature and take it to market rather than shape what gets built.

What we offer

  • Full-time, remote from anywhere in Ukraine. Lviv is a plus. One trip to Lviv to meet the team is welcome; there is no regular travel.
  • Military service deferment (бронювання) through the company, details at the offer stage.
  • 24 calendar days of paid vacation plus 5 sick days a year, and Ukrainian public holidays.
  • Learning paid by the company: LinkedIn Learning and courses on platforms such as Coursera.
  • Claude and the other tools you need for the work.

Interview process

  • Screening call with DNA325
  • Interview with the president
  • Test task
  • Soft skills assessment
  • HR interview
  • Final interview with the company's investor

Before you apply

Please answer these three questions in your cover letter. Applications without answers will not be reviewed.

  • The PLG B2B SaaS product you did product marketing for: its name, a link, and your role there.
  • LinkedIn Ads: did you create and launch campaigns yourself in Campaign Manager? Roughly how many, over what period, and in what monthly budget range?
  • One link to something you shipped that users saw: a pricing page, onboarding flow, in-app message, email sequence or landing page (live or archived), plus one line on what you changed.

Decision Inc. is a global digital partner that enables businesses to reinvent themselves to realise their full potential.

Our teams have engaged with more than 400 clients globally over the past 15 years, providing them with the expertise to build, operate, and optimise their digital businesses.

Based in four global offices, our exceptional consultants focus on delivering value to clients by keeping them at the centre of our service delivery. To find out more about our exciting fast-paced culture visit: Careers at Decision Inc.﻿

Role overview

The Solution Architect owns the SAP Datasphere data foundation for a quantity-driven project cost forecasting proof of concept on one UGL construction project. The role designs how project, WBS, actuals, commitments, CATS (Non-SAP system) estimate and contract data are connected, reconciled and exposed as a governed semantic layer for downstream planning and reporting.

What the Architecture must solve:

Datasphere modelling

Design spaces, graphical and SQL views, analytic models and a clean semantic layer; keep reusable data definitions separate from planning logic.

Federation and live data

Design N-1 historical data in Datasphere combined with live current-day data from S/4HANA; test CDS view and filter performance at project-level volumes.

S/4HANA connectivity

Set up and secure connections to S/4HANA 2025 (or an approved fallback system); work with client Basis and security teams on access and roles.

S/4HANA project data

Understand WBS, networks, activities, actuals and commitments (journals, POs, goods receipts, timesheets); read ACDOCA and CO structures.

Data integration and mapping

Load flat files (CATS estimate, contract schedule) as an early-build route; map keys across S/4, CATS and contract data; classify unmatched and duplicate records.

Data quality and reconciliation

Reconcile Datasphere totals to S/4 at WBS level; document lineage, refresh timing, record counts and an exceptions register.

Tenant and licensing

Confirm tenant, licence path, spaces, users and roles; advise on reusing an existing demo tenant versus a new one.

Must Have Technical Skills:

  • POC and stage-gate delivery: evidence-led gates, early smoke tests of the live link, and clear statements of what a fallback does and does not prove.
  • Architecture decisions: documents design choices and publishes principles so the POC architecture is not later replaced.
  • Handover to consumers: exposes governed measures and dimensions that a planning and reporting team can consume without rework.
  • Stakeholder engagement: works with client SAP technology, finance reviewers and SAP/licence partner specialists, and explains data issues in business terms.
  • Authority: Must be able to guide the customer and dictate the best way to integrate with Seamless planning.
  • Experience as a Datasphere federation reference for S/4HANA at another client.
  • Familiarity with Primavera P6 data and the SAP object assignment pattern.
  • Background in construction, engineering or resources project controls.
  • Working knowledge of SAC as a consumer of Datasphere models.
  • Typically 15+ years in SAP BW data and analytics, including 3+ years designing on Datasphere (or SAP Data Warehouse Cloud).
  • At least two Datasphere implementations with live S/4HANA federation or replication.
  • SAP Datasphere or S/4HANA certification is advantageous.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

All Star Healthcare Solutions is one of the nation's fastest-growing locum tenens healthcare staffing firms, proudly serving Providers, Clients, and the Community with excellence. Headquartered in Boca Raton, FL, we offer a professional, fast-paced environment that is collaborative, innovative, and never overly corporate.

We recruit, credential, license, and place physicians and advanced practice providers with hospitals and health systems nationwide, supporting the full lifecycle of those relationships.

As a Sun-Sentinel Top Places to Work recipient, we invest in our people—their personal, professional, and financial goals—while fostering a culture built on teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement. If you're looking for the opportunity to influence business strategy, lead transformational initiatives, and help shape the future of a growing organization, All Star is the place to build your career.

What You Will Do

All Star Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced Salesforce Platform Owner to lead the strategy, governance, and continuous improvement of our Salesforce platform.

This position serves as the primary owner of the platform roadmap, prioritizing enhancements, managing change, and driving adoption across provider-side and client-side operations. The Salesforce Platform Owner will collaborate with business leaders, technology teams, and external partners to ensure Salesforce solutions align with organizational goals and deliver measurable business value.

This role combines business process expertise, technical knowledge, and strategic decision-making to maintain a reliable, scalable, and well-governed enterprise platform.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

You Will Own the Following:

  • Lead the Salesforce platform roadmap, translating business objectives into a prioritized, actionable plan with clearly defined outcomes and timelines.

  • Manage and continuously prioritize the Salesforce backlog, including enhancements, defects, data initiatives, and technical improvements.

  • Oversee the intake and evaluation of platform requests, ensuring priorities align with business needs, available resources, and strategic objectives.

  • Develop and maintain business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria while coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) and final approvals.

  • Lead release planning, stakeholder communications, and post-deployment validation to ensure successful platform enhancements.

  • Establish and maintain platform governance standards, including change management, system access, security controls, and production release approvals.

  • Partner with implementation partners and managed-service vendors to define project scope, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.

  • Lead Salesforce integration initiatives for acquired businesses, aligning workflows, reporting structures, data models, and operational processes.

  • Oversee data governance initiatives, including data quality, stewardship, reporting standards, and organizational data structures.

  • Evaluate and prioritize AI, Agentforce, and automation opportunities while establishing appropriate governance, security, and data quality standards.

  • Drive Salesforce adoption through training, documentation, user enablement, feedback sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Establish and monitor key platform performance indicators, including system health, user adoption, defect rates, delivery timelines, data completeness, and business impact.

  • Manage platform licensing, capacity planning, and associated costs while evaluating build-versus-buy and configuration decisions.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams, facilitating discovery sessions, aligning priorities, and driving consensus on platform solutions.

Required Education and Experience

  • 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including platform architecture, administration, and solution delivery across multiple Salesforce Clouds, such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Data Cloud.

  • Strong knowledge of modern Salesforce technologies, including Flow, Flow Orchestration, Lightning Web Components, Dynamic Forms, Salesforce DX, Platform Events, and API-based integrations.

  • Experience evaluating, designing, and implementing Salesforce Agentforce and Einstein AI capabilities, including prompt design, testing, governance, and security considerations.

  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, including data harmonization, identity resolution, profile unification, and cross-system activation.

  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data architecture, including object relationships, large data volumes, security and sharing models, and data retention strategies.

  • Demonstrated experience leading data governance and quality initiatives, including deduplication, validation, master data management, account hierarchies, and data stewardship.

  • Experience with enterprise data migration and integration, including ETL/ELT processes, middleware, real-time integrations, reconciliation, and deployment planning.

  • Knowledge of reporting and analytics architecture, including data warehouses, business intelligence tools, and enterprise reporting solutions.

  • Understanding of data security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, including PHI and HIPAA considerations.

  • Experience managing Salesforce platform upgrades, enhancements, and enterprise technology initiatives.

  • Advanced understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), testing methodologies, and release management.

  • Strong knowledge of Agile development methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.

  • Experience leading end-to-end technical initiatives while collaborating with cross-functional business and technology teams.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Strong presentation, documentation, and technical writing skills are a plus.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At All Star Healthcare Solutions, we believe our employees are our greatest investment. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support your career growth, well-being, and work-life balance.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary with an annual discretionary bonus opportunity

  • Remote work model that supports flexibility while fostering collaboration and connection

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future

  • Three weeks of paid time off, plus 10 paid holidays

  • Ongoing professional development and leadership growth opportunities

  • Opportunity to help shape the technology strategy and Salesforce platform of one of the nation's fastest-growing healthcare staffing organizations

  • A collaborative, people-first culture where your ideas are valued and innovation is encouraged

Location

This position offers the flexibility to work remotely, allowing you to contribute, collaborate, and stay connected with the team from your home workspace. We're looking for someone who thrives in a remote environment and can communicate and collaborate effectively across teams.

jobs.description:
warum zu uns

Empower People. Create Success. Bei Scalian Germany stehen die Mitarbeitenden und das Miteinander im Fokus. Wir brennen für unsere Themen, bringen uns proaktiv ein und geben fachlich und persönlich tagtäglich unser Bestes. Gemeinsam feiern wir unsere kleinen und großen Erfolge, freuen uns aufrichtig für- und miteinander und unterstützen uns gegenseitig. Schaffe einen echten Mehrwert und nutze die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten, Deine Kenntnisse einzubringen und zu vertiefen, eigenverantwortlich Deine Ideen und Projekte voranzutreiben sowie andere zu inspirieren und zu motivieren.

was wir gemeinsam vorhaben

  • Trusted AI ermöglichen: Übersetze regulatorische Anforderungen sowie Vorgaben zu Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz und Qualitätssicherung in konkrete technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen, damit AI-Lösungen sicher und kontrolliert produktiv eingesetzt werden können.
  • AI-Einsatzbereitschaft bewerten: Führe Bewertungen zur sicheren Einsatzbereitschaft von AI-Lösungen durch, identifiziere Handlungsfelder und entwickle konkrete Maßnahmenpläne.
  • Governance praxistauglich gestalten: Definiere Trusted-AI-Kontrollen für Governance, Informationssicherheit, Datenschutz, Modellnutzung, Datenhaltung, Nachvollziehbarkeit, menschliche Aufsicht und Verantwortlichkeiten.
  • Sichere Architekturen gestalten: Entwickle gemeinsam mit unseren Experten sichere AI-Architekturen für Cloud-, Private-Cloud-, On-Premises- sowie besonders geschützte oder souveräne Umgebungen.
  • AI sicher in Produktion bringen: Begleite die Risikoklassifizierung, definiere erforderliche Nachweise und gestalte Governance-Prüfpunkte vom PoC bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
  • Kunden beraten und Lösungen gestalten: Übernimm eine führende Rolle in Presales-Aktivitäten, Architektur-Reviews sowie technischen und strategischen Kundengesprächen.
  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit steuern: Bringe Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Engineering, Legal/Datenschutz und Plattform-Teams zusammen und binde bei speziellen Themen rund um Qualitätssicherung, Safety oder Zertifizierung gezielt weitere Experten ein.
  • Expertise skalierbar machen: Entwickle aus Projekterfahrungen wiederverwendbare Bewertungsmethoden, Kontrollkataloge, Referenzmuster und Best Practices und gib Dein Wissen an Kollegen weiter.

womit du überzeugst

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Trusted AI, Responsible AI, AI Governance, AI Risk oder Secure AI und hast entsprechende Anforderungen bereits auf reale AI-Lösungen angewendet.
  • Du hast regulatorische, Security- und Privacy-Anforderungen bereits in konkrete technische Controls, Prozesse und erforderliche Nachweise übersetzt.
  • Du kennst den gesamten AI-Lifecycle von Assessment, Entwicklung und Validierung über Deployment bis hin zu Monitoring und Change und verstehst die relevanten Schnittstellen zu MLOps und Plattformen.
  • Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit dem EU AI Act, GDPR und ISO/IEC 27001; Kenntnisse in ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 23894, NIS2 oder Cyber Resilience Act sind ein Plus.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in regulierten oder mission-critical Umgebungen und kannst Risiken, Auditability, Human Oversight und erforderliche Nachweise fundiert bewerten.
  • Du kannst regulatorische und technische Anforderungen so ausbalancieren, dass Governance und Security die produktive Einführung von AI ermöglichen, anstatt sie lediglich zu kontrollieren.
  • Du kannst komplexe Trusted-AI-Themen souverän mit technischen sowie Management-Stakeholdern diskutieren und hast Erfahrung in Kundenworkshops, Presales und der fachlichen Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Deine Englischkenntnisse sind gut in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du bist bereit für regelmäßige Dienstreisen innerhalb Deutschlands. Darunter verstehen wir die grundsätzliche Flexibilität unter der Woche beim Kunden vor Ort zu sein.

worauf du dich freuen kannst

Unsere besondere Unternehmenskultur:

  • Herzliches und wertschätzendes Miteinander, in dem jede Persönlichkeit zählt
  • Offener Austausch und offene Türen - vom Junior bis zum Vorstand
  • Zahlreiche Team- und Unternehmensevents, wie unser jährliches Sommerfest zusammen mit unseren Familien
Unsere Benefits für Wohlergehen und Wachstum:

  • Smartes Arbeiten, z.B. mobil und mit flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen, Möglichkeit für Sabbaticals und Workation
  • Zusatzleistungen, z.B. Corporate Benefits, attraktive betriebliche Altersvorsorge und JobRad
  • Health Care Benefits, z.B. vergünstigte Mitgliedschaften für Urban Sports Club
Unser gemeinsamer Weg:

  • Intensive Einarbeitung durch ein umfangreiches Onboarding und Patenprogramm
  • Vielfältige interne Weiterbildungsangebote und externe Fördermaßnahmen
  • Internationales Austauschprogramm zur Förderung der persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe
Und vieles mehr.

was du wissen solltest

Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten! Daher prüfen wir Deine Bewerbung nicht ausschließlich auf eine bestimmte Stelle bezogen, sondern als eine Bewerbung an das Unternehmen Scalian Germany. In einem persönlichen Gespräch finden wir gemeinsam heraus, ob Deine Ziele und unsere Vorstellungen zueinander passen.

Du findest Dich im Themengebiet und Standort nicht wieder? Sende uns gerne Deine Unterlagen zu – wir berücksichtigen Dich gerne für weitere Projekte an auch an anderen Standorten.

Alles Weitere erzählen wir Dir in einem persönlichen Gespräch. Sende Deine Unterlagen entweder per E-Mail an oder nutze den "Bewerben"-Button (Dateigröße max. 35 MB).

jobs.description:
Job Title: Technical Lead, Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) Projects
Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time (client working days only; no client holidays)
Location: Remote, United States (Eastern Time schedule)
Employment Type: W-2, full time, 40 hours per week
Pay Rate: $60-$80/hr (W-2)
Engagement Type: Contract, 15 months beginning December 1, 2026, with a possible extension of up to one additional year
Final Interview: Client interview by phone or in person

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring a Technical Lead on behalf of the client, a state government agency, to support its Integrated Eligibility and Enrollment (IE&E) program. Under the direction of the state IT Manager, the Technical Lead performs technical lead and backup technical lead duties on the implementation of the state's new integrated eligibility system and on other IE&E projects, programs and systems as assigned.

The Technical Lead is the project team's technical authority and the link between the project team, the state's health and human services departments, the state's central IT agency and the implementation vendor: leading technical design, build, test and deployment activities, overseeing data migration and interfaces, and keeping the quality of the technical solution high.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the assigned technical lead and a member of the project team, take part in project meetings and stay current with the project vision.
  • Coordinate with the state's health access, children and families, human services and digital services organizations and other stakeholders to resolve problems and questions, and report back to the project team.
  • Lead technical design and technology build, test and deployment activities, and provide technical support.
  • Oversee data migration and the implementation of interfaces between existing solutions and the new integrated eligibility system.
  • Support Agile and hybrid development methods and give input on the team's Agile and hybrid practices.
  • Keep the project team informed of technical risk, complexity and sizing for the ideas it identifies, and work with the project owner on technically feasible options that meet the project's needs and priorities.
  • Support infrastructure and platform decisions.
  • Oversee a healthy release management process and maintain the overall quality of technical solutions.
  • See that vendor code is reviewed and accepted, and identify, prioritize and communicate technical debt and risks.
  • Coach the project team on technical concepts to support decisions, and coach other technical resources on the state and vendor teams.
  • Answer technical questions through technical sprints, research, evaluations and prototypes.
  • Take part in vendor evaluation panels, evaluate vendor markets to help the state acquire IT modules, and work with the project owner, project manager and procurement lead to monitor vendor performance after award.
  • Coordinate with software vendors to investigate application issues and deliver effective resolutions, and work with the vendor to review and produce system documentation and training materials.
  • Recommend system modifications that improve efficiency and reduce operating costs.
  • Take part in team retrospectives, research industry trends and best practices, and unblock issues as they arise.
  • Provide weekly status: planned tasks accomplished, tasks incomplete or behind schedule with reasons, and tasks planned for the next two weeks.

Requirements

Required:

  • Considerable support, development and implementation experience, with a deep understanding of the underlying technologies, business processes and support processes, and the ability to work with a broad range of stakeholders across lifecycle phases.
  • Experience serving as technical lead on large system implementations delivered with vendors, including technical design, build, test and deployment.
  • Experience overseeing data migration and the implementation of interfaces between existing and new systems.
  • Working experience with Agile and hybrid delivery methods.
  • Experience reviewing and accepting vendor code, managing releases and managing technical debt.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical team members and coach other technical staff.
  • Current annual cybersecurity awareness training certificate (a copy is submitted to the client with your resume), or the ability to complete it before submission; the client's annual compliance training must also be completed and kept current during the engagement.
  • Three professional references, submitted with the application, who can speak to your technical lead work.
  • Available full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time, for the full 15-month engagement beginning December 1, 2026.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States; work cannot be performed from outside the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099).

About the Role.

PURE Insurance is actively investing in our data, analytics, data science, machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities. We are building IDEAS (Innovation in Data Engineering, Analytics & Science), a centralized Data & AI department that brings together specialists across data architecture, engineering, analytics, governance, and advanced modeling. This structure creates opportunities for collaboration and impact across every function of the insurance ecosystem, including Claims, Underwriting, Actuarial, Product, Distribution, and Finance.

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI solutions that leverage unstructured and semi-structured data to improve business processes and member outcomes. From claim notes and inspection reports to property photos, policy documents, call recordings, and correspondence, this role will focus on transforming complex information into actionable business value.

As an early member of PURE's AI Engineering function, you will play a key role in building production-ready AI solutions, establishing engineering best practices, and helping shape the team's future capabilities.

What You'll Do.

  • Design and build end-to-end AI solutions, from initial scoping with business partners through development, evaluation, and production deployment.
  • Identify and apply the most effective AI or machine learning techniques for each business problem, including large language models (LLMs) and other approaches as appropriate.
  • Make key technical design decisions related to document parsing, information extraction, retrieval, and context engineering.
  • Partner with the AVP of AI Engineering to identify common patterns across solutions and develop reusable components for PURE's AI platform.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to define success criteria and develop evaluation and validation strategies that measure real-world performance.
  • Monitor AI solutions in production, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve performance as business needs evolve.
  • Help establish engineering standards, development practices, and technical processes as PURE's AI Engineering function grows.
  • Mentor junior AI engineers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance as the team expands.

What We're Looking For.

  • 3–5+ years of experience developing Python-based AI or machine learning solutions.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building solutions that leverage large language models (LLMs).
  • Demonstrated experience designing, deploying, and evaluating AI solutions in production environments.
  • Experience extracting and processing information from documents, images, and other unstructured data sources.
  • Strong understanding of LLM-based applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, and context engineering.
  • Experience developing evaluation frameworks and using performance metrics to guide AI solution development.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals, including Git, testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code reviews.
  • Working knowledge of major cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts, design decisions, and trade-offs effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a business-focused mindset, with an emphasis on delivering measurable results.

What Will Make You Stand Out.

  • Experience working in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience developing computer vision solutions.
  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or data scientists.
  • Experience building APIs or endpoints using FastAPI or Flask.
  • Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tools such as Arize or MLflow.

‌

What We Do

We're a member-owned property and casualty insurer designed exclusively for financially successful families and driven by a purpose of doing what is right for our members. We provide exceptional service, hospitality and care, we partner with our members to help prevent losses and we create smart insurance solutions at fair prices.

We aim for our members to love their insurance. It is our mission is to create a membership experience so compelling that ​our members never want to leave.

Who We Are

We want to be transparent about what we expect from each other. From PURE, you can expect:


Opportunities to stretch and grow: your professional and personal development matters to us. We’re committed to providing experiences through on-the-job learning and professional development that increase your impact and rewards.


Clarity and kindness: you can rely on us to be open, honest and supportive, offering clarity on what success looks like.


Support in good times and bad: we believe in showing up for each other consistently, not only when it’s easy. You can expect a thoughtful partner, even when we disagree.


A community that cares: we are committed to sustaining a community in which each person feels cared for as an individual. We lift each other up, celebrate wins together and support one another through challenges in work and life.

Who You Are

All of the strongest relationships are a partnership- a two way street. So here’s what we ask of you:

  • Aim to bring your best every day: you’re here because you want to be part of a team that makes a real impact and aims high.
  • Be a student and a teacher: share your knowledge and talents and be willing to listen and learn from those around you.
  • Get comfortable being uncomfortable: we face tough moments and obstacles with a “courage over comfort” approach and a positive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Be a culture builder: building a positive culture is everyone's responsibility, based on care, respect and openness to diverse perspectives.

‌

The base salary for this role can range from $130,000 to $155,000 based on a full-time work schedule. An individual’s ultimate compensation will vary depending on job-related skills and experience, geographic location, alignment with market data, and equity among other team members with comparable experience.

To ensure a successful onboarding experience, all new hires must work onsite at one of our offices during their first week of employment. Candidates should apply only if they are able to meet this requirement.

ParentSquare started in 2011 with a simple belief: when families are involved, students thrive.
