jobs.description:
MERIDIAL

SMB AI Power User — Competitive Evaluations

Company

Meridial

Location

Remote

Engagement Type

Independent Contractor

About Meridial

Meridial places skilled, remote-first professionals into high-trust, high-precision operational opportunities for leading technology companies. Our teams work as an embedded extension of our clients' own product and operations organizations, holding the same quality bar and the same deadlines.

The Opportunity

As an SMB AI Power User on the Competitive Evaluations team, you'll help a major consumer technology company find out where its bundled AI assistant subscription falls short of the standalone assistants small businesses already pay for. You are not an AI researcher studying the problem from the outside - you are a working or experienced business owner who already runs on these tools, and your own operations are the test bed.

Your day is spent doing what you already do: drafting ad copy, planning content, answering customer messages, researching suppliers, and reconciling numbers. The difference is that you do it across competing assistants, side by side, and document precisely where each one breaks. The failures you surface are the failures real paying subscribers will hit, which is exactly why the seat calls for a genuine operator rather than an evaluator.

What You'll Do

  • Run head-to-head prompts and multi-turn workflows across the client's assistant and competing paid assistants, using tasks drawn from your own business operations and marketing.
  • Build and maintain a library of realistic small-business test cases spanning ad creative and copy, organic content planning, customer messaging, competitor research, pricing, scheduling, and light bookkeeping.
  • Identify and document failure modes - wrong answers, unnecessary refusals, weak instruction-following, tone misses, brand-unsafe output, broken formatting, context lost across turns, unusable image or video output.
  • Write clear, reproducible reports: prompt used, model and surface, expected output, actual output, severity, and why the failure matters to a paying business subscriber.
  • Assess the bundled subscription on value terms - what a business owner actually receives versus what a standalone competitor subscription delivers for comparable spend.
  • Stress-test assistant features inside the social and commerce surfaces where business owners meet them, not only the standalone chat product.

What We're Looking For

  • Owner or operator of a small or medium business - sole proprietor, founder, or the person running day-to-day operations at a business of roughly 1–200 employees.
  • Daily, habitual use of generative AI tools in that business, for both operations and marketing. Experimental or occasional use is not a fit.
  • Organic presence on Instagram and Facebook for the business, maintained personally: posting, Stories, Reels, comment and message response.
  • Hands-on paid advertising experience on Meta platforms - has personally built, launched, and optimized campaigns with real budget.
  • Based in the United States and authorized to work here.
  • Capacity sufficient to complete deliverables per the agreed scope and timeline, which may include up to 40 hours per week
  • Exceptional written English - able to describe a failure clearly enough that an engineer can reproduce it without follow-up.
  • Comfortable working independently against a rubric and holding a weekly output cadence.

Nice to Have

  • At least one current paid AI subscription (ChatGPT Plus/Pro, Claude Pro/Max, Gemini Advanced, or similar), so competitive comparison rests on actual use.
  • Runs a side business or second venture alongside a primary role - the profile that tends to test AI hardest against limited time.
  • Heavy Instagram user, personally and commercially: fluent in Reels, Stories, trends, and creator tooling.
  • Subscribes to two or more AI assistants simultaneously and holds an informed view on where each one wins.
  • Uses AI beyond chat - automations, agents, API or no-code integrations, custom GPTs or Projects.
  • Prior experience with model evaluation, red teaming, data annotation, QA, or structured user research.
  • Working familiarity with adjacent SMB tooling: Shopify, Square, QuickBooks, Klaviyo, Canva, CapCut, Later, or similar.
  • Industry range across the two hires - for example, one services or retail operator alongside one e-commerce or creator-economy operator.

We offer a pay range of $40-$50 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

This is a first-of-its-kind seat built around three priorities: deciding what Bobtail builds, deciding what it deliberately does not build, and executing at a high level in lockstep with engineering and the rest of the senior management team to ship it. You'll work directly with the CEO to turn a wide set of strategic options, into a sequenced, evidence-backed roadmap.

The ideal candidate has led product at a company of comparable size and complexity, with a track record of setting strategy from ambiguity rather than just running an existing roadmap, and the discipline to say no as often as yes. This individual will be highly data-driven and analytical, with the judgment to move on conviction when the data is inherently thin. We are looking for a strong product leader who can build the product management function at Bobtail from the ground up, hire and develop a team, and partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market leadership to turn decisions into shipped product. This includes identifying new products, services, platform capabilities, and revenue opportunities that solve meaningful problems for our customers and strengthen our competitive position. The right person will not wait for someone to hand them a list of features to build. They will spend time understanding how our customers operate, where they struggle, what they currently pay others to do, and what problems remain unsolved.

You should apply if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in product management and strategy, including experience leading product at a company of comparable size and complexity.
  • A track record of setting product strategy from ambiguity and defending sequencing decisions with both data and judgment.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, lending, factoring, transportation technology, or another transaction-heavy financial environment strongly preferred.

  • Comfort with compliance and risk constraints (KYC/KYB, lending, payments) is a plus.
  • Experience building and leading a product team, including hiring the first few members of a function.
  • Strong technical fluency - you don't need to write code, but you should be able to work closely with engineering on architecture trade-offs and technical feasibility.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with strong pattern-recognition and problem-solving skills.
  • A bias toward shipping and iterating over long planning cycles.
  • Comfort operating at a founder-led, profitable company rather than a venture-subsidized one.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to clearly communicate product strategy and trade-offs to senior leadership. The discipline to say no - comfortable deferring or killing ideas that don't earn their place on the roadmap, even when they're compelling in isolation or popular internally. Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and challenge senior stakeholders constructively.
  • Financial fluency - comfortable modeling and defending the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of a roadmap bet directly to the CFO and other finance stakeholders. A track record of measuring product success based on customer and business outcomes.
  • An obsession with the customer and the product - you can't walk past something broken without wanting to fix it, and you know the product as well as the people using it, not just the roadmap slide.

You will be responsible for:

  • Decide What to Build: Develop and maintain a product strategy that clearly connects product investment to the company's broader strategic and financial objectives. Look beyond incremental feature improvements to identify opportunities for meaningful product innovation.
  • Process around decision making: Create a disciplined process for gathering and evaluating ideas without allowing the product roadmap to become a collection of stakeholder requests. Ensure completed functionality solves the underlying customer or business problem rather than simply meeting documented requirements.
  • Decide What Not to Build: Exercise real judgment about scope. Establish clear criteria for when to build, continue investing in a new product, change direction, or discontinue an initiative.
  • Execute at a High Level: Partner closely with engineering - and with design, go-to-market, and senior leadership - to turn the roadmap into shipped product on a predictable cadence, not just a plan.
  • Defend the Business Case: Build and defend the revenue potential, development cost, and opportunity cost of each major roadmap bet to the CFO, so product decisions hold up under financial scrutiny, not just strategic conviction.
  • Own the outcome: Ensure new products have clearly understood operational, financial, regulatory, and risk requirements before launch. Measure product success based on business outcomes - not simply whether features were delivered.
  • Own the Product: Take full, unbounded ownership of Bobtail's product. There are no lanes here; if it touches the customer or the platform, it's yours to shape.
  • Obsess Over the Customer and the Product: Establish a disciplined process for identifying and evaluating new product opportunities. Spend meaningful time talking directly with customers rather than relying exclusively on feedback filtered through Sales or Operations. Develop a strong understanding of competitors and adjacent providers within transportation finance and fintech. Live inside the carrier's day-to-day and inside the product itself. Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

A little bit about our team:

WMG Technology’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team sits at the intersection of enterprise engineering and business enablement. We embed engineers with global business units — including Finance, HR, and our recorded music labels — to turn operational pain points into high-value AI and automation solutions.

Working directly with the business, we run a centralized intake, routing, and delivery model so the business can move in days or weeks using existing tools, while larger foundational work graduates cleanly onto the product roadmap. We set a shared technical bar, reuse what already works, and keep AI deployments secure, cost-transparent, and maintainable.

Your role:

Reporting to the Director of FDE & AI Optimization, the Engineering Manager will lead a team of embedded engineers and own how FDE work is taken in, built, reused, and graduated.

This is a hands-on people-manager role. You will coach engineers who sit inside lines of business while holding a centralized technical reporting structure, operating playbook, and delivery standard. You will partner with Data Engineer, Product Owner, and business sponsors to turn ambiguous requests into a clear, repeatable operating model — and to make sure FDE is a trusted path for AI optimization, not a shadow-IT queue.

The ideal manager brings an equal blend of technical judgment and organizational empathy: comfortable in the tools, rigorous about routing and reuse, and able to help non-technical stakeholders translate operational pain points into work the team can actually ship.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Build, coach, and manage a high-performing FDE team, including hiring, performance, and embedding engineers in specific lines of business while keeping them aligned to core tech standards.

  • Define, scale, and maintain the FDE technical operating playbook — intake standards, routing rules, reusable delivery models, and engagement lifecycle — so work enters, ships, and leaves FDE by clear criteria.

  • Turn ambiguous organizational processes (intake routing, priority rubrics, and graduation gateways) into clear, repeatable frameworks that business sponsors actually use.

  • Align engineers, product owners, business sponsors, and executive partners around shared technical standards, priority, and delivery roadmaps — and resolve boundary conflicts so there is one intake path, not shadow requests.

  • Champion reusable assets, developer tooling (including ADK/SDK patterns and an internal assets marketplace), and best practices so teams stop reinventing the wheel and production work has a named owner and a maintenance path.

  • Set the technical bar for bottom-up AI optimization: agents and automation on validated enterprise frameworks (including Databricks, Gemini Enterprise, Claude, and Airtable).

  • Own end-to-end operational governance for FDE deliveries — security and compliance, Cost of AI telemetry, and lifecycle management from prototype through production graduation or retire.

  • Partner with divisional leaders and budget owners to translate operational pain points into technical requirements, educate business units on how to work with tech, and give leadership a clear view of FDE capacity, outcomes, and aggregate AI cost.

  • Define success metrics for the FDE engagement model and run the operating rhythm (intake SLA, reuse, outcomes) that keeps the team efficient as demand scales.

About you:

  • You have 7+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, data engineering, or AI/ML delivery, including 2+ years managing engineers.

  • You have led teams in a Forward Deployed Engineering, technical consulting, or heavily matrixed environment where talent is embedded in the business and still held to a central technical bar.

  • You have defined, scaled, and maintained operational playbooks — intake standards, routing, and reusable delivery models — not just written a process doc.

  • You can transform ambiguous processes (intake routing, priority rubrics, graduation gateways) into clear, repeatable frameworks that stick across teams.

  • You have championed reusable assets, developer tooling (e.g. ADK/SDK patterns), and best practices that improve team-wide efficiency and long-term asset maintenance.

  • You have owned operational governance across the delivery lifecycle, including compliance, cost telemetry (Cost of AI), and the path from prototype to production graduation.

  • You have deep familiarity with modern LLM ecosystems, agentic workflows, and cloud data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Gemini, Claude, Cursor).

  • You can evaluate business requests with discernment — distinguishing agile, low-effort optimization wins (days/weeks) from intensive initiatives that belong on a product roadmap (months/years).

  • You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex AI paradigms into tangible operational value for non-technical stakeholders.

  • You have experience measuring engineering ROI and managing vendor/licensing or infrastructure cost in a production environment.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience rolling out an intake + routing model in a matrixed enterprise (what the team takes vs. routes to product, platform, or decline), with a visible backlog and an SLA on triage.

  • Hands-on delivery of agents, automation, or internal platforms on Databricks, Gemini Enterprise, Claude, Airtable, and/or Cursor.

  • Experience standing up a reuse path (starter kits, ADK/SDK, asset marketplace) and a written production-ownership / graduate-or-retire standard.

  • Music, media, or entertainment industry experience, or prior work supporting functions such as Finance, HR, or creative/label operations.

  • Comfort operating as a player-coach: close enough to the technical work to set standards, without needing to be the strongest coder on the team.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Location: Montreal, Quebec, Toronto, or Ontario

About Numa

Numa is building the platform to power AI-native dealerships, rearchitecting automotive service and sales with advanced AI agents that automate customer interactions, streamline operations, and reimagine how dealerships work. Numa integrates AI into every aspect of dealership functions—from rescuing customer calls and voicemails that generate more revenue, to reducing customer resolution times that drive overall customer satisfaction (CSI), to improving dealership team productivity and accountability. Numa has raised $50 million from leading investors (Google, Threshold, Costanoa, Mitsui, and Touring Capital).

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build and ship ML/AI systems that interact with real customers thousands of times a day. Our voice agents book service appointments, rescue missed calls, and route callers through natural conversations. You’ll work across products and platforms. You’ll ship AI features including prompts, agents, tools, and production ML models, while building the evaluations and tooling that help teams ship with confidence. You’ll also contribute to our ML platform, including model serving, LLM infrastructure, and production observability. At Numa, we believe great ML is about more than building bigger models. It’s about knowing whether a change is good enough to ship. Our evaluation-first approach makes that measurable in CI and production.

What You’ll Do

  • Build conversational AI systems for phone and SMS that understand customer needs, take action, and know when to act autonomously
  • Develop tooling such as memory, knowledge graphs, and validated customization that help agents reason and adapt to dealership needs
  • Train, evaluate, and deploy ML models using Ray Serve and Dagster for prediction, classification, ranking, and capacity forecasting, and keep them healthy in production
  • Create offline and online evaluations, simulations, and CI gates that catch regressions and continuously measure quality in production
  • Implement shared evaluation, observability, and LLM tooling that helps product squads ship faster and more reliably
  • Raise the engineering bar through design and code reviews, technical writing, and mentorship
  • Work autonomously when goals are clear and help create clarity when they are not

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of software or machine learning engineering experience, with a track record of shipping ML or LLM powered systems to production
  • Strong Python and solid software engineering fundamentals; you write code others can build on, test, and trust
  • Hands-on experience building AI systems; training and deploying ML models (prediction, classification, ranking) and/or working with LLMs (prompting, tool use, agents, retrieval) with a real intuition for where they break
  • A rigorous, evaluation-first instinct, you reach for measurement to tell a real improvement from a lucky one, and a real regression from noise
  • Comfort operating with meaningful ambiguity in a product environment, and the judgment to know where to invest depth versus speed
  • Ownership and communication; you can carry a piece of work from problem framing through shipped, monitored, and improved

Nice To Have

  • Experience building or operating ML platform and tooling: evaluation frameworks, model serving, feature/prompt registries, or ML observability
  • Familiarity with our stack or its neighbors: LiveKit, Ray Serve, Dagster, Vertex AI, GCP, Kubernetes, Pulumi, or provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Deepgram, ElevenLabs)
  • Comfortable taking a model or agent from prototype to production and owning it there
  • Proficient with real-time or streaming systems: voice, telephony (SIP/WebRTC), or low-latency inference
  • Familiarity working in a startup or high-growth environment with evolving conditions

What Success Looks Like

  • Your squad ships AI features faster and with more confidence because the evals and tooling around them are solid
  • No AI change you own reaches customers without an evaluation standing behind it and regressions are caught before they ship
  • You've turned at least one hard-won squad lesson into platform leverage the rest of the team now relies on
  • Production issues in your area are understood, measured, and closed with statistical confidence that the fix actually worked
  • Other engineers are better at building AI systems because of your reviews, your writing, and how you work

Why Join Numa

  • We believe in everyone's growth
  • Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000
  • Represent category-defining AI technology that is transforming the automotive industry
  • Join a high-growth organization with significant opportunities for career advancement

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: $200,000 - $250,000 CAD
  • Equity Packages
  • Flexible PTO
  • Fully Covered Group Insurance

At Numa, you’ll have the chance to represent game-changing technology in an industry that’s ready for innovation. If you love being in the field, thrive on solving problems in real time, and want to make an impact at a high-growth company, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Overview

The Senior Employee Experience Partner (EEP) is the primary HR partner for managers and employees across a defined portfolio, owning the frontline employee experience end-to-end. This role leads manager capability building and coaching, supports employees and managers through organizational change, owns employee relations and investigations from intake to resolution, and drives engagement action planning and follow-up. Operating within the Employee Experience function, the Senior EEP brings deep expertise in HR partnership, employee relations, and people-centered problem solving to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for every employee and manager they serve. This role is expected to exercise independent judgment, influence without authority, and take ownership of outcomes at a higher level of complexity and ambiguity than the EEP level.

Global Scope & Context

This role has broad global accountability, supporting employees, managers, and HR partners across multiple regions and time zones. The Senior EEP is expected to serve as a regional subject matter expert, adapting HR partnership and employee experience support across diverse cultural contexts, delivering consistency in how employees and managers are served regardless of location or time zone.

Who are we and what do we do?

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

Location: This is a fully remote position, open to candidates residing anywhere in India.


Role in a Nutshell

As a Team Lead - Sales Development at BrowserStack, you will lead a dynamic and growing Sales Development team in a fast-paced environment. Reporting to the Manager - Sales Development, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of the sales pipeline by driving top-of-funnel activity and nurturing a team of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to ensure they reach their full potential. You’ll be a key contributor to the company’s growth, working in a start-up-like atmosphere that encourages innovation and agility, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

This hands-on leadership role requires a strategic thinker passionate about coaching and developing high-performing sales teams, optimizing processes and aligning sales strategies with the company’s overall business goals.

  • Excellent Communication & Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with team members, stakeholders, and leadership. Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally and working within a team-based environment to achieve company goals.
  • Highly Motivated & Results-Driven: Passionate about driving results, taking ownership, and inspiring a team to meet or exceed sales development targets.

What Will You Do?

jobs.description:
Mindoula’s teams of case and care managers, supported by technology including a mobile engagement app, proprietary psychometrics, and predictive analytics, are the key to its success. Mindoula expects to expand rapidly across multiple business lines in multiple states and is seeking an experienced professional for its Clinical Program Manager role within the Collaborative Care Program.

Mindoula’s Collaborative Care Program (CCP) is a virtual behavioral health overlay based on the University of Washington-based AIMS Center’s Collaborative Care Model. CCP works in conjunction with primary care, women’s health, and specialty physician groups to provide care to patients with mild-to-moderate behavioral health needs. It is estimated that upwards of 20% of patients in these groups may be experiencing mental health/behavioral health distress. Mindoula signs service contracts with groups, whose providers then refer select patients to CCP while continuing to play an ongoing role in treatment.

The Clinical Partnership Manager (CPM) will grow to be a Collaborative Care expert focused on driving, building, and nurturing current and new partnerships within our Collaborative Care Program. This work will occur at the account, practice, and provider level with the ultimate goal of achieving specific referral volume goals and increasing referral volume.

Ultimately, the Clinical Partnership Manager’s main job is activating physicians within contracted practices to refer patients to the CCP service. Clinical Partnership Managers will carry a specific referral goal/quota on a monthly basis, and will be evaluated based not only on this outcome, but also on their ability to engage with key physician referrers in their territory. These physician interactions will occur via phone, video conference and in person.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

What You Will Bring

Education

A degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or another relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Statistical Programming & Technical Guidance

Project Management

Sponsor & Stakeholder Engagement

About Celldex

Celldex is pioneering new horizons in immunology to deliver life-changing therapies. We are relentless in our pursuit of novel antibody-based treatments that engage the human immune system and directly affect critical pathways to improve the lives of patients with allergic, inflammatory and autoimmune disorders. We have built a culture where innovative and talented people thrive—focusing a significant effort on attracting and retaining passionate and motivated employees who want to play a role in helping people with serious health conditions and who see this effort as personally rewarding. In our highly entrepreneurial environment, employees are empowered and the opportunity for professional development occurs every day.

Celldex is now entering an exciting new chapter – building a commercial team to launch barzolvolimab - the most advanced anti-KIT therapy in pivotal development that has the potential to redefine treatment for multiple allergy and dermatological diseases with Phase 3 studies in CSU, ColdU, and SD. We’re looking for curious, driven builders who can connect their day-to-day work to enterprise-level impact, endlessly prioritize what matters most, and deliver on their commitments with urgency and ownership. If you’re energized by building something meaningful, excited to grow personally and professionally, and motivated to create lasting impact in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment, we’d love to meet you.

Ready to make an impact? Learn more about joining the Celldex Team today!

Overview

The National Account Director (NAD) is responsible for developing, managing, and optimizing strategic relationships with national and regional payer organizations to ensure broad patient access to Barzolvolimab. Reporting to the Executive Director, National and Key Accounts, the NAD will lead account planning, contract strategy, reimbursement discussions, and ongoing payer engagement activities across assigned managed care customers.

This highly strategic role requires deep expertise in market access, reimbursement, payer decision-making, and account management. The NAD will serve as the primary point of contact for key payer accounts and will work collaboratively with Market Access, Medical Affairs, Sales, Field Reimbursement, Contracting, Patient Services, and Commercial Operations to develop and execute account-specific strategies that support successful coverage, reimbursement, and product adoption. The successful candidate will combine strong business acumen, relationship management skills, and market access expertise to drive favorable outcomes for patients, providers, and Celldex.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned national and regional payer organizations.
  • Establish and maintain senior-level relationships with key payer decision-makers, including pharmacy, medical, policy, contracting, and reimbursement stakeholders.
  • Lead payer engagement activities related to Barzolvolimab coverage, reimbursement, contracting, and access initiatives.
  • Negotiate and manage payer agreements in partnership with Market Access leadership, Legal, Finance, and Contracting teams.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop and execute payer strategies that align with Celldex's overall commercial and market access objectives.
  • Communicate the clinical, economic, and patient value proposition of Barzolvolimab to payer customers in compliance with company policies and regulations.
  • Monitor evolving payer policies, reimbursement landscapes, formulary decisions, and competitive dynamics and provide actionable insights to internal stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with Field Reimbursement, Patient Services, and Commercial teams to ensure alignment between payer strategy and field execution.
  • Identify and proactively address payer-related risks, access barriers, and reimbursement challenges that may impact product adoption.
  • Participate in forecasting, contract modeling, business reviews, and market access planning activities.
  • Provide account-specific intelligence and recommendations to support launch planning, reimbursement strategy, and business decision-making.
  • Maintain accurate account records, engagement plans, and business reporting in accordance with company requirements.
  • Operate in full compliance with all company policies, legal requirements, and industry regulations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MPH, PharmD, MS, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Minimum of 8 years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, managed care/market access, or healthcare industry experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience managing payer, managed care, health plan, PBM, or integrated delivery network relationships.
  • Demonstrated success developing and managing strategic payer accounts and executing complex access strategies.
  • Strong understanding of managed care, healthcare reimbursement, formulary management, coverage policy development, and payer decision-making processes.
  • Experience negotiating and managing payer contracts preferred.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior executives and key decision-makers within payer organizations.
  • Strong analytical, business planning, and financial acumen, including experience evaluating contract performance and market access opportunities.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional stakeholders and organizational levels.
  • Experience supporting specialty pharmaceutical or biotechnology products preferred.
  • Experience with buy-and-bill products strongly preferred.
  • Immunology, allergy, dermatology, or specialty biologic experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting product launches and reimbursement strategy development preferred.

Compensation Statement

Position Overview:

The Director of Data & Analytics is ExploreK12's senior data leader, reporting to the VP of Engineering. The Director leads the team responsible for how company data is modeled, governed, and delivered across the enterprise, including data engineering, analytics, business intelligence, reporting, and Data & Analytics' contribution to adaptive-learning capabilities.


The Director leads a working Senior Manager responsible for adaptive logic and analysis, a PM / BA / Scrum Master, and data engineers supporting enterprise and product needs. The Director is accountable for the overall technical direction, architecture, delivery, and development of the Data & Analytics organization while remaining directly involved in the team's most important technical work.


This is a working Director role. The Director must be able to open any model in the repository, reason about its design and implementation without a translator, and contribute directly to complex or ambiguous technical work. A candidate who intends to step away from the code is not a fit for this role.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Data & Analytics organization, including a Senior Manager, PM / BA / Scrum Master, and data engineers, with accountability for organizational performance, talent development, hiring, and developing engineers' technical and modeling judgment.
  • Set the data roadmap with the VP of Engineering within the broader technology and data strategy, prioritizing initiatives based on business value, cost, risk, and capacity.
  • Serve as a trusted data partner to business, product, and BU leaders, providing credible feasibility, cost, and trade-off assessments before work begins.
  • Treat data as a product: understand the users and requirements for data assets and manage the warehouse, models, reporting, and dashboards with clear ownership, quality standards, and measures of success.
  • Own data architecture and engineering standards, including warehouse design, modeling conventions, shared codebase standards, and use of curated data layers; use design and code reviews to ensure quality and develop team judgment.
  • Build deep knowledge of source data across product lines and lead reconciliation of metrics and sources of truth across legacy systems.
  • Ensure Data & Analytics' contribution to adaptive logic and analysis is well governed and coordinated with Product and other teams that share this work.
  • Represent Data & Analytics on the Data Governance Committee and translate governance, privacy, and security requirements into platform controls and practices, including access controls, the data glossary and catalog, PII tagging, and lineage.
  • Implement and maintain data platform controls that support compliance with student data privacy obligations, including FERPA, COPPA, state student privacy laws, and district data privacy agreements.
  • Ensure the reliability, quality, security, observability, and cost efficiency of data platforms and pipelines, including incident response and alignment with Engineering's CI/CD, testing, security, and cloud practices.
  • Establish and report meaningful measures of Data & Analytics performance across data quality and availability, reliability, adoption, stakeholder value, cost, and governance coverage.
  • Spend approximately 40% of the role hands-on: build dbt models alongside the team, take on complex or ambiguous technical work, review critical designs and code, and use AI coding assistants regularly.
  • Lead responsible AI use in Data & Analytics, in support of the VP of Engineering's AI strategy: establish team practices for AI-assisted development, including verifying AI-generated code and measuring its impact on delivery, and partner with Legal/Privacy, Security, and other stakeholders to define and implement rules for appropriate use of company data, especially student data, in AI tools and features.

Job Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in data and analytics, including 4+ years managing engineers who build warehouse data models.
  • Expert SQL and strong dimensional modeling and layered warehouse design skills.
  • Hands-on production experience with dbt and Snowflake, including Snowflake roles, permissions, performance, and cost optimization.
  • A track record of substantive pull request review and GitHub-based development workflows.
  • A product mindset, with experience managing data capabilities around defined users, requirements, quality standards, and measures of success.
  • Experience translating governance and privacy requirements into platform controls such as access policies, PII tagging, lineage, and quality monitoring.
  • Evidence of building deep fluency in complex source data, ideally across multiple products or through company or platform integration.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools in production workflows, or demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt and establish effective practices for their use.
  • Strong people leadership and the ability to explain technical decisions, costs, risks, and trade-offs to executives and non-technical partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Student data privacy experience, including FERPA, COPPA, and district data agreements, or experience in another regulated data domain.
  • Familiarity with adaptive-learning systems, learning analytics, or statistical modeling of student performance.
  • Experience with Python, Tableau, and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce and Revenue Cloud data.
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex Analyst or other generative AI approaches to self-service analytics.

Why Work for Us

When you join ExploreK12™, you become part of a mission to help educators unlock brighter futures for every student.


As a trusted leader in educational technology, we serve more than 17 million students and educators across 150+ countries with innovative, research-backed learning solutions that truly make a difference. An Equal Opportunity Employer

Job Summary:

As a Quality Assurance Analyst at Helm, you are a champion of quality across every stage of the software development lifecycle. You work closely with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teammates to ensure Helm CONNECT meets the highest standards of reliability, usability, and performance for our customers in the marine industry. You don't just find bugs - you ask the questions that prevent them, challenge assumptions early, and make the whole team think more deeply about quality.

This role will be embedded within the Kirby project delivery team in Research and Development, providing dedicated QA coverage for a contractually committed, large-scale customer engagement.

Job Description:

What you are responsible for:


Quality Strategy and Execution:

  • Design, write, and execute test cases across web and mobile platforms for assigned product lines and project work.
  • Create and maintain test plans for releases and delivery milestones, ensuring coverage is intentional, traceable, and communicated clearly to the team.
  • Work closely with product owners, developers, and QAs to identify areas of risk and strategically prioritize testing to maximize coverage and impact.
  • Validate integration quality between Helm CONNECT and third-party systems and integrations scoped within the Kirby engagement.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teammates - including support and account managers - to investigate reported issues, respond to questions, and ensure high-priority problems are visible, tracked, and never fall through the cracks.

AI-Augmented Quality Assurance:

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated output - catching hallucinations, refining results, and ensuring AI-assisted work meets Helm's quality standards.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools and share learnings with the broader QA team to continuously improve testing efficiency.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Advocate for quality as a mindset across the team, not just a final checkpoint.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tooling, and coverage.
  • Support the growth of test automation practices within the team.

What you bring to the team:


Technical Expertise:

  • Proven experience in manual, integration, and API testing.
  • Solid understanding of Git fundamentals - branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and navigating a shared repository.

jobs.excerpt: TITLE:Senior Specialist, Business Development & Strategic PartnershipsRESPONSIBLE TO:Senior Manager, Strategy & Business DevelopmentDIVISION/DEPT:Innovation & Business DevelopmentSUPERVISES:N/AFLSA STATUS:ExemptSUMMARY The Senior Specialist, Business Development & Strategic Partnerships will play an important role in helping Goodwill Industries International (GII) turn enterprise-level strategic partnerships into operational reality across the Goodwill network.
jobs.description:
TITLE:Senior Specialist, Business Development & Strategic PartnershipsRESPONSIBLE TO:Senior Manager, Strategy & Business DevelopmentDIVISION/DEPT:Innovation & Business DevelopmentSUPERVISES:N/AFLSA STATUS:Exempt

SUMMARY

The Senior Specialist, Business Development & Strategic Partnerships will play an important role in helping Goodwill Industries International (GII) turn enterprise-level strategic partnerships into operational reality across the Goodwill network. Working closely with the Innovation & Business Development team, this role serves as the day-to-day execution and program management lead for GII's strategic partnerships, supporting local Goodwill organizations as they adopt new technologies and processes, and helping successful pilots scale to many stores.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity, building clear documentation and roadmaps, and working with partners and member organizations to solve practical problems. The role offers broad exposure to retail operational optimization, the resale industry, sustainability, and reverse logistics, along with a clear path to grow into broader partnership responsibilities.

BASIC FUNCTION

This role will support GII's business development strategy by:

  • Serving as a day-to-day execution and project management contact for enterprise-level strategic partnerships, in close coordination with the Senior Manager, Business Development.
  • Coordinating with local Goodwill organizations to stand up cross-functional teams. Supporting local Member deployment through the implementation of new processes and technologies.
  • Translating pilot learnings into executive-level documentation. Building roadmaps and plans to scale initiatives across hundreds or thousands of stores.
  • Collaborating closely with Donated Goods Retail, Sustainability, Legal, Finance, and Data/IT teams to keep partnership work aligned and deliver against strategic goals.
  • Contributing to GII's broader view of enterprise strategy by ensuring external relationships improve network economics and enhance workforce and community impact.

SPECIFIC DUTIES

Pilot & Program Execution

  • Support the day-to-day management of active pilots and programs, tracking milestones, dependencies, risks, and open issues, and escalating as needed.
  • Support the design of measurement plans for retail tests, including KPIs, data sources, and success criteria, so results clearly inform scale decisions.
  • Help build and maintain scale plans (readiness assessments, rollout sequencing, training, process and tooling needs) for programs moving from pilot to broader deployment.
  • Capture learnings from participating Goodwill organizations and partners and translate them into clear recommendations for the team.

Member Coordination & Enablement

  • Coordinate with local Goodwill organizations to stand up cross-functional implementation teams and support onboarding, deployment of new technologies, and adoption of new processes.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for member questions, helping to troubleshoot and remove barriers to implementation.
  • Coordinate enablement materials (playbooks, SOPs, training, FAQs) for member organizations and internal teams.

Documentation, Templates & Roadmaps

  • Create clear documentation for new program implementations, including process guides, project plans, and roadmaps.
  • Support the creation of repeatable templates that accelerate deal velocity while protecting the network's interests, drafting in partnership with Legal, Finance, and the Senior Manager. This role does not own negotiations or deal-making.

Partner Account Management

  • Engage with partner representatives in a professional, well-prepared manner, helping to organize workstreams, follow up on action items, and make sense of ambiguity.
  • Support governance and cadence with key partners, including meeting preparation, agendas, status updates, and joint roadmaps.
  • Help identify opportunities to expand programs to additional members, markets, and operating contexts.

Financial & Impact Analysis

  • Support basic financial modeling, including ROI and cost-benefit analysis, to help members and GII understand the economics of new programs and inform scale decisions.
  • Manage and track KPIs for partnerships (e.g., revenue, volumes, member participation, cost-to-serve, diversion, workforce and community outcomes).
  • Prepare clear dashboards and narratives for leadership and participating members.

Market Intelligence

  • Track industry trends across retail and resale, circular economy, recycling, logistics, marketplaces, and enabling technologies, and synthesize implications for Goodwill.
  • Contribute to briefings, partner summaries, and executive updates.

RELATIONSHIPS

Internal:Daily contact with the Senior Manager, Business Development; regular contact with the Vice President, Innovation & Business Development; frequent collaboration with Innovation, Sustainability, Donated Goods Retail, Legal, Finance, and Data/IT teams.

Goodwill local organizations: Frequent engagement with operations, retail, and leadership teams at member organizations to support implementation, understand local needs and capabilities, and gather feedback.

External:Regular interaction with representatives of enterprise-level strategic partners and, over time, other retailers, brands, logistics providers, recyclers, and technology firms.

SKILLS NEEDED

  • Strong attention to detail, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • Professional written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage confidently with external partners and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Structured thinking and the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous situations; takes initiative and works well with limited direction.
  • Strong program or project management fundamentals, including planning, tracking, documentation, and risk management.
  • Working knowledge of financial modeling, ROI, and cost-benefit analysis (e.g., Excel or Google Sheets).
  • Collaborative approach to working across functions and with member organizations that have diverse operating contexts.
  • Proficiency with common productivity, project management, and presentation tools; familiarity with CRM or pipeline tools is helpful.
  • Interest in retail/resale, circular economy, sustainability, reverse logistics, or technology-enabled operations (preferred).
  • High ethical standards, mission orientation, and commitment to equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to travel as required (approximately 5-15%).

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Relevant experience in account management, client service, consulting, program or project management (including PMO roles), or retail operations. Experience supporting or scaling pilots in a retail or multi-site setting is a plus, as is experience working in federated networks or multi-stakeholder environments.

ACRT, Inc.Full time Regular

ACRT, Inc. is seeking an experienced arboriculture professional with a strong background in training, leading, and developing field personnel in arboriculture and utility line clearance operations. This remote position requires approximately 75% travel throughout the United States to deliver training at customer locations and ACRT company sites.

Candidates will serve as subject matter experts in arborist safety and field operations, delivering structured, hands-on training to students performing arboricultural and utility-related work. The Traveling Crew Trainer will coach, provide feedback, evaluate skill development, and reinforce safe work practices across a wide range of experience levels. This role requires extensive travel nationwide to support workforce development initiatives and ensure consistent safety and performance standards across regions.

The tree care and utility industries continue to evolve with new equipment, techniques, and regulatory requirements that demand ongoing skill development. This position is ideal for someone who is passionate about elevating safety culture and advancing technical excellence across the industry. As safety is a core value at ACRT Services, we are seeking a candidate committed to making a measurable impact by sharing their arboricultural knowledge, field expertise, and dedication to safe work practices. Even reinforcing fundamental safety principles can significantly reduce risk, prevent line strikes, and help protect both workers and the communities they serve.

This position will provide hands-on and classroom-based training in electrical hazard awareness, hazard tree identification and mitigation, utility pruning standards, roping and rigging techniques, felling procedures, line strike prevention, rescue techniques, and both basic and advanced climbing systems. Candidates must have experience in tree care, utility line clearance operations, and climbing techniques. The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate with and instruct diverse groups of adult learners, clearly demonstrate technical skills in both field and classroom settings, and maintain a strong commitment to safety, professionalism, and continuous improvement.

Duties and Responsibilities: The Traveling Crew Trainer will be responsible for the following:

  • Deliver classroom and hands-on field training nationwide on topics including electrical hazard awareness, hazard tree identification and mitigation, utility pruning standards, roping and rigging techniques, felling procedures, line strike prevention, rescue techniques, and basic and advanced climbing systems.
  • Travel approximately 75% throughout the United States to conduct training at customer locations and ACRT company sites.
  • Coordinate and book personal travel arrangements in alignment with company travel policies.
  • Evaluate student performance through written exams, practical skill assessments, and participation; record and submit student scores, attendance records, and required documentation for certificate processing and data entry.
  • Review and grade self-certification materials and examinations; upload and maintain accurate student training records.
  • Collect, review, and analyze course evaluations and participant feedback to continuously improve training delivery, content effectiveness, and overall student experience.
  • Develop new and customized training programs to meet specific customer needs, regulatory requirements, and operational challenges.
  • Review, update, and maintain course curricula, examinations, and training materials on an annual basis to ensure alignment with current industry standards, safety regulations, and best practices.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and industry representative by attending and presenting at trade shows, conferences, and industry events.
  • Actively support business development efforts by identifying potential training opportunities, cultivating new customer relationships, and maintaining strong partnerships with existing clients.
  • Reinforce company safety culture and ensure all training activities reflect current safety standards, policies, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Provide coaching and constructive feedback to participants to strengthen technical competency, safe work practices, and overall job performance.
  • Maintain professional certifications, technical knowledge, and instructional effectiveness through ongoing professional development.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree or experience in Forestry, Horticulture, Arboriculture, Environmental Studies, Conservation, Natural Resources or related fields or a high school diploma plus 4 years related experience in the tree care industry

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bilingual in Spanish
  • ISA or TCIA certification

What we offer you:

Along with competitive compensation, the Travel Crew Trainer will receive:

  • Company provided travel and daily meal per diems during the work week.

Description du poste

Relevant de la Vice-présidente, Services professionnels et Expérience client, cette personne aura pour mandat d'assurer la livraison des projets d'implantation de nos solutions de commerce électronique, selon les paramètres établis, tout en veillant à la satisfaction des clients et à la rentabilité du portefeuille. Elle dirige également le bureau de projets : gouvernance, méthodologie, capacité et suivi financier. Nous cherchons une personne ayant un solide leadership, une grande rigueur financière et un réel intérêt pour l'automatisation et l'IA. À titre de Gestionnaire, vous encadrez une équipe de 7 personnes, composée de gestionnaires de projets et d'analystes d'affaires, entièrement en télétravail.

Votre mission

Vous aimez quand un portefeuille de projets tourne rondement : échéanciers respectés, marges au rendez-vous, chaque heure travaillée facturée, clients satisfaits — et une équipe mobilisée, même à distance. C'est exactement votre terrain de jeu.

À titre de Gestionnaire, Services professionnels et Bureau de projets, vous êtes le chef d'orchestre de la livraison de nos projets clients sur nos plateformes Orckestra et K-ecommerce. Vous gérez la capacité de l'équipe, gardez le cap sur les risques, les budgets et les échéanciers, et faites évoluer nos processus pour qu'ils soient plus simples, plus automatisés et plus rentables. Bref, vous transformez des plans de projet en résultats concrets

Ce que vous ferez

  • Être redevable de la livraison du portefeuille de projets : échéanciers, budgets, portée et qualité, du démarrage à la clôture.
  • Prendre en charge directement certains dossiers clients stratégiques ou en difficulté, et agir comme point d'escalade auprès des clients.
  • Identifier et analyser les facteurs de risque de chaque projet — probabilité, impacts, plans de contingence — et intervenir avant qu'ils ne se matérialisent.
  • Superviser la préparation des estimés, approuver les demandes de changement et assurer un contrôle serré des ressources humaines et financières tout au long du projet.
  • Coordonner les ressources entre projets concurrents et orchestrer une communication fluide avec les clients et les parties prenantes internes (ventes, produit, support, finances).
  • Contribuer aux prévisions financières mensuelles (revenus, backlog, utilisation) et à la fermeture de fin de mois des Services professionnels.

Bureau de projets, rentabilité et automatisation

  • Diriger le bureau de projets : gouvernance, méthodologie d'implantation, gabarits, jalons, indicateurs et rapports d'avancement.
  • Mettre en place des outils de contrôle et des processus pour s'assurer que toutes les heures effectuées sont facturées aux clients, afin d'augmenter le taux de facturable et le ratio SP, et d'atteindre les standards Harris.
  • Gérer la capacité et la planification des ressources, avec une vue consolidée et prévisionnelle des charges de travail.

jobs.description:
Overview

Nakupuna Prime is looking for a Testing and Evaluation (T&E) Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support the Defense Acquisition University’s learning asset development and training delivery. The contractor shall provide Test & Evaluation (T&E) expert(s) with extensive experience and knowledge in evaluating data, the methods used, and their application within the DoD Systems Acquisition domain. The ideal candidate will be fluent in Agile, Lean, and DevSecOps methodologies and possess working knowledge of emerging technologies such as Azure cloud, generative AI, and quantum computing.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

Specific actions include the following:

  • Provide subject matter expertise and technical guidance on the content development of DAU authored learning assets.
  • Review and implement DAU Initial Design Strategies.
  • Participate in Curriculum Requirements meetings.
  • Participate and lend expertise in course development meetings.
  • Serve as the lead subject matter expert in the building of course and credential exercises, projects, and assessments.
  • Review DAU authored learning assets for technical accuracy, currency, consistency with current policy, and adherence to the requirements in the Initial Design Strategy.
  • Review and select commercial training material for appropriateness and inclusion in DAU courseware.
  • Develop and/or review question banks, Terminal Learning Objectives, Enabling Leaning Objectives, Design Documents, lesson outlines and outlines converted into slides for DAU credential assets, modules, and lessons.
  • Participate in Scrum and SWARM approaches to flexible team-based development using ADO Kanban boards.

Qualifications

Skills and Qualifications: The ideal candidate is familiar and has experience with the following technical knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • Determining whether collected data are sufficient to support established DT&E metrics (e.g., performance, reliability, cybersecurity, and interoperability) and operational evaluation metrics (e.g., effectiveness, suitability, survivability)
  • Determining whether data collected via experiment, demonstration, developmental test, operational test, and/or modeling and simulation tools are sufficient to facilitate a credible DT and OT evaluation of the system (or system-of systems)
  • Evaluating conclusions by confirming that the collected data can sufficiently and accurately support the evaluation frameworks in the approved TEMP or other test strategy documentation.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience, with direct involvement in PMO operations supporting DoD systems acquisition.
  • Demonstrated success applying software T&E practices within large DoD programs, particularly within or in partnership with a PMO.
  • Proven experience integrating T&E strategies into TEMP and TES documentation.
  • Strong background in Agile, Lean, and DevSecOps for software testing and development.
  • Solid understanding of Azure cloud infrastructure, generative AI, and quantum computing principles.
  • Experience in curriculum development, learning strategy design, and delivery.
  • Ability to manage software T&E risk assessments and create mitigation strategies aligned with PMO expectations.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder alignment skills within cross-functional and technical teams.
  • Self-motivated and self-monitoring, exceptional oral and written communications, and ability to multi-task.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Highly proficient in SharePoint and Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

Clearance: Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain a favorable background check

Location: Most of the work is performed remotely. The SME will travel as needed to Dayton, OH and the National Capital Region.

Physical Requirements: The ideal candidate must at a minimum be able to meet the following physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation:

  • Ability to perform repetitive motions with the hands, wrists, and fingers.
  • Ability to engage in and follow audible communications in emergency situations.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and working on a computer.

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a proven YouTube Growth & Performance Specialist to manage, optimize, and scale channels supporting nonprofits, documentary films, and mission-driven campaigns.

We need an expert in YouTube’s platform features, audience growth, analytics, advertising, and conversion optimization—with demonstrated results.

This is NOT a content creation, video editing, or general social media position.

Our team produces high-quality video content. We need someone who knows how to maximize its reach, engagement, subscriber growth, and return on advertising investment.

Key Responsibilities

YouTube Channel Management & Optimization

  • Audit existing channels, video libraries, audiences, and performance.
    Optimize titles, thumbnails, descriptions, metadata, tags, chapters, and YouTube SEO.
  • Master YouTube’s native tools: playlists, end screens, cards, channel layouts, calls to action, and advanced settings.
  • Improve organic discovery, watch time, audience retention, click-through rates, and subscriber conversion.
  • Identify opportunities to improve existing content performance.

Audience Growth & Conversion

  • Develop strategies to grow qualified subscribers, views, and returning audiences.
  • Optimize the viewer journey from impressions and clicks to subscriptions, website visits, registrations, donations, and transactions.
  • Identify high-performing audiences, content, and acquisition channels.
  • Establish measurable growth goals and performance benchmarks.

YouTube Advertising & ROI

  • Plan, manage, and optimize YouTube campaigns through Google Ads.
  • Oversee targeting, budgets, bidding, remarketing, and conversion strategies.
  • Establish and track performance ratios, including:
  • Cost per view (CPV)
  • Cost per click (CPC)
  • Cost per subscriber
  • Cost per lead, registration, or transaction
  • Conversion rates and return on ad spend (ROAS)
  • Develop reliable forecasts connecting advertising investment with measurable results.
  • Optimize spending based on actual performance, not vanity metrics.

A/B/C Testing & Analytics

  • Test titles, thumbnails, calls to action, audiences, and ad creatives.
  • Leverage YouTube’s native testing capabilities and Google Ads experiments.
  • Measure impressions, CTR, retention, watch time, subscriber growth, and conversions.
  • Build dashboards connecting ad spend to audience growth and meaningful actions.
  • Translate data into recommendations that continually improve performance.

Required Platform & Software Expertise

Core Platforms

YouTube Studio & Advanced Analytics

Google Ads / YouTube Advertising / Demand Gen

Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

Google Tag Manager & conversion tracking

YouTube native title and thumbnail testing

Looker Studio / performance dashboards

UTM tracking and attribution

Additional Experience Preferred

vidIQ / TubeBuddy

YouTube SEO and competitive analysis

CRM, donation, and transaction tracking integrations

Google for Nonprofits / YouTube Nonprofit Program

Advanced audience targeting and conversion optimization

Qualifications

  • Proven experience growing and optimizing YouTube channels.
  • Documented results increasing subscribers, qualified views, engagement, and conversions.
  • Experience managing advertising budgets with measurable cost-per-result outcomes.
  • Advanced technical knowledge of YouTube’s native platform features.
  • Experience with structured A/B testing, analytics, and attribution.
  • Ability to explain advertising economics and make data-driven decisions.
  • Nonprofit, advocacy, documentary, or cause-based media experience strongly preferred.
  • We prioritize demonstrated performance and technical expertise over general marketing credentials.

What Success Looks Like
We want someone who can confidently answer:

  1. What does it cost to acquire 100 or 1,000 qualified subscribers?
  2. How many targeted views, clicks, or conversions can a given advertising budget generate?
  3. Which videos, thumbnails, audiences, and advertising strategies perform best?
  4. How do we convert viewers into subscribers, supporters, donors, or customers?
  5. How do we continually improve results while reducing acquisition costs?

Our goal is measurable, repeatable audience growth supported by reliable performance data.

Engagement Structure

Independent contractor / monthly retainer

Remote collaboration

Initial channel audit and growth strategy
Defined 30/60/90-day performance objectives
Ongoing testing, optimization, and reporting
Advertising budgets separate from professional fees

Long-term engagement potential

jobs.description:
Short Intro and About the Job

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated regulatory professional to join the Regulatory Excellence function of our North America Medical Nutrition business combining Kate Farms, Nutricia North America, Functional Formularies and Real Food Blends. This role offers a unique opportunity to play a key role in our fast-growing medical nutrition business, using expertise to create value and directly impact the development and commercialization of unique products that support the needs of infants, patients, and consumers with specific dietary requirements.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted regulatory expert and strategic business partner, collaborating extensively with Research & Innovation, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, and other colleagues across the U.S. and global organization. The role requires strong knowledge of food and nutrition regulations, particularly labeling and claims, along with the ability to assess regulatory risk and develop practical, compliant solutions that support innovation and business growth.

The Senior Manager, Regulatory is responsible for developing and executing regulatory strategies for assigned products and brands across our North America Medical Nutrition portfolio, including foods for special dietary use, medical foods and infant formula. The position provides science- and regulation-based guidance on product development, ingredient and packaging compliance, labeling, advertising and promotional claims, regulatory submissions, and risk management to support successful commercialization while maintaining compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong scientific and regulatory expertise with sound business judgment, effective collaboration and communication skills, and a practical, thoughtful approach to risk management. Success in this role requires the ability to navigate complex regulatory issues, influence cross-functional teams, and enable business objectives in a fast-paced environment, while maintaining high standards of regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our Regulatory team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position:

  • Provide regulatory guidance and strategic support to Research & Innovation, Medical Affairs, Marketing, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and Legal throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Lead regulatory review and approval of product labeling, packaging, advertising, digital content, promotional materials, and regulated claims.
  • Assess and confirm substantiation of product claims in collaboration with Medical Affairs, Nutrition Science, Research & Innovation, and Legal to ensure scientific support and regulatory compliance
  • Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional project teams, proactively identifying regulatory risks and opportunities throughout development and commercialization activities.
  • Develop and execute practical regulatory approaches for new products, reformulations, ingredient introductions, and product changes to support successful commercialization.
  • Evaluate product formulations, ingredients, specifications, and manufacturing changes to ensure compliance with applicable U.S. regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and external partners to ensure ingredient, product, and documentation compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare regulatory assessments, risk evaluations, and recommendations to support informed business decisions.
  • Monitor emerging regulatory developments, industry trends, enforcement activities, and agency guidance; assess business implications and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Support interactions with regulatory agencies, including the United States Food and Drug Administration, in connection with inspections, inquiries, audits, and import-related activities.
  • Provide regulatory support during product quality issues, recalls, crisis management activities, and corrective action initiatives.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • This role is primarily performed in a remote office setting and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position (e.g., seated or standing) for extended periods.
  • The employee will occasionally be required to travel to Danone corporate offices.

The salary range for this position is $130,000-187,000K USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone USA additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.

About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree. Degrees in Nutrition, Food Science, Regulatory Affairs, Chemistry, Biology, or other scientific disciplines are preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in a Regulatory Affairs (or similar) role with a CPG food manufacturer or ingredient supplier
  • Demonstrated experience with food labeling and regulatory requirements for nutrition-focused products.
  • Experience with Foods for Special Dietary Use (FSDU), medical foods, infant formula, or other specialized nutrition products is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of United States food regulations
  • Scientific proficiency and ability to understand science-based regulations and communicate scientific topics to various functions, including marketing and legal
  • Strong writing and presentation skills
  • Strategic thinker adept at working cross-functionally to achieve goals in a timely manner
  • Creative approach to problem solving, bringing new or alternative regulatory solutions that can best serve the business
  • Strong drive for results and ability to bring projects to completion
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Detail-oriented, accurate and excellent record-keeping skills

About Us, We offer and What's next

Danone’s North America Medical Nutrition business brings together a growing portfolio of mission-driven brands, including Kate Farms, Nutricia, Functional Formularies, and Real Food Blends. Together, we deliver science-backed nutrition solutions for infants, children, and adults with complex nutritional needs, whether they consume nutrition orally or through a feeding tube.

Our ambition is clear: to improve health outcomes, expand access to high-quality nutrition, help reduce healthcare costs, and build sustainable growth. We combine trusted, consumer-loved brands with strong scientific and medical expertise to create nutrition solutions that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

By joining our approximately 450-person North America Medical Nutrition organization, you will become part of Danone’s broader North American and global network. You will have the opportunity to contribute to a growing business, collaborate across brands and functions, and help shape the future of medical nutrition in the US.

You will also join one of the world’s largest Certified B Corporations, working for a company committed to creating lasting value for people and the planet.
