Our technology is deployed across defence and national security applications — already protecting lives and strengthening security across the U.S. and allied markets.

Backed by QIC, Main Sequence, R+VC, Salus Ventures, Folklore Ventures, DYNE Ventures and Beaten Zone Venture Partners, Arkeus is entering a major growth phase. We are a small, fast-moving company with the energy and ambition of a start-up and the technical credibility of a world-class defence technology provider.

We work at the intersection of optics, autonomy, robotics and real-time AI and we deploy what we build. If you want to ship technology that matters, not technology that ships decks, this is where you belong.

Check it yourself on News | Arkeus

We have developed an inclusive, transparent and engaging culture that focuses on building a diverse workforce — realising that to attract the very best, we need to ensure our culture is ready to welcome people from all ages, genders and backgrounds.

About the role

As VP of Growth at Arkeus , you will own Arkeus’ commercial footprint, pipeline expansion, and strategic positioning within the United States Department of Defense (DoD) and its global allies, intelligence community, and civil security agencies. This is a senior leadership role that sits at the center of our global expansion strategy. You will capture new multi-million-dollar opportunities and forge tight integrations with senior leadership within the US DoD, Tier-1 drone manufacturers and uncrewed system OEMs across all forms of autonomy.

You will translate high-level go-to-market strategies into massive tactical contract wins. Working in lockstep with our Australia-based leadership team and the US-based growth teams, you will ensure our AI powered sensing systems become the default perception standard for autonomous systems both in the US and its global allies.

You will directly lead, mentor and drive our team of Business Development professionals, along with the Customer Success and Integration teams as they seek to deliver a compelling customer experience for our growing deployed base.

About you

You are a senior defense tech commercial leader with a proven track record of selling disruptive capabilities into the US military. You are intimate with DoD acquisition pathways (such as OTAs, SBIR Transition, and Programs of Record) and have deep-set relationships across the Pentagon and uncrewed systems ecosystems.

You have high-energy start-up hustle paired with the sophisticated execution mindset required to unseat legacy defense incumbents. You look at the rapidly evolving landscape of software-defined warfare and know exactly how to align our technical superiority with the shifting requirements of the US warfighter. Crucially, you are energized by ambiguity — writing the playbook for our US market dominance is a feature of the job, not a bug

You are a high-level, data-driven operator with a proven track record of unlocking predictable and sustainable revenue in complex, fast-moving deep-tech ecosystems. You understand that growth isn't just about traditional marketing; it requires aligning customer acquisition, contract activation, and international monetization frameworks into a single unified strategy.

Key responsibilities

  • Build US Growth Org: Recruit, scale, and lead a high-performing US-focused business development, capture, and sales-engineering team.
  • Drive Global Revenue Scaling: Own the overarching growth strategy, expanding international pipelines across AUKUS and allied defence markets.
  • Build International Growth: Develop the foundations for global growth; gaining footholds and momentum in key global target markets
  • OEM Partner Integration: Expand commercial integrations with major drone, USV, and aerospace manufacturers to embed Arkeus technology into their legacy and next-gen platforms.
  • Acquisition Management: Navigate and execute federal procurement cycles, proposal developments, and government evaluations to convert technical wins into long-term Programs of Record.
  • Cross-Functional Synergy: Partner with Product Development & Marketing and AUS/US-based Manufacturing to feed frontline user feedback into the product roadmap and marketing messages are aligned to maximise impact.
  • Brand Evangelism: Represent Arkeus at the highest levels of US defense leadership, positioning our edge-AI software enabled hardware architecture as critical infrastructure for uncrewed systems.
  • Sounding Board to CEO: Serve as a trusted radar for the CEO regarding US defense policy shifts, budget allocations, and competitor landscapes.
  • Data-Driven Experimentation: Implement rigorous analytics and KPIs to evaluate the performance of business development initiatives, identifying high-impact levers to pull.
  • Build a High-Performing Growth Team: Lead and scale our Growth team with a culture of leadership, ownership, disruption and audacity that puts our customers first.

Your experience and skills

  • Executive Stature: Senior commercial leadership experience at the VP Growth, Head of Federal, or Chief Commercial Officer level within a scaling deep-tech or defense-tech firm.
  • Defense Native: Proven track record selling hardware-software integrated capabilities, edge-computing, or optical/ISR sensors to US military clients.
  • AUKUS/International Fluency: Experience working within international or allied defense environments (e.g., managing Australian-US defense dual-use controls) is highly regarded.
  • Global Go-to-Market: Demonstrated success launching and positioning technology products in international environments, with particular emphasis on the U.S. and allied defence sectors.
  • High Commercial Acumen: Masterful understanding of how complex operational delivery affects revenue margins, pricing models, and long-term customer relationships.
  • Elite Communication: Ability to code-switch flawlessly between talking highly technical capabilities with edge-AI engineers and talking strategic outcomes with Pentagon stakeholders.
  • Deep Tech Credibility: Track record in scaling complex hardware-enabled software products, ideally within Defence, aerospace, autonomous systems, robotics, or computer vision.
  • Clearance: Ability to obtain or hold a U.S. Secret (or higher) security clearance.
  • Team Building: Demonstrated ability to build teams, systems and processes in a high-growth environment with limited resources.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: you can make good decisions with incomplete information and adjust quickly when the picture changes.

Why join Arkeus

  • You will work on the hardest problems in deep-tech — optics, autonomy, real-time AI and hardware-software integration in a single product. The gap between what you build and where it ends up is almost nonexistent.
  • You will collaborate with exceptional leaders who have decades of combined experience in AI, optics and defence. You will be learning from — and contributing to — the best in the field.
  • You will become part of a close-knit, ego-free team where ideas compete on merit, not seniority. Low politics, high trust. The kind of team you will still be talking about in ten years.
  • You will work hard and be expected to bring your best — and in return you will grow faster than you ever would at a large organisation.
  • You will work on technology that is already deployed in real environments — protecting lives and strengthening security across defence and national security applications.
  • You will receive a competitive, market-benchmarked salary, structured career pathways built to grow with you, and the opportunity to participate in our Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP).
  • You will have the opportunity to mentor bright emerging talent through our highly sought-after intern program and strong connections with leading universities.

If this sounds like you, please apply even if you don't check every box listed above, and join our growing team in improving security and saving lives!

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:

Job Title: Senior Cybersecurity Auditor


Location: India-Remote


Who we are:

Unisys is a global information technology company that builds high-performance, security-centric solutions for the most digitally demanding businesses and governments on Earth. Unisys’ offerings include security software and services; digital transformation and workplace services; industry applications and services; and innovative software operating environments for high-intensity enterprise computing. Unisys builds better outcomes securely for its clients across the Government, Financial Services and Commercial markets. For more information, visit .

Our Vision: Enhancing people’s lives through secure, reliable advanced technology.

Our Core Beliefs:

  • Curiosity: We embrace the unknown and continuous learning.
  • Creativity: We look past routine ways of doing things.
  • Client-Centricity: Our clients’ success is our success.
  • Integrity: We act ethically and honestly.

Position Summary:

Unisys is looking for a seasoned Cybersecurity Auditor, based in India and part of the global CISO team, who will act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and independently plan, execute and drive cybersecurity audits across the organisation’s security, infrastructure, application and cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on technical depth. The role partners with the CISO, GIS, Infrastructure (CIT) and Business Unit teams across the globe through the full audit lifecycle: scoping, planning, execution, reporting and remediation tracking.

The role demands strong stakeholder and leadership engagement. The candidate will present audit results and risk exposure to senior management and the CISO, negotiate findings and remediation timelines, and handle challenging stakeholders across regions and cultures with credibility, objectivity and composure, while keeping the audit programme on schedule.

The candidate will provide regular status updates on audits to senior management, highlighting key risks, challenges and the actions being taken to address them.

Working relationship with Internal and External Teams

  • Work with the CISO and GIS and CIT teams globally – Infrastructure, Applications, Security Architecture, GIS Leadership team, Security Operations team
  • Work with BISOs of the four Business Units and Business Unit leadership across regions
  • Work with other global CISO team members, and with Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as required
  • External – Certifying agencies, vendors, client auditors, client account teams and external audit firms

Key Responsibilities:

Plan and Execute Cybersecurity Audits – 65%

  • Independently own and drive end-to-end cybersecurity audits as the SME, from scoping to closure, with minimal supervision.
  • Manage the internal security audit programme based on requirements from international standards such as ISO, NIST, NIST-CSF, NIS2, Cyber-Essentials Plus, PCI, SSAE 18 etc. using a risk-based audit approach.
  • Prepare, review and maintain the annual audit calendar, audit plans, audit management documentation and audit lifecycle in line with risk priorities and business commitments across regions.
  • Define audit scope, objectives, criteria and sampling approach in consultation with the CISO, GIS and CIT teams.
  • Perform audits based on criteria defined in ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 22301, ISO 20000, NIST, NIST-CSF, NIS2,, SSAE 18 SOC1/SOC2, SOX, Cyber-Essentials Plus, PCI-DSS etc., including audit planning, evidence gathering, field notes and documentation of findings.
  • Perform technical audits for various security domains, for example Vulnerability and Patch Management, Identity and Access Management, Application Development, DevSecOps, Network and Infrastructure Security, Security Operations and Incident Response, Crisis Management and BC/DR.
  • Perform cloud security audits across Azure, AWS and GCP environments, covering identity and access management and privileged entitlements, network segmentation and perimeter controls, data protection (encryption and key management), logging and monitoring, security configuration and posture, and the shared responsibility model.
  • Audit cloud-native and modern platform controls, including container and Kubernetes security, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code, and SaaS/PaaS security, against criteria such as CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM and NIST.
  • Use technical testing and data analysis (configuration reviews, scripts, CLI and query-based evidence collection, log analysis) to validate controls rather than relying only on documentation and interviews.
  • Work with GIS teams to identify the scope of infrastructure and application services to be covered by technical audits.
  • Evaluate control design and operating effectiveness, perform root cause analysis, and assess the risk rating and business impact of findings.

Stakeholder Engagement, Reporting and Remediation – 20%

  • Lead audit kick-off, execution, closing and status meetings with IT, infrastructure, security teams and business units, working across global time zones.
  • Prepare clear, risk-focused audit reports and executive summaries and review them with stakeholders and leadership on a regular basis.
  • Hold leadership-level conversations with the CISO and senior management on audit results, risk exposure and trends, and escalate unresolved or high-risk issues in a timely way.
  • Manage difficult or resistant stakeholders across regions: negotiate and agree findings, remediation plans and timelines, and drive accountability for closure.
  • Track remediation actions to closure, validate the evidence of fixes, and report on overdue items and repeat findings.

Audit Programme Governance and Continuous Improvement – 15%

  • Track audit metrics and KPIs, identify recurring themes, and recommend improvements to the control environment.
  • Continuously improve audit methodology, templates and workpapers, and monitor changes in standards, regulations and the threat landscape that affect the audit plan.
  • Include AI security in audit scope and work with AI governance to ensure AI security requirements are covered by audits.
  • Mentor junior team members and share audit best practices with the global CISO team.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Knowledge and Qualifications:

  • Education and Experience
    • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Engineering in Computer Science or a related field.
    • Overall experience of 12–15 years, with at least 6 years of technical experience working on infrastructure or application systems.
    • Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity and IT audits based on industry standards, including leading audits independently as a subject matter expert.
    • Must have performed technical audits hands-on, including at experience in auditing cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP).
    • Demonstrated experience in the full audit lifecycle (scoping, planning, fieldwork, reporting and remediation follow-up) and in risk-based audit methodologies.
    • Experience working in a global organisation with stakeholders across regions, cultures and time zones.
  • Technical Skills
    • Strong technical depth in at least four of the following: Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability and Patch Management, Network and Infrastructure Security, Application Security and DevSecOps, Security Operations and Incident Response, BC/DR, Data Protection and Cryptography.
    • Hands-on knowledge of cloud security architecture and controls on Azure, AWS or GCP, including IAM and privileged access, network security, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and security posture management; multi-cloud exposure is preferable.
    • Working Knowledge of CSPM, EDR, IAM, Vulenerability Management tools like Wiz, Crowdstrike, MS Defender, MS Entra, Tenable, etc
    • Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code security, and operating system, database and network device hardening.
    • Ability to independently assess technical evidence (configurations, logs, scan outputs, scripts) and to challenge technical teams credibly on control gaps.
    • Working knowledge of ITGC and SSAE 18 SOC1/SOC2. Working knowledge of SOX, PCI-DSS, NIST 800-53 and CIS Benchmarks is preferable.
    • Knowledge and experience in AI security and AI security audits.
    • Working knowledge of GRC and compliance automation tools for Audits, Risks Management
  • Certifications
    • Must have CISA and CISSP certification (or equivalent senior-level security certification).
    • Cloud security certification, for example CCSP, Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500), AWS Certified Security – Specialty or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, is strongly preferred.
    • ISO 27001 Lead Auditor is an added advantage.
    • Other technical certifications such as CCSK, CISM, CRISC, GSNA, CEH or OSCP are a plus.
  • Leadership and Interpersonal Skills
    • Proven ability to engage the CISO and senior leadership, present audit results and risk, and handle conflict and pushback from challenging stakeholders while maintaining audit independence.
    • Excellent oral, written and presentation skills including the ability to write concise executive-level reports.
    • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork capabilities with strong negotiation, influencing and conflict-resolution skills.
    • Ability to indirectly manage by influencing larger groups.
    • Ability to work individually but also to collaborate in a virtual global team, with vendors and clients across time zones, including flexibility for early or late calls.
    • Good change management and project management skills.

Unisys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that considers all qualified applicants without regard to age, blood type, caste, citizenship, color, disability, family medical history, family status, ethnicity, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, national origin, parental status, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, transgender status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.

Job Description:

The Senior QA Analyst leads QA representation in Sprints and are responsible for leading and mentoring an assigned team of QA Analysts that perform testing activities for new software enhancements and bugs in a controlled environment before the release to the CSI customer. They serve as a point of escalation for the most complex projects and act in a team lead capacity, ensure the quality and stability of the software being released and that it supports CSI’s many goals relating to customer service. They provide daily guidance for the collection of data from background research on necessary software enhancements and/or issues requiring immediate attention and lead and participate in the testing process. They execute and oversee tests and compare actual results with expected results to identify and analyze anomalies and potential trends to ensure the expected results for the project or bug can be ascertained.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Functions as a lead QA Analyst for an assigned functional QA team, providing daily guidance, mentorship, and direction; serves as a point of escalation for problem resolution and assists management with assessing team productivity and capacity.
  • Provides team performance feedback and input into the employee review process; may assist management with addressing and/or resolving employee relations issues.

  • Reviews and assigns QA tasks to team members, ensuring Sprint activities are completed and accurately recorded through resolution.

At Kinaxis, our Talent Acquisition team plays a critical role in enabling business growth by ensuring we attract, engage, and hire exceptional talent across the organization. Department: Study Set Up

SUMMARY

The Medical Writer is responsible for interpreting complex clinical study protocols and other medical/scientific documentation to prepare and coordinate laboratory specification and study‑specific medical/technical documents for ACM Global Laboratories. They will partner with internal departments in the development, drafting, review, editing, and finalization of documents used to conduct clinical studies.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of complex clinical study and amendments in accordance to standard operating procedures (SOPs) and regulatory requirements.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the development, revision, and maintenance of high profile and expedited complex study documents and amendments in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Responsible for authoring and finalizing global lab specification documents (GLSD) and other related documents, as needed.
  • Interpret, understand, and contribute to the scientific details of the protocol/technical documentation; identify and resolve gaps to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert (SME) for medical documentation utilized throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Lead, initiate, and manage multiple rounds of internal and external document review.
  • Liaise and drive timely collaboration between key stakeholders to ensure technical documentation meet high quality standards and aligns with business process.
  • Participate in client interactions during study start-up activities and/or during study amendment process.
  • Review of low to medium complexity GLSD in accordance to SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • With support of a mentor, work on the review of high complexity GLSD in accordance with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Lead the development, revision, and maintenance of lab manuals in accordance to SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Review lab manuals to ensure alignment with SOPs and Quality Assurance processes.
  • Resolve challenges and build consensus between all cross-functional groups and collaborators in a timely manner.
  • Maintain a general working knowledge of Food & Drug Administration (FDA), Medical & Healthcare Regulatory Agency (MHRA), New York State Department of Health (NYSDOH), Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH and other pertinent regulations.
  • Demonstrate initiative in professional self-development to improve job performance to maintain relevant working knowledge of clinical trials.
  • Resolve queries for complex studies by using knowledge of regional differences and internal ACM processes for low and medium complexity GLSD and understanding of department responsibilities.

  • BA/BS, or equivalent experience in scientific field

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and desktop publishing or word processing

jobs.excerpt: Introducción En Servitalent, consultora especializada en la selección de talento para el sector industrial, seleccionamos a un/a Business Development Manager para un fabricante de panadería con larga trayectoria y líder en su país de origen que ha decidido crecer a lo grande.
jobs.description:
Introducción

En Servitalent, consultora especializada en la selección de talento para el sector industrial, seleccionamos a un/a Business Development Manager para un fabricante de panadería con larga trayectoria y líder en su país de origen que ha decidido crecer a lo grande.

La compañía tiene un plan para multiplicar su tamaño en los próximos años, acaba de ampliar su capacidad de producción y ha elegido España como mercado prioritario dentro de su ambicioso plan de crecimiento internacional que tiene a Francia como su siguiente foco. Le falta la persona que lo haga realidad.

Tu misión es construir ese mercado. Decidirás a qué puertas llamar, sentarás a los compradores de la gran distribución frente a un producto que se distingue en el lineal y convertirás su interés en referencias. Y no empiezas en blanco: hay cuentas activas y contactos de ferias esperando a alguien que los haga crecer.

Si sabes abrir cuentas en centrales de compra y quieres que tu trabajo se note en los resultados desde el primer año, esta es tu oportunidad para dejar huella en un proyecto que está empezando.

Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades

  • Abrir puertas: Trazar el mapa de centrales de compra y llegar a quienes deciden en productos de panadería y congelados.

  • Poner el producto a prueba: Organizar pruebas y degustaciones y convertirlas en referencias.

  • Negociar y cerrar: Preparar propuestas y acordar condiciones, con la dirección a tu lado.

  • Hacer crecer lo que ya hay: Desarrollar las cuentas activas y dar seguimiento a los contactos de ferias.

  • Estar donde se decide: Representar a la compañía en ferias del sector y visitar tiendas para ver cómo rota el producto.

  • Ser la voz del mercado: Trasladar lo que piden compradores y consumidores al equipo de producto y participar en el lanzamiento de la marca en España.

  • Abrir el siguiente mercado: Participar en la entrada en otros mercados europeos cuando España esté en marcha, con Francia como siguiente etapa.

  • Medir: Mantener el CRM al día y anticipar la evolución de las ventas.

Qué estamos buscando

a. Educación

No se exige una titulación concreta. Lo que cuenta es tu recorrido comercial y tu conocimiento del canal.

b. Experiencia

  • Al menos cinco años en venta B2B.

  • Experiencia comercial en alimentación vendiendo a gran distribución. Conoces sus canales, sus centrales y cómo se consigue una referencia.

  • Has abierto cuentas nuevas, además de gestionar cartera.

  • Se valora especialmente la experiencia en pan. También encajan perfiles de bollería, pastelería, masas congeladas, congelados salados, pan envasado o de compras en cadenas de distribución.

c. Herramientas

CRM para el seguimiento comercial y las previsiones.

d. Idioma

Español nativo o bilingüe e inglés de nivel avanzado. El francés es un plus.

e. Skills

  • Iniciativa: Generas tus propias oportunidades.

  • Negociación con compradores exigentes.

  • Autonomía y constancia para trabajar inicialmente en formato home-office, sin equipo a cargo y con alta independencia.

  • Organización y foco en resultados.

  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para viajar por España, a otros mercados europeos y a la sede central.

Qué ofrecemos

  • Retribución: Fijo de 50.000 a 70.000 € brutos anuales, más comisión sobre ventas. Lo que vendes se nota.

  • La dirección a tu lado: Reporte directo a la Dirección General, formación y acompañamiento personal desde el primer día, y decisiones rápidas.

  • Un producto en el que creer: Calidad diferencial que se defiende sola en una degustación.

  • Capacidad para crecer: Una planta recién ampliada, preparada para servir lo que vendas.

  • Influencia real: Tu visión del mercado pesa en el desarrollo de producto y en el lanzamiento de la marca.

  • Recorrido: El puesto crece con la expansión a otros mercados.

  • Día a día: Teletrabajo desde España, con preferencia por Barcelona o su área, coche, gastos de la actividad y formación en fábrica.

Por qué postularse

Pocas veces se puede construir un mercado desde el principio con el respaldo de una compañía consolidada, un producto con argumentos y la dirección implicada en cada paso. Aquí tu trabajo tendrá nombre propio.

Servitalent gestiona el proceso con total confidencialidad. Primero hablarás con nuestro equipo, que te contará quién es la compañía, y después con su dirección.

Si encajas en el perfil, inscríbete y nos pondremos en contacto contigo.

jobs.title: Scrum Master – Healthcare Technology and Asset Management (HTAM)
jobs.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Scrum Master – Healthcare Technology and Asset Management (HTAM) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program within the Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) product line.
jobs.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Scrum Master – Healthcare Technology and Asset Management (HTAM) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program within the Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) product line.

The Scrum Master will facilitate Agile delivery, coordinate cross-functional teams, remove impediments, and support continuous improvement across multiple healthcare technology and asset management initiatives.

This position will primarily support the Strategic Equipment Planning Guide – Enterprise Equipment Request (SEPG-EER) Cloud application, while also providing Scrum Master support for Maximo Enterprise Asset and Work Management (EAWM) and Enterprise Asset Management/Computerized Maintenance Management System (EAM/CMMS) data migration activities.

SEPG-EER supports VA medical centers in planning, budgeting, and requesting medical equipment, including maintaining rolling five-year equipment plans. The application operates within VA's Azure cloud environment and follows a monthly release schedule supported by automated regression testing.

The selected candidate will work within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Train (ART), collaborating with Product Owners, development teams, testers, technical leadership, and VA stakeholders to ensure effective sprint execution, release readiness, and coordination of dependencies across multiple teams.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile Scrum ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives across assigned HTAM teams.
  • Provide Scrum Master support for SEPG-EER Cloud, Maximo EAWM, and EAM/CMMS data migration initiatives.
  • Coordinate Agile delivery activities across multiple teams to ensure alignment with program objectives, sprint commitments, and release schedules.
  • Prepare teams for quarterly Planning Interval (PI) Planning activities, including capacity planning, feature readiness, dependency identification, and risk assessment.
  • Participate in Scrum of Scrums, Agile Release Train (ART) synchronization meetings, and coordination activities with the Release Train Engineer.
  • Support SEPG-EER's monthly release cycle, including sprint scope management, regression testing coordination, release readiness reviews, and Change Control Board (CCB) approvals.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners to balance production defects, user-reported issues, planned enhancements, and technical debt within sprint commitments.
  • Coordinate with testing teams to ensure automated regression testing is incorporated into release readiness and Definition of Done requirements.
  • Track Section 508 accessibility findings, coordinate remediation activities, and monitor outstanding issues through resolution.
  • Maintain visibility of data migration activities, dependencies, and cutover tasks associated with Maximo EAWM and AEMS/MERS legacy system transitions.
  • Track assigned migration tasks, ownership, timelines, and progress toward enterprise asset management modernization objectives.
  • Coordinate with shared services teams, including cybersecurity, testing, and architecture, to ensure required support aligns with sprint schedules.
  • Maintain accurate Jira boards, sprint backlogs, story estimates, dashboards, and Agile reporting artifacts.
  • Monitor Agile delivery metrics, including team velocity, sprint commitment completion, carryover work, and delivery predictability.
  • Facilitate team discussions regarding sprint performance, delivery challenges, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Identify, document, escalate, and track impediments affecting sprint execution and team productivity.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-team dependencies and escalate unresolved blockers through appropriate Agile Release Train channels.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners and VA stakeholders to maintain refined, prioritized, and appropriately estimated backlogs at least two sprints ahead.
  • Coach development teams, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Scrum principles, SAFe practices, and Agile delivery methodologies.
  • Support effective sprint scope management and ensure urgent or unplanned work follows established intake and prioritization processes.
  • Facilitate collaboration among distributed teams working in fully remote environments.
  • Coordinate with other HTAM Scrum Masters to align cross-team dependencies, PI Planning inputs, and shared delivery objectives.
  • Support stakeholder communications regarding sprint progress, delivery risks, dependencies, and release readiness.
  • Maintain Agile documentation, team working agreements, retrospective outcomes, and continuous improvement action items.
  • Promote Agile best practices, team accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across assigned initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Minimum six years of professional experience serving as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
  • Demonstrated experience independently facilitating Scrum ceremonies across multiple consecutive sprint cycles.
  • Experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Train, including participation in at least one Planning Interval (PI) Planning event.
  • Strong understanding of Agile Scrum methodologies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Hands-on experience using Jira to manage Agile boards, sprint backlogs, filters, dashboards, and Agile reporting.
  • Experience using Confluence or comparable collaboration and documentation platforms.
  • Experience supporting distributed software development teams in fully remote environments.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Teams or comparable virtual collaboration tools.
  • Experience collaborating with Product Owners, developers, testers, technical leadership, and business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, escalate, and resolve impediments affecting Agile delivery.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional dependencies and managing competing priorities across technical teams.
  • Understanding of Agile delivery metrics, including velocity, sprint commitments, carryover, and delivery predictability.
  • Experience facilitating effective team communication, conflict resolution, and collaborative decision-making.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and facilitation skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with technical teams, business stakeholders, and customer leadership.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple Agile delivery activities while maintaining team alignment and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience serving as Scrum Master for applications in production sustainment with established monthly or quarterly release schedules.
  • Experience supporting software development teams that utilize automated regression testing and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-hosted web applications and Power BI reporting environments.
  • Experience supporting capital planning, budgeting, equipment procurement, or healthcare technology management initiatives.
  • Experience tracking and coordinating remediation of Section 508 accessibility findings.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data migration, legacy system modernization, or application cutover activities.
  • Familiarity with enterprise asset management and maintenance platforms, including IBM Maximo, Nuvolo, or ServiceNow EAM.
  • Experience simultaneously supporting two or more Agile teams.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA), Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), or other federal healthcare IT programs.
  • Experience facilitating remote PI Planning sessions, retrospectives, and collaborative workshops using Mural or Miro.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Smartsheet, Jira Align, or comparable enterprise collaboration tools.
  • SAFe Advanced Scrum Master (SASM) certification.
  • SAFe Agilist (SA) or SAFe Practitioner (SP) certification.
  • ICAgile Certified Professional in Agile Coaching (ICP-ACC) certification.
  • PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) certification.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Four additional years of professional experience in Scrum Master responsibilities or Agile delivery may substitute for the bachelor's degree.

Required Certification:

  • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or Certified Scrum Master (CSM) certification.
  • Professional Scrum Master I (PSM I) certification is accepted as an equivalent qualification.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a VA Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential.
  • Must meet the VA residency requirement of residing in the United States for at least three of the previous five years.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $90,000 to $155,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

About Us:

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

How We Work:

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

Bold in how we dream and innovate

Responsive to feedback, challenges and opportunities

Accountable for results and best in class outcomes

Visionary in future focused problem-solving

Exceptional in execution and impact

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a strategic customer advisor and business outcome leader who partners with enterprise customers to drive measurable security value and cyber resiliency. This is a senior, consultative role that operates at the intersection of technology and business strategy—engaging at the CISO and executive level while maintaining the technical depth necessary to guide complex Proofpoint deployments.

The TAM serves as a trusted executive consultant, proactively identifying strategic risks, architecting adoption and value realization plans, and coaching customers on aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security and business frameworks. While the role has evolved to lead with strategic advisory, a strong technical and security software foundation remains essential.

Successful candidates will bring executive presence, commercial acumen, and a proven track record of driving customer outcomes at the enterprise level—combined with deep experience in Linux, messaging, and cloud security environments. Above all, they will have a passion for ensuring a top-quality customer experience.

Your Day-to-Day

Strategic & Advisory (~50%)

  • Drive business outcomes aligned to customer security and organizational goals, ensuring measurable ROI across the Proofpoint investment.
  • Serve as a strategic risk advisor—proactively identifying and mitigating renewal, adoption, and security posture risks before they impact the customer.
  • Act as an executive consultant—building trusted relationships at CISO/VP level, delivering strategic insights and forward-looking recommendations.
  • Architect adoption and value realization plans that ensure customers maximize the full breadth of their Proofpoint deployment.
  • Coach customers on cyber resiliency strategy—aligning Proofpoint capabilities to their broader security framework and organizational risk tolerance.
  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning sessions, articulating security value in business terms.

Technical & Operational (~50%)

  • Maintain technical expertise across the Proofpoint platform—staying current on product capabilities, integrations, and roadmap.
  • Understand the customer’s unique security goals, business requirements, network configuration, and Proofpoint deployment; proactively make recommendations to improve security posture and system performance.
  • Act as a technical advocate to manage and monitor interactions with the Proofpoint technical support team, proactively escalating issues and feature requests.
  • Conduct proactive health checks and provide system performance recommendations aligned to the customer’s deployment.
  • Provide insight on industry trends, the security landscape, best practices, and product roadmaps affecting the customer’s business.
  • Assist customers with setting goals and success criteria for their Proofpoint deployment, and provide reports to track key metrics and progress.
  • Conduct weekly status calls, monthly management calls, and periodic executive-level business reviews.

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

JOB OBJECTIVE:

The Safety and Loss Control Consultant conducts loss analysis and research prior to conducting on-site occupational safety and loss prevention surveys to assess the policy holder's safety efforts and to detect occupational safety hazards to employees. The Safety and Loss Control Consultant prepares and submits reports of findings to management and makes recommendations to management to correct hazards and safety and loss control program needs. This position also participates in management training programs; researches literature, laws, standards and technical developments in the field of safety and loss control and provides the Underwriting Department with risk assessments in support of underwriting determinations.


The Consultant works with standard to large accounts and accounts that present more complex hazard and safety issues. The Consultant may mentor and provide guidance to Safety and Loss Control Trainees as needed. The Consultant participates in training sessions for policyholders in conjunction with Senior Safety and Loss Control Consultants. This requires a vast working knowledge and experience with all aspects of loss control regarding all property and casualty coverages written by Encova:

• General and Products Liability

• Workers’ Compensation

• Property
• Auto/Fleet

• Risk Improvement

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

4. Conducts simple Industrial Hygiene testing.
5. Researches literature, standards, laws, and rules to provide policy holders with effective solutions.
6. Develops cost effective methods to correct hazardous conditions.
7. Analyzes loss information to determine accident trends and provide policy holders with effective solutions.
8. Provides underwriting with accurate and timely reports on the hazards and the effectiveness of controls and the willingness of the policy holder to comply with recommendations to control hazards.
9. Keeps underwriting apprised of any changes in hazards or exposures through copies of reports to policy holders and special reports to underwriting.
10. Responds to requests from policy holders, underwriters, and other agencies in a timely fashion regarding safety issues.
11. Communicates ideas and issues with management to reach successful agreement through innovation, creativity, and compromise.
12. Provides leadership and motivation of the support staff to achieve loss control goals and objectives.

OTHER FUNCTIONS:

jobs.description:
On behalf of DataTech Client #1, SD Solutions is looking for a talented Technical Project Manager to lead client implementations of a product, a Master Data Management (MDM) platform that runs inside each client's own Databricks workspace and cloud environment.

You will own delivery from kickoff to go-live: planning the work, coordinating Frisco Analytics engineers with client data, security, and business teams, and keeping everyone clear on status, risks, and decisions. Because the platform is deployed in the client's environment, much of the work is shared with client teams, so clear and steady communication matters as much as technical fluency in this role.

SD Solutions is a staffing company operating globally. Contact us to get more details about the benefits we offer.

Responsibilities:

Delivery and planning

  • Run two to three concurrent product implementations end to end: scope, plan, schedule, budget, and go-live.
  • Break each engagement into workstreams such as environment setup, source system onboarding, match tuning, data steward enablement, and production cutover.
  • Track milestones, dependencies and resourcing, and fix slippage early rather than reporting it late.
  • Manage scope and change requests through a clear, documented process.

Client and stakeholder coordination

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for client sponsors, data owners, platform administrators, and business data stewards.
  • Coordinate the work clients own in their own environment, such as Databricks workspace access, Unity Catalog permissions, and cloud infrastructure, so it lands on time.
  • Facilitate decisions on match rules, confidence thresholds, and steward review workflows, and record who decided what and why.
  • Lead steering committee meetings and executive readouts.

Security and compliance support

  • Work with Frisco Analytics and product teams to support client security reviews and due diligence questionnaires during onboarding.
  • Ensure implementation team members follow the access, data handling, and confidentiality requirements that apply to client engagements.
  • Route security incidents or concerns to the right owners promptly.

Team leadership

  • Coordinate a delivery team of data engineers and consultants without direct reporting authority.
  • Run sprint ceremonies, stand-ups and retrospectives, and keep project tooling and documentation current.
  • Capture lessons learned to improve Frisco Analytics' implementation playbook.

How you'll communicate

Strong communication is the core skill of this role. You will be the person clients and engineers rely on to know where things stand and what happens next.

  • Translate between audiences. Explain entity matching, golden records, and access permissions to business sponsors in plain language and turn business needs into clear requirements for engineers.
  • Write clearly. Produce concise status reports, RAID logs, decision records, meeting notes, and project plans that a busy executive can scan in two minutes.
  • Run focused meetings. Set agendas, keep discussions on track, close with owners and dates, and send follow-ups the same day.
  • Deliver hard news early. Raise risks, delays, and scope issues directly, with options and a recommendation, before they become surprises.
  • Listen and ask good questions. Uncover unstated requirements, client constraints, and concerns from security and governance teams.
  • Hold firm, kindly. Push back on scope creep and unrealistic dates while keeping the relationship strong.
  • Present with confidence. Lead steering committees, demos, and executive readouts for client leadership.

Requirements:

  • 4 to 7 years of experience in project management, with at least 3 years managing client-facing technical or data projects.
  • A track record of delivering data platform, data integration, analytics, or enterprise software implementations on time and within budget.
  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake or similar) and at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure).
  • Understanding of data concepts such as data quality, data governance, role-based access control, and handling of personal data (PII).
  • Comfort with both Agile and Waterfall delivery, and the judgment to blend them for a client's needs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with examples of client-facing reports, presentations, or executive updates you have owned.
  • Experience with project tooling such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, business, or equivalent experience.

Advantages:

  • Experience implementing Master Data Management (MDM), entity resolution, or customer 360 solutions.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, or Databricks workflows.
  • Exposure to AI or machine learning features in enterprise software, including how to explain human review and auditability to clients.
  • Experience supporting client security reviews, vendor due diligence, or compliance requirements such as SOC 2.
  • A PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or similar certification.
  • Consulting or systems integrator background, working across several clients at once.

About the company:

A Databricks-native SaaS platform built to consolidate enterprise data into a single AI-ready layer. The product covers three domains: master data management (MDM), relationship graphs, and product information management (PIM) — all governed and deduplicated via LLMs and running natively on the Databricks Lakehouse.

jobs.description:
AI Solutions Architect / Copilot Developer

Human-centered problem-solving meets Microsoft AI technology

Role Overview

We're looking for someone who thinks like a strategist, debates like a philosopher, and builds like an engineer. This role sits inside our AI Solutions Group, where the individual will need to reason clearly about ambiguous problems, build consensus among stakeholders, and translate that thinking into working solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.

You'll partner directly with clients to figure out where AI can provide tangible improvements, gather and interpret requirements (even when clients aren't sure what they need), build solutions using Power Platform tools, help test and validate what you've built, and keep it optimized over time. This role is about people, logic, and persuasion as much as it is about implementation.

Why This Role Is Different

We believe the core skills for working effectively with AI aren't primarily technical. They're:

  • Creative problem solving: finding non-obvious paths through ambiguous, messy, or "less than optimal" situations
  • Strategic thinking: seeing the whole system, not just the ticket in front of you
  • Logic and structured reasoning: the same discipline that makes a good philosopher makes a good prompt engineer and a good solution architect
  • Communication and diplomacy: building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities, teaching non-technical teams, and handholding through change

If you have a background in philosophy, strategy consulting, teaching, mediation, debate, logic, systems thinking, or similar disciplines, and you're excited by AI tools, we want to talk to you, even if your technical resume looks nontraditional.

What You'll Actually Do

With Clients

  • Act as a trusted advisor: ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and help clients articulate problems they haven't fully defined yet
  • Build consensus across stakeholders with different, sometimes conflicting, priorities. This is often the hardest part of the job
  • Teach and support end users through change, including patient handholding for less AI-fluent teams
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into plain language

Building the Solution

  • Design and develop solutions in Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and related Power Platform tools
  • When necessary, integrate adaptive cards, connectors, triggers, and APIs to extend functionality
  • Craft effective prompts and grounding strategies for Copilot, Claude, and related AI tools. This is applied logic and language craft as much as coding
  • Build and prototype using Copilot-related AI tools for development and automation, always within strict data-control guardrails
  • Where possible, apply this same workflow to working with Anthropic’s Claude

Keeping It Working

  • Participate in testing, validation, and quality assurance
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancement of deployed solutions
  • Document decisions and create user guides that make adoption easier, not harder
  • Escalate and resolve issues, mentoring teammates along the way

Staying Sharp

  • Continuously evaluate new AI tools and platforms, with a healthy respect for compliance, governance, and data protection in a regulated environment
  • Bring an "AI mindset": curious, experimental, but never careless with sensitive data

What We're Looking For

Core (non-negotiable) skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and structured reasoning: you can break down a fuzzy problem into a clear plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to and persuade skeptical or non-technical audiences
  • Diplomacy and consensus-building, with comfort navigating disagreement without avoiding it
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and a track record of picking up new tools quickly
  • Comfort improvising solutions to non-technical problems, including political, organizational, or human friction, not just code bugs

Technical qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or real-world experience equivalent, any field, with philosophy, humanities, and social sciences welcome, and 3+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Hands-on experience (or strong aptitude to quickly gain it) with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and Copilot Studio
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools, especially Microsoft Copilot and Claude, including prompt engineering and LLM behavior
  • Ability to work within a regulated environment with strict data controls, balancing experimentation against compliance

Preferred:

  • Background in strategy consulting, teaching, philosophy, logic, mediation/facilitation, or debate
  • Understanding of Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and system integrations
  • Experience with RAG-based architectures
  • Certifications in Power Platform, AI, or Copilot-related specialties
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery

Work Environment

  • Location: United States, Eastern Time Zone
  • Travel: None required
  • Schedule: Remote-first, asynchronous-friendly, with some real-time overlap for meetings and collaboration

The Bigger Picture

This is a strategic development role on a high-performing team helping organizations reimagine how they work with AI, using Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, Claude, and beyond. The technology moves fast, and we have a need for people who can think clearly, communicate persuasively, and navigate ambiguity with grace. If that's you, let’s talk.

Role Overview

The Manufacturing Process Engineer will work closely with Product Design, Manufacturing Engineering, contract manufacturers, and equipment suppliers to develop robust, scalable, and cost-effective manufacturing processes for high-volume consumer electronics products.

The role will support the full product development lifecycle, from early product architecture and design decisions through process development, equipment qualification, factory implementation, and mass production readiness.

  • Influence product definition and architecture selection through early Design for Manufacturing engagement with Product Design teams.
  • Develop manufacturing processes across areas including precision electronic assembly, automation, sealing, adhesive application, metal fabrication and finishing, injection molding, and leak testing.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing partners and equipment suppliers to develop robust and scalable production solutions.
  • Improve manufacturing efficiency, flexibility, and scalability through workflow analysis, capacity planning, space optimization, and equipment layout.
  • Identify, evaluate, and introduce new manufacturing processes, technologies, and equipment.
  • Support process qualification, factory implementation, and production ramp.
  • Drive improvements in manufacturability, yield, cycle time, quality, and production efficiency.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience with NX or other CAD tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with DOE, GRR, tolerance analysis, and statistical analysis.

You will play a central part in shaping how AI-enabled service management is adopted across Capita.

You’ll shape the strategy and operating model for the function, using data and insight to improve performance, drive standardisation, automation and continuous improvement, and ensure our services evolve alongside changing customer and technology needs, including the move towards intelligent self-service, virtual agents and proactive support.

Alongside operational leadership, you’ll have significant responsibility for financial performance, governance, security and risk, while building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Capita.

This is an opportunity for an established IT Services leader to influence at a senior level while leading a large and important area of our technology organisation.

Director Service Desk & Service Management

  • Up-to-date knowledge of technology, service-management trends and emerging opportunities, including AI, automation and AIOps
  • Experience of improving customer and colleague experience through self-service, omnichannel support and proactive service

  • Developing and delivering a roadmap for AI-enabled service management, including virtual agents, intelligent triage, knowledge automation and predictive insight
  • Modernising service platforms, tooling and processes to reduce manual effort, ticket volumes and cost to serve

  • Ensuring the function remains responsive to emerging technologies, market developments and changing business requirements
  • Leading change and adoption so that colleagues understand and are confident using new tools, AI and ways of working

You’ll create a clear strategic direction for IT Services, modernising how we deliver support and embedding AI and automation, while ensuring strong and predictable operational performance.


Success will mean delivering resilient and effective services, improving customer and colleague outcomes, strengthening governance and financial performance, and building a service organisation that continuously evolves. You’ll also develop strong leadership capability across your teams, ensuring colleagues understand the strategy, are empowered to deliver against it and have opportunities to develop.

Role Title: General Counsel

Role Type: Contractor

  4. Demonstrated commitment to innovation at the intersection of law and technology.

As a Lead Delivery Manager, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

jobs.title: Intern - Product Design
jobs.excerpt: Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow.
jobs.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

  • Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Roon, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins

  • Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development

  • Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

About the Role

HARMAN's Software Experiences Business Unit (SEBU) builds software products that connect people to music. Our portfolio includes Roon, the leading music library management and playback platform for audiophiles, alongside new music products currently in development.

In this role you will help our product teams understand the people we build for. You will run competitive and user research across music discovery, streaming, and short-form content, sit inside the day-to-day work of a product team, and bring back the language, habits, and unmet needs of a younger audience in a form the team can act on.

This is a paid internship, and you will work as a member of the team rather than an observer. Length of the internship is dependent on when your new hire onboarding happens, but a typical program is 12-weeks. You will join standups and reviews, own your own research threads, and present what you learn directly to the people making product decisions.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Work as an embedded member of the team: join standups, design and product marketing discussions and product reviews, and contribute ideas as a working member of the group.

  • Track and analyze competitors and adjacent products to identify feature gaps, emerging trends, and unmet needs in the category.

  • Maintain a competitive tracker the team can use week-to-week, covering feature releases, notable launches, and shifts in how competitors position themselves.

  • Recruit and interview users in the 16 to 25 age range, with support from the product and marketing teams, to surface authentic language, listening habits, and unmet needs around music discovery and sharing.

  • Support structured usability and concept testing on new features and prototypes: help run sessions, capture qualitative and quantitative feedback, and turn it into concrete recommendations the team can act on within a development sprint.

  • Investigate how the target audience responds to curation and algorithmic recommendation, and feed what you find into feed and curation discussions.

  • Study visual and interaction trends across music, social, and related apps, and share what you find so our product and design teams stay current with what feels credible to a Gen Z audience.

  • Listen to public conversation about products in our category across Reddit, Discord, TikTok comments, and app store reviews, and flag the themes worth the team’s attention.

  • Support user feedback programs alongside the community and R&D teams: help draft survey questions, track incoming feedback and bug reports, and keep a running log of recurring themes.

  • Keep the research repository usable: tag and organize interview notes, clips, and findings so the team can still find them after the internship ends.

  • Summarize findings regularly into short internal documents the team can act on week to week, and deliver a final write-up and presentation pulling together the full 12 weeks of insight.

  • Own one self-directed project: define a question about the product with your manager, run the research, and present your recommendation to the team.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

  • Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program or higher at an accredited institution having completed your Sophomore year or later, taking at least one class in the semester/quarter before participation in the internship program, and returning to school for at least one semester upon completion of the internship program

  • Must have a cumulative 3.0 GPA

  • Preferred degree program in business, marketing, design, human-computer interaction, communications, music business, or a related field.

  • Genuine curiosity about consumer products and how people find, share, and talk about music.

  • Strong written communication: able to turn messy notes into a short, clear document that someone else can act on without a walkthrough.

  • Comfort talking to people you do not know, running an interview, and asking the follow-up question rather than accepting the first answer.

  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several research threads at once with light supervision in a remote environment.

  • Comfortable working with survey results and simple data sets, and willing to report what the findings actually show, including when they are inconvenient.

  • Hands-on familiarity, as a user, with the platforms where music culture happens, including TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, and the major streaming services.

  • Discretion with confidential product, partner, and roadmap information.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Prior internship, coursework, or project experience in user research, product management, marketing, or design.

  • Practical exposure to research methods such as interviews, surveys, or usability testing.

  • Experience building an audience or creating content on a social platform, or moderating an online community.

  • Working knowledge of tools such as Figma, Notion, and survey or analytics platforms.

  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of using them to work faster and better: synthesizing interview notes, drafting research summaries, and speeding up desk research.

  • A personal stake in music: musician, DJ, playlist curator, writer, or active participant in a scene.

Things To Know

  • This role allows for remote work and a candidate can be located anywhere in the United States.

  • This position allows for up to 20 hours per week, constituting a Part-Time Internship. Flexibility for more working hours is at the discretion and ability of the business unit.

  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment (post-offer).

What You Can Expect

  • Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)

  • Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs

  • Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Pay Transparency

Freshman: $19.00

Sophomore: $21.00

Junior: $23.00

Senior: $24.00

Master: $28.00

Dependent on the internship offered, pay is based on factors, including without limitation, the applicant's level of education and business need.

Benefits

HARMAN is interested in your health and wellbeing and offers benefits designed to support your wellbeing. Benefits and perks may vary depending on the nature of your relationship with HARMAN, and may include paid sick leave and medical benefits.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology
Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. Job Title: Technical Lead, Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) Projects
Work Arrangement: Fully remote within the United States; full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time (client working days only; no client holidays)

Final Interview: Client interview by phone or in person

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring a Technical Lead on behalf of the client, a state government agency, to support its Medicaid Management Information System (MMIS) program. Under the direction of the state IT Manager, the Technical Lead performs technical lead and backup technical lead duties on two MMIS projects, and on other MMIS projects, programs and systems as assigned:

  • Pharmacy benefit services: replacement of the state's pharmacy benefit services solution.
  • Interoperability, phase 2: prior authorization processes and health data exchange APIs under the CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization final rule (CMS-0057-F).

The Technical Lead is the project team's technical authority and the link between the project team, the state's health and human services departments, the state's central IT agency and the implementation vendors: leading technical design, build, test and deployment activities, overseeing data migration and interfaces, and keeping the quality of the technical solution high.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the assigned technical lead and a member of the project team, take part in project meetings and stay current with the project vision.
  • Coordinate with the state's health access, children and families, human services and digital services organizations and other stakeholders to resolve problems and questions, and report back to the project team.
  • Lead technical design and technology build, test and deployment activities, and provide technical support.
  • Oversee data migration and the implementation of interfaces between existing solutions and the new systems being implemented.
  • Support Agile and hybrid development methods and give input on the team's Agile and hybrid practices.
  • Keep the project team informed of technical risk, complexity and sizing for the ideas it identifies, and work with the project owner on technically feasible options that meet the project's needs and priorities.
  • Support infrastructure and platform decisions.
  • Oversee a healthy release management process and maintain the overall quality of technical solutions.
  • See that vendor code is reviewed and accepted, and identify, prioritize and communicate technical debt and risks.
  • Coach the project team on technical concepts to support decisions, and coach other technical resources on the state and vendor teams.
  • Answer technical questions through technical sprints, research, evaluations and prototypes.
  • Take part in vendor evaluation panels, evaluate vendor markets to help the state acquire IT modules, and work with the project owner, project manager and procurement lead to monitor vendor performance after award.
  • Coordinate with software vendors to investigate application issues and deliver effective resolutions, and work with the vendor to review and produce system documentation and training materials.
  • Recommend system modifications that improve efficiency and reduce operating costs.
  • Take part in team retrospectives, research industry trends and best practices, and unblock issues as they arise.
  • Provide weekly status: planned tasks accomplished, tasks incomplete or behind schedule with reasons, and tasks planned for the next two weeks.

Requirements

Required:

  • Considerable support, development and implementation experience, with a deep understanding of the underlying technologies, business processes and support processes, and the ability to work with a broad range of stakeholders across lifecycle phases.
  • Experience serving as technical lead on large system implementations delivered with vendors, including technical design, build, test and deployment.
  • Experience overseeing data migration and the implementation of interfaces between existing and new systems.
  • Working experience with Agile and hybrid delivery methods.
  • Experience reviewing and accepting vendor code, managing releases and managing technical debt.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical team members and coach other technical staff.
  • Current annual cybersecurity awareness training certificate (a copy is submitted to the client with your resume), or the ability to complete it before submission; the client's annual compliance training must also be completed and kept current during the engagement.
  • Three professional references, submitted with the application, who can speak to your technical lead work.
  • Available full time, Monday to Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:30 PM Eastern Time, for the full 15-month engagement beginning December 1, 2026.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States; work cannot be performed from outside the United States; W-2 only (no C2C or 1099).
  • Must pass a national criminal background check, sign the client's acceptable use and confidentiality terms, work only on client-provided systems, disclose any conflict of interest and any planned use of AI tools in the work, and not use AI meeting assistants in client meetings.

Preferred:

  • Technical lead experience on state Medicaid systems, such as MMIS or Medicaid Enterprise Systems modules, pharmacy benefit systems, or interoperability and prior authorization APIs.
  • Experience working with a state central IT agency alongside program departments.
  • Experience evaluating vendors and IT modules in public sector procurements.

How to Apply

Please send your resume, three professional references and copies of your certificates (any certifications listed on your resume and your current cybersecurity awareness training certificate) to with "Technical Lead, MMIS" in the subject line. For each reference, include the name, title, organization, email address, phone number and the work the reference can speak to.
