jobs.title: Head of CRO & Experimentation
jobs.excerpt: About Dr.  Berg Nutritionals Dr.  Berg Nutritionals is a leader in the health and wellness industry focused on addressing the root causes of health concerns.
jobs.description:
About Dr. Berg Nutritionals
Dr. Berg Nutritionals is a leader in the health and wellness industry focused on addressing the root causes of health concerns. We offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for growth, where you can contribute to helping millions achieve better health through education, premium supplements, and holistic practices like the Healthy Keto® diet.

Working with us, you’ll be part of a globally recognized brand with a social media presence reaching over 49 million followers across platforms.

Be a part of an innovative and fast-growing company that is passionate about transforming lives through education on health and wellness. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where your contributions make a real impact, this is the place for you.

Why This Role Matters
If you want to be the person who owns the truth in the data, sets the standard for how we test, and gives leadership the evidence they need to make big calls, this is the role for you.

We’re a nine-figure DTC brand with data spread across Shopify, Amazon, subscriptions, email, and content, and teams already running tests across the customer journey. What we don’t have yet is one person who owns how we measure, test, and learn. That’s you.

You’ll lead analytics and experimentation for our Customer Journey & Revenue division: the metrics, the definitions, the testing program, the analysis, and the insights. When someone asks “is this working, and how do we know?”, you’re the one with the answer. Working alongside the Director of Customer Journey & Revenue, you’ll make sure every major decision is backed by numbers everyone trusts.

This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role with the freedom to build the functions the way they should be built.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership trusts one set of numbers, and you’re the one who defined them
  • Every test across the customer journey runs through a process you built, prioritized by impact
  • Leaders make faster, more confident decisions because your insights are clear and reliable
  • The impact of every major initiative is measured honestly, so we know what to scale and what to stop

What You’ll Own

The Numbers

  • Own our core customer and revenue metrics and definitions (conversion, retention, LTV, revenue, and more) and the metrics catalog teams rely on
  • Be the final check on data accuracy before it reaches decision-makers
  • Translate business questions from leaders into clear requirements, queries, and data models
  • Partner with our data engineering team to make sure the data platform captures what the business needs
  • Build and evolve reporting and dashboards, starting with our customer journey dashboard


The Testing Program

  • Own the cross-departmental experimentation roadmap, prioritized by revenue potential, traffic, and funnel drop-off
  • Set the standards for how every test is proposed, designed, run, and judged, including a shared intake process and KPI framework
  • Instrument the customer journey with the KPIs and data points needed to measure every stage
  • Lead all results analysis (statistical significance, incremental revenue, win rate)
  • Strengthen incoming test briefs by sharpening hypotheses and success metrics, and resolve conflicts when teams want to test the same page or audience
  • Run the regular test review cadence and keep a shared library of learnings across teams


The Insights

  • Be the trusted source of evidence behind major decisions: what’s happening, why, and what the data suggests
  • Turn analysis into clear, confident recommendations for the Director of Customer Journey & Revenue and executive leadership
  • Represent analytics and testing in cross-functional planning (dev sprints, content calendar, lifecycle) so data shapes decisions from the start
  • Roll up your sleeves when needed, whether that’s writing a query, configuring a test, or building a report yourself


Your First 90 Days

  • Partner with the Director of Customer Journey & Revenue to instrument the full journey with KPIs and data points
  • Stand up a Phase 1 metrics catalog and get it adopted
  • Deliver your point of view on where the journey is performing and where we’re leaving money on the table
  • Launch the test prioritization process and run the first tests through it

What You Bring
Required

  • 7+ years in analytics, BI, experimentation, CRO, or growth analytics, including leading a program or function across multiple teams
  • Experience at a high-volume DTC e-commerce brand
  • Experience with subscription or replenishment business models
  • Strong SQL and hands-on experience with Power BI
  • Deep comfort with statistics, funnel analysis, attribution, and measuring revenue impact across multiple data sources
  • Proven ownership of a testing program end to end: roadmap, prioritization model, KPI framework, and process
  • A track record of strong partnerships across departments (content, lifecycle/CRM, development, design) without directly managing those teams
  • Experience creating documentation, processes, and shared resources that teams actually use
  • The ability to turn analysis into clear, concise recommendations for leadership, in writing and in person

Preferred

  • Experience at a DTC e-commerce brand doing $100M+ in annual revenue
  • Health, wellness, or supplement industry experience
  • Experience with CRO/testing and analytics tools (A/B testing platforms, web analytics, session recording and heatmap tools)
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Shopify, Amazon, Klaviyo, Recharge, and/or FullStory
  • Experience partnering with data engineering on a data warehouse or data lake
  • Experience building or scaling an analytics or experimentation team

Work From Home Requirements

  • Up-to-date Mac or Windows computer with anti-virus protection
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection
  • Quiet, distraction-free workspace
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools and software
  • Experienced using Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Outlook, Teams, Word, OneDrive)

Compensation & Benefits
We are intentional about creating a work environment that supports both high-quality work and the people doing it. We aim to provide our team with the structure, resources, and flexibility needed to do meaningful work while maintaining personal well-being.

We recognize that employees have responsibilities and priorities outside of work, and we respect and support that with our policies and benefits.

We are a fully remote team, allowing team members to work from where they are most comfortable and to avoid unnecessary commuting and overhead.

jobs.excerpt: Overview Working at Atlassian Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two.
jobs.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Your future team

Our Sales Development team partners with Sales, Marketing and other go-to-market teams to build qualified pipeline and deliver a positive customer experience from the first conversation.

As a Sales Development Manager, you’ll directly lead and coach a team of Sales Development Representatives (SDRs). You’ll help them develop their prospecting, discovery and qualification skills, achieve agreed performance targets, and build strong foundations for their sales careers.

This is a hands-on, first-line leadership role. Working within the direction set by Sales Development leadership, you’ll translate priorities into clear daily execution, remove operational barriers and create an inclusive, accountable team environment. You’ll lead an AI-augmented team, using modern tools to reduce repetitive research and administration so SDRs can focus on commercial judgement, relationships and meaningful customer discovery.

In this role you will:

Lead, coach and develop your team

  • Provide regular, individualised coaching through one-to-ones, call reviews, role plays and actionable feedback.

  • Use conversation intelligence and AI-assisted call insights to identify individual skill gaps, tailor role plays and feedback, and accelerate new-hire ramp.

  • Coach SDRs to critically review, fact-check and refine AI-generated research and outreach, applying commercial judgement, relevant tone and human accountability before engaging customers.

  • Coach SDRs on account research, relevant outreach, objection handling, discovery and qualification.

  • Support onboarding and ramp, helping new team members build confidence and demonstrate the skills required for success.

  • Communicate clear performance expectations, recognise achievements and address performance gaps in partnership with your manager.

  • Support career development and contribute to recruiting and interviewing new team members.

Deliver qualified pipeline

  • Guide day-to-day execution against agreed pipeline-generation and qualification targets.

  • Help SDRs prioritise accounts, prospects and activities within their assigned territories.

  • Guide SDRs in signal-led prospecting, using AI-assisted account intelligence and buyer intent signals to prioritise high-potential accounts and tailor relevant outreach.

  • Reinforce customer-led conversations that uncover business challenges, impact and meaningful next steps.

  • Partner with Account Executives, Solution Specialists, and Account managers to improve opportunity quality, acceptance and handover.

  • Review individual and team results, identify risks early and implement practical corrective actions.

Maintain operational discipline

  • Establish a consistent rhythm for coaching, performance reviews and team communication.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records, reporting and visibility into progress against targets.

  • Use funnel and activity insights to identify coaching needs and improve conversion—not simply increase activity volume.

  • Maintain data quality and responsible workflow integration across CRM, sales-engagement tools and approved AI tools; assess conversion lift, research time saved and pipeline yield alongside activity measures.

  • Resolve routine operational issues and escalate matters requiring broader decisions or support.

Collaborate and improve ways of working

  • Work with Sales, Marketing, Enablement and Operations to execute agreed campaigns and prospecting priorities.

  • Share feedback on lead quality, messaging, customer needs and handover processes.

  • Help the team apply approved AI tools to research, personalisation, preparation and prioritisation, while checking source accuracy, protecting customer data and retaining human judgement over customer-facing work.

  • Partner with Enablement and Operations to pilot AI-assisted prospecting and coaching workflows within established processes, evaluate output quality and measurable impact, and document effective practices in team playbooks.

Your background

  • Experience leading, supervising or coaching a sales development or comparable customer-facing team.

  • A strong foundation in B2B solution selling, prospecting, discovery and qualification.

  • Evidence of improving performance through coaching, clear expectations and constructive feedback.

  • The ability to interpret pipeline and conversion data and turn insights into practical action.

  • Strong communication, organisation and cross-functional relationship-building skills.

  • Demonstrated experience embedding AI tools or conversation intelligence into sales and coaching routines, with evidence of measurable productivity, ramp or conversion improvements.

  • A builder mindset: comfortable piloting AI-assisted workflows, evaluating tool outputs critically and turning successful approaches into repeatable team playbooks.

  • A customer-focused, inclusive leadership style and a willingness to learn and adapt.

What success looks like

  • Consistent progress towards agreed qualified-pipeline and opportunity targets.

  • Stronger discovery, qualification and Account Executive handovers.

  • Improving SDR capability, ramp progress and individual performance.

  • Accurate reporting and timely visibility into risks.

  • A healthy, engaged team with clear expectations and development plans.

  • An AI-augmented team that spends more time in meaningful customer conversations and less time on manual research and administration, with measurable improvements in conversion quality and ramp.

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

jobs.title: Technical Data Business Analyst – Enterprise Asset Management (Data Wranglers)
jobs.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Technical Data Business Analyst – Enterprise Asset Management (Data Wranglers) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) program.
jobs.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Technical Data Business Analyst – Enterprise Asset Management (Data Wranglers) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Healthcare Environment and Logistics Management (HELM) program.

The Technical Data Business Analyst will support the implementation of VA's Enterprise Asset Management/Computerized Maintenance Management System (EAM/CMMS), leveraging the Nuvolo platform within the ServiceNow environment.

This position is responsible for analyzing legacy data structures, defining data migration requirements, developing source-to-target data mappings, and supporting data profiling, cleansing, validation, and migration activities associated with VA's enterprise asset management modernization initiative.

The EAM/CMMS initiative supports the modernization of VA healthcare equipment and asset management capabilities. The selected candidate will collaborate with VA business stakeholders, data engineers, migration specialists, developers, and technical leadership to support the accurate and reliable transition of equipment, asset, and location data from legacy systems into the enterprise platform.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, document, and refine business and technical data requirements supporting VA's EAM/CMMS implementation.
  • Collaborate with VA business owners, data engineers, and technical stakeholders to translate data requirements into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Support enterprise data migration activities associated with the implementation of the Nuvolo EAM/CMMS solution within the ServiceNow environment.
  • Analyze legacy data structures, business rules, and data relationships to support migration planning and system implementation.
  • Develop and maintain source-to-target data mappings, transformation specifications, and data migration requirements.
  • Support data migration planning from legacy Maximo and VA VistA equipment management systems.
  • Profile, analyze, and assess legacy equipment, asset, and location records to identify data quality issues and migration requirements.
  • Collaborate with data migration teams to cleanse, standardize, validate, and reconcile legacy data before migration.
  • Identify data inconsistencies, duplicate records, missing information, and transformation requirements.
  • Document data validation rules, reconciliation procedures, and data quality requirements.
  • Support data preparation and validation activities for individual VA facility migration waves.
  • Collaborate with technical teams supporting Databricks data pipelines and enterprise data transformation processes.
  • Document data integration and mapping requirements involving iFAMS, FMS, CDW, RTLS, and related enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate with data engineers and integration specialists to clarify data structures, transformation logic, and migration dependencies.
  • Maintain requirements traceability throughout data analysis, transformation, testing, migration, and deployment activities.
  • Support data migration testing, reconciliation, user acceptance testing (UAT), and defect resolution activities.
  • Analyze migration failures, data discrepancies, and validation issues, coordinating resolution with technical teams.
  • Develop data process flows, mapping documentation, validation procedures, and migration support materials.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and team coordination activities.
  • Maintain data requirements, user stories, technical documentation, and project artifacts using Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify migration risks, data dependencies, and implementation challenges.
  • Support stakeholder communications regarding data readiness, migration progress, quality issues, and remediation activities.
  • Assist with deployment readiness, data cutover planning, and post-migration validation.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on data quality, migration accuracy, and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

  • Minimum eight years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Analyst, Data Business Analyst, or Systems Analyst supporting enterprise software implementations.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing complex business and technical data requirements.
  • Experience developing technical requirements for enterprise data migrations, system integrations, and application implementations.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis, data mapping, data transformation, and migration methodologies.
  • Experience developing source-to-target mappings, transformation specifications, and data validation requirements.
  • Experience profiling, cleansing, reconciling, and validating enterprise data.
  • Understanding of relational databases, data structures, and enterprise data integration concepts.
  • Experience analyzing legacy system data and supporting migration to modern enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of business process modeling, workflow analysis, and technical requirements documentation.
  • Proficiency with process modeling tools and methodologies, including BPMN and Microsoft Visio.
  • Experience maintaining requirements traceability throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience working within Agile Scrum or SAFe development environments.
  • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for requirements management, backlog tracking, and documentation.
  • Experience collaborating with data engineers, developers, migration specialists, testers, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting data migration testing, reconciliation, user acceptance testing, and defect resolution.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience implementing or supporting ServiceNow, Nuvolo, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions.
  • Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA), or other International Institute of Business Analysis (IIBA) certification.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA), or other federal healthcare IT programs.
  • Experience working with legacy enterprise asset management systems, including IBM Maximo or VA VistA.
  • Familiarity with enterprise financial and healthcare data systems, including iFAMS, FMS, CDW, or RTLS.
  • Experience supporting large-scale enterprise data migrations and phased system deployments.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, enterprise data pipelines, and data transformation processes.
  • Experience using SQL or comparable data analysis tools to support data profiling, validation, and reconciliation.
  • Experience developing data dictionaries, mapping specifications, transformation rules, and migration documentation.
  • Understanding of the VA Logistics Integration Platform (VALIP) or comparable enterprise integration environments.
  • Familiarity with the VA Technical Reference Model (TRM).
  • Understanding of Authority to Operate (ATO), Risk Management Framework (RMF), and Section 508 accessibility requirements.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data governance, data quality management, and system modernization initiatives.
  • Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States, subject to VA approval.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $65,000 to $110,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.
  • Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses.

Overview

Job Title: Pre-Construction Coordinator

Reports to: Estimating Manager

Department: Pre-Construction / Estimating

Status: Regular Full Time Position – Exempt/Salary

Job Description:

Responsible for managing and coordinating the front-end estimating and proposal development process for both large capital projects and smaller site-level opportunities. Serves as a central point of communication between clients, estimators, project stakeholders, and management to ensure opportunities are properly screened, organized, estimated, and submitted on time.

As a Pre-Construction Coordinator, you will coordinate communications, information management, and assignments required to process requests for proposal (RFPs) into customer proposals. This will be accomplished through collaborative efforts with various GrayWolf functional departments, such as estimating, procurement, safety, quality, and executive management. This position will be primarily responsible to ensure that we are providing complete, accurate, and compelling proposals to our heavy industrial clients.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Receive and evaluate new project opportunities and support/perform initial vetting prior to Bid/No-Bid (BNB) discussions.
  • Coordinate and participate in BNB meetings and facilitate opportunity qualification decisions.
  • Assign proposal numbers and establish estimate folders and related project documentation management.
  • Schedule, coordinate, and facilitate all estimate kick-off meetings and bid review meetings.
  • Maintain and update the estimating opportunity list within Smartsheet, ensuring current statuses, priorities, review dates, and due dates are accurately reflected.
  • Track and distribute RFP addendums, clarifications, and revisions to estimating teams.
  • Review RFPs for required deliverables and work with estimating management to ensure all tasks are properly assigned and tracked to completion to support the proposal due date.
  • Assist estimating personnel in assembling required vendor and subcontractor scope packages and coordinate with the Procurement Department to support attainment of qualifying bids.
  • Assist with preparation of proposal letters, qualification documents, and other submission requirements.
  • Upload and manage accurate proposal submissions through client procurement platforms, including Workday, Procore, Ariba, and other client-specific systems.
  • Communicate regularly with estimators regarding workload, bid schedules, proposal due dates, scope issues, and information requirements.
  • Coordinate with clients to obtain missing information, clarify bid requirements, and request bid extensions when necessary.
  • Assist estimating personnel in maintaining visibility of workload and proposal priorities across active opportunities.
  • Serve as a communication liaison between clients, estimating teams, and management to support successful and timely proposal development and submission.
  • Core Functions:
  • Opportunity Management
  • Bid Coordination
  • Smartsheet and Opportunity Tracking Administration
  • Workload and Resource Coordination
  • Estimating Process Support
  • Proposal Development and Submission
  • Client Communication
  • This description emphasizes the significant coordination, communication, and workload management aspects of the role, which go beyond simple administrative support and are critical to successful project pursuit and estimating operations.

Qualifications

Education/Training:

  • High school diploma or equivalent. College degree preferred but not required.
  • Prior construction estimating or supervisory experience required.

Work Experience:

  • Three, or more, years of progressively responsible experience in an industrial construction estimating department.
  • Must have proven experience providing companies with accurate information that aids operations in achieving corporate goals.

We are seeking a Principal Programmer to join our team. As a Principal Programmer, you will lead and deliver high-quality statistical programming outputs that are essential to the success of clinical development programs across a diverse project portfolio. This position plays a key role in regulatory-compliant data submission, CDISC standards adherence, cross-functional collaboration, and the technical mentorship of programming teams. You will operate within FSP client systems and under FSP client SOPs, working closely with Biometrics, Data Management, Biostatistics, and Medical Writing functions to drive study success from programming strategy through final submission.

  • Lead statistical programming activities on FSP projects, including development and QC of deliverables, ensuring quality, traceability, reproducibility, and timeliness
  • Serve as a technical authority, solving complex programming challenges and setting a standard of exemplary performance for the broader programming team
  • Ensure all statistical programming systems, processes, and deliverables comply with applicable regulatory requirements, including 21 CFR Part 11, eCTD guidance, and CDISC SDTM and ADaM standards
  • Maintain detailed project and validation plans, managing competing priorities across concurrent projects with strong time management and organizational discipline
  • Collaborate efficiently with Biometrics, Data Management, and Medical Writing teams across geographies, including teams in Europe and India
  • Provide input into and mentor statistical programmers on documents produced by cross-functional partners, including biostatisticians, data managers, and medical writers
  • Interact with regulatory agencies, as needed, regarding specifications for electronic submissions and lead the development of statistical programming submission deliverables
  • Contribute to the design of new statistical programming processes or optimization of existing workflows to improve productivity, quality, and client satisfaction
  • Support the professional development of local programming teams through functional mentorship and strategic guidance on deliverables and processes
  • Adhere to and ensure team compliance with all applicable CRS work instructions, SOPs, and client-specific processes
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving statistical programming techniques and applicable technical advancements and support their implementation
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external clients to manage expectations and ensure overall client satisfaction

Candidate Profile

You will thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in SAS and/or R programming, CDISC standards expertise, and regulatory submission knowledge
  • Experience working in statistical programming within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research environments
  • The ability to lead cross-functional teams and communicate clearly across disciplines and geographies
  • A quality-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and accountability for deliverable accuracy
  • Comfort working within FSP models, client systems, and matrix organizations

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science or equivalent with relevant research experience, or Master's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related numerate discipline

  • Consistent experience as a lead statistical programmer across multiple concurrent projects
  • Proficiency in SAS and/or R
  • Strong knowledge of CDISC ADaM and SDTM standards
  • Strong knowledge of relevant regulatory and data submission guidelines, including 21 CFR Part 11 and eCTD requirements
  • Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage timelines and cross-functional workstreams

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Experience working in an FSP or embedded client model

  • експертиза побудови процесу A/B-тестування або системної участі дизайну в експериментах;

  • досвід роботи з дизайн-системами на масштабі (кілька продуктів чи платформ), побудова governance і процесів;

  • сильне продуктове мислення: пріоритизація, trade-offs, аргументація даними;

  • розуміння UX-досліджень, information architecture, interaction design, mobile-first;

  • впевнене володіння Figma, компонентним підходом, досвід співпраці з інженерними командами;

  • досвід презентацій флоу, ідей, результатів для керівництва.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід у digital entertainment, gaming, streaming чи інших high-engagement B2C-продуктах;

  • робота з кількома продуктами чи брендами на одній платформі;

  • Motion design і мікровзаємодії, основи front-end та AI-інструменти в дизайн-процесах, design ops;

  • запуск продуктів на нових ринках, локалізація UX.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

P.S. Якщо після відгуку не бачиш нашого листа – зазирни у “Спам” або інші розділи. Іноді наші відповіді губляться там 👀

Job Description:

CSI is seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to lead complex, high-visibility initiatives supporting the integration of Qolo’s payments technology and capabilities across CSI. This full-time role will coordinate cross-functional integration efforts and help ensure projects move successfully from initial planning through implementation and delivery.

In this role, you will build and manage project plans, coordinate dependencies, identify and address risks, communicate project status, and follow through on open items. You will work closely with product, engineering, technology, operations, and business stakeholders to maintain alignment and drive integration initiatives forward.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical project management experience within a complex environment.

Previous experience in payments, banking, financial technology, or another regulated industry is preferred but not required for candidates who demonstrate relevant technical project experience and the ability to learn the payments domain.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the planning and execution of technical projects supporting the Qolo–CSI integration.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate integration activities across product, engineering, operations, business, and other internal teams.
  • Monitor project progress and provide clear, consistent status updates to stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies early and drive appropriate mitigation and resolution plans.
  • Follow up on outstanding decisions, action items, and deliverables to keep projects moving forward.
  • Facilitate project meetings, document key decisions, and ensure stakeholders understand responsibilities and next steps.
  • Manage changing priorities and project scope while maintaining alignment with broader integration objectives.
  • Support project governance, status reporting, escalation, and change-management activities.
  • Partner with technical and product teams to understand integration requirements and translate them into actionable project plans.
  • Help coordinate testing, implementation, launch, and operational-readiness activities.
  • Use project data, reporting, and AI-enabled tools to improve visibility, communication, and delivery efficiency.
  • Promote effective Agile project-management practices and continuous process improvement.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Significant experience managing complex technical projects or programs from planning through implementation.
  • Demonstrated ability to create project plans, track milestones, manage risks, report status, and follow up on open items.
  • Experience coordinating work across technical, product, business, and operational teams.
  • Strong understanding of project-management methodologies, including Agile and traditional delivery approaches.
  • Ability to understand technical concepts, integrations, dependencies, and project impacts without needing to serve as the technical architect.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating project status, risks, and decisions to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and drive progress within a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Aha!, or comparable project and portfolio management tools.
  • Practical understanding of how AI tools can support project planning, research, documentation, communication, and productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting projects within payments, banking, financial technology, or another regulated industry.
  • Knowledge of payment platforms, payment processing, card-based payments, or financial-services integrations.
  • Experience supporting platform integrations, mergers and acquisitions, technology modernization, or other large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with APIs, cloud-based platforms, system integrations, testing, release planning, or production implementation.
  • Experience using tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Claude, Glean, or comparable platforms. Prior experience with CSI’s specific tools is not required.
  • Project Management Professional, Certified ScrumMaster, SAFe, or similar project-management or Agile certification.

What Success Looks Like

  • Qolo–CSI integration projects have clear plans, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Project risks, dependencies, and decisions are identified and communicated before they negatively affect delivery.
  • Technical and business stakeholders remain informed, aligned, and accountable throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Open items receive consistent follow-up, and projects continue moving forward despite changing priorities.
  • Project reporting gives leadership an accurate and actionable view of progress, risks, and next steps.

jobs.excerpt: Career Category MarketingJob Description Role Overview The Senior Marketing Manager, BiTE® Portfolio Marketing & Operations, will help shape how Amgen commercializes and supports successful implementation of the portfolio across healthcare settings.
jobs.description:
Career Category

Marketing

Job Description

Role Overview


The Senior Marketing Manager, BiTE® Portfolio Marketing & Operations, will help shape how Amgen commercializes and supports successful implementation of the portfolio across healthcare settings. In this dual Senior Marketing Manager and Field Operations lead role, you will support portfolio-level marketing strategy and execution across Amgen’s approved and anticipated BiTE® therapies, including IMDELLTRA, BLINCYTO, and prostate cancer asset. You will help expand the BiTE® Operationalization Capability, an important part of the Oncology Business Unit’s long-term strategy, by connecting brand priorities and strategies, healthcare stakeholder needs, and field insights to practical, scalable marketing and enablement solutions.


Reporting to the OBU Director of Strategy, Operations and Planning, the successful candidate will work across brand marketing, the BiTE® Operationalization Team (BOT), field leadership, training, and other cross-functional partners. Together, you will develop and deliver initiatives that strengthen field readiness and help healthcare stakeholders navigate the operational considerations of BiTE® therapies, supporting a focus on the efficacy and safety of these products and supporting overall experience for patients.


This role offers the opportunity to shape BiTE® operationalization portfolio strategy and see it through to execution: setting direction, translating priorities into plans and resources, coordinating review and deployment, and using marketing research, analytics and field feedback to improve what comes next. You will also support strategic planning and operating rhythms for the Director, BiTE® Enablement, and the BOT organization, helping teams stay aligned and move portfolio priorities forward.


The successful candidate brings pharmaceutical marketing experience, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to turn strategy into clear, effective execution in a complex, matrixed environment. This position will serve as a key connector between brand-created marketing strategy and field execution. The candidate would be tasked with translating brand priorities, customer insights, customer educational needs, and field insights into coordinated marketing initiatives and scalable resources. The role will help coordinate alignment across BiTE® therapies while addressing the distinct operational education considerations associated with each product.


In addition to core marketing responsibilities, this individual will provide strategic planning and organizing support to the Director, BiTE® Enablement and the BOT organization. This includes supporting business planning, coordinating field readiness initiatives, managing key operating rhythms, and facilitating cross-functional communication and execution of portfolio priorities.

Key Responsibilities


BiTE® Portfolio Marketing Strategy & Operations

  • Shape and execute insight-driven marketing initiatives across Amgen’s approved and anticipated BiTE® therapies in partnership with the Director, BiTE® Enablement and brand marketing teams.
  • Lead cross-portfolio initiatives that address shared educational and operational considerations while supporting distinct strategies and approved information for each therapy.
  • Translate portfolio priorities, customer and field insights into actionable marketing plans, unbranded educational resources, brand derivative materials and field enablement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to build scalable resources that can support multiple BiTE® therapies while accommodating brand-specific needs.
  • Leverage approved core brand assets to develop derivative materials tailored to the specific needs and roles of the broader stakeholder community involved in supporting the onboarding of patients to BiTE® therapies.
  • Align cross-functional partners on strategic objectives, content requirements, field usability, and implementation timelines.
  • Guide brand derivative materials and BiTE® educational resources through review, approval, deployment, and ongoing maintenance with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Prepare for future BiTE® therapies by identifying early marketing enablement needs and coordinating cross-portfolio resource planning.

Marketing Resource Development & Field Enablement

  • Lead planning and development of portfolio-level educational resources, brand derivative materials, operational experience continuum materials, and field enablement tools with brand teams and cross-functional partners.
  • Develop standardized, nonprescriptive educational materials that help healthcare stakeholders understand general operational considerations associated with Amgen BiTE® therapy requirements.
  • Partner with BOT leadership to identify recurring educational themes and resource needs that can inform future marketing initiatives.
  • Coordinate with brand teams to maintain appropriate consistency across portfolio materials and alignment with approved brand-specific content.
  • Develop field-facing resources that clarify available educational tools, intended audiences, and approved use parameters.
  • Gather and synthesize customer insights, field feedback on resource relevance, clarity, and usability, then use those insights to inform improvements.
  • Assess resource deployment, field utilization, and educational engagement to support continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & BOT Partnership

  • Connect strategy, resource development, and field execution so the BiTE® Operationalization Capability continues to grow with the portfolio.
  • Serve as a primary marketing liaison between BiTE® Enablement, brand marketing teams, BOT leadership, training, and field-based stakeholders.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships across Sales, Marketing, Medical, Market Access, Analytics, and other relevant functions.
  • Partner with BOT leaders to understand emerging themes from customer-identified operational education topics and translate relevant insights into potential portfolio marketing resource needs.
  • Support consistent communication and coordination across brand and field stakeholders regarding BiTE® Enablement initiatives, resource availability, and portfolio priorities.
  • Work collaboratively with field leadership to support internal readiness, appropriate resource deployment, and alignment on approved ways of working.
  • Help identify cross-portfolio opportunities to simplify internal processes, reduce duplication, and improve coordination across teams.
  • Ensure that marketing-related activities involving BOT remain consistent with established role boundaries and applicable approval requirements.

Sales Planning & Organizing (SPO) and Business Operations

  • Partner closely with the Director, BiTE® Enablement, to support annual and ongoing business planning, prioritization, and execution of key organizational initiatives.
  • Coordinate planning calendars, milestones, deliverables, and operating timelines across BiTE® Enablement and BOT workstreams.
  • Support coordination of recurring business reviews, leadership meetings, field planning sessions, and cross-functional operating rhythms.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, initiative trackers, business updates, and other planning tools that support visibility and accountability.
  • Organize cross-functional inputs into concise business summaries, leadership presentations, action plans, and follow-up communications.
  • Support planning and coordination for national field meetings, leadership meetings, onboarding sessions, and special projects.
  • Maintain oversight of key initiative milestones, open action items, and execution dependencies, facilitating timely escalation to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Support internal vendor coordination, resource planning, and related business processes as required for assigned initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, streamline operating workflows, and strengthen execution discipline across the organization.

Field Training, Readiness & Organizational Enablement

  • Partner with training and BOT leadership to support the development and coordination of field training and readiness initiatives.
  • Help translate portfolio marketing priorities and approved educational resources into appropriate field training and communication plans.
  • Support development of training materials, facilitator resources, meeting content, and field communications in collaboration with appropriate functional owners.
  • Facilitate alignment of training milestones, resource availability, and implementation timelines across current and future BiTE® therapies.
  • Gather field feedback to identify opportunities to improve clarity, consistency, and usability of training and educational resources.
  • Support internal rollout planning for new marketing resources, organizational capabilities, and approved ways of working.

Portfolio Planning, Insights & Performance Monitoring

  • Organize and synthesize relevant inputs from brand teams, BOT, training, and field stakeholders to inform portfolio planning and resource prioritization.
  • Support establishment of appropriate objectives, milestones, and performance measures for assigned marketing and enablement initiatives.
  • Maintain visibility into resource development timelines, approval status, field deployment, and utilization.

jobs.description:
Votre rôle

Digital Services France (DSF) crée une nouvelle Direction nommée Direction Digital, Data et IA (DDIA), en charge de porter la stratégie, le portfolio d'offres, les opérations mutualisées et la performance économique des activités Digital, Data et IA de DSF (à l’exception des activités Microsoft portées par la Direction Expertime). Cette direction est composée d’environ 330 salariés en France, au Maroc et à l’Ile Maurice.

Dans le cadre de cette création, nous recrutons le/la directeur(ice) de cette direction, rattaché au directeur de Digital Services France et membre du CODIR de DSF. Dans un marché en tension mais porté par l'accélération de l'IA agentique, vous avez pour mission de redynamiser la stratégie DDIA, de structurer une gouvernance claire et lisible, et de porter le retour à une croissance profitable et durable de ce périmètre.

Missions principales

Stratégie, portfolio et gouvernance :

  • Définir et faire évoluer la stratégie DDIA (axes de développement, choix de partenaires stratégiques) en cohérence avec la stratégie globale de DSF ;
  • Structurer le portfolio d'offres Digital, Data et IA (Data/IA, Confiance et numérique responsable, Expérience Client/Employé/Opérationnelle, produits digitaux), garantir une déclinaison homogène des offres (dont les produits digitaux) sur l'ensemble du territoire, en lien avec les Régions et les Agences Conseil & Expertise et piloter une vision consolidée. Structurer et clarifier la gouvernance de la direction DDIA, à l'image des dispositifs existants pour les activités Cloud et Microsoft.

Pilotage économique :

  • Porter la responsabilité primaire du P&L des activités DDIA (chiffre d'affaires par offre, marge nationale) ;
  • Définir le budget et dimensionner la workforce interne/externe en fonction des ambitions de développement en collaboration avec les Régions;
  • Piloter l'équation de performance globale en coordination avec les P&L régionaux dont les Régions de DSF sont garantes

Management et animation des équipes :

  • Piloter les Départements Portfolio, Avant-Vente, Opérations Mutualisées et Live Intelligence, ainsi que les activités du Directeur Technique IA et du Directeur Influence IA
  • Animer un lien fonctionnel fort avec les Directeurs Conseil & Expertise en région et la Direction La Fabrique, afin qu'ils contribuent au cycle de vie du portfolio et à la diffusion des innovations ;
  • Manager les Responsables de départements de la Direction DDIA

Alignement commercial et delivery :

  • Assurer l'alignement de nos capacités et savoir-faire en termes de delivery avec nos offres, en coordination avec la Direction Performance & Optimisation;
  • Assurer et accompagner la bonne diffusion commerciale de nos offres en coordination avec la Direction Commerciale Nationale ;
  • Renforcer l'orchestration territoriale de la stratégie DDIA avec les Régions et les équipes commerciales (grands comptes / ETI et PME)

Compétences et transformation IA :

  • Porter, avec le Directeur Technique IA et le Directeur Influence IA, l'accélération de la transformation IA en interne comme en externe.
  • Structurer et industrialiser, via l'IA Academy, l'upskilling/reskilling des collaborateurs à l'ère de l'IA ;

Votre profil

Vous êtes

Formation et expérience : Diplôme supérieur (Bac+5, école d'ingénieur ou de commerce) avec une expérience confirmée de direction dans le secteur des ESN, sur les activités Digital, Data et/ou IA impliquant le management d’un P&L, d’une stratégie d’offre et d’équipes pluridisciplinaires d’au moins 300 salariés ainsi que la conduite de projet(s) de transformation.

Compétences requises :

Domaine

Compétences attendues

Expertise métier

Connaissance approfondie du marché Digital, Data, IA ; culture des offres et du portfolio d'une ESN

Leadership

Capacité à fédérer un collectif transverse, à porter une vision stratégique et à accompagner le changement

Pilotage économique

Maîtrise de la gestion de P&L, du budget et des indicateurs de performance

Vision stratégique

Capacité à anticiper les évolutions technologiques et de marché, notamment liées à l'IA générative et agentique

Communication

Excellentes compétences relationnelles, capacité à convaincre en interne (CODIR, Régions) et en externe (partenaires, clients)

Entité

Orange Business est un intégrateur réseau et numérique qui comprend toute la chaîne de valeur du monde digital, permettant à nos clients de se concentrer sur les initiatives stratégiques qui font avancer leur business.

Chaque jour, vous collaborerez avec une équipe dédiée à la livraison de solutions globales cohérentes et durables, peu importe où nos clients opèrent.

Avec plus de 30 000 salariés en Europe, Asie, Amérique et Afrique, nous proposons un environnement dynamique et innovant permettant de développer et affiner vos compétences.

Nous offrons des opportunités passionnantes dans la data et le digital, le cloud, l'IA, la cybersécurité, ou encore l'IoT et le digital workspace.

Entité de rattachement

Digital Services est l'ESN d'Orange Business qui combine les expertises Cloud, Digital, Data et IA. Plus de 4 000 experts répartis dans toute la France accompagnent des entreprises et institutions publiques dans leur transformation numérique. Nous rejoindre, c'est participer à l'accompagnement de nos clients à travers des missions stimulantes et variées. Digital Services France place le Numérique Responsable au cœur de ses préoccupations, affirmant ainsi l’importance qu’elle accorde au numérique inclusif, durable et de confiance.

  • Definir a estratégia de testes da squad, equilibrando a pirâmide de testes (unit, integration, E2E).

  • Analisar requisitos e histórias com PO e devs, definindo critérios de aceite testáveis (BDD/Gherkin quando fizer sentido).
  • Validar correções e melhorias em ambiente de sustentação, com foco em evitar regressões em produção.
  • Investigar incidentes junto ao time, reproduzir bugs e documentá-los com evidências claras.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de qualidade (cobertura automatizada, taxa de defeitos escapados, flaky tests, tempo de execução).
  • Atuar como referência técnica: revisar código de testes, orientar QAs menos experientes e disseminar boas práticas.

  • Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Quality Assurance, com atuação comprovada em nível sênior.
  • Vivência prática em automação de testes Web com pelo menos um framework de mercado: Cypress, Playwright ou Selenium WebDriver.
  • Automação de testes de API REST (Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Karate ou similar).
  • Programação para automação em JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Python.
  • Integração de testes em pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI ou Jenkins).
  • Domínio de Git e fluxo de trabalho com Pull Requests.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de teste (particionamento, valor-limite, testes exploratórios, regressão) e da pirâmide de testes.
  • Experiência em times ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).
  • SQL para validação e preparação de massa de dados.

Diferenciais

  • Testes de performance e carga (k6, JMeter ou Gatling).
  • Automação de testes mobile (Appium, Detox ou Maestro).
  • Contract testing (Pact) e testes em arquiteturas de microsserviços.
  • Experiência em times de sustentação, com SLA e gestão de incidentes.
  • Observabilidade aplicada a qualidade (logs, Datadog, Grafana, New Relic).
  • Uso de IA aplicada a testes (geração de casos, self-healing de seletores, análise de falhas).
  • Noções de testes de segurança (OWASP) e acessibilidade (WCAG).
  • Certificações como ISTQB/CTFL ou CTAL.

Competências comportamentais

  • Senso de dono da qualidade: atua na prevenção de defeitos, não só na detecção.
  • Comunicação clara: traduz riscos técnicos para PO, devs e cliente.
  • Priorização sob pressão: sabe decidir o que testar primeiro em demandas urgentes de sustentação.
  • Colaboração: trabalha lado a lado com o time e compartilha conhecimento.
  • Aprendizado contínuo: acompanha novas ferramentas e práticas de qualidade.

jobs.title: Director of Demand Planning
jobs.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱 RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support.
jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

ROLE OVERVIEW:
RYZE Superfoods is rapidly expanding across retail, DTC, Amazon, and TikTok Shop. We are seeking a hands-on demand planning leader to own forecasting, lead our Demand Planning Manager, build scalable automated/AI-driven planning infrastructure, and drive alignment across Sales, Marketing, and S&OP.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

Responsibilities will include:


Demand planning across all channels

  • Build and maintain the consensus plan for retail, DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and marketplaces, by SKU and month over a rolling 18 months, in units and dollars.
  • Lead channel-level forecasting to support 30,000+ retail doors while DTC and digital channels scale in parallel
  • Bring every forecast input into that plan with a named owner and a due date each cycle. That includes the items that fall between teams today: gifts, merchandise, kits and limited-time offers.
  • Reconcile the plan to Finance's revenue plan every cycle, so a demand gap shows up as a dollar gap.

Committed demand and upside, kept apart

  • Run the plan in two columns: committed and upside. Every retail initiative carries a confidence level, reviewed weekly with Sales, and new distribution moves to committed when the retailer confirms it.
  • Work with supply planning so long-lead purchases and production are sized to the committed column, and the upside is held as an option with suppliers.
  • Model upside and downside scenarios and show what each does to inventory and cash before the company commits.

Forecast accuracy and bias

  • Own forecast accuracy as a measurable output, not a reporting exercise
  • Measure accuracy and bias by channel, retailer and SKU at one, two and three months of lag, and publish the results weekly. Current targets are 70% at three months, 80% at two, 90% at one and 95% in-month.
  • Change the plan when sell-through misses. Set the triggers that force a revision, apply them in the same cycle, and record the reason.
  • Log the driver behind every material forecast change so the next cycle learns from it.

Retail and launch forecasting

  • Forecast sell-in from sell-through: POS, weeks of supply, door counts and velocity by account, using retailer portals, distributor data and syndicated data.
  • Build launch and ramp curves for new retailers and new items from comparable launches, and re-base them within the first weeks of real sales.
  • Size promotions, endcaps and displays from measured lift, and take the pull-forward out of the months that follow.

DTC and digital forecasting

  • Forecast the subscription business from its drivers: new customers, retention and rebill rates, and gift and add-on attachment, with Growth and Data owning the assumptions alongside you.
  • Own the Amazon and TikTok Shop forecasts with the channel leads, including promotional events.

Team and tools

  • Lead our Demand Planning Manager and any future demand planning hires
  • Work actively in our planning platform and partner with our data and systems teams to build automated reporting, forecast workflows and channel-level visibility
  • Be an early adopter and driver of AI tools within the planning function we are actively building this capability and want someone who leans into it

S&OP and cross-functional influence

  • Run the demand review in the monthly S&OP cycle and hold every input owner to the calendar.
  • Challenge promotional plans, launch assumptions and growth targets that the data does not support, with Sales, Marketing and the executive team.
  • Work with New Product Launch and Marketing so that no launch or promotion reaches the calendar without a demand plan behind it.
  • Hand supply planning a plan it can execute. Production schedules, inventory targets and the rolling forecasts we send co-manufacturers and suppliers all start from your number.

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS


  • CPG background required. You have worked in consumer packaged goods and understand how demand planning functions inside a multi-channel brand.
  • Channel expansion experience. You have been part of a brand scaling aggressively adding doors, launching new channels, managing the forecast complexity that comes with growth. You know how launch assumptions go wrong and how fast to correct them.
  • Retail forecasting depth. You know the difference between a load-in and a sell-through rate, and you forecast from POS. You have worked with brokers, distributors and retailer replenishment teams.
  • Fluent in DTC and marketplaces. You can forecast a subscription business from acquisition and retention, and you understand how Amazon and social commerce behave around promotions.
  • Hands-on and managing. You have led a small team before but you are still doing the work. You are not a manager who delegates and reviews—you are in the data and in the tools alongside your team.
  • Comfortable with software and data. You pick up new tools quickly and are not waiting for a report to tell you what is happening. Experience working with data or BI teams to build what you need is a plus.
  • Curious about AI. We are pushing AI adoption across the company and want someone who is excited to build, not just use. You do not need to be an engineer, you need to be willing to explore.
  • Clear communicator. You can translate a complex forecast into a clean story for leadership and you are willing to have a hard conversation when the numbers do not support the plan.
  • 8+ years in demand planning or forecasting within CPG
  • Has owned the consensus demand plan for a multi-channel consumer brand, with reported accuracy and bias
  • Has managed at least one direct report in a planning function while still carrying forecasts personally
  • Retail forecasting for national accounts such as Target, Walmart, Kroger or club, using POS and syndicated data (Circana, SPINS or Nielsen)
  • DTC and marketplace forecasting; subscription experience is a plus
  • New-item and new-distribution forecasting through rapid door expansion
  • Has run the demand review in a monthly S&OP cycle and reconciled the plan with Finance
  • Has worked in a planning system and with data teams; NetSuite, Snowflake or SQL experience is a plus

Job Summary

Quality Management Specialist

Aptive Resources is seeking a Quality Management Specialist to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Office of Research and Development (ORD) Cooperative Studies Program (CSP) under the Field Enterprise Research Support Services (FERSS) contract. Sponsored by the Palo Alto VA Medical Center (VAMC), this role coordinates the planning, execution, and tracking of activities required for CSP’s six Epidemiology Centers (ECs) to achieve ISO 9001:2026 Quality Management System (QMS) certification, ensuring a structured, clause-aligned implementation across centers.

This position requires strong knowledge of ISO 9001 principles, QMS structures, and controlled document governance, combined with the project management and facilitation skills needed to align work across distributed teams. The selected candidate will work closely with EC Directors, Quality Assurance leads, document governance teams, ISO subject matter experts (SMEs), and CSP Central Office.

This is a full-time (40 hours/week), 100% remote position.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive ISO 9001:2026 implementation plan, organized by phase (Gap Assessment, QMS Development, Rollout, Internal Audit, and Certification), based on direction from EC Directors.
  • Coordinate clause-specific planning for all actionable ISO 9001 requirements, including Context of the Organization, Leadership, Planning, Support, Operation, Performance Evaluation, and Improvement.
  • Support identification of processes across the six ECs suitable for unified evaluation, and manage milestones and communication around development of unified EC processes for external review and certification scope.
  • Facilitate cross-center gap analysis workshops and consolidate results into a clause-specific gap assessment.
  • Support resource needs assessments, including staffing, SME input, and certification body contracting mechanisms.
  • Map existing EC QMS components to ISO 9001 clauses and identify elements to adopt, adapt, or abandon.
  • Support integration of clause-aligned documentation processes across centers, including controlled document lifecycles and compliance with global versus local documentation requirements.
  • Monitor implementation progress against the project plan, identify schedule risks and quality gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain progress dashboards and milestone tracking to provide transparent visibility into implementation status.
  • Prepare monthly written progress summaries for CSP leadership.
  • Facilitate cross-center collaboration and knowledge sharing among EC Directors, Quality Assurance leads, document governance teams, ISO SMEs, and CSP Central Office.
  • Apply risk management and change management practices to support adoption of new QMS processes across distributed teams.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in public health, epidemiology, life or biomedical sciences, health administration, business or management, quality management, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in quality management, QMS implementation, or project management within a complex or regulated organization.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ISO 9001 principles (ISO 9001:2015 and/or the 2026 revision), including leadership, context of the organization, risk-based thinking, document control, and audit requirements.
  • Knowledge of QMS structures and controlled document lifecycles, including document governance practices.
  • Experience with process mapping and workflow optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and manage project plans, schedules, milestones, and risks across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Strong facilitation, written, and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing progress reports for leadership audiences.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or above) in a scientific, public health, or related field.
  • Direct experience leading or supporting an organization through ISO 9001 certification, including multi-site or unified certification scope.
  • Familiarity with quality management systems in research organizations, especially epidemiologic or clinical research environments.
  • Knowledge of regulatory alignment for research QMS, including Good Clinical Practice (GCP), federal requirements, and VA policies.
  • ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor certification, or an ASQ quality certification (e.g., CQA, CMQ/OE).
  • Project management, process improvement, or change management certifications (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt, Prosci Change Management).
  • Experience working in a federal or VA research environment; familiarity with the VA Cooperative Studies Program is a plus.
  • Experience with change management and stakeholder engagement across geographically distributed teams.

Physical Requirements

Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods, use a computer keyboard and mouse, and communicate verbally and in writing. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, bend, or lift up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Our model works. Jobseekers enter our programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and are placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, we have supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy.
Upwardly Global is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. The Product Designer will own the user experience of our platform end-to-end, collaborating with cross-functional teams to craft user-centered design solutions. They will leverage data and user research to inform the design process, resulting in products that are visually appealing but also highly functional and aligned with user needs. Because we are building an AI-powered career platform, this position will shape how our users experience AI as a helpful and trustworthy guide.

  • Own and evolve our design system- design documentation, style guides, component patterns, and asset libraries - to ensure consistency across a multi-role platform and to ensure alignment with the branding and enable clean handoff to engineering.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, meet deadlines, and demonstrate professionalism and a positive attitude.

Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the Eastern Time Zone of the U.S. Preference will be given to candidates located in New Jersey; however, remote candidates throughout the Eastern Time Zone are encouraged to apply.

As a Workers’ Compensation Adjuster, you will manage a caseload of workers’ compensation claims from initial investigation through resolution. You'll play a key role in ensuring injured employees receive appropriate medical care and benefits while collaborating with employers, medical providers, nurse case managers, and legal partners. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in workers’ compensation claims handling, litigation management, and return-to-work strategies while utilizing modern claims technology and AI-powered tools to improve efficiency and outcomes.
Duties and Responsibilities
  • Investigates, evaluates, and resolves assigned Workers’ Compensation claims of a more complex or litigated nature in a timely manner in accordance with legal statutes, policy provisions, and company guidelines.
  • Evaluate claimant eligibility; communicate with attending physician, employer and injured worker.
  • Work with both the claimant and their physician to medically manage the claim, from initial medical treatment to reviewing and evaluating ongoing treatment and related information.
  • Work directly with employers to facilitate a return to work, either on a full-time or modified duty basis.
  • Confirm coverage and applicable insurance policy or coverage document and statutory requirements.
  • Identify potential for third party recovery, including subrogation, Second Injury Fund or other fund involvement (when applicable) and excess or reinsurance reimbursement. Pursue the process of reimbursement and complete posting of recovery to the claim file, where appropriate.
  • Identify potential for disability or pension credits or offsets and apply same where appropriate.
  • Ensure timely denial or payment of benefits in accordance with jurisdictional requirements.
  • Establish claim reserve levels by estimating the potential exposure of each assigned claim, establish appropriate reserves with documented rationale, maintain and adjust reserves over the life of the claim to reflect changes in exposure.
  • Establish compensability status through case investigation and evaluation and application of jurisdictional statutes and laws.
  • Manage diary in accordance with Best Practices and complete tasks to ensure that cases move to the best financial outcome and timely resolution.
  • Where litigation is filed, evaluate exposure and work with defense counsel to establish strong defenses, prepare litigation plan of action, set legal reserve and manage litigation over life of claim.
  • Close all files as appropriate in a timely and complete manner.
  • Maintain closing ratio as directed by management team.
  • Oversee and coordinate medical treatment for injured employees and provide information to treating physicians regarding employees’ medical history, health issues, and job requirements; provide direction to assigned nurse case manager where applicable.
  • Complete PARs (payment authorization request) when applicable.
  • Comply with all excess and reinsurance reporting requirements; manage self-insured retention reporting.

Qualifications

  • High School diploma required.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 2 years of experience handling workers’ compensation claims.
  • Experience managing claims investigations, compensability determinations, and benefit administration.
  • Litigation and/or subrogation experience preferred.
  • Workers’ compensation designations, certifications, or industry training are a plus.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $18.45 - $23.55 hourly, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

Together, we take pride in making a meaningful difference to the environment.

We’re helping build the world of tomorrow with solutions that improve everyday life while making a positive impact on the planet. Our products and services work in harmony to provide comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind for millions of homes and businesses.
