Notre acquisition amène énormément de trafic sur nos produits : le prochain levier de croissance, c'est de transformer davantage de visiteur(se)s en client(e)s, puis de faire en sorte que nos abonné(e)s tirent pleinement parti de leur abonnement.

C'est tout l'enjeu du poste de Product Growth Ops : ta mission est de transformer nos visiteur(se)s en client(e)s et de maximiser leur engagement dans la durée, avec un impact direct sur le chiffre d'affaires et la rentabilité de nos SaaS.

Tu interviens sur trois leviers : reconvertir les visiteur(se)s et inscrit(e)s qui n'ont pas finalisé leur parcours (re-marketing), construire et opérer le CRM qui unifie la connaissance de nos client(e)s B2C, et maximiser l'engagement de nos utilisateur(rice)s, avant comme après l'achat, pour réduire leur time-to-value et augmenter leur lifetime value.

Tu es le/la premier(e) Product Growth Ops de DotWorld : tu es pleinement lead sur la manière de conduire les campagnes, le choix des outils et la définition des indicateurs de succès. Ta réussite se mesure à l'impact de tes actions sur les conversions et le revenu - ici, ce sont les résultats qui comptent, pas le temps passé.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoins l'organisation Produit, sous la responsabilité de Jérémy RICHARD, notre CPO, qui sera ton manager direct.

Le poste est rattaché au Produit car la grande majorité de tes initiatives se construisent avec les Product Managers de chaque SaaS. Tu travailles aussi en lien étroit avec l'équipe Acquisition et le département Data : un rôle transverse, à la jonction du produit, du marketing et de la donnée.

💻 Tes responsabilités

Re-marketing & conversion

  • Concevoir et piloter les campagnes de re-marketing (emailing, retargeting) pour reconvertir les visiteur(se)s et inscrit(e)s n'ayant pas finalisé leur parcours d'achat

  • Construire les audiences et le ciblage en coordination avec l'équipe Acquisition, pour des campagnes cohérentes sur l'ensemble du funnel

  • Mesurer la performance de chaque campagne (délivrabilité, conversion, revenu) et itérer rapidement

CRM unifié

  • Mettre en place et piloter un CRM unifié des client(e)s et prospects B2C de l'ensemble de nos SaaS, référence unique pour toutes les équipes

  • Structurer le modèle de données client, garantir sa fiabilité et construire des segmentations exploitables, avec le département Data

  • Mettre la donnée CRM au service des campagnes, du produit et de l'acquisition (audiences, triggers, personnalisation)

Engagement, adoption & rétention

  • Amener chaque utilisateur(rice) à la valeur le plus vite possible et réengager les abonné(e)s qui n'utilisent plus le produit

  • Concevoir et automatiser les campagnes lifecycle tout au long du cycle de vie utilisateur (in-app, emails, newsletters)

  • Mener des études et interviews utilisateur(rice)s pour comprendre pourquoi certain(e)s ne reviennent pas, et transformer ces insights en recommandations concrètes pour les équipes Produit

  • Suivre l'activation, l'engagement et la rétention, et partager des insights actionnables

Growth machine

  • Outiller, automatiser et documenter les mécaniques growth pour qu'elles passent à l'échelle sur l'ensemble de nos SaaS

  • Faire le pont entre Produit, Acquisition et Data pour que la machine tourne sans friction

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • Environ 5 ans d'expérience en growth, CRM / lifecycle marketing ou marketing automation

  • Des résultats prouvés et chiffrés : tu sais relier tes campagnes à leur impact sur la conversion et le revenu

  • Une expérience en B2C à fort volume est indispensable, idéalement sur des SaaS par abonnement

  • Un profil growth avant tout, à l'aise pour travailler au quotidien avec des équipes Produit

Compétences techniques

  • Solide maîtrise des CRM et des plateformes de marketing automation, de la configuration au pilotage

  • Conception et pilotage de campagnes emailing et in-app, retargeting

  • Analyse de données : funnels, cohortes, segmentation, tableaux de bord, outils d'analytics produit

  • Culture d'expérimentation : conception et lecture de tests, décisions fondées sur la donnée

  • Usage autonome et quotidien des outils d'IA (analyse, rédaction, automatisation, création de segments et de contenus)

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Ownership de bout en bout : de la conception d'une campagne à la mesure de son impact

  • Hands-on, autonome et orienté(e) résultats

  • Aisance dans la gestion de nombreuses parties prenantes

  • Exigence qualité et souci du détail sur chaque message envoyé aux utilisateur(rice)s

  • Curiosité pour les utilisateur(rice)s : tu aimes comprendre leurs comportements et leurs besoins

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais courant (B2 minimum) - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement

✨ Les avantages du poste

  • Un rôle transverse et central, au cœur de la Growth machine de plusieurs SaaS B2C

  • Un impact direct et mesurable sur le revenu, à l'échelle de millions d'utilisateur(rice)s

  • Le premier poste de Product Growth Ops chez DotWorld : tu choisis les outils, les méthodes et les KPI

  • Une forte autonomie et une vraie liberté de décision sur tes campagnes

  • Un environnement IA-first, où l'IA fait partie intégrante de la manière de travailler

🔥 Les défis du poste

  • Un périmètre large (re-marketing, CRM, lifecycle) sur plusieurs SaaS : savoir prioriser est essentiel

  • Un terrain de jeu à construire : tu poses les fondations du CRM et des mécaniques growth, avec le département Data

  • Des objectifs ambitieux sur la conversion et le revenu, suivis de près dès ta prise de poste

  • De nombreuses parties prenantes (Product Managers, Acquisition, Data) à embarquer

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  • Étude de cas growth en live avec notre CPO, Jérémy - 1h

  • Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance, Matteo - 1h

  • Prise de références

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche

Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante

Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence

Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ?

Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

  • Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.

☕ Budget coworking Si tu préfères bosser hors de chez toi, on prend en charge ton espace de coworking à hauteur de 200 euros par mois pour plus de confort et de focus.

🌴 Vacances sur mesure Prends les congés dont tu as besoin pour te ressourcer. On te fait confiance pour gérer ton temps libre.

⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.

🌏 Télétravail - monde Change d'air et découvre le télétravail depuis un fuseau horaire différent pendant un mois.

🖥️ Budget équipement On te donne un budget pour t'équiper avec tout ce qu'il te faut : ordinateur portable, bureau, chaise, écran, casque… tout pour être au top !

🥳 2 séminaires par an Deux fois par an, on se retrouve en équipe pour des moments inspirants et fun : un au printemps et un à l'automne.

📍 Pour les profils basés à Lausanne Bureaux modernes, accès au sport, parking et participation aux frais de déplacement.

🌻 Nos valeurs

PERFORMANCE"Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.

OWNERSHIP"Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.

INTEGRITY"We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.

GROWTH"Always be Learning" Le monde change trop vite pour se reposer sur ses acquis. DotWorld est une école. Notre promesse est simple : tu travailleras dur, mais dans 2 ans, tu auras acquis 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle. Nous valorisons la courbe d'apprentissage (la pente) plus que l'expérience passée (le point de départ).

jobs.excerpt: At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students.
jobs.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

The Product Marketing Manager, Literacy (Temporary) provides focused, hands-on support to the Literacy Product Marketing team at Curriculum Associates from approximately November 2026 through May 2027. Working across the literacy portfolio, including Mosaico: Lectoescritura and Magnetic Literacy, the role executes go-to-market deliverables such as collateral, sales enablement materials, website and campaign content, state adoption support, and event materials. Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing, this role turns established messaging and priorities into finished, accurate deliverables that help Sales, Regional Marketing, and educators understand and adopt Curriculum Associates literacy programs. This is a temporary assignment averaging 30 hours per week.

The impact you'll have:

  • Execute product-level marketing plans for core and supplemental literacy products, including Magnetic Literacy and Phonics for Reading, in partnership with the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing and product marketing peers, so launches and campaigns stay on schedule
  • Develop and update collateral and sales enablement materials, such as overview brochures, presentations, guides, FAQs, and flyers, so Sales and Regional Marketing can present literacy programs clearly and consistently
  • Draft and edit digital content, including product page updates, campaign copy, email, and social content, in partnership with Web, Integrated Campaigns, and Regional Marketing so educators see accurate, current information
  • Support curriculum adoption efforts by gathering market information, preparing messaging and competitive summaries, and building adoption materials
  • Conduct market and competitive research, such as district listening sessions, focus group preparation, and event or customer visit notes, and summarize findings so they inform messaging and go-to-market decisions
  • Prepare materials and follow-up for conferences, webinars, and events, such as booth kits, session materials, and one-pagers, so teams are ready to share program stories with educators and district leaders
  • Write scripts and content for videos, case studies, and thought leadership pieces in partnership with Video, Research, and Content teams so customers and Sales have proof points that reflect real classroom use
  • Provide flexible support to priority launches and campaigns, such as Mosaico: Lectoescritura and biliteracy, by completing assigned deliverables so the team can focus on strategy for those programs
  • Partner with Product, Research/Insights, Sales, Enablement, Web, Video, and Brand to gather input, confirm accuracy, and move deliverables through review and approval so materials reflect product capabilities and meet company content standards
  • Track deliverable status, open items, and handoffs in a weekly update to the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing so priorities stay visible and work transitions cleanly at the end of the assignment

Who we're looking for:

  • Translate direction and established messaging into clear, well-executed marketing deliverables on defined timelines
  • Write and edit clear, accurate, audience-appropriate marketing content in English
  • Manage multiple concurrent deliverables with competing due dates, and communicate status and risks to stakeholders
  • Prioritize requests that arrive through multiple channels, such as direct messages, email, and project tools, in agreement with the Associate Vice President of Product Marketing
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including Product, Sales, Enablement, Research/Insights, Web, Video, and Brand, and incorporate their input into final deliverables
  • Use Microsoft 365 (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and Teams). Experience with work-management tools such as Workfront and sales enablement platforms such as Highspot is preferred
  • Apply company brand, content, and review guidelines, and route any claims about product effectiveness through the required evidence review before use
  • Observe and absorb information communicated through relevant materials such as meetings, product documents, and written feedback, and apply it to deliverables
  • Maintain the confidentiality of unreleased product, roadmap, and customer information, and complete required confidentiality and intellectual property agreements
  • Work independently in a remote setting during U.S. business hours, including availability for scheduled team meetings

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or a combination of education and experience that provides equivalent knowledge
  • 3+ years of experience in product marketing, content marketing, or related marketing work for K–12 curriculum, educational publishing, or education technology
  • Experience creating sales enablement materials, collateral, or campaign content that supports a product launch
  • Working knowledge of K–12 literacy instruction, such as foundational skills, phonics, and comprehension, and how districts review and adopt curriculum
  • Preferred: experience supporting state or district adoption processes; experience with supplemental or foundational literacy programs; professional fluency in Spanish (reading and writing); classroom teaching experience

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $40 - $50/hr.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our

Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an

individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits - Temporary employees who average, and maintain, at least 30 hours of work per week may become eligible for medical coverage, under the Affordable Care Act, after an initial waiting period. Temporary and per-diem employees working more than 20 hours per week are eligible for twelve paid

holidays. All temporary employees are eligible for accrued sick time. Temporary employees may be

eligible to participate in the 401k if they meet the hours required of the plan.


Travel: Less than once per month. Occasional domestic travel by air or car, including overnight stays, may be requested for conferences, customer events, or district visits. Attendance is to be confirmed.

Hours: Average of 30 hours per week; assignment runs approximately through May 15, 2027


Application Deadline: December 11, 2026. This is subject to close earlier if there is a high volume of applicants or a qualified hire is made

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Vice President, Total Rewards provides strategic design and direction, execution and ongoing management of USACS total rewards programs. As an integral member of our HR leadership team, the Vice President of Total Rewards will have a focus on constant innovation to ensure that our benefit and compensation programs remain competitive, sustainable, scalable, and positively impact the short- and long-term performance of the organization.

jobs.description:
Energy Markets Consultant/Senior Energy Markets Consultant

Location: US Remote or ICF Office Hybrid (Reston, VA)


About ICF

ICF helps clients navigate the rapidly evolving energy landscape through market analysis, forecasting, transaction support, strategic advisory services, and regulatory expertise. Our clients include power plant developers, utilities, infrastructure investors, lenders, private equity firms, technology companies, government agencies, and other stakeholders shaping the future of the energy industry. ICF’s Power Markets team supports investment decisions, asset development, mergers and acquisitions, resource planning, and policy evaluation across major U.S. power markets and regions, including CAISO, WECC, ERCOT, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, SPP, and SERC.


About the Role

ICF is seeking an Energy Markets Consultant/Senior Energy Markets Consultant to join our growing Power Markets practice. In this role, you will work with leading energy industry participants to evaluate investment opportunities, forecast market outcomes, assess risks, and develop strategies in an increasingly complex energy environment.

You will contribute to projects involving power market forecasting, asset valuation, transmission and interconnection analysis, renewable energy development, battery energy storage systems (BESS), resource adequacy, data center load growth, and energy transition initiatives. Working alongside experienced industry professionals, you will gain exposure to a broad range of technical, financial, and strategic issues affecting U.S. electricity markets while developing expertise that directly informs major investment and business decisions.


What You Will Be Doing

  • Perform quantitative, economic, and technical analyses of U.S. power markets using commercial market models, proprietary tools, and large datasets.
  • Develop long-term forecasts of energy, capacity, ancillary services, and renewable energy market outcomes.
  • Evaluate renewable energy, battery storage, conventional generation, transmission, and emerging energy investments.
  • Analyze market fundamentals, including load growth, fuel prices, transmission congestion, generation retirements, policy changes, and new resource additions.
  • Support interconnection and transmission analyses, including assessments of queue activity, network upgrade costs, congestion impacts, and project economics.
  • Assist with asset valuations, project financing analyses, acquisition due diligence, and M&A support engagements.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to enhance ICF’s proprietary forecasting methodologies, databases, and analytical tools.
  • Prepare client presentations, technical reports, and market insights that effectively communicate complex findings to technical, nontechnical, and executive audiences.
  • Support business development initiatives through market research, proposal preparation, conference participation, and thought leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Economics, Finance, Operations Research, Mathematics, Energy Systems, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, and 2–8+ years of relevant experience in U.S. power markets.
  • Experience with power market simulation and forecasting tools such as PROMOD®, PLEXOS®, Aurora®, PSLF®, or similar platforms.
  • Project management and/or consulting experience.
  • Experience communicating complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of market design, transmission systems, resource adequacy, and generation economics.
  • Experience supporting renewable energy, battery storage, transmission, utility, or infrastructure investment projects.
  • Knowledge of asset valuation, project finance, M&A due diligence, or investment analysis.
  • Experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, generative AI, and AI-enabled productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot) to improve market analysis, research, forecasting, data processing, automation, and client deliverables.
  • Interest in emerging topics, including energy transition, data center load growth, electrification, battery storage, transmission expansion, and grid modernization.
  • Experience using Python, R, SQL, Power BI, or other advanced analytical tools.

Professional Skills

  • Strong attention to detail, initiative, and commitment to client service.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a desire to continuously learn about energy markets and emerging technologies.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose: moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Proposal and Contract Manager to join our team. As a Senior Proposal and Contract Manager, you will manage the full proposal and contract process for clinical research clients, turning Requests for Proposal (RFPs) into client-ready budgets and contracts that set the foundation for successful studies. This client-facing position plays a key role in proposal accuracy, contract negotiation, and client satisfaction. It requires consistent management of proposal and contract processes from RFP receipt through client signature. You'll collaborate with Operations, Project Management, Legal, Business Development, and Finance teams, work with subject matter experts (SMEs), and follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) to deliver high-quality work.


Responsibilities include overall accountability for the end-to-end RFP process and the negotiation and management of client contracts, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence client outcomes.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic proposals, sound budgeting, and effective client negotiations. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Proposal and Contract Manager can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.


Key Responsibilities

  • Hold overall accountability for the full RFP process, from receiving and analyzing RFP documentation, including study protocols or synopses, through to delivery, identifying and mitigating risks along the way.
  • Ensure the appropriate SMEs are assigned to and notified of each RFP and coordinate key strategic and operational areas throughout proposal preparation.
  • Prepare and modify strategic proposals and budgets in response to RFPs and revisions, based on SME feedback and proposal management input, ensuring alignment with client specifications, communications, and internal assumptions.
  • Manage the overall contract process for specific or varied accounts, coordinating Operations, Project Management, Legal Business Development, and Finance to prepare, review, and negotiate contracts in line with departmental SOPs and work instructions.
  • Develop account-specific contract standards, including budget presentation, payment terms, and standard contract language, and build contract strategies and plans for delivery and client signature.
  • Lead and facilitate client meetings to negotiate costs and terms by targeted client signature dates, providing formatted client grids that clearly explain the rationale for cost changes.
  • Amend project budgets in partnership with project and functional teams, using internal tools and reports to update client budgets.
  • Draft contract documents from Parexel templates, and identify and manage contractual issues that require finance, tax, or other stakeholder input, applying lessons learned to new contracts.
  • Obtain third-party quotes as needed and independently map client bid-grids to the pricing tool, keeping mapping references up to date.
  • Keep documents, files, and data current in the appropriate systems for metrics and key performance indicator (KPI) reporting, while meeting internal and external deadlines.
  • Serve as a resource and mentor for less experienced team members, aid colleagues as workload allows, and take part in process improvement initiatives, tool refreshes, and change champion activities.

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in proposal development, contract negotiation, and budgeting.
  • A strong understanding of clinical study operations across different regions of the world, ideally gained through industry experience.
  • The ability to collaborate across teams, communicate clearly, and escalate difficult situations appropriately.
  • A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and a sense of urgency.
  • Comfort working with pricing tools, Salesforce, and data systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Life Science, Business, or Languages, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 4-6 years of previous experience in project support, finance, contracting, or proposals in a Contract Research Organization (CRO) or similar environment.
  • Broad experience in proposals and contract management, including contractual terms, pricing structures, pricing tools, and data systems such as Salesforce.
  • Standard knowledge of managing client contract processes and accounts, including reporting.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of cash flow and revenue recognition.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of relevant software, including Windows, Word, Excel, Outlook, and databases.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to work irregular and/or extended hours as needed to meet client proposal deadlines.
  • Fluent in written and oral English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA
  • Experience with multinational and multicultural companies

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.


If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

jobs.title: Manager, OSP QA (Close Out Package - Quality Assurance)
jobs.excerpt: Company Description Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society.
jobs.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance (COP QA) Manager to lead our team responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving Outside Plant (OSP) project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.


The ideal candidate will provide leadership, technical oversight, and operational direction to a team of QA specialists responsible for ensuring closeout packages are complete, accurate, and compliant with company specifications, customer requirements, and established quality standards.


This role requires a strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction, fiber optic testing, construction documentation, quality assurance processes, and team leadership. The manager will be responsible for driving review consistency, maintaining productivity and quality standards, identifying recurring deficiencies, and implementing corrective actions to improve the overall closeout process.


A critical component of this position is collaboration with OSP Project Managers (PMs) to communicate quality deficiencies, provide training and guidance, and improve the accuracy and completeness of initial package submissions.


The manager will also be responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports to track team performance, package review progress, quality trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Lead, manage, and develop the OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance team responsible for reviewing and validating completed OSP project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.
  • Oversee daily QA operations, including workload distribution, review prioritization, resource allocation, and adherence to established turnaround times.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, productivity targets, and quality standards for QA team members.
  • Monitor individual and team performance to ensure consistent, accurate, and timely completion of closeout package reviews.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, mentoring, and ongoing training to QA specialists to promote accountability, consistency, and professional development.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex package deficiencies, technical discrepancies, and operational challenges.

Closeout Package Quality Assurance

  • Oversee the comprehensive review of OSP closeout packages to ensure all required documentation, testing results, construction records, and supporting materials meet company specifications and customer requirements.
  • Ensure the team validates the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of submitted documentation, including as-built drawings, fiber assignments, splice records, test results, network inventory records, and other required closeout deliverables.
  • Direct the review and validation of fiber optic test results, including OTDR, insertion loss, optical power meter, Fiber Inspection Probe (FIP), Chromatic Dispersion (CD), and Polarization Mode Dispersion (PMD) data, as applicable.
  • Ensure fiber optic testing documentation reflects appropriate testing methodologies, equipment settings, wavelengths, test durations, and acceptance criteria in accordance with engineering and contractual requirements.
  • Establish and maintain standardized QA checklists, review procedures, acceptance criteria, and documentation requirements.
  • Ensure package deficiencies are accurately documented, communicated, tracked, and resolved before final QA approval.
  • Maintain consistent quality standards across all reviewers to minimize discrepancies, rework, and customer rejections.
  • Ensure completed closeout packages meet internal acceptance requirements and are ready for customer submission.

Project Management Collaboration & Corrective Action

  • Partner closely with OSP Project Managers to identify, communicate, and resolve closeout package deficiencies and documentation discrepancies.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to Project Managers regarding rejected or incomplete submissions, including required corrections and expectations for resubmittal.
  • Identify recurring submission errors, documentation gaps, and process deficiencies across projects and individual Project Managers.
  • Develop and deliver targeted training, coaching, and corrective action initiatives to improve the quality and consistency of closeout package submissions.
  • Collaborate with OSP operations, engineering, construction, and project management leadership to address systemic quality issues and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to reduce repeat deficiencies, improve first-pass acceptance rates, and minimize unnecessary review cycles.
  • Support Project Managers in understanding closeout requirements, internal specifications, and customer-specific acceptance criteria.
  • Escalate recurring or unresolved quality issues to appropriate leadership with recommended corrective actions.

Reporting, Metrics & Performance Management

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly reports detailing QA team performance, closeout package review activity, quality metrics, and operational trends.
  • Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
  • Total closeout packages received, reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • First-pass acceptance and rejection rates.
  • Package review turnaround times and aging.
  • Outstanding packages, backlog volume, and review status.
  • Rejection reasons, deficiency categories, and recurring quality issues.
  • Individual reviewer productivity and quality performance.
  • Project Manager submission quality and resubmittal trends.
  • Rework volume and repeat rejection rates.
  • Analyze performance data to identify bottlenecks, productivity challenges, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and tracking tools to provide leadership with visibility into QA operations and overall closeout package readiness.
  • Provide regular performance summaries to management, highlighting trends, risks, corrective actions, and improvement initiatives.
  • Utilize reporting data to establish performance benchmarks, measure process effectiveness, and support resource planning.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Compliance
  • Develop, document, and continuously improve QA processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), review checklists, and acceptance workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline the closeout review process, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency without compromising quality.
  • Implement quality control measures to ensure consistent application of internal specifications and customer requirements.
  • Perform periodic audits of completed QA reviews to verify reviewer accuracy, process compliance, and documentation quality.
  • Analyze rejection trends and root causes to develop corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve documentation standards, submission processes, and overall closeout package quality.
  • Ensure QA records, review histories, and supporting documentation are maintained in accordance with company standards and audit requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on increasing first-pass acceptance rates, reducing review cycle times, and improving customer delivery readiness.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong background in Outside Plant (OSP) fiber optic construction, network documentation, quality assurance, or project management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing operational workflows, or supervising quality assurance activities.
  • Strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction processes, including fiber placement, splicing, testing, network documentation, and project closeout requirements.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience reviewing or analyzing fiber optic test results, including OTDR, OLTS, FIP, CD, and PMD, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and validate OSP construction drawings, as-built documentation, splice diagrams, fiber assignments, and network records.
  • Experience reviewing technical documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established specifications.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify recurring quality issues, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain operational reports, performance metrics, and KPI tracking.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and other business reporting and documentation tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide constructive feedback, facilitate training, and collaborate effectively with Project Managers and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to hold team members accountable for performance, quality standards, and established procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Previous experience managing OSP closeout package reviews, construction documentation QA, or fiber optic test acceptance teams.
  • Familiarity with EXFO FastReporter, EXFO ConnectorMax, Viavi FiberCable2 Suite, Viavi FiberChekPRO, Anritsu NetWorks, and similar fiber optic test analysis platforms.
  • Experience with Google Earth, GIS-based mapping tools, network inventory systems, and OSP construction documentation platforms.
  • Experience developing dashboards, automated reports, or performance tracking tools using advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting applications.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, optical transport systems, telecommunications network architectures, and applicable industry standards.
  • Experience developing training programs, standard operating procedures, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of customer-specific OSP closeout requirements, contractual acceptance standards, and construction quality processes.

Key Performance Expectations

  • Success in this position will be measured by the manager's ability to:
  • Maintain consistent, accurate, and timely QA reviews of OSP closeout packages.
  • Improve first-pass acceptance rates and reduce recurring deficiencies in Project Manager submissions.
  • Minimize QA backlog and maintain established package review turnaround times.
  • Improve team productivity, review consistency, and individual reviewer performance.
  • Deliver accurate, actionable daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting.
  • Reduce customer rejections resulting from incomplete or inaccurate closeout documentation.
  • Implement effective training and corrective action programs that produce measurable improvements in submission quality.
  • Continuously improve QA workflows, operational efficiency, and overall closeout package readiness.

Estimated base salary range: $84,900 - $130,000 USD/annually.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Product Owner is a senior product leader who serves as the product lead for a large, cross-functional patient experience initiative to reimagine how new patients are onboarded, from identification and scheduling through the early visits and the transition to ongoing care. Guided by the principle that earlier information enables earlier care, the role turns the vision into a prioritized product roadmap that improves patient engagement, provider preparedness, care continuity, and clinical documentation quality, accelerating clinical and financial value.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Lead Product Owner partners with executive sponsors, business and clinical leaders, and workstream leads to deliver an initial MVP launch while continuing to advance the broader vision. The role helps keep shared documentation aligned with product decisions, guides technical and business decisions across engineering, data, design, and operations, and mentors Product Owners who support the initiative.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and integrated roadmap for the patient journey, sequencing the initial MVP and the fully reimagined journey across its stages, from identification through scheduling, initial visits, and the transition to ongoing care.
  • Translate journey design into epics, requirements, and complex user stories for capabilities such as care planning in the electronic medical record, pre-visit reporting, earlier records retrieval and gap identification, chart-prep triggers, upstream capture of critical patient information, forms and portal engagement, and earlier diagnostic screening workflows.
  • Prioritize across workstreams, making key decisions on value trade-offs, MVP scope, release sequencing, and dependencies, and drive resolution of open decisions such as patient identification criteria, clinical approvals, and opportunities to use technology to reduce provider administrative burden.
  • Partner with clinical operations, center and provider leadership, sales and growth, patient engagement, analytics, IT, compliance, engineering, and design to define role-based responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths, so every journey stage has accountable owners and closed-loop handoffs.
  • Establish and monitor shared success measures with analytics partners, such as time to first visit, pre-visit records capture, forms completion, task completion, timely documentation, and risk adjustment accuracy, and use them to drive continuous optimization.
  • Lead launch readiness and post-launch support for the MVP, including workflow validation with frontline teams, training and job aids, FAQs, decision and issue logs, escalation paths, hypercare, and ongoing refinement of the implementation roadmap.
  • Support the investment and value case for the journey, ensure regulatory alignment, and communicate progress, risks, and decisions to executive sponsors and senior leadership forums.
  • Provide leadership and representation, including mentoring Product Owners, shaping team culture, and participating in cross-enterprise initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Product Management, Health Informatics, Business), including experience leading enterprise-scale digital products.
  • 7+ years of product management (or related) experience, including 3+ years in a senior or lead role, ideally in digital health or virtual care.
  • Proven ability to define and deliver product roadmaps using Agile methodologies, including backlog management, sprint planning, and leading agile ceremonies.
  • Strong understanding of value-based care models, clinical workflows, and healthcare regulations.
  • Demonstrated success using data, user research, and clinical insights to guide product decisions, improve outcomes, and track key KPIs (e.g., roadmap delivery, feature adoption, NPS, care gap closure).
  • Excellent collaboration skills with clinicians, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders, and strong communication abilities to influence senior leadership and non-technical audiences.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% within the U.S. to support product initiatives and stakeholder engagement.
  • Remote role; must be available to work normal business hours in Eastern Standard Time (EST).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business administration, Health Informatics, Public Health, or a related field.
  • Experience in senior-focused or Medicare Advantage care models, especially within virtual or hybrid care delivery systems.
  • Certification in Agile or Product Management, such as Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or Pragmatic Institute certification.

jobs.excerpt: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes.
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics


Labcorp is seeking a remote-based Director, Consumer Pricing and Analytics to join our team!


Responsibilities:

Pricing & Demand Modeling

  • Lead price elasticity, demand forecasting, and scenario modeling to inform pricing, promotional, subscription, bundling, margin, and portfolio decisions.
  • Evaluate pricing opportunities and risks by balancing consumer demand, competitive dynamics, and business objectives.
  • Establish pricing frameworks and governance that support profitable, data-driven decision making.

Customer Economics & Growth Performance

  • Develop customer lifetime value (LTV), cohort, and retention frameworks.
  • Analyze customer, transaction, and product performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion, average order value (AOV), and long-term customer value.
  • Partner with Marketing, Finance, Product, and Merchandising leaders to align growth strategies with financial outcomes.

Experimentation, Measurement & Performance Insights

  • Partner on testing and experimentation strategies for pricing, promotions, subscriptions, bundles, and customer offers.
  • Establish measurement methodologies and success metrics that quantify initiative performance and business impact.
  • Develop executive reporting and performance insights that provide visibility into pricing effectiveness, customer economics, and growth initiatives.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that enable continuous optimization and informed decision making.

Competitive & Market Intelligence

  • Lead competitive intelligence efforts across pricing, product assortment, promotions, industry trends, and competitors.
  • Monitor consumer and market trends to identify opportunities, risks, and shifts in competitive positioning.
  • Translate market intelligence into strategic insights that inform portfolio, pricing, and growth strategies.
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to scale competitive intelligence, identify emerging trends, and enhance predictive insights.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or Mathematics.
  • 7 or more years of experience in pricing analytics, revenue management, customer economics, commercial analytics or business intelligence.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA).

Additional Job Standards:

  • Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, consumer health, or other highly regulated industries where pricing decisions must balance customer value, compliance, and business objectives.
  • Demonstrated success building pricing and analytics management capabilities from the ground up, including frameworks, governance, tools, and measurement approaches.
  • Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, pricing decisions, competitive intelligence, and business performance.
  • Strong quantitative skills — comfort building pricing models, running elasticity analysis, and translating data into clear recommendations.
  • Experience supporting direct-to-consumer (DTC), ecommerce, marketplace, retail, and/or consumer-focused digital health businesses.
  • Experience supporting subscription-based products, membership programs, or recurring revenue businesses.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining pricing optimization, price elasticity, demand forecasting, customer lifetime value, and scenario-planning models.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience translating large datasets into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience pricing products sold directly to consumers (as opposed to purely B2B or payer-negotiated pricing)
  • Track record of partnering cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Merchandising, and Finance
  • Advanced Excel/modeling skills; experience with pricing or BI tools (e.g., SQL, Looker, Tableau)
  • Excellent communication skills — able to present pricing recommendations to executives and translate strategy into simple, actionable guidance for go-to-market teams


About the Role

Labcorp OnDemand is a DTC consumer testing business growing rapidly within the expanding consumer health market.

As Director, Consumer Pricing & Analytics, you will play a foundational role in developing the models and insights that inform pricing decisions for direct-to-consumer diagnostic products in a market shaped by payer dynamics, out-of-pocket consumer spend, regulatory considerations, and competitive lab/testing offerings.

You'll build the pricing frameworks and governance that let the business grow profitably while staying accessible to the consumers we serve. This role is directly responsible for tying pricing decisions to business outcomes — including revenue growth targets, margin goals, customer acquisition cost (CAC) and lifetime value (LTV) improvement, and subscription growth.

The ideal candidate brings experience from a direct-to-consumer, e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, retail, and/or digital health consumer business and has a proven track record of translating complex data into actionable commercial recommendations.

This role is remote-based in the US.

Acid Recovery Application Engineer(chemical process engineer)

Join a Global Leader in Process Systems Engineering

GMM Pfaudler is a leading supplier of highly engineered equipment and process systems serving the chemical, pharmaceutical, energy, and industrial markets. Our Systems Group designs and delivers custom process solutions including Acid Recovery, Evaporation, Distillation, Reactor, and Wiped Film Evaporation (WFE) systems for customers around the world.

GMM Pfaudler designs and builds Acid Recovery process systems which, through evaporation and distillation process steps, purify spent/waste acid from various chemical processes enabling customers to re-use the acids to reduce operating costs. As part of our strategic growth, we are expanding our Acid Recovery business in the United States. This role offers a unique opportunity to become a technical leader in a specialized and growing technology area while working closely with our global Acid Recovery Center of Excellence in Hofheim, Germany.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Chemical Process Engineer to support business development through the sale of Acid Recovery Systems throughout North America.

This role combines process engineering, customer engagement, and commercial sales. You will work directly with customers to understand their process requirements, develop preliminary process designs to meet customer needs, prepare project costs estimates and proposals, and negotiate contracts to secure new business.

The ideal candidate enjoys working directly with customers to understand their process needs, solving complex process challenges and transforming process data into practical, commercial-scale solutions, and securing contracts.

What You'll Do

Process Design & Application Engineering

  • Develop preliminary process designs for acid recovery systems based on customer requirements, pilot testing data, and historical system performance.
  • Collaborate with pilot test engineers to develop and execute testing programs and then utilize pilot plant and laboratory data to scale processes to commercial production systems.
  • Perform engineering calculations and complete mass and energy balances for system equipment sizing and select instrumentation necessary for process monitoring and control.

Customer & Sales Support

  • Review customer inquiries and identify technical and commercial requirements.
  • Serve as the customer’s technical resource throughout the sales cycle.
  • Present process solutions and system recommendations to customers.
  • Travel to customer sites to support business development through technical discussions, proposal reviews, and contract negotiations.

Proposal Development

  • Utilize in-house cost data and vendor quotations to develop system cost estimates.
  • Prepare budgetary and firm-price proposals that present GMM Pfaudler solutions and their technical and commercial value to customers.

Project Support

  • Review customer purchase orders and ensure alignment with proposal scope.
  • Support project handoff activities with project execution teams.
  • Provide technical guidance during early project execution phases.
  • Participate in post-project reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry with sufficient system design/engineering experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of strong chemical process engineering experience; 8 – 15 years experience preferred.
  • Experience designing chemical process systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20-30%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with evaporation and distillation systems.
  • Customer-facing technical sales experience.
  • Additional skills which are not required but considered a plus for a candidate
    • Acid recovery systems design or operation experience
    • Experience conducting or utilizing pilot plant testing.
    • Aspen Plus, Aspen Exchanger Design, or similar process simulation and equipment sizing software.

Why Join GMM Pfaudler?

  • Unique opportunity to become a U.S.-based expert in Acid Recovery technology.
  • Exposure to diverse process applications across chemical and industrial markets.
  • Direct interaction with customers and leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Flexible work arrangements including remote work potential.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Job Description Summary

Job Title: Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA)

(Field Based)

Primary Location: Southeast United States

Drive clinical trials forward where it matters most - at the site level and with patients at the center. As a Senior CRA at Novartis, you will manage trusted site relationships and perform on-site and remote monitoring activities to support the initiation, conduct, and timely completion of Phase I – IV trials in compliance with International Council for Harmonization / Good Clinical Practices (ICH/GCP), local regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and monitoring procedures. Serving as a key point of contact for investigational sites, you will proactively manage site performance, recruitment, quality, risks, and issue resolution to ensure sustainable trial execution and high-quality data delivery. Assigned to complex trials and/or less experienced sites, you may also act as a Subject Matter Expert, support audit and inspection readiness activities, ensure timely implementation of corrective actions, and collaborate with local and global cross-functional teams to drive process improvements that help bring innovative therapies to patients faster.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 80% travel.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead assigned sites as the primary point of contact throughout study delivery
  • Build strong relationships to ensure site performance, quality, and milestone achievement
  • Manage Phase I to Phase IV trials per monitoring plans and company procedures
  • Conduct site initiation visits and deliver ongoing training for site personnel
  • Perform remote and on-site monitoring to ensure compliance and patient safety
  • Maintain accurate documentation and update all clinical systems in a timely manner
  • Identify risks, resolve issues, and escalate concerns as needed
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive efficient study execution
  • Support timely data query resolution and ensure data accuracy
  • Act as a subject matter expert across study activities when required

Essential Requirements

  • Minimum of three years of clinical site monitoring experience
  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in science, healthcare, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of clinical research and drug development processes
  • Knowledge of ICH/GCP and 21 CFR regulatory requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
  • Strong site management, communication, and problem-solving skills
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken, Spanish highly desired
  • Ability to drive and travel extensively, up to 80%, in a company vehicle

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience in multiple therapeutic areas and Veeva Vault CTMS is a plus
  • Advanced knowledge and use of AI

The salary for this position is expected to range between $108,500 and $201,500 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

US-based eligible employees will receive a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, life and disability benefits, a 401(k) with company contribution and match, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including vacation, personal days, holidays and other leaves.

We are looking for a Senior SQL Developer to be a part of PROVE Partner's parent company Allira’s team (remote). We are making SQL the single source of truth for all of our data. Every report, reconciliation and financial statement will run from SQL, while Salesforce and Pulse remain our working systems and feed SQL, until better systems are identified. You will be the hands-on technical owner of the SQL platform. You will also scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs, build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, and manage the project day to day, working closely with Finance, Operations and our Salesforce team.

What you'll do

  • Scope the system migration across our Salesforce orgs: data mapping, sequencing, effort, risks and cutover approach
  • Design and build the SQL data model: staging, cleansed core tables and reporting marts
  • Build and schedule data loads from Salesforce, Pulse, the general ledger, loans and the loan ledger, and other sources
  • Rebuild our Salesforce reports in SQL, including accruals, repayments, settlements, clearing reports and weekly journal entries
  • Write tie-out logic that reconciles SQL to the general ledger on every load and every close
  • Turn manual exception reports into automated data-quality checks and alerts
  • Produce credit facility, lender and investor reporting by entity and funding vehicle
  • Build integrations that write from SQL back to Salesforce and other systems, with clear system-of-record and reconciliation rules
  • Manage the project: plan, timeline, status reporting, risks and coordination with Finance, Operations and the Salesforce team
  • Work with our Salesforce team on data mapping and on changes that affect SQL

What you bring

  • Completed at least one project of similar scope from start to finish, such as a Salesforce-to-SQL migration that included reporting and finance close
  • Hands-on two-way integration experience: writing data from SQL to Salesforce and other systems (Salesforce APIs, Bulk API or middleware)
  • Project management skills: scoping, planning, running timelines and status, managing risks and stakeholders
  • 5+ years writing production SQL (T-SQL / SQL Server preferred): stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and query tuning

Nice to have

  • Power BI or SSRS report development
  • Salesforce administration or development experience
  • Git, CI/CD for database deployments
  • Project management certification (PMP or similar)

Why join

You'll build the data platform from the ground up and own it, with direct visibility to Finance leadership and a clear impact on how the firm closes its books.

Job Description

Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you are a part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Strategic Planning & Operations, Director

The Strategic Planning and Operations Director reports to and serves as a strategic and operational partner to the Senior Vice President of US Business Operations (USBO) and the USBO leadership team. The Director helps translate business priorities into clear plans, decisions and high-quality execution; strengthens leadership alignment and organizational effectiveness; and coordinates across functions, regions and other stakeholders. The role leads priority initiatives, supports the organization’s operating rhythm, and brings structure and sound judgment to complex, matrixed work.


Responsibilities:


  • Work with the Senior Vice President of US Business Operations (USBO) and the USBO leadership team to shape and advance strategic priorities, support cross-functional business objectives, and advise on key activities and issues.

  • Support skills-building and employee development initiatives that strengthen organizational capabilities.

  • Doctorate degree and 4 years of commercial, project management, marketing or related experience; OR

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Experience in sales, marketing, commercial operations or consulting within the biopharmaceutical industry, or in a closely aligned business function.
  • Strong strategic thinking, critical thinking, analytical and project management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects end to end and translate strategy into practical plans and results.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear presentations and explain complex information.
  • Excellent interpersonal, active listening, negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, including senior leaders, and to build alignment without direct authority.
  • Proactive, self-directed, intellectually curious and adaptable, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Sound judgment and ability to navigate matrixed and sometimes ambiguous environments while fostering a collaborative, values-based, high-performance culture.
  • Understanding of Corporate Governance processes and the ability to work within them.

What you can expect of us


As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
