jobs.excerpt: About Skylight Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.
jobs.description:
About Skylight

Skylight is a digital consultancy using design and technology to help government agencies deliver better public services.

We’re at the forefront of a civic movement to reinvent how all levels of government serve families, patients, and many others in today’s digital world.

If you want to play a part in driving this critical movement forward, we’d love for you to join our growing team of public interest technologists.

The work we do matters.

About the job

At Skylight, software engineers design, implement, and maintain software systems to improve government services for users. This software is built to meet the needs of regular users of government services as well as Skylight’s partners in government.

A consulting software engineer focuses on advisory engagements where the deliverable is guidance, assessment, or technical strategy rather than delivering code.

Skylight has partnered with the U.S. Air Force across multiple legacy modernization efforts. The work spans modernization of legacy systems, new capability development in multi-vendor environments, iteration on established platforms, all inside an agile transformation and broader organizational change.

You’ll assess legacy systems, shape the technical strategy for modernizing them, and pair directly with government engineers to raise the bar on how software gets built. Expect to spend your time in architecture reviews, working sessions with vendors and Air Force teams, and hands-on demonstrations of modern, AI-assisted engineering practices.

What to know going in

Your first 30 days are about working with the Skylight team and government personnel, learning the client’s domain and organization, and enabling your government partners. Access to users varies from team to team, so you’ll need to get creative about how you reach them. The client is early- to mid-transformation, so expect organizational and operational change along the way.

This role is contingent on Skylight being awarded the underlying contract. If we’re not awarded the contract, we’ll let you know promptly and discuss whether there are other opportunities that fit.

What you’ll do

  • Assess legacy applications and their technical environments to identify technical debt, instability, and other opportunities for improvement, then design, document, and communicate solutions
  • Own the modernization strategy, technical direction, architectural decisions, and test strategy for the modernization, in collaboration with government engineers and partner vendors but accountable for the result
  • Advocate for and model lean-agile engineering practices such as API-first design, simple design, continuous integration, version control, and automated testing
  • Guide teams toward secure, compliant software that meets federal security standards and defends against common vulnerabilities
  • Pair with and coach government engineers so modern practices, including AI-assisted development, stick after you’ve moved on
  • Collaborate with product managers, researchers, and designers so technical recommendations serve user and mission needs

What we’re looking for

Basic qualifications

  • Ability to write clean, working, and reusable code
  • Understand the different pieces of software systems and how to fit them together, while keeping performance, reliability, and availability in mind
  • Familiar with how to build secure, compliant software and defend against common vulnerabilities
  • Experience evaluating existing systems and communicating technical findings and recommendations to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfort holding architectural decision rights on a multi-vendor engagement, and making the tradeoffs legible to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working in agile software development
  • Interest in mentoring, coaching, and pairing with government partners so they can carry the work forward
  • Experience working on cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering, ops) in iterative delivery
  • A mindset and work approach that aligns with our core values

Nice-to-haves

  • Military or government experience
  • Experience leading legacy modernization efforts or reverse-engineering legacy applications where the code, the documentation, and stakeholder knowledge don't agree
  • Experience with web-based tech stacks (e.g., Java/React) and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience coaching other engineers on the failure modes of AI-assisted development
  • Experience delivering technology in government, regulated industries, or other public-benefit settings
  • A track record of staying aligned and accountable on remote teams

Don’t meet every qualification but think you can do the job? We’d still love to hear from you. If you’re excited about the role, apply. We consider candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences.

Other requirements

  • Some of our available roles are on federal contracts that require a degree or additional years of experience as a substitute.
  • All work must be conducted within the U.S., excluding U.S. territories.
  • This contract requires U.S. citizenship to be eligible for employment.
  • You must be able to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC), which requires a favorable background check.
  • You must complete a company background check successfully.

Logistics

Position type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

Location

This is a fully remote position.

Travel

Expect occasional travel to Air Force bases across the U.S., quarterly at most.

Expected start date

November 2026

Care package

Salary

We want to give you the most competitive salary possible. After all, you deserve it! To that end, we use the results of our interview process to determine what salary is most appropriate given your current level of seniority. For a Software Engineer at Skylight, the current salary ranges are as follows:

  • Associate Software Engineer: $90,000–$125,000
  • Software Engineer I: $120,000–$140,000
  • Software Engineer II: $135,000–$160,000
  • Senior Software Engineer: $150,000–$185,000
  • Staff Software Engineer: $170,000–$203,000
  • Principal Software Engineer: $180,000–$230,000

Benefits

Your well-being is important to us, so we focus on supporting you in a variety of ways:

  • Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and AD&D insurance
  • Dependent care FSA, healthcare FSA, health savings account
  • Dollar-for-dollar 401(k) match up to 10% of your salary with no vesting period
  • Flexible paid-time-off policy (generally around 25 days per year), plus 11 paid federal holidays
  • Up to 12 weeks paid-time-off for all eligible new birth, adoption, or foster parents
  • Performance rewards, including annual salary increase, annual performance bonus, spot bonuses, and stock options
  • Business development / sales bonuses
  • Referral bonuses
  • Annual $2000 allowance for professional development
  • Annual $750 allowance for tech-related purchases
  • Annual swag budget of $100 to display your Skylight pride with some merchandise (hoodies, hats, and more)
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
  • An environment that empowers you to unleash your superpowers for public good

Interview tips

Our process includes a preliminary screen, a skills interview, a behavioral interview, and a reverse interview where you meet your potential team — usually four conversations across two to three weeks. Here are some tips to help you prepare for a successful interview:

  • Visit our join page to learn more about how our interview process works.
  • Check out our Career Pathways framework to learn more about the different roles within Skylight and the skills needed to do them.
  • Browse our case studies to learn more about our work.

If you’d like to request reasonable accommodations during the application or interviewing process, please contact our recruiting team at .

We participate in E-Verify and upon hire, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you’re authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Demand Generation Manager About the Role Blackbaud unleashes the potential of the people and organizations who change the world.
jobs.description:
Senior Demand Generation Manager

About the Role

Blackbaud unleashes the potential of the people and organizations who change the world. As the leading software provider exclusively dedicated to powering social impact, we help our customers move faster, work smarter, and achieve more.

As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you will own the strategy, execution, and optimization of integrated demand generation programs that create qualified pipeline and contribute to bookings across priority audiences and markets.

This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced demand generation marketer who can independently translate go-to-market priorities into sophisticated, multichannel buyer journeys. You will work closely with Sales and cross-functional Marketing partners, use performance data to identify opportunities and gaps, and continuously improve how Blackbaud creates, captures, and converts demand.

You will bring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, taking ownership of complex programs from initial audience and journey design through measurement, optimization, and scaled reuse.

What You’ll Do

  • Own integrated demand generation programs across email, digital, paid media, nurture, webinars, events, account-based marketing, and other channels, with clear accountability for pipeline and bookings outcomes.
  • Translate vertical strategy, audience priorities, approved messaging, and content strategy into connected buyer journeys across demand creation, capture, nurture, and conversion.
  • Develop sophisticated always-on and campaign-specific nurture strategies that address different buyer personas, stages, behaviors, and signals of intent.
  • Partner closely with Sales leaders and sellers to understand target accounts, territory priorities, market opportunities, opportunity quality, and conversion expectations.
  • Establish regular operating rhythms with Sales to evaluate engagement, pipeline development, opportunity quality, funnel progression, bookings contribution, and areas requiring intervention.
  • Use performance data and market signals to identify gaps and opportunities, recommend adjustments, and make informed decisions about audience, channel, program, and investment mix.
  • Design and execute structured experimentation across audience, messaging, offers, channels, sequences, personalization, and Sales follow-up, then scale approaches that measurably improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Field and Event Marketing to connect pre-event engagement, onsite experiences, and post-event follow-up into cohesive programs that accelerate buyer progression.
  • Work across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Industry Strategy, Field Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Sales to ensure programs operate as an integrated customer journey rather than disconnected activities.
  • Use approved product positioning, value propositions, claims, competitive insights, and launch materials from Product Marketing and adapt them appropriately for audiences and campaign execution.
  • Identify gaps in messaging, product proof, buyer insight, or campaign readiness and proactively partner with the appropriate teams to resolve them.
  • Leverage marketing automation, CRM data, intent and engagement signals, AI-enabled tools, and reporting to improve targeting, personalization, efficiency, and speed to market.
  • Develop reusable campaign frameworks, playbooks, testing approaches, reporting practices, and best practices that strengthen demand generation execution across the organization.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for demand generation, sharing insights and proven approaches with colleagues and helping elevate the quality of programs across the broader Marketing organization.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Qualified pipeline and bookings contribution.
  • Pipeline generated relative to program investment.
  • Conversion across priority buyer journeys, funnel stages, and target accounts.
  • Opportunity quality and progression in partnership with Sales.
  • Effectiveness of audience, channel, nurture, and account-based strategies.
  • Speed and quality of testing, learning, and optimization.
  • Successful scaling and reuse of high-performing demand generation programs and practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of B2B demand generation, growth marketing, integrated marketing, or related experience, with demonstrated ownership of programs tied to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success building and optimizing sophisticated multichannel demand generation programs across multiple stages of the buyer journey.
  • Strong experience partnering directly with Sales around target accounts, pipeline creation, opportunity quality, funnel conversion, and shared business outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms, along with a strong understanding of lead and account lifecycle management, segmentation, nurture, and performance measurement.
  • Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to translate marketing, funnel, and pipeline data into actionable decisions.
  • Experience designing structured tests and using results to continuously improve audiences, offers, messaging, channels, sequencing, and conversion.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple complex programs and priorities while maintaining strong attention to execution and business outcomes.
  • Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, with the ability to bring Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Field Marketing, Marketing Operations, and other partners together around shared objectives.
  • Ability to translate broader go-to-market strategy and approved positioning into focused, relevant buyer experiences without losing strategic intent.
  • A track record of identifying opportunities for improvement and creating repeatable frameworks, processes, or programs that extend impact beyond an individual campaign.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube ​

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our Intelligence for Good® vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

About the team

The Workforce Management team helps power a consistent, high-quality experience across Zillow’s contact center operations. We partner closely with customer-facing teams and operational leaders to align staffing, scheduling, and real-time performance with customer needs and business goals. As part of Business Operations, this team uses data and collaboration to support efficient operations and help teams deliver great service every day.

About the role

The Specialist I, Workforce Management supports effective contact center staffing and performance by maintaining schedules, monitoring real-time volume and service levels, and providing data-driven insights to help leaders meet operational targets and deliver a consistent customer experience.


You will get to


  • Monitor real-time contact volumes, queues, and schedule adherence, and recommend intraday staffing adjustments to help teams meet service level and response time targets.
  • Analyze daily and intraday forecast-to-actual performance, identify trends and variances, and summarize risks and opportunities for workforce performance to supervisors and managers.
  • Build, maintain, and adjust schedules, shift bids, and off-phone activities (such as training, meetings, and projects) to align staffing with forecasted demand while supporting team member availability constraints.

generating schedules, forecasts, or performance reports.

jobs.excerpt: Exterro is seeking a Legal Engineer to shape our purpose-built AI for law firms and the legal industry.
jobs.description:
Exterro is seeking a Legal Engineer to shape our purpose-built AI for law firms and the legal industry. Grounded in ARMOUR—our vision for an AI framework that fundamentally changes how legal, compliance, and risk workflows are tackled—we are building AI agents that perform real legal work, and we need practicing lawyers who know that work from the inside to build them. You have practiced law and seen exactly where hours go: first-pass review, issue spotting, drafting from precedent, and chasing deadlines. In this high-impact role, you will serve as both the legal subject matter expert in the room and a hands-on builder, translating how lawyers actually work into instruction sets, workflows, and AI agents—and proving they meet the standard a partner would sign off on. No coding background is required; we will teach you the tools, as we cannot teach years of legal judgment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Agent & Workflow Development: Write and refine the instructions, prompts, playbooks, and reference materials that drive our AI agents across use cases such as contract review, diligence, drafting, research, litigation support, and [your core domain].
  • Legal Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the primary legal SME for product and engineering teams—explaining how legal tasks are truly executed, defining what good output looks like, identifying edge cases and risks, reviewing specs, and challenging assumptions.
  • Quality Assurance & Evaluation: Create gold-standard answers, test sets, and grading rubrics. Stress-test agent outputs for accuracy, reasoning, citations, and hallucinations, and determine when solutions are ready to ship.
  • Governance & Safeguards: Design human-review checkpoints and guardrails that respect privilege, confidentiality, and professional responsibility rules.
  • Customer Discovery & Co-Design: Join discovery calls, pilots, and design sessions with law firms; map their workflows and translate customer feedback into actionable product priorities.
  • Continuous Maintenance & Enablement: Maintain and update agents as models, laws, and customer needs evolve, while sharing insights through demos, playbooks, and content.

Qualifications:

  • Legal Credentials & Practice Experience: JD or equivalent legal qualification (admission to practice preferred), paired with 3–7 years of practice at a law firm (associate, senior associate, or partner) or a blend of legal practice and knowledge management/innovation work.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep familiarity with at least one practice area, such as litigation, eDiscovery, privacy, M&A, commercial contracts.
  • AI Fluency & Judgment: Hands-on experience using AI tools in legal practice, genuine curiosity about how they work, and sound judgment regarding where AI belongs in legal work and where it does not.
  • Structured Communication & Agility: Precise, structured writing skills capable of distilling a 40-page playbook into clear, unambiguous instructions, alongside comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration within a startup-style product team.
  • Preferred Qualifications:
    • Experience in a law firm's knowledge management, innovation, or practice-support function.
    • Hands-on experience with workflow or agent builders, prompt libraries, or retrieval (RAG) setups.
    • Light technical fluency (Python, SQL, JSON, APIs, or no-code automation).
    • Familiarity with AI evaluation methods, AI governance, or emerging AI regulation.
    • Client-facing experience such as business development, secondments, or training lawyers.

Why Exterro?

  • Impact: Play a key role in a company at the forefront of data risk management, shaping a product category from the ground up alongside engineers and product leaders while helping businesses and law firms safeguard and streamline their work in an increasingly complex digital world.
  • Growth Opportunity: Join a rapidly growing organization with hands-on training in AI tools, prompting, and evaluation from day one, offering a clear path to Senior or Lead Legal Engineer, Product, or Customer leadership.
  • Culture: Work in an innovative, inclusive, and collaborative environment, where your contributions are valued, and your professional development is supported.

Exterro participates in E-Verify and is a drug-free workplace. All employment offers are contingent upon the successful passing of a background check.

We believe in the importance of pay transparency and strive to create a fair and equitable workplace for all employees. As a remote first organization, our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The base salary range for this remote position is $131,000-$164,000 per year, based on skills, experience and qualifications. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate. Exterro is a total compensation company, and this role may be eligible for variable pay, equity, bonus and/or other forms of compensation as part of the package. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, retirement plans, flexible paid time off and more.

Candidates are encouraged to discuss their salary expectations during the interview process. We are committed to ensuring that compensation aligns with market standards and is commensurate with the responsibilities of the role.

All employees are responsible for understanding and adhering to the organization’s security and privacy policies, procedures, and standards. As part of your role, you are expected to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information and systems within your scope of responsibility. Additionally, you are required to participate in mandatory security and privacy training and ensure that best practices are applied in all work activities.

jobs.excerpt: #RunwiththePack At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.
jobs.description:
#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

As a Threat Researcher, you will work at the intersection of cybersecurity research, threat hunting, and detection engineering. You will study real-world attacker behavior across endpoint, network, cloud, and identity telemetry, then turn those insights into practical detection logic, hunt content, tooling, and recommendations that improve customer protection.


This role partners closely with Security Services, Threat Intelligence, Product Management, and engineering teams. The goal is to rapidly understand emerging threats, identify where we can improve coverage, and deliver detections and guidance that are useful, reliable, and actionable at operational scale.


You should be comfortable moving through ambiguous investigations: forming hypotheses, hunting across large datasets, validating signals, writing detections in code or rule frameworks, documenting findings, and helping services teams respond to new and active threats.

What You’ll Do

  • Research emerging threats, adversary techniques, and attack trends relevant to Arctic Wolf customers.
  • Hunt across large-scale endpoint, network, cloud, and identity datasets to identify suspicious behavior and coverage opportunities.
  • Design, write, test, and maintain detections using Python, Sigma, Suricata, and SQL based formats and queries.
  • Translate threat intelligence, hunt findings, and services feedback into high-quality detection logic, reports, runbooks, and recommendations.
  • Continuously tune and improve existing detections for efficacy, reliability, and signal quality.
  • Support Security Services during emerging threats by providing research context, detection guidance, and investigation support.
  • Identify gaps in visibility, coverage, and platform capabilities, and propose practical improvements.
  • Document technical findings clearly and share knowledge across teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: threat research, detection engineering, threat hunting, and security content development
  • Strong Python development skills and experience writing maintainable, testable code.
  • Experience developing detections or signatures using Sigma, Suricata, SQL, Python-based logic, or detections-as-code workflows.
  • Ability to analyze technical threats and convert research into practical security outcomes.
  • Understanding of attacker techniques, defensive tradecraft, and common investigation workflows.
  • Ability to write clear technical documentation, reports, and runbooks.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with services, research, product, and engineering teams.
  • Ability to work autonomously once onboarded, identifying priority research opportunities and driving through to operational security impact.
  • Located in the United States and able to work remotely with a distributed team.

How You’ll Work

  • You are curious, practical, and motivated by solving real security problems.
  • You enjoy research, hunting, and digging into technical details while keeping customer impact in focus.
  • You are comfortable with autonomy and can move from ambiguous problem spaces to clear, actionable security outcomes.
  • You value quality and can balance speed, rigor, and maintainability.
  • You communicate clearly, share knowledge openly, and work well across teams.
  • You stay current with evolving threats, attacker behavior, and defensive techniques.

This is an opportunity to help shape how threat research becomes production-grade security value: from idea, to investigation, to detection, to measurable customer impact.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401(k) contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 77,900 to 262,500 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & LLM Applications to support the development, integration, and deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) capabilities within the IRIS platform.

Location: Remote role;

  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.

In this role, you will:

  • Focus on building large language model (LLM) applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and intelligent analytics solutions supporting defense and intelligence missions.
  • Have hands-on experience with Python, generative AI frameworks, and cloud-based development environments, along with an interest in delivering secure, reliable AI solutions for mission-critical applications.
  • Be responsible for research in simulation of human intelligence processes by machines including learning, reasoning, and self-correction.
  • Design advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms to solve critical business challenges.

What you'll do:

  • Develop, test, and integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into the IRIS platform, including large language model (LLM) features, generative AI pipelines, and intelligent analytics modules aligned to customer requirements.
  • Contribute to sprint-based development cycles under IRIS Agile and Scrum practices, participating in daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint demos, and Big Room Planning sessions.
  • Implement and maintain retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, vector database integrations, and semantic search features supporting IRIS decision-support workflows for defense and intelligence customers.
  • Build and support evaluation frameworks and quality assurance pipelines to ensure reliable, accurate, and secure AI-generated outputs in mission-critical environments.
  • Assist with AI and ML model deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization in cloud environments including AWS GovCloud IL5 and FedRAMP-compliant infrastructure, including CI/CD pipeline integration.
  • Collaborate with IRIS Platform and Enablement and ServiceNow/EPMP engineering teams to ensure AI feature compatibility and seamless integration across IRIS modules.
  • Document model configurations, prompt engineering techniques, RAG architectures, and AI workflows; maintain technical documentation aligned to IRIS release standards.
  • Support Cyber and Intelligence Sector IRAD technical execution under the direction of senior engineers; contribute to prototype development, TRL advancement, and milestone reporting.
  • Apply responsible AI principles including bias detection, hallucination mitigation, and human-in-the-loop review workflows to production AI features serving government customers.
  • Provide technical support during customer demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and platform on-boarding activities as needed.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or a Master's degree with relevant project or research experience.
    • An additional 4 years of experience will be considered in lieu of a bachelor's degree.
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, including experience developing or integrating LLM-based solutions (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent) in a professional or academic setting.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Python and experience with at least one AI/ML development framework such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques, vector databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB, pgvector, or equivalent), or embedding models.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms — AWS or Microsoft Azure — and deploying or supporting AI/ML models in cloud environments.
  • Experience with version control (Git), Agile/Scrum development practices, and collaborative DevSecOps workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently within established guidelines and contribute to team objectives.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear technical documentation.
  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain a Secret security clearance.

Preferred requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher; TS/SCI eligibility preferred.
  • Prior experience on the IRIS platform or other DoD analytics, decision-support, or intelligence community platforms (ODIN, Maven, C2IE, OMEGA, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience with prompt engineering techniques including few-shot learning, chain-of-thought prompting, or structured output generation.
  • Experience with agentic AI architectures, multi-agent orchestration, or LLM tool-use capabilities.
  • Familiarity with model fine-tuning methods including LoRA, QLoRA, RLHF, or similar parameter-efficient techniques.
  • Experience with MLOps practices including model monitoring, A/B testing, or LLM evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with geospatial data formats (GeoJSON, KML) and visualization libraries (Plotly, D3.js) for operational analytics applications.
  • Exposure to information operations, cognitive warfare, influence analysis, or Combatant Command analytical environments.
  • Relevant certifications: AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Azure AI Engineer, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, or DeepLearning.AI.

Target Salary Range

$86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Overview TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.
jobs.description:
Overview

TISTA Science and Technology Corporation is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management Development Security Operations (SCM DSO) program.

The Business Analyst will support the development, sustainment, and modernization of two VA healthcare supply chain applications: the Clinical Product Tool (CPT) and National Contingency Response Tool (NCRT).

This position is responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, developing user stories and acceptance criteria, supporting Agile development activities, coordinating user acceptance testing, and ensuring application enhancements align with VA operational needs.

CPT supports the administration of VA medical and surgical supply contracts and is transitioning to the VA Enterprise Cloud. NCRT enables VA facility supply chain personnel to request and coordinate critical medical supplies during emergencies. Both applications support essential supply chain operations across VA medical centers.

At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission-driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do.

TISTA associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account & Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short-term & Long-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more!


Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements from VA stakeholders and application users.

  • Support business analysis activities for the Clinical Product Tool (CPT) and National Contingency Response Tool (NCRT).

  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, developers, and technical teams to translate business needs into actionable requirements.

  • Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications to support Agile development activities.

  • Support backlog refinement and sprint planning to ensure requirements are clearly defined and ready for development.

  • Assist Product Owners with prioritizing CPT enhancements supporting VA medical supply contract administration.

  • Analyze and document current-state and future-state business processes and application workflows.

  • Facilitate requirements gathering sessions, stakeholder discussions, and business process reviews.

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), including test scenario development, execution support, and results documentation.

  • Collaborate with VA stakeholders to validate application functionality and obtain testing approvals.

  • Review production incidents and help desk tickets to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities.

  • Translate recurring application issues into documented requirements and backlog items.Identify, document, and track Section 508 accessibility requirements throughout the development lifecycle.

  • Support application modernization and cloud migration activities from a business requirements perspective

  • Prepare release notes, user guides, training materials, and briefing documentation for VA stakeholders.

  • Maintain accurate requirements documentation and support knowledge transfer across business and technical teams.


Qualifications

  • Minimum three years of experience as a Business Analyst or Requirements Analyst supporting software development projects.

  • Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements.

  • Experience developing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications within an Agile development environment.

  • Experience working directly with government stakeholders or enterprise business users to gather and validate requirements.

  • Experience using Jira or similar Agile backlog management tools.

  • Understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and software development lifecycles.

  • Experience supporting backlog refinement, sprint planning, and requirements prioritization.

  • Experience documenting business processes, workflows, and application requirements.

  • Experience facilitating requirements discussions and communicating with business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, testers, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and customer stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) programs, particularly supply chain, logistics, procurement, or contracting systems.
  • Experience supporting federal healthcare IT applications and business operations.
  • SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) or Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) certification.
  • Experience supporting Section 508 accessibility compliance and accessible application development.
  • Familiarity with human-centered design principles and user experience requirements.
  • Experience supporting application modernization or cloud migration initiatives.
  • Experience supporting federal security authorization or Authority to Operate (ATO) processes from a requirements perspective.
  • Experience coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT), requirements validation, and stakeholder sign-off.
  • Experience preparing user guides, release notes, training documentation, and stakeholder briefing materials.
  • Active or recent VA background investigation and identity credential.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Clearance:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Public Trust background investigation and VA identity credential.

Location:

  • Remote within the United States, subject to VA approval. Occasional travel within the continental United States may be required.

Pay Range:

  • The suggested pay for this position ranges from $59,000 to $105,000 annually.
  • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Join the largest delivery-first restaurant group in the United States!

Who we are:
At Salted, we're leading the charge to build the next generation of the restaurant industry. We focus on making better-for-you cuisine accessible while offering clean-label, plant-driven, and most importantly – delicious food. Join us in shaping the future of the restaurant industry and be part of our innovative culinary journey!

The Role:

This is a senior leadership role owning accounting, financial reporting, and compliance across a fast-growing, multi-state business. You'll fully own the accuracy and integrity of Salted's financial statements, partnering with the team to run day-to-day accounting while you lead reporting, validation, and analysis. You'll also oversee multi-state payroll, making sure our people are paid accurately and on time and that our wage, tax, and withholding practices stay compliant as we expand into new states.

You'll also serve as the company's compliance leader, staying ahead of regulatory obligations across every jurisdiction we operate in. This role suits someone who pairs technical accounting depth with strong operational judgment and the ability to build scalable systems as we grow. You'll be successful here if you bring precision, ownership, and a solution-focused approach to both the numbers and the people who rely on them.

Your Impact:

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, and fully own the reporting, validation, and analysis of Salted's financial statements
  • Deliver accurate, timely financial reporting and lead variance analysis, providing insight to leadership on business performance
  • Partner with our staff accountant to manage day-to-day accounting operations, including AP, AR, ASC 842, accruals, and reconciliations
  • Lead multi-state payroll, ensuring accurate wage calculations, tax withholdings, and compliance across 8+ states (CA, TX, FL, GA, CO, IL, NJ, VA, and more)
  • Oversee HRIS operations, including employee data integrity, onboarding and offboarding workflows, and org structure changes across integrated systems
  • Own the company's compliance function, ensuring nothing lapses across business licenses, health permits, food handler certifications, sales tax registrations, and other recurring regulatory obligations at every kitchen location
  • Manage payroll tax filings and registrations as we expand into new states
  • Oversee benefits enrollment, deductions, and reporting in partnership with HR
  • Identify inefficiencies and drive process improvements, scaling our accounting and compliance systems as we grow
  • Serve as a trusted resource for leadership, managers, and employees on accounting, payroll, and compliance matters
Skills & Experience:
  • 7+ years of experience in accounting, with progressive responsibility and time spent owning financial statements and close
  • CPA strongly preferred
  • Deep knowledge of GAAP and financial reporting, with hands-on experience across the full accounting cycle
  • Experience with multi-state payroll and regulatory compliance
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, with comfort building models and working with large datasets
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, since accounting errors, missed filings, and lapsed permits have real consequences
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities
  • Strong communicator who can explain accounting and compliance topics clearly to non-technical partners
  • Demonstrated leadership and ownership, with the ability to build and improve how work gets done
  • Degree in accounting, finance, or a related field

Salary: $140,000 - $175,000

Benefits:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • 401k with up to a 4% employer match after one year
  • Remote Work
  • Paid Parental Leave

Job Title: Recruitment & Operations Coordinator

Location: Remote – Latin America Preferred

Type of Contract: Full-Time | Remote

Salary Range: Market Rates

Language Requirements: Advanced English – Strong written and verbal communication skills

Our client is seeking a proactive and highly organized Recruitment & Operations Coordinator with approximately 3 years of recruitment or staffing experience to support their growing North American team. You will play a key role in recruitment coordination, onboarding, candidate submissions, and payroll administration while ensuring daily recruitment and operational workflows run smoothly. This position offers a long-term development opportunity, with the potential to take on broader responsibilities across recruitment and operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Recruitment Coordination: Support recruitment activities for business and non-IT functions, including finance, administration, medical, and nursing positions. Assist with candidate screening, recruitment coordination, and job posting management.
  • ATS & Recruitment Administration: Create and update job postings, maintain accurate job and candidate statuses, upload candidate documentation, monitor interview schedules, and coordinate placement end-date follow-ups.
  • Candidate Submissions: Prepare and submit candidates through VMS platforms such as Beeline and Bounty. Review and audit candidate submission information before forwarding profiles to clients.
  • Onboarding & Compliance: Monitor onboarding documentation, identify outstanding requirements, send reminders, initiate background checks through Certn, and coordinate candidate reference checks.
  • Payroll & Timesheet Administration: Follow up on timesheet submissions and approvals for approximately 50 temporary workers, manage weekly independent contractor invoices, and coordinate purchase order follow-ups with clients.
  • Administrative & Operational Support: Maintain recruitment spreadsheets, upload resumes to the recruitment mailbox, coordinate new-hire check-ins, and ensure accurate records across recruitment and operational systems.
  • Process Improvement & Client Support: Monitor administrative workflows, identify process gaps, support timesheet automation improvements, and gradually take on additional responsibilities involving IT recruitment and client communication.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Approximately 3 years of experience in recruitment, recruitment coordination, staffing, or a similar operational support role.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with candidates, colleagues, and clients.
  • Working knowledge of recruitment processes, including candidate screening, interview coordination, onboarding, and candidate submissions.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn and navigate multiple systems, including ATS/CRM platforms, spreadsheets, VMS platforms, and background-check tools.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to multitask, prioritize competing deadlines, and manage recurring administrative responsibilities.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through when handling candidate records, onboarding documentation, timesheets, and confidential information.
  • Proactive mindset, strong sense of urgency, curiosity, and the ability to anticipate needs, ask questions, identify outstanding tasks, and work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in agency recruitment or within the staffing industry.
  • Experience recruiting for business functions such as finance, administration, healthcare, or nursing.
  • Familiarity with IT recruitment and an interest in expanding into technical recruiting.
  • Experience with ATS/CRM systems, Beeline, Bounty, Certn, Microsoft Outlook, and Excel.
  • Previous exposure to payroll administration, timesheet management, contractor invoicing, and onboarding coordination.
  • Experience communicating with clients across multiple North American time zones.
  • Previous leadership, team coordination, or management experience.

Working Hours & Availability

  • Core working hours must overlap with Eastern Time business hours.
  • Potential schedules include 9:00 AM–5:30 PM ET or 10:00 AM–6:30 PM ET.
  • Some flexibility may be required to accommodate client needs across Eastern, Central, Mountain, and Pacific time zones.
  • A split-shift arrangement may be considered depending on workflow requirements and client submission deadlines.

Additional Role Considerations

  • This is a long-term opportunity with room for professional growth and increased responsibility.
  • The initial focus will be supporting business-function and non-IT recruitment, with potential expansion into IT recruitment and broader operational responsibilities.
  • The successful candidate must be comfortable balancing recruitment activities with administrative, onboarding, and payroll-related tasks.

jobs.excerpt: It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.  Our people are the foundation of our success.
jobs.description:
It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.

Job Summary


We are adding a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Analyst to our team. This is a remote position based in the US; sponsorship is not available for this role.


The primary responsibilities of this role include:

  • Directs the interpretation of protocols, budget documents, and Medicare coverage analysis into a structure within the clinical trial management system.
  • Ensures the structure provides the procedures that must be performed in the clinic and serves as the inventory of procedures to be priced in the budget and contracting function of the organization.
  • Works with the Research Protocol Educator and Budget Analyst to ensure the structure design is consistent with the protocol and budget requirements along with the procedures that will be performed in the clinic.
  • Responsible for structure set-up in the clinical trial management system involving corrections and updates.
  • Serves as the system expert to the clinical trial management system.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's Degree highly preferred; work experience may be substituted for education.
  • 3+ years' clinical research-related experience
  • 2 years' related work experience in protocol review, budget and/or MCA completion
  • A Research Certification such as ACRP or CCRP is highly preferred.


About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

Online Recruiting-related Scams


McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:


McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: .

When an applicant does not meet mandatory role qualifications or fails required prescreening questions, the system applies the corresponding disposition in accordance with those human-defined criteria.

jobs.description:
The Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist, reporting to the Call Center Quality Assurance (QA) Supervisor, will monitor the interviewing staff, checking both the accuracy of the responses keyed into the CATI system and providing feedback to interviewers on several performance measures, such as reading verbatim, respondent rapport, professional phone manner, keeping control of the interview, and refusal avoidance. Will provide QA support to project teams associated with performance based contracts primarily focused on the productivity, quality and delivery of service for ICF contracts supporting a variety of programs and clients.


Shift

The tasks below will provide this team the opportunity to work in a collaborative yet consistent manner in order to achieve a more productive and high quality work environment. Based on project needs, your schedule, or these duties, may change as necessary. It is important to emphasize that your new role as a QA Specialist requires you to be completely engaged with agents during monitoring and coaching sessions. As a QA Specialist you will also be responsible to send up any calls that require immediate corrective action to the QA Supervisor as well as the appropriate Manager and Shift Supervisor. You will also occasionally be required to immediately perform a live monitoring session upon request, conduct study specific trainings and refreshers, as well as host client monitoring sessions as needed.

What you will be doing - Shift tasks

  • Complete a minimum of 12 monitoring sessions
  • Coach a minimum of 12 monitoring sessions
  • Ensure all previously completed monitoring sessions are coached within 3 days
  • Ensure all information is updated in the QA database with completed work and file completed forms thus far
  • Other duties as assigned

Production and Protocol Responsibilities

Daily debrief with your supervisor to discuss any new updates and requirements for the day:

  • Monitor interviewers for all projects, or to the required SLA for each project.
  • Identify project monitoring goals for the day based on project complete percentages on previous day / weekly results.
  • Provide quality monitoring for the entire outbound survey research staff.
  • Use the QA reports to ensure all agents are being monitored per standards set by management.
  • Complete coaching sessions for each completed monitoring session. Coaching feedback should be presented as close to real time as possible.
  • Ensure all data collected is in accordance with falsification, confidentiality, and data quality policies.
  • Host client monitoring sessions as necessary.
  • Conduct live monitoring sessions on demand as requested by Management staff.
  • Perform project training classes as required

jobs.description:
Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Lifestyle

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

  • Contribute your talents to high-end, esteemed brands like JBL, Mark Levinson, Roon, Revel, Denon, and Bowers & Wilkins

  • Unite your passion for audio innovation with high-tech product development

  • Create pitch-perfect, cutting-edge technology that elevates the listening experience

About the Role

HARMAN's Software Experiences Business Unit (SEBU) builds software products that connect people to music. Our portfolio includes Roon, the leading music library management and playback platform for audiophiles, alongside new music products currently in development.

In this role you will help our product teams understand the people we build for. You will run competitive and user research across music discovery, streaming, and short-form content, sit inside the day-to-day work of a product team, and bring back the language, habits, and unmet needs of a younger audience in a form the team can act on.

This is a paid internship, and you will work as a member of the team rather than an observer. Length of the internship is dependent on when your new hire onboarding happens, but a typical program is 12-weeks. You will join standups and reviews, own your own research threads, and present what you learn directly to the people making product decisions.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Work as an embedded member of the team: join standups, design and product marketing discussions and product reviews, and contribute ideas as a working member of the group.

  • Track and analyze competitors and adjacent products to identify feature gaps, emerging trends, and unmet needs in the category.

  • Maintain a competitive tracker the team can use week-to-week, covering feature releases, notable launches, and shifts in how competitors position themselves.

  • Recruit and interview users in the 16 to 25 age range, with support from the product and marketing teams, to surface authentic language, listening habits, and unmet needs around music discovery and sharing.

  • Support structured usability and concept testing on new features and prototypes: help run sessions, capture qualitative and quantitative feedback, and turn it into concrete recommendations the team can act on within a development sprint.

  • Investigate how the target audience responds to curation and algorithmic recommendation, and feed what you find into feed and curation discussions.

  • Study visual and interaction trends across music, social, and related apps, and share what you find so our product and design teams stay current with what feels credible to a Gen Z audience.

  • Listen to public conversation about products in our category across Reddit, Discord, TikTok comments, and app store reviews, and flag the themes worth the team’s attention.

  • Support user feedback programs alongside the community and R&D teams: help draft survey questions, track incoming feedback and bug reports, and keep a running log of recurring themes.

  • Keep the research repository usable: tag and organize interview notes, clips, and findings so the team can still find them after the internship ends.

  • Summarize findings regularly into short internal documents the team can act on week to week, and deliver a final write-up and presentation pulling together the full 12 weeks of insight.

  • Own one self-directed project: define a question about the product with your manager, run the research, and present your recommendation to the team.

What Makes You A Strong Fit

  • Must be currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program or higher at an accredited institution having completed your Sophomore year or later, taking at least one class in the semester/quarter before participation in the internship program, and returning to school for at least one semester upon completion of the internship program

  • Must have a cumulative 3.0 GPA

  • Preferred degree program in business, marketing, design, human-computer interaction, communications, music business, or a related field.

  • Genuine curiosity about consumer products and how people find, share, and talk about music.

  • Strong written communication: able to turn messy notes into a short, clear document that someone else can act on without a walkthrough.

  • Comfort talking to people you do not know, running an interview, and asking the follow-up question rather than accepting the first answer.

  • Organized and self-directed, able to manage several research threads at once with light supervision in a remote environment.

  • Comfortable working with survey results and simple data sets, and willing to report what the findings actually show, including when they are inconvenient.

  • Hands-on familiarity, as a user, with the platforms where music culture happens, including TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Reddit, and the major streaming services.

  • Discretion with confidential product, partner, and roadmap information.

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Prior internship, coursework, or project experience in user research, product management, marketing, or design.

  • Practical exposure to research methods such as interviews, surveys, or usability testing.

  • Experience building an audience or creating content on a social platform, or moderating an online community.

  • Working knowledge of tools such as Figma, Notion, and survey or analytics platforms.

  • Fluency with AI tools and a habit of using them to work faster and better: synthesizing interview notes, drafting research summaries, and speeding up desk research.

  • A personal stake in music: musician, DJ, playlist curator, writer, or active participant in a scene.

Things To Know

  • This role allows for remote work and a candidate can be located anywhere in the United States.

  • This position allows for up to 20 hours per week, constituting a Part-Time Internship. Flexibility for more working hours is at the discretion and ability of the business unit.

  • Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment (post-offer).

What You Can Expect

  • Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)

  • Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs

  • Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well-being

  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

Freshman: $19.00

Sophomore: $21.00

Junior: $23.00

Senior: $24.00

Master: $28.00

Dependent on the internship offered, pay is based on factors, including without limitation, the applicant's level of education and business need.

Weight % - Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results


30%: Manage and maintain the Okta Identity Cloud environment, including user lifecycle management, application integrations, and security policies.


30%: Design, develop, and deploy complex Okta Workflows to automate various identity and access management tasks (e.g., user provisioning, de-provisioning, group management, password resets, multi-factor authentication).
Continuously analyze and optimize existing Okta automations for efficiency, reliability, and scalability. Integrate Okta with other systems and applications using Okta APIs and connectors.


10%: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for Okta automations and processes.


10%: Provide support and troubleshooting for Okta-related issues, including workflow failures, user access problems, and integration errors.


20%: Adhere to security best practices and industry standards in the design and implementation of Okta automations. Keep up-to-date with the latest Okta features, updates, and best practices. Ensure the Okta data is backed and readily available for restorations in emergencies Foster close collaboration with application owners and teams to ensure seamless integration.

5+ years of industry experience in Identity and Access Management.

Description

As a Senior AI Engineer you will design, build and run the Python LLM services behind Bridgewise's conversational AI — a system of 20+ microservices. You own features end to end, from architecture to production delivery and monitoring, and turn LLMs and NLP models into reliable, scalable, cost-aware software.


Responsibilities

  • LLM services: design and build scalable Python microservices with LLMs at their core; own features from design to deployment and monitoring; write clean, tested code and review others' code.
  • LLM integration & reliability: prompt management, structured outputs, tool use and agent workflows; model routing, fallbacks, retries, caching, streaming and rate-limit handling; RAG infrastructure (ingestion, embeddings, vector search).
  • Model serving: deploy BERT-based and other NLP models with the Data Science team; optimize inference latency, throughput and cost (batching, quantization, instance choice).
  • Evaluation & observability: automated evaluation and regression tests for prompt/model changes; tracing, logging and monitoring of LLM quality, latency and cost across services.
  • Event-driven data: Kafka pipelines (consumer groups, offsets, dead-letter queues, schema evolution); NoSQL modelling (Couchbase, Redis, Elasticsearch) and vector search; secure, versioned REST APIs.
  • Cloud & cost: run services on AWS (EC2, EKS, Lambda, S3) and Kubernetes with DevOps; track and cut per-service cost, including LLM API usage and GPU instances.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • 6+ years of hands-on software development, including 2+ years building LLM-powered applications in production
  • Expert Python, OOP and software engineering fundamentals
  • Production LLM API integration: prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool use, agent workflows
  • LLM evaluation and monitoring of quality, latency and cost in production
  • Apache Kafka: topic design, consumer groups, offset management, reliability patterns
  • NoSQL databases (Couchbase, Redis, Elasticsearch or similar)
  • Docker and Kubernetes deployments; strong AWS experience
  • Distributed-system resilience (circuit breakers, retries, rate limiting, dead-letter queues) and the architecture skills to design and evolve scalable systems
  • Daily, proficient use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code or similar)
  • Takes features from requirements to production independently; strong team player
  • Upper-Intermediate English or higher (spoken and written)
  • BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field


Nice to have:

  • RAG, vector databases and semantic search
  • Serving and optimizing NLP / deep-learning models in production (PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers)
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar
  • Financial markets / fintech / trading domain knowledge
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  • Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Langfuse, LangSmith
  • Application security: OWASP Top 10, secrets management, JWT/OAuth2, prompt-injection protection

  • 5+ years writing production SQL (T-SQL / SQL Server preferred): stored procedures, views, functions, indexing and query tuning

Nice to have

  • Power BI or SSRS report development
  • Salesforce administration or development experience
  • Git, CI/CD for database deployments
  • Project management certification (PMP or similar)

Why join

You'll build the data platform from the ground up and own it, with direct visibility to Finance leadership and a clear impact on how the firm closes its books.

Nalco Water, an Ecolab Company, is seeking an Industry Technical Consultant for pre-commissioning of closed-loop systems, including TCS (Technology Cooling System) loops. This role supports our local field and corporate accounts teams with project scoping, planning, and hands-on technical consulting for our customers. Our Industry Technical Consultants support business growth, drive innovation, and transfer technical knowledge to help customers improve reliability, efficiency, and sustainability. If you enjoy solving complex technical problems, supporting field teams, and helping customers bring new cooling systems safely into service, we invite you to apply.

As an Industry Technical Consultant, you will provide practical technical leadership on customer projects, from early scoping through to system handover. You will define and plan pre-commissioning activities for open- and closed-loop cooling systems, including TCS loops, and provide consulting for on-site work such as flushing, cleaning, passivation, filling, and initial fluid conditioning. The role requires the ability to connect mechanical systems knowledge, water chemistry, materials compatibility, and heat transfer performance, while translating that expertise into clear recommendations for customers, field sales teams, account managers, and engineering stakeholders.

Key Expertise Required:

  • Pre-commissioning of closed loops, including mechanical completion checks, pressure testing, flushing and cleaning, passivation, filling, and fluid quality verification prior to handover
  • Mechanical systems knowledge, including piping, pumps, heat exchangers, valves, and filtration, and the impact of materials, flow, temperature, and operating conditions on system cleanliness, reliability, and efficiency
  • Hands-on industry experience with both open- and closed-loop cooling processes, including cooling towers, chilled water, and secondary or process cooling loops
  • TCS and direct-to-chip liquid cooling, including cold plates, cooling distribution units, secondary loops, fluid quality requirements, and interfaces with wider facility infrastructure
  • Closed-loop chemistry and heat transfer fluids, including water, glycol blends, and inhibited formulations, with an understanding of corrosion control, microbiological risk, and monitoring requirements during commissioning and start-up

What’s in it For You:

  • The opportunity to take on some of the world’s most meaningful challenges, helping customers achieve their sustainability goals
  • The ability to make an impact with a company that is passionate about your career development
  • A flexible, independent work environment

What You Will Do:

  • Support local field teams and corporate account teams with the scoping and planning of closed-loop pre-commissioning projects, including defining scope of work, sequence of activities, resources, and timelines.
  • Provide on-site supervision and technical consulting during the pre-commissioning of closed-loop systems, including TCS loops, ensuring work is carried out safely and to specification.
  • Work closely with customers, contractors, and engineering teams to understand system design and requirements, recommend suitable pre-commissioning procedures and treatment solutions, and provide training and support to ensure proper operation of implemented systems.
  • Lead problem-solving efforts using root cause analysis methodologies to resolve commissioning, application, or best practice concerns at customer sites.
  • Prepare documented pre-commissioning plans, method statements, and reports that record results, findings, and recommendations for ongoing operation.
  • Collaborate with field sales and corporate account teams to support industry-specific or strategic technical sales opportunities.

  • Facilitate training for associates and customers, sharing your specialized knowledge to foster skill development and proficiency.
  • Coach individuals in the organization on processes, applications, technologies, and commissioning best practice.

Position Details:

  • This position is remote (UK or EU based) and will support customers across Europe.
  • 50% or more overnight travel is required
  • Includes benefits package and company car

Your profile:

  • Demonstrable technical expertise in the pre-commissioning or commissioning of closed-loop systems, mechanical systems, process engineering, HVAC, industrial cooling, or data center infrastructure
  • Hands-on industry experience in both open- and closed-loop cooling processes
  • Ability to apply core mechanical and technical principles across piping systems, equipment, materials compatibility, fluid selection, heat transfer, and water chemistry
  • Ability to scope, plan, and supervise project work on site, coordinating with contractors and customers to deliver to schedule and specification
  • Inquisitive mind, challenging the status quo and embracing disruptive technologies
  • Excellent communicator, able to consult, coach and mentor both internal stakeholders and customers alike
  • Value mindset with a focus on delivering measurable savings and impact to our customers
  • Solution-oriented, problem-solving mindset to complex challenges
  • Willing and able to travel throughout Europe to customer sites

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Mechanical background preferred, e.g. a degree or technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related Engineering discipline
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in the pre-commissioning or commissioning of open- and closed-loop cooling systems, including TCS loops, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, data center infrastructure, or adjacent cooling and heat transfer applications
  • Experience supervising on-site technical work and supporting project scoping and planning
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and approach
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented professional with an ability to work with minimal direction.
  • Excellent team orientation, proactivity and sense of urgency in supporting business growth and market leadership through differentiated technology and expertise

Enterprise Management is a full-spectrum consulting and management firm specializing in back-office operations, financial infrastructure, and executive oversight for health and human services organizations. We provide strategic support to affiliated companies through contractual partnerships, optimizing operations and maintaining compliance across multiple industries including behavioral health, primary care, real estate, supportive housing, and food service.

  • Support internal productivity and time-tracking platforms by managing user access, assisting with basic troubleshooting, and generating reports
