What We Do at Anno.ai

Anno.ai is a mission-focused defense technology startup dedicated to accelerating the safe and effective development of next-generation autonomous systems. We specialize in building and operating advanced test ranges for low Technology Readiness Level (TRL) single- or dual- use autonomous platforms, providing a critical bridge between early-stage innovation and real-world mission requirements.

Our ranges are designed to replicate complex, contested, and dynamic environments—giving innovators, researchers, and defense partners the ability to validate, stress-test, and mature their systems with speed and rigor. By combining deep technical expertise with a strong national security ethos, Anno.ai ensures that emerging autonomous technologies are tested not only for performance, but for resilience, adaptability, and operational relevance.

Anno.ai is a growing company with a team drawn from diverse professional backgrounds, bringing together expertise in defense, technology, engineering, and operations. We intentionally build our teams on the foundation of trust. Our values including the trust rule, ownership, bias for action, never stop learning, and sustainable excellence, not only guide how we work internally, but also how we partner with customers and stakeholders.

At Anno.ai, we believe that mission success depends on empowering innovation at the edge. We exist to help our partners move faster, fail smarter, and ultimately deliver autonomous capabilities that safeguard both national security and the future of global stability.

Position Overview

As a Federal Contracts & Business Development Manager, you will manage federal contract administration and coordinate acquisition, capture, and business development activities that advance Anno.Ai’s mission in the defense and national security market.

This position requires 5–10 years of relevant professional experience and is ideal for a mid-career professional who understands the Department of Defense (DoD) environment and can take ownership of contract actions, proposal coordination, and customer engagement.

You will maintain contract records and obligations, evaluate federal opportunities, coordinate capture plans and proposals, and build productive customer and partner relationships. Working closely with company leadership, technical teams, and external stakeholders, you will translate requirements into practical actions that support compliant contracting and sustainable growth.

We're looking for someone who is resourceful, analytical, organized, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment. The ideal candidate brings practical experience navigating the defense ecosystem, strong communication skills, sound judgment, and a willingness to take initiative. You should enjoy solving complex problems, building relationships, and continuously learning.

The ideal candidate would reside in Minneapolis, MN. However, this position is remote, and candidates located anywhere within the Continental United States (CONUS) will be considered.

Candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship required) and travel up to 20% of the time.

What You’ll Do

Federal Contract Administration and Acquisition

  • Manage day-to-day administration of assigned federal contracts and subcontracts from award through closeout, maintaining accurate records, correspondence, and action trackers.
  • Track contract requirements, deliverables, funding, periods of performance, and reporting deadlines with technical and finance teams; flag risks and follow up on outstanding actions.
  • Coordinate contract reviews, modifications, and negotiation inputs with leadership and appropriate advisors; document approvals and elevate issues requiring authorized decisions.
  • Evaluate acquisition pathways, contract vehicles, and solicitation requirements; coordinate reviews of statements of work and related documents to align scope, pricing inputs, and commitments.

Capture and Proposal Coordination

  • Coordinate capture plans for assigned opportunities, documenting customer needs, competitive positioning, teaming options, win themes, and actions for leadership review.
  • Manage proposal calendars, compliance matrices, contributor assignments, and review cycles for requests for information (RFIs), requests for proposals (RFPs), and other solicitations.
  • Work with technical, operations, and finance teams to assemble clear, responsive proposal content, past performance examples, and pricing inputs; track gaps and resolve inconsistencies.
  • Coordinate final approvals and timely submissions, maintain proposal records, and capture lessons from customer feedback and debriefings to improve future pursuits.

Opportunity Pipeline and Business Development

  • Identify and qualify federal opportunities aligned with Anno.Ai’s technologies, test range capabilities, and strategic priorities.
  • Monitor government opportunity sources, agency plans, and industry activity to identify upcoming procurements and potential paths to market.
  • Research customer missions, funding outlooks, competitors, and partners to assess opportunity fit, timing, and the company’s ability to compete.
  • Maintain an accurate opportunity pipeline with stages, estimated values, expected award dates, owners, next steps, and supporting information.
  • Prepare opportunity assessments and bid/no-bid recommendations for leadership, considering strategic fit, resources, competitive position, and delivery commitments.
  • Provide regular pipeline updates and actionable growth recommendations; develop capability statements, customer presentations, and business development briefings.

Customer Engagement and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build and maintain relationships with government customers, contracting personnel, prime contractors, and industry partners to understand needs and develop opportunities.
  • Coordinate customer meetings, industry events, and partner discussions; document priorities, commitments, and follow-up actions while protecting sensitive information.
  • Collaborate with leadership and technical teams on teaming arrangements and customer solutions; coordinate agreement reviews and handoffs from capture to contract execution.
  • Take ownership of assigned contracting and growth activities, improve shared tools and processes, and adapt to changing priorities in a collaborative startup environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–10 years of relevant professional experience in federal contracting, acquisition, business development, capture, proposal coordination, or a related field. Equivalent military or government experience will be considered.
  • Working knowledge of federal acquisition processes, DoD customers, and contracting practices, including familiarity with the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS).
  • Practical experience administering contracts or supporting acquisition actions, reviewing requirements, maintaining documentation, and tracking obligations and deadlines.
  • Experience coordinating federal proposals or capture activities and supporting opportunity research, pipeline tracking, or customer and partner engagement.
  • Ability to independently research complex topics, analyze information, identify risks and opportunities, and develop practical recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing professional reports, presentations, briefings, proposals, or decision-support materials.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated initiative, problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities with appropriate guidance.
  • Ability to build effective working relationships and collaborate with technical, operational, business, and government stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn customer relationship management (CRM), proposal, and contract tracking tools.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive, proprietary, or mission-related information.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote, fast-moving, mission-focused team.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, including U.S. citizenship.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.

  • Paid leave programs

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱 RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support.
jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

ROLE OVERVIEW:

The Senior Manager of Manufacturing & Supply is a critical leadership hire responsible for owning the full production value chain — from co-manufacturer management and production execution through raw material sourcing and supplier relationships. This role is the production and sourcing engine of RYZE’s Operations function.

This role requires someone who will roll up their sleeves. RYZE is at a stage where the manufacturing function needs both strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The Senior Manager of Manufacturing & Supply must be comfortable operating at the co-man floor level while simultaneously building the systems, processes, and team that will scale to $1B.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

Responsibilities will include:


Co-Manufacturer Management

  • Own full accountability for all co-manufacturing partners, serving as the single point of ownership for output, quality, cost, and delivery
  • Lead onboarding and stabilization of new co-manufacturers, including recipe transfer, production validation, equipment installation, and ramp-up execution
  • Manage transitions away from legacy partners, ensuring zero disruption to supply continuity
  • Establish and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with each co-manufacturing partner in collaboration with Quality
  • Develop and implement performance scorecards tracking delivery, quality, cost, and responsiveness

Production Execution

  • Oversee production scheduling, capacity planning, and line allocation across all manufacturing sites in coordination with Supply Chain Planning
  • Ensure production commitments are met while proactively resolving constraints, bottlenecks, and line conflicts
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase yield, reduce waste, and optimize per-unit costs
  • Implement inventory buffer strategies for packaging and raw materials to stabilize operations and eliminate reactive supply issues

Sourcing & Procurement

  • Own sourcing, purchasing, and supplier management across all raw materials and inputs
  • Hire and lead sourcing leadership to manage day-to-day supplier relationships, negotiations, and vendor onboarding
  • Define and execute a supplier diversification strategy to mitigate single-source risk
  • Lead supplier negotiations, contract management, and cost optimization at scale
  • Manage critical raw material supply challenges and ensure continuity of supply for key inputs

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team supporting production, supply, and sourcing operations
  • Provide coaching, performance management, and day-to-day leadership
  • Build and scale a high-performing, execution-focused team aligned to business growth

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Supply Chain Planning: Align on demand forecasts, production priorities, and inventory targets while providing feedback on constraints and lead times
  • Quality: Partner on audits, inspections, batch release processes, and QBRs while maintaining a collaborative relationship within an independent governance structure
  • New Product Introduction (NPI): Support production readiness for new SKUs, including trials, validation, and commercialization ramp-up
  • R&D / Innovation: Collaborate on formulation feasibility, pilot runs, and scale-up of new products

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS


  • 5–8+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain, including 2–4+ years in a management or supervisory role
  • Demonstrated experience managing day-to-day relationships with co-manufacturing partners, supporting output, quality, cost, and delivery goals
  • Hands-on experience supporting the onboarding of new co-manufacturers, including recipe transfer, production validation, and ramp-up execution
  • Experience assisting with transitions between manufacturing partners while maintaining supply continuity
  • Proven ability to support raw material and packaging procurement, supplier coordination, and commercial negotiations
  • Experience managing and mentoring direct reports across production, supply, and sourcing operations
  • Strong command of production scheduling, capacity planning, and line allocation across multiple sites
  • Proven ability to drive continuous improvement that increases yield, reduces waste, and lowers per-unit costs
  • Experience developing supplier diversification strategies and mitigating single-source risk
  • Ability to design inventory buffer strategies for raw materials and packaging that prevent reactive supply issues
  • Working knowledge of food safety and quality systems, including audits, inspections, and batch release (e.g., GMP, HACCP, SQF/BRC)
  • Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, budgeting, and negotiation of commercial terms

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT AGELESSRX Our mission is radical life extension.
jobs.description:
ABOUT AGELESSRX
Our mission is radical life extension. We’re here to beat death.

At AgelessRx, we’re building the infrastructure to accelerate breakthroughs in longevity and fundamentally change how people approach their health. At the center is a profitable, high-eight-figure telehealth business serving tens of thousands of paying members who want to improve their energy, sleep, strength, hormonal health, and overall quality of life.

We’re building something much bigger than a telehealth company. By helping people achieve their health goals, we’re also creating something researchers rarely have access to: real-world data from people using real interventions, tracked over time, with opportunities to participate in future clinical research.

We’ve intentionally built capabilities that many companies outsource, including our own decentralized clinical trial platform, an in-house clinical network, and an AI-native technology stack. Our research includes PEARL, a clinical trial studying rapamycin, and we’ve been recognized as an XPRIZE Healthspan finalist.

We think big. Growing from eight to nine figures in revenue is an important milestone, but it’s not the end goal. We believe healthcare will look fundamentally different in five years, and we intend to help drive that transformation.

We keep our team small by design. We look for people who take ownership, move quickly, embrace AI, pay attention to the details, and aren’t afraid to tackle difficult problems. You’ll have the autonomy, tools, and opportunity to make a meaningful impact without layers of bureaucracy. We’re building a team of people who want to do the work, not just oversee it.

OVERVIEW

We're looking for a hands-on Head of Growth to lead and scale our growth engine across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You'll own growth performance, bringing together paid media, lifecycle marketing, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and analytics to drive sustainable revenue growth and improve customer acquisition economics.

This is a role for someone who knows how to build strategy but is equally comfortable getting into the details. You'll set priorities, challenge assumptions, evaluate performance, and work directly with channel owners and agency partners to turn insights into action. When something isn't working, you'll know how to diagnose the problem and drive a solution.

We're not looking for someone who simply manages a team or oversees an agency. We want a growth leader who has personally built, tested, and optimized acquisition channels, understands the economics behind scaling a DTC business, and can create the systems and accountability needed to deliver results.

You'll work closely with our growth PM, lifecycle team, analyst, and agency partners across Google, Meta, and affiliates, leveraging our AI-native platform to rapidly build, test, and optimize customer experiences.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Revenue Growth: Drive growth across new customer acquisition, retention, and revenue per customer, targeting 3%+ month-over-month growth in monthly cash collected.
  • Growth Economics: Own CAC, LTV, payback periods, and marginal ROI, ensuring investments are allocated toward the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Customer Funnel Performance: Optimize the end-to-end customer journey, including offers, pricing, landing pages, checkout, post-purchase cross-sell, and retention.
  • Channel Strategy & Investment: Set channel-level performance targets, manage growth budget allocation, and identify opportunities to test and scale new acquisition channels.
  • Experimentation: Build and lead a high-velocity testing program across channels, customer segments, offers, messaging, and conversion funnels.
  • New Product Growth: Develop and execute GTM business cases for new products, audiences and channels, including opportunity sizing, financial scenarios, positioning, channel strategy, resourcing, launch execution and performance evaluation.
  • Growth Operations: Establish the systems, reporting, and operating rhythms that keep growth teams and partners aligned, accountable, and focused on measurable outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Growth Strategy & Performance

  • Develop and execute a growth strategy that connects acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue expansion.
  • Establish growth priorities, performance targets, budget guardrails, and clear expectations for CAC, LTV, payback, and ROI.
  • Evaluate channel performance and make informed decisions about where to invest, optimize, scale, or pull back.
  • Identify and test new growth opportunities across channels, partnerships, customer segments, and products.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting, growth models, budget allocation, and investment decisions.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights, recommendations, and business implications for leadership.

Hands-On Channel & Funnel Optimization

  • Work directly with channel owners, growth PMs, and agency partners to establish weekly priorities and drive execution.
  • Regularly audit paid media accounts and growth channels, including account structure, bidding strategies, attribution, reporting, and optimization practices.
  • Investigate performance changes, challenge assumptions, and identify opportunities to improve channel efficiency and conversion.
  • Bring forward and execute new growth initiatives rather than relying solely on ideas generated by agencies or team members.
  • Optimize the customer journey from acquisition through eligibility, checkout, onboarding, renewal, winback and cross-sell, measuring how funnel improvements affect conversion, retention and customer economics.
  • Ensure consistent positioning, messaging, and value propositions throughout the customer journey.

Experimentation, Analytics & Growth Economics

  • Own the growth experimentation roadmap, prioritizing tests based on potential revenue impact and business value.
  • Partner with the growth PM and cross-functional teams to execute experiments across offers, pricing, messaging, customer segments, and conversion funnels.
  • Establish clear hypotheses, success metrics, measurement approaches, and decision criteria for major experiments.
  • Reconcile platform attribution, first-party conversion data, MMM/MTA and incrementality tests to establish reliable performance measures and guide channel investment, experimentation and scaling decisions.
  • Use performance insights to continuously improve acquisition efficiency, conversion, retention, and customer lifetime value.

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Lead growth as an integrated function, aligning paid media, lifecycle, CRO, analytics, and agency partners around shared goals.
  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm through weekly priorities, performance reviews, experimentation updates, and clear accountability.
  • Hold internal teams, agencies, and vendors accountable for execution, performance, and results.
  • Identify and remove blockers, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and improve how growth initiatives move from idea to execution.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Brand, Content, Clinical, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to support growth initiatives.
  • Coach and develop team members, strengthen team performance, and help build the growth organization as business needs evolve.
  • Foster a high-ownership, analytical, AI-native culture focused on continuous improvement and measurable outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated success driving revenue growth and scaling customer acquisition in a high-growth, consumer-focused business.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with paid acquisition, particularly Google and Meta, including the ability to audit accounts, diagnose performance issues, and guide optimization decisions.
  • Strong understanding of growth economics, including CAC, LTV, payback periods, marginal ROI, and budget allocation.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities, lean teams, and limited bureaucracy.

jobs.title: Director, Field Enablement & Capabilities
jobs.excerpt: The Role Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine.
jobs.description:
The Role

Joining Moderna means advancing mRNA science to transform medicine. Work with exceptional global teams on a broad pipeline and build a career that makes a real difference for patients.

Moderna’s U.S. Infectious Disease business is entering an exciting new phase of growth, with an expanding portfolio and an opportunity to transform how our field teams engage customers. As we evolve from product-focused selling to strategic, portfolio-based customer engagement, you will shape the capabilities, tools, and learning experiences that enable our U.S. Account Management organization to succeed in an increasingly complex and competitive healthcare environment.

In this highly hands-on individual contributor role, you will own the strategy and execution of U.S. field enablement, translating commercial priorities into impactful training, product readiness, coaching, communications, and measurable capability development. Reporting to the Vice President of US Marketing, Infectious Disease, with a dotted-line relationship to the Head of Enterprise Talent and Capability, you will work closely with Account Management leadership, cross-functional partners, training operations, and external vendors to build a scalable, future-ready field organization.

Here's What You'll Do

Shape the future of field enablement and commercial capability development

  • Own and execute an integrated, scalable U.S. field enablement strategy and capability development roadmap, aligning learning priorities with commercial strategy, portfolio evolution, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and upcoming product launches.
  • Translate business priorities into practical learning experiences, field tools, coaching approaches, and coordinated communications that enable consistent, high-quality execution across the Account Management organization.
  • Strengthen field capabilities across strategic account planning, portfolio-based selling, customer engagement, competitive selling, and healthcare ecosystem navigation, supporting the transition from product-focused interactions to broader, customer-centric portfolio discussions.
  • Partner with Account Management leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to integrate capability development into broader commercial priorities, ensuring the field understands evolving expectations, available resources, and ways of working.
  • Leverage field feedback, leadership insights, capability assessments, learner data, and commercial performance indicators to identify development gaps, measure effectiveness, and continuously refine enablement investments.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Talent and Capability to leverage existing learning programs, platforms, and resources, creating a consistent, coordinated learner experience across Moderna.

Drive product knowledge, launch readiness, and field certification

  • Lead the product knowledge training strategy and establish readiness standards for both new hires and experienced Account Managers, ensuring alignment with the broader field enablement roadmap.
  • Define audience- and role-specific learning requirements across onboarding, product launches, label changes, product updates, annual refreshers, and field certification or readiness assessments, as appropriate.
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Medical, Regulatory, Legal, and Compliance to ensure product training is scientifically accurate, current, compliant, aligned with approved content, and responsive to evolving commercial priorities.
  • Build structured learning pathways that equip Account Managers with the product knowledge, competitive understanding, and portfolio expertise required to engage customers confidently and effectively.

Own learning design, content strategy, and capability deployment

  • Serve as the primary U.S. owner of field enablement curriculum, content, and readiness, defining learning objectives, designing curricula, developing or overseeing training materials, and managing external learning vendors as needed.
  • Own and continuously optimize the overall learning portfolio, ensuring training programs, curricula, individual modules, and standalone learning resources are structured, accessible, and aligned with specific business needs and target audiences.
  • Establish clear relationships between learning programs, curriculum pathways, and training requirements, providing stakeholders with direction on where new or updated content belongs and how existing learning opportunities can be leveraged.
  • Act as the central point of contact for cross-functional learning requests, gathering content updates, maintaining visibility into ongoing initiatives, and ensuring learning investments are coordinated rather than duplicated.
  • Partner with training operations to ensure effective execution of LMS administration, learning assignments and tracking, scheduling, curriculum maintenance, certification records, and related operational activities, while retaining strategic ownership of learning design and field readiness.
  • Apply adult learning theory, behavioral science, and skills-based development principles to create engaging blended learning experiences, incorporating digital learning platforms, interactive practice, and practical reinforcement approaches.
  • Explore opportunities to leverage Generative AI and emerging digital learning technologies to enhance content development, personalize learning experiences, accelerate knowledge access, and strengthen field capability development, within Moderna's approved technology and compliance frameworks.
  • Collaborate with Account Management leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver impactful training, skills-practice workshops, and capability-building sessions at national sales meetings and other major commercial meetings.

Elevate commercial selling effectiveness and leadership coaching

  • Develop practical, skills-based programs that strengthen consultative selling, strategic account planning, effective questioning, objection handling, negotiation, competitive differentiation, and messaging effectiveness during customer engagements.
  • Build capabilities that enable Account Managers to navigate increasingly complex healthcare ecosystems, understand customer priorities, and communicate the value of Moderna's expanding infectious disease portfolio.
  • Equip Account Management leaders with actionable coaching tools, structured reinforcement approaches, and field performance insights to embed new skills, sustain learning adoption, and drive measurable behavior change.
  • Partner with field leadership to connect training investments to day-to-day execution, reinforcing consistent customer engagement practices and continuous commercial capability improvement.

Enable digital tools, analytics, and data-driven field execution

  • Collaborate with Commercial Operations, Analytics, and relevant business partners to strengthen field proficiency in CRM systems, customer targeting and profiling, data literacy, and other commercial execution resources.
  • Enable Account Managers to translate customer insights, account data, and available commercial intelligence into more effective account planning, prioritization, and customer engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to incorporate digital innovation, including appropriate Generative AI-enabled tools, into learning experiences and field workflows to improve knowledge accessibility, productivity, and execution effectiveness.

Champion compliant, high-quality field enablement

  • Ensure all learning content, field resources, communications, and enablement activities adhere to Moderna policies and applicable healthcare laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.
  • Maintain strong partnerships with Medical, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, and other relevant stakeholders to support appropriate content review, approval, and deployment.
  • Balance strategic ownership with hands-on execution, leveraging training operations and external vendors for administration, deployment, and delivery while maintaining accountability for the quality, consistency, and business impact of U.S. field enablement.

The key Moderna Mindsets you’ll need to succeed in the role:

  • “We act with dynamic range, driving strategy and execution at the same time at every step.” You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on ownership, translating an evolving U.S. commercial strategy into practical field capabilities, relevant learning experiences, and measurable improvements in execution.
  • “We obsess over learning. We don’t have to be the smartest we have to learn the fastest.” You will foster a culture of continuous learning, using field insights, learner feedback, emerging technologies, and performance data to rapidly evolve capabilities and help our Account Management organization stay ahead of changing customer expectations and competitive dynamics.

Here's What You'll Need (Basic Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sales enablement, commercial training, sales leadership, strategic account management, commercial excellence, or a related commercial function within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines or healthcare
  • Demonstrated experience translating business strategy into field training, capability development, and practical execution tools.
  • Experience developing commercial and/or product training for field-based teams.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and project management skills, with the ability to drive work independently in a matrixed environment.
  • Experience managing external vendors or training partners.

Here's What You'll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience in vaccines, infectious disease
  • Strong understanding of strategic account management and consultative selling, including stakeholder mapping, account planning, competitive selling, negotiation, and customer influence.
  • Experience designing product and commercial training curricula, onboarding programs, readiness standards, and continuous learning approaches.
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning and behavior-change principles.
  • Experience supporting major launches, new-category entry, or significant commercial transformation.
  • Ability to translate complex scientific, commercial, and customer information into clear, practical field learning.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively as a hands-on individual contributor, prioritize across multiple competing needs, and deliver with limited dedicated resources.
  • Willingness to travel nationally based on field and business needs.

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work. That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

  • Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
  • A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
  • Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
  • Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
  • Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
  • Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $167,000.00 - $300,700.00(for positions that may be performed in California, the expected salary range is $234,825.00 - $270,175.00, which reflects the range permitted under California Labor Code requirements) . This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.


By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

Our client is building the software that hearing clinics run on patient records, bookings, hearing tests and sales. Clinic chains and hospitals use it every day. You join the team that owns the Sales domain: quote, invoice, insurance claim and payment. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who ships business outcomes, not just tickets. You own features end to end - from why a clinic needs them, through design and build, to checking in production that they worked. AI coding agents are a normal part of every step of your work.

Tech environment:C# / .NET 8.0, Azure Services (Azure SQL, AI Search, Service Bus, App Insights, Data Factory), Entity Framework Core, Docker, Kubernetes, MassTransit, React with TypeScript, plus growing use of Python for AI tooling and experimentation.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

  • Design, build and run full-stack features in the Sales domain: .NET services, event-driven integrations and React front end.

  • Work with the Product Owner and QA from discovery onwards. Shape the spec and agree acceptance criteria before code is written.

  • Find the gaps in a spec before you build. Close the small ones yourself and bring only business questions to the Product Owner.

  • Use AI tools across the whole lifecycle: planning, design, build, testing, review and maintenance. Keep the human judgement on correctness, security and data protection.

  • Own quality: unit and integration tests, code review, and non-functional requirements (performance, security, observability) as part of the design.

  • Follow features into production: watch telemetry and usage, support releases, investigate incidents and close the loop with the product team.

  • Contribute to architecture discussions and decision records with the Tech Lead and architects and help pay down tech debt in the sales flows.

  • Make the team better at AI: mentor engineers and share the instructions, checks and small tools that work.

  • Product Mindset

    As AI takes on more of the typing, the value of an engineer moves to judgement: knowing what to build, why, and what good looks like for the user. In this role you:

    • Start every feature with the business question: who in the clinic uses it, and what problem it solves for them.

    • Push back with alternatives when a request is expensive and a simpler solution gives most of the value.

    • Explain technical trade-offs in business terms to Product Owners, delivery and customer-facing colleagues.

    • Look at usage, support tickets and customer feedback after release, and feed what you learn into the next iteration.

IF YOU ARE

  • Typically 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building and running production systems. We value practical experience and demonstrated capabilities over years alone.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C# and modern .NET, including:

    • ASP.NET Core and Web APIs.

    • Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.

    • Clean Architecture and maintainable application design.

  • Solid frontend development experience using React and TypeScript, particularly for complex business applications.

  • Practical experience designing and developing microservices architectures.

  • Understanding of asynchronous communication and event-driven systems, ideally using:

    • Azure Service Bus.

    • MassTransit.

    • Similar messaging and event-processing technologies.

  • Strong SQL database experience, including relational data modelling and transactional business data.

  • Experience with API design, automated testing, debugging, and security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of everyday development, such as:

    • Ability to demonstrate practical AI-assisted development workflows, including examples of reviewing AI-generated code, identifying mistakes, and understanding when AI should not be used.

    • Strong product mindset, with examples of contributing to feature definition, understanding business needs, and influencing technical and product decisions.

    • Good command of English (B2 or above), both written and spoken.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Python for AI tooling, evaluations and prototypes.

  • Features built on LLM APIs: prompting, tool use, and measuring the quality of the results.

  • Experience in regulated domains (medical devices, healthcare, finance) or with sensitive personal data.

  • AKS / Kubernetes.

  • You have built or improved developer tooling, CI/CD or AI agent setups that other engineers use.

AS AN OPINOV8R, YOU WILL HAVE

  • Digital-First Approach:Great talent knows no borders! You can work from wherever you are — we hire and collaborate with professionals worldwide.

  • Remote Work Model:Balance your professional and personal life with our flexible working conditions, empowering you to deliver your best from anywhere.

  • Exciting Projects:Dive into impactful projects across industries that challenge and spark creativity.

  • Boost Your Expertise:Grow your career with continuous learning, development opportunities, and hands-on experience.

HOW’S THE HIRING PROCESS GOING

jobs.description:
Location: 100% remote (EMEA + South America)

Classification: Full-time

Pay Range: €82,000–140,000; determined by several factors, including location

Miaplaza is looking for two Engineering Managers to lead two of our software development teams. We’re hiring for one existing team of 7 engineers and one new team that we will hire developers into.

This is a management role for someone who wants to grow as a manager while still remaining hands-on with code. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading your team and doing hands-on work alongside them.

About Miaplaza

Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations!

What you’ll work on

We’re a C# and platform growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both product and engineering initiatives. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50/50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers.

How management works at Miaplaza

We're a US-based company, so this may differ from what you've done before:

  1. You start as an engineer. You’ll onboard as a senior engineer on your own team for two months, begin manager onboarding in month two, and take over the team at around week 10. Both phases matter equally, and this isn’t negotiable.

  2. You stay hands-on. Around 50% of your time stays hands-on after onboarding, but leading and supporting your engineers always comes first.

  3. You teach. Growing your engineers and those around you is a core responsibility. You'll have full oversight of your direct reports' work, because you can't teach well without seeing the process behind the output.

  4. Feedback is the norm. You'll give specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something, and you'll receive it too.

Requirements

What you must bring

We can only move forward with candidates who meet these requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in software development in one or more object-oriented programming languages

  • 3+ years of experience with front-end software development in a reactive front-end framework

  • 3+ years of experience with software architecture

  • 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level

  • 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader

  • 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead

  • Experience working directly with product and design on scoping and prioritization

  • Experience being on-call and resolving production incidents

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

What makes you stand out

  • Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration

  • Experience with consumer platforms at scale

  • Experience building in regulated environments

  • Experience with DevOps technologies (eg K8s, IaC, sysadmin, build pipelines, etc.)

  • Extensive senior front-end development experience

Responsibilities

  • Work with your teams to design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable web applications using primarily C# and Vue.js

  • Collaborate with your product trio (PM, UX, EM), product leadership team, and other EMs to scope, prioritize, and deliver features that matter to students and families

  • Set the quality bar for your team. You'll have dedicated capacity for reliability and architecture work rather than fitting it around feature delivery, and a strong say in where that capacity goes.

  • Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean architecture, soft skills, best practices, etc

  • Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, so our process is longer than usual. At every stage we try to respect your time.

  1. Application and CV review. We review your application answers and CV, then follow up with an update.

  2. Initial technical screen (20 min). A few administrative questions and short technical questions related to the role.

  3. Behavioral interview (1 hour). With a member of our HR team, about your experience and approach so far.

  4. 1st technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to answer technical questions tailored to our work.

  5. 2nd technical interview (1 hour). With a member of the engineering team to dive into a hypothetical scenario and how you’d tackle it.

  6. Leadership interview (1 hour). With our Head of Engineering or executive leadership.

  7. Reference check. We contact the 3 references you provide, including at least one former or current manager, a colleague, and a former or current direct report.

  8. Offer and background check. Once you sign your offer, we run a background check in accordance with applicable law.

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Our compensation philosophy aims for equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement in the range depends on demonstrated skills, internal equity and local labor market rates for your area.

Miaplaza is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

Application Developer - Security Engineering

PRIMARY PURPOSE

Designs, develops, and maintains applications, integrations, and automation that support enterprise security operations. Partners with Security Operations, IAM, Cloud Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture to turn detection and response requirements into working software. Builds and tunes content within the organization’s SIEM platform, develops data pipelines that feed it, and automates response workflows. Applies secure-by-default engineering practices, least privilege, and documented change control to everything delivered.


Essential Functions and Responsibilities


Application development

  • Develops, tests, and maintains applications, APIs, and services supporting security operations and compliance reporting.
  • Writes code that follows secure development standards, including input validation, output encoding, secrets management through an approved vault, and dependency scanning in the build pipeline.
  • Participates in peer code review, maintains unit and integration test coverage, and supports CI/CD pipelines for application and detection content releases.
  • Produces and maintains technical documentation, including design decisions, data flows, interface contracts, and runbooks with named ownership.

SIEM engineering and detection content

  • Builds, tests, and tunes SIEM detection rules, correlation searches, dashboards, and scheduled reports.
  • Develops and maintains log ingestion pipelines: source onboarding, parsing, field extraction, normalization to a common schema, and enrichment.
  • Troubleshoots ingestion gaps, parsing failures, licensing and volume issues, and data quality problems affecting detection reliability.
  • Manages detection content as code in version control, with documented test cases, promotion through non-production environments, and rollback procedures.
  • Maps detection coverage to a recognized framework such as MITRE ATT&CK and reports coverage gaps to Security leadership.

Automation and integration

  • Develops integrations between the SIEM and adjacent platforms, including EDR, identity, ticketing, vulnerability management, and cloud-native security services.
  • Builds SOAR playbooks and automation scripts that reduce manual analyst effort, with approval gates on any action that is destructive or privileged.
  • Instruments applications and infrastructure for security-relevant logging and validates that required audit events reach the SIEM.

Governance and collaboration

  • Works with Security, Cloud Engineering, IAM, and application teams to gather requirements and validate that delivered tooling meets operational need.
  • Supports audit and compliance evidence requests related to logging, monitoring, and alerting controls.
  • Follows enterprise change management for all production changes, including approvals, testing evidence, and defined back-out plans.
  • Participates in an on-call or escalation rotation for critical security tooling.

Qualifications

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Full Stack Engineer owns the NBA platform's orchestration and state machine — the system that carries a decision from the moment it is made to the moment it is activated, delivered, and acknowledged across member engagement channels. Built in Node.js/TypeScript on the Temporal workflow platform, the solution manages durable workflow execution, long-running member journeys, and reliable action delivery through Transactional Outbox and Kafka-based event patterns. This role owns the critical path between decision generation, activation, delivery, and receipt processing, ensuring actions are executed correctly, consistently, and at enterprise scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you write code, lead a small team of engineers and contractors, and are accountable end-to-end for the durability, correctness, observability, and timeliness of action delivery across the member journey.

Key Responsibilities


  • Pod delivery — Own end-to-end delivery for the orchestration pod: planning, execution, quality, and shipping on time.
  • Workflow orchestration — Design and build durable, long-running workflows on Temporal in Node.js/TypeScript that model the member action lifecycle, state transitions, scheduling, activation, and delivery outcomes.
  • Action delivery architecture — Own the end-to-end action delivery pipeline from decision publication through activation, delivery acknowledgment, and state reconciliation. Design and implement Transactional Outbox patterns, atomic persist-and-publish workflows, idempotency controls, retry/backoff mechanisms, dead-letter queue handling, and delivery receipt processing.
  • Activation integrations — Own the components that activate decisions to Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and publish through Kafka output patterns to downstream channels. Define delivery contracts, activation guarantees, and receipt ingestion patterns that ensure reliable action execution.
  • Hands-on development — Contribute code alongside the team, including Temporal workflows and activities, Node.js services, Kafka producers and consumers, outbox processors, and integration services.
  • Technical decisions — Make the day-to-day architecture decisions for the pod, including workflow design, state machine modeling, retry and compensation strategies, idempotency, topic strategy, schema evolution, delivery guarantees, and API contracts.
  • Distributed systems reliability — Engineer for correctness in a highly asynchronous environment. Ensure exactly-once business intent through idempotent consumers, deduplication strategies, durable state management, safe retries, and graceful failure handling.
  • Observability and operations — Establish monitoring, tracing, alerting, and operational visibility across workflow execution, event publication, activation processing, and delivery acknowledgment pipelines.
  • Team leadership — Manage and mentor engineers and contractors; run code reviews, uphold engineering standards, and keep the team unblocked and moving.
  • Cross-team coordination — Coordinate interfaces with decisioning, the Action Library, activation systems, and the platform team; surface dependencies, integration risks, and operational concerns early.


Use your skills to make an impact


Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or relevant area
  • 6+ years of full stack software engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years in a tech-lead or senior-lead capacity.
  • Strong Node.js/TypeScript backend experience building production services.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, with Temporal strongly preferred (or comparable technologies such as Cadence, Step Functions, or Airflow for durable workflows).
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Experience designing and implementing Kafka producer and consumer patterns in production environments.
  • Experience building reliable event delivery systems using Transactional Outbox, event-driven integration patterns, or comparable messaging architectures.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small pod through delivery and be accountable for technical outcomes.
  • Experience operating cloud-native systems on Azure or equivalent cloud infrastructure using Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Clear communicator who can represent the pod's architecture, delivery status, operational risks, and tradeoffs to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Production experience with Temporal at scale, including workflow versioning, long-running workflow management, and operational lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience implementing Transactional Outbox patterns, delivery acknowledgment workflows, dead-letter queue management, receipt reconciliation, and exactly-once processing semantics.
  • Experience integrating Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) or comparable activation and engagement platforms.
  • Experience with Kafka ecosystem tooling, event schema governance, and large-scale event-driven architectures.

Software Engineering Lead

Location: UK Mobile Worker

Salary: £61,500 - £78,800


Are you ready for your next career challenge?


Help shape a new supply chain management system solution, supporting sourcing and procurement, inventory, planning and order management.

Join the team as we develop a new solution, starting with a technical demonstrator and working towards a production-ready system. This is an opportunity to influence how the integrated solution is designed, deployed and supported from an early stage.

Role overview


Bring your technical expertise to a role where you can lead without stepping away from hands-on engineering. As Software Engineering Lead, you’ll provide technical leadership across the configuration, integration, development, deployment and support of ESCS software capabilities.


You’ll shape engineering patterns, tackle complex implementation challenges and mentor fellow engineers, keeping security, quality and operability at the heart of delivery.


Where you’ll make an impact:


  • Lead software configuration, integration and delivery within your capability team.
  • Turn architecture and requirements into practical, maintainable integrations and configured solutions.
  • Help the team deliver better software through engineering standards, thoughtful reviews, automation and mentoring.

What you’ll be doing:


  • Lead the configuration, extension, integration and deployment of cloud-hosted COTS (commercial-of-the-shelf) and SaaS (software-as-a-service) products, developing supporting software where required and maintaining the solution throughout its lifecycle.
  • Define and apply reusable engineering patterns for APIs, event-driven integration and data exchange between products and services.
  • Guide code, configuration and technical design reviews, and bring your problem-solving skills to complex defects.
  • Build security, automated testing, observability and operational readiness into the solution from the outset, including resilience and performance validation.
  • Lead improvements to CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, deployment automation and effective release practices.
  • Create clear technical design, configuration, interface and support documentation that helps colleagues understand and maintain the integrated solution.
  • Work closely with architecture, analysis, data, test and infrastructure colleagues to estimate work, guide implementation and identify technical risks early.
  • Share your expertise through practical mentoring and help build consistent engineering practices across teams.

What you’ll bring: required skills:


  • Practical JavaScript and TypeScript skills, predominantly for configuring and extending a web application, with transferable skills from equivalent technologies welcomed.
  • Python or equivalent programming and scripting skills for integration, automation and other supporting software functions.
  • The ability to develop and troubleshoot RESTful APIs, event-driven integrations and data exchanges connecting COTS, SaaS and other services.
  • Practical AWS and/or Azure experience, with familiarity with cloud architecture and the ability to transfer cloud concepts across platforms.
  • A security-first approach to coding and software assurance.
  • The ability to build quality into delivery through automated unit, component and integration testing, including resilience, performance and security checks.
  • Practical knowledge of CI/CD, Git workflows (or equivalent), deployment automation and DevSecOps practices in an agile delivery environment.
  • Skills in observability, logging, monitoring and diagnostics to support reliable software.
  • Practical experience of Infrastructure as Code, using Terraform or equivalent tools.
  • The ability to explain technical designs and interfaces clearly, lead constructive reviews and support other engineers through mentoring. A track record of delivering and supporting production software or integrated solutions in complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience leading technical implementation, guiding engineering decisions and championing code, configuration and integration quality.
  • Demonstratable experience in leading software engineering teams in an agile delivery environment.

Additional experience we’d value:


  • High-volume transactional or supply chain systems.
  • Web-application configuration and extension in a SaaS or COTS environment.
  • Containers and orchestration platforms.
  • AI-assisted development used within approved engineering and security controls.

What success looks like:


  • You lead delivery of integrated software that is secure, testable, observable and straightforward to maintain.
  • Your documentation makes configuration, design decisions and interfaces clear to the people who build and support the system.
  • You identify engineering risks early and work with colleagues to resolve them.
  • Your technical leadership, practical guidance and constructive reviews help other engineers strengthen their work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
